FILE: client/src/features/avatar/data/avatarWardrobe.js
================================================
export const categories = [
  { id: 'bases', label: 'Characters', icon: 'bi-person-hearts' },
  { id: 'dresses', label: 'Dresses', icon: 'bi-heart' },
  { id: 'tops', label: 'Tops', icon: 'bi-stars' },
  { id: 'skirts', label: 'Skirts', icon: 'bi-flower1' },
  { id: 'shorts', label: 'Shorts', icon: 'bi-grid' },
  { id: 'accessories', label: 'Accessories', icon: 'bi-gem' }
]

const bases = ['cat', 'dog', 'fox', 'elephant', 'dinosaur', 'rabbit', 'chick', 'duck']
export const lockedBases = ['rabbit', 'chick', 'duck']

export const wardrobe = {
  bases: bases.map(name => ({
    id: name,
    name: name[0].toUpperCase() + name.slice(1),
    image: `/avatars/bases/${name}.png`,
    comingSoon: lockedBases.includes(name)
  })),
  ...Object.fromEntries(
    ['dresses', 'tops', 'skirts', 'shorts', 'accessories'].map(category => [
      category,
      Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
        id: `${category}-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        name: `${category === 'accessories' ? 'Accessory'
          : category === 'shorts' ? 'Shorts'
          : category === 'skirts' ? 'Skirt'
          : category === 'dresses' ? 'Dress' : 'Top'} ${i + 1}`,
        image: `/avatars/${category}/${category}-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.png`
      }))
    ])
  )
}

export const defaultAppearance = () => ({
  baseId: 'cat',
  equipped: { dress: '', top: '', bottom: '', accessory: '' }
})

export function findItem(category, id) {
  return wardrobe[category]?.find(item => item.id === id) || null
}

export function categoryForBottom(id) {
  return id?.startsWith('skirts-') ? 'skirts'
    : id?.startsWith('shorts-') ? 'shorts' : null
}

// Normalize server data so old saved shoes never appear in the UI or API payload.
export function normalizeAppearance(saved) {
  const defaults = defaultAppearance()
  const base = wardrobe.bases.find(item => item.id === saved?.baseId && !item.comingSoon)
  const equipped = saved?.equipped || {}
  return {
    baseId: base?.id || defaults.baseId,
    equipped: {
      dress: equipped.dress || '',
      top: equipped.top || '',
      bottom: equipped.bottom || '',
      accessory: equipped.accessory || ''
    }
  }
}

FILE: client/src/features/avatar/services/avatarApi.js
================================================
import axios from 'axios'
const client = axios.create({ baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL, timeout: 10000 })
function config() {
  const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
  if (!token) throw new Error('Please log in again.')
  return { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
}
export async function getSavedAvatar() {
  const response = await client.get('/auth/me', config())
  return response.data.user.avatarAppearance
}
export async function saveAvatar(appearance) {
  const response = await client.patch('/auth/me/avatar', appearance, config())
  return response.data.user
}

FILE: client/src/features/avatar/views/AvatarStudioView.vue
================================================
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import AvatarPreview from '../components/AvatarPreview.vue'
import { categories, wardrobe, defaultAppearance, normalizeAppearance } from '../data/avatarWardrobe.js'
import { getSavedAvatar, saveAvatar } from '../services/avatarApi.js'
import '../../../styles/avatarStudio.css'

const router = useRouter()
const appearance = ref(defaultAppearance())
const category = ref('dresses')
const loading = ref(true)
const saving = ref(false)
const error = ref('')
const success = ref('')
const snapshot = ref('')
const currentItems = computed(() => wardrobe[category.value] || [])
const modified = computed(() => JSON.stringify(appearance.value) !== snapshot.value)
function fieldFor(c) {
  return ({ dresses: 'dress', tops: 'top', skirts: 'bottom', shorts: 'bottom', accessories: 'accessory' })[c]
}
function selected(id) {
  return category.value === 'bases'
    ? appearance.value.baseId === id
    : appearance.value.equipped[fieldFor(category.value)] === id
}
function choose(id) {
  const item = currentItems.value.find(x => x.id === id)
  if (item?.comingSoon) return
  success.value = ''
  if (category.value === 'bases') {
    appearance.value.baseId = id
  } else {
    const e = appearance.value.equipped
    if (category.value === 'dresses' && id) { e.top = ''; e.bottom = '' }
    if (['tops', 'skirts', 'shorts'].includes(category.value) && id) e.dress = ''
    e[fieldFor(category.value)] = id
  }
}
function clearOutfit() {
  appearance.value.equipped = { ...defaultAppearance().equipped }
  success.value = ''
}
async function load() {
  loading.value = true
  error.value = ''
  try {
    const saved = await getSavedAvatar()
    appearance.value = normalizeAppearance(saved)
    snapshot.value = JSON.stringify(appearance.value)
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e.response?.data?.message || 'Unable to load saved avatar.'
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
async function save() {
  if (saving.value || !modified.value) return
  saving.value = true
  error.value = ''
  success.value = ''
  try {
    const user = await saveAvatar(appearance.value)
    appearance.value = normalizeAppearance(user.avatarAppearance)
    snapshot.value = JSON.stringify(appearance.value)
    sessionStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(user))
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('carecircle:profile-updated'))
    success.value = 'Your cute new look is saved! â™¡'
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e.response?.data?.message || 'Unable to save your outfit.'
  } finally {
    saving.value = false
  }
}
onMounted(load)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="avatar-studio container-fluid pb-5">

FILE: client/src/features/calendar/calendarDays.js

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// Dates and events for the family Calendar. Pure functions, so they are easy to test.
// Everything is in Singapore time (no daylight saving, always +08:00).
// Weeks start on Monday, like the Contributions page.
import { taskRecipientId } from '../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js'
import { displayName } from '../recipients/recipientLabels.js'

const TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Singapore'
const OFFSET = '+08:00'
const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

// Any date -> "2026-10-27" (its day in Singapore)
export function dayKey(value) {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

// "2026-10-27" -> "2026-10"
export function monthOf(key) {
    return key.slice(0, 7)
}

// Noon keeps the day the same whatever the browser's own time zone is
function noon(key) {
    return new Date(`${key}T12:00:00${OFFSET}`)
}

export function addDays(key, days) {
    return dayKey(noon(key).getTime() + days * DAY)
}

// "2026-10" + 1 -> "2026-11"
export function shiftMonth(month, by) {
    const [year, mon] = month.split('-').map(Number)
    const total = year * 12 + (mon - 1) + by
    return `${Math.floor(total / 12)}-${String((total % 12) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

// 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday
function weekdayIndex(key) {
    return (noon(key).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
}

// Whole weeks covering the month: [{ key, day, inMonth }], 35 or 42 days
export function monthGrid(month) {
    const first = `${month}-01`
    const start = addDays(first, -weekdayIndex(first))
    const lastOfMonth = addDays(`${shiftMonth(month, 1)}-01`, -1)
    const end = addDays(lastOfMonth, 6 - weekdayIndex(lastOfMonth))

    const days = []
    for (let key = start; key <= end; key = addDays(key, 1)) {
        days.push({ key, day: Number(key.slice(8)), inMonth: monthOf(key) === month })
    }
    return days
}

// The first and last moment shown on the grid, for the API's from/to
export function gridRange(month) {
    const days = monthGrid(month)
    return {
        from: new Date(`${days[0].key}T00:00:00${OFFSET}`),
        to: new Date(`${days[days.length - 1].key}T23:59:59.999${OFFSET}`)
    }
}

export const WEEKDAYS = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']

// "October 2026"
export function monthLabel(month) {
    return noon(`${month}-01`).toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

// "Tuesday 27 October"
export function dayLabel(key) {
    return noon(key)
        .toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        .replace(',', '')
}

// "2:30pm"
export function timeLabel(value) {
    return new Date(value)
        .toLocaleTimeString('en-SG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        .replace(/\s/g, '')
        .toLowerCase()
}

// "2:00pm" -> "2pm", for the small chips on the grid
export function shortTime(label) {
    return label.replace(':00', '')
}

// ---- Events ----

// What the family needs to know at a glance. "missed": still open after it started.
export function taskState(task, now = Date.now()) {
    if (task.status === 'open' && new Date(task.startAt).getTime() <= now) return 'missed'
    return task.status
}

export const STATE_LABELS = {
    open: 'Needs someone',
    missed: 'Nobody took it',
    claimed: 'Claimed',
    in_progress: 'In progress',
    completed: 'Done',
    cancelled: 'Cancelled',
    appointment: 'Next appointment'
}

const firstName = (name) => String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || ''

// Tasks and "next appointment" notes -> one sorted list of calendar events.
// Cancelled tasks are left out: they won't happen.
export function buildEvents({ tasks = [], appointmentNotes = [], familyId, now = Date.now() }) {
    const events = []

    for (const task of tasks) {
        if (task.status === 'cancelled' || !task.startAt) continue
        const state = taskState(task, now)
        const claimer = typeof task.claimedBy === 'object' ? task.claimedBy?.name : ''
        events.push({
            id: `task-${task._id}`,
            kind: 'task',
            day: dayKey(task.startAt),
            at: new Date(task.startAt).getTime(),
            time: timeLabel(task.startAt),
            endTime: task.endAt ? timeLabel(task.endAt) : '',
            title: task.title,
            recipientId: taskRecipientId(task),
            recipientName: displayName(task.recipient) || 'Household',
            place: task.location?.name || '',
            state,
            who: claimer && ['claimed', 'in_progress', 'completed'].includes(state) ? firstName(claimer) : '',
            to: { name: 'task-detail', params: { familyId, taskId: task._id } }
        })
    }

    for (const note of appointmentNotes) {
        const next = note.consultation?.nextAppointment
        if (!next) continue
        const recipientId = note.recipient?._id ?? note.recipient ?? null
        const where = [note.consultation.doctorName, note.consultation.clinic].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
        events.push({
            id: `appointment-${note._id}`,
            kind: 'appointment',
            day: dayKey(next),
            at: new Date(next).getTime(),
            time: timeLabel(next),
            endTime: '',
            title: where ? `Follow-up with ${where}` : 'Follow-up appointment',
            recipientId,
            recipientName: displayName(note.recipient) || 'Care recipient',
            place: '',
            state: 'appointment',
            who: '',
            to: recipientId ? { name: 'recipient-log', params: { recipientId } } : null
        })
    }

    return events.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)
}

// Everyone, one recipient's events, or tasks for nobody in particular ("household")
export function filterEvents(events, recipient) {
    if (!recipient || recipient === 'all') return events
    if (recipient === 'household') return events.filter((event) => event.kind === 'task' && !event.recipientId)
    return events.filter((event) => event.recipientId === recipient)
}

// { "2026-10-27": [events...] }
export function groupByDay(events) {
    const days = {}
    for (const event of events) (days[event.day] ||= []).push(event)
    return days
}

FILE: client/src/features/calendar/__tests__/calendarDays.spec.js

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import {
    dayKey, shiftMonth, monthGrid, gridRange, monthLabel, dayLabel, timeLabel, shortTime,
    taskState, buildEvents, filterEvents, groupByDay
} from '../calendarDays.js'

describe('calendar dates (Singapore time, weeks start Monday)', () => {
    it('puts a late-night UTC time on the next Singapore day', () => {
        expect(dayKey('2026-10-27T17:30:00Z')).toBe('2026-10-28')
        expect(timeLabel('2026-10-27T06:00:00Z')).toBe('2:00pm')
        expect(shortTime('2:00pm')).toBe('2pm')
        expect(shortTime('2:30pm')).toBe('2:30pm')
    })

    it('moves between months across a year', () => {
        expect(shiftMonth('2026-12', 1)).toBe('2027-01')
        expect(shiftMonth('2026-01', -1)).toBe('2025-12')
    })

    it('builds whole Monday-to-Sunday weeks around the month', () => {
        const days = monthGrid('2026-10') // 1 Oct 2026 is a Thursday, 31 Oct a Saturday
        expect(days[0]).toEqual({ key: '2026-09-28', day: 28, inMonth: false })
        expect(days.at(-1)).toEqual({ key: '2026-11-01', day: 1, inMonth: false })
        expect(days).toHaveLength(35)
        expect(days.filter((d) => d.inMonth)).toHaveLength(31)
        expect(monthGrid('2026-03')).toHaveLength(42) // starts on a Sunday
    })

    it('gives the API the first and last moment on the grid', () => {
        const { from, to } = gridRange('2026-10')
        expect(from.toISOString()).toBe('2026-09-27T16:00:00.000Z')
        expect(to.toISOString()).toBe('2026-11-01T15:59:59.999Z')
    })

    it('labels months and days', () => {
        expect(monthLabel('2026-10')).toBe('October 2026')
        expect(dayLabel('2026-10-27')).toBe('Tuesday 27 October')
    })
})

describe('calendar events', () => {
    const now = new Date('2026-10-27T04:00:00Z').getTime() // noon in Singapore
    const task = (extra) => ({
        _id: 't1', title: 'Eye check', status: 'open', startAt: '2026-10-28T02:00:00Z',
        recipient: { _id: 'r1', name: 'Tan Ah Kow', nickname: 'Grandpa' }, ...extra
    })

    it('marks an open task that already started as missed', () => {
        expect(taskState(task({ startAt: '2026-10-27T01:00:00Z' }), now)).toBe('missed')
        expect(taskState(task(), now)).toBe('open')
        expect(taskState(task({ status: 'claimed', startAt: '2026-10-27T01:00:00Z' }), now)).toBe('claimed')
    })

    it('turns tasks and follow-up appointments into one sorted list', () => {
        const events = buildEvents({
            familyId: 'f1',
            now,
            tasks: [
                task({ _id: 'late', title: 'Physio', startAt: '2026-10-28T08:00:00Z', status: 'claimed', claimedBy: { name: 'Mia Tan' } }),
                task(),
                task({ _id: 'gone', status: 'cancelled' })
            ],
            appointmentNotes: [{
                _id: 'n1',
                recipient: { _id: 'r1', name: 'Tan Ah Kow', nickname: 'Grandpa' },
                consultation: { doctorName: 'Dr Lim', clinic: 'AMK Polyclinic', nextAppointment: '2026-10-28T05:00:00Z' }
            }]
        })

        expect(events.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['task-t1', 'appointment-n1', 'task-late'])
        expect(events[0]).toMatchObject({ day: '2026-10-28', time: '10:00am', recipientName: 'Grandpa', state: 'open' })
        expect(events[0].to).toEqual({ name: 'task-detail', params: { familyId: 'f1', taskId: 't1' } })
        expect(events[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'appointment', title: 'Follow-up with Dr Lim, AMK Polyclinic', state: 'appointment' })
        expect(events[1].to).toEqual({ name: 'recipient-log', params: { recipientId: 'r1' } })
        expect(events[2]).toMatchObject({ state: 'claimed', who: 'Mia' })
    })

    it('filters by person or household, and groups by day', () => {
        const events = buildEvents({
            familyId: 'f1',
            now,
            tasks: [task(), task({ _id: 'home', recipient: null, startAt: '2026-10-29T02:00:00Z' })]
        })
        expect(filterEvents(events, 'r1').map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['task-t1'])
        expect(filterEvents(events, 'household').map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['task-home'])
        expect(filterEvents(events, 'all')).toHaveLength(2)
        expect(Object.keys(groupByDay(events))).toEqual(['2026-10-28', '2026-10-29'])
        expect(events[1].recipientName).toBe('Household')
    })
})

FILE: client/src/features/calendar/views/CalendarView.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// Family Calendar: every task in the family (whoever claimed it) and every follow-up
// appointment written in a consultation note, on one month grid.
// Click a day to see its list; each item opens the task, or the note's care log.
// Double-click a day, or "+ Add task" in its list, to post a task on that day (like Apple Calendar).
// Google Calendar sync (E, Chaithra) sits beside it for people who want it on their phone.
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { useFamilyWorkspace } from '../../family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js'
import { useFamilyTasks } from '../../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
import { getLogs } from '../../logs/services/logsApi.js'
import { displayName } from '../../recipients/recipientLabels.js'
import FamilyEmptyState from '../../family/components/FamilyEmptyState.vue'
import NewTaskModal from '../../tasks/components/NewTaskModal.vue'
import GoogleCalendarSync from '../../my-tasks/components/GoogleCalendarSync.vue'
import {
    dayKey, monthOf, shiftMonth, monthGrid, gridRange, monthLabel, dayLabel, shortTime,
    buildEvents, filterEvents, groupByDay, WEEKDAYS, STATE_LABELS
} from '../calendarDays.js'

const MAX_CHIPS = 3

const { selectedFamily, selectedFamilyId, recipients, isLoading, errorMessage, loadFamilies } = useFamilyWorkspace()
const { tasks, isLoading: tasksLoading, errorMessage: tasksError, refetch } = useFamilyTasks()

// ---- Which month and day ----
const now = ref(Date.now())
const today = computed(() => dayKey(now.value))
const month = ref(monthOf(dayKey(Date.now())))
const selectedDay = ref(dayKey(Date.now()))

function showMonth(next) {
    month.value = next
    // Keep the list useful: today if it's in this month, otherwise the 1st
    selectedDay.value = monthOf(today.value) === next ? today.value : `${next}-01`
}
const goToday = () => showMonth(monthOf(today.value))

const days = computed(() => monthGrid(month.value))

// ---- Follow-up appointments from consultation notes (only for the shown weeks) ----
const appointmentsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: computed(() => [...queryKeys.logs(selectedFamilyId.value), 'appointments', month.value]),
    queryFn: () => {
        const { from, to } = gridRange(month.value)
        return getLogs(selectedFamilyId.value, { appointmentFrom: from.toISOString(), appointmentTo: to.toISOString(), limit: 50 })
    },
    enabled: computed(() => Boolean(selectedFamilyId.value))
})

// ---- Events ----
const recipientFilter = ref('all')
watch(selectedFamilyId, () => { recipientFilter.value = 'all' })

const events = computed(() => filterEvents(
    buildEvents({
        tasks: tasks.value,
        appointmentNotes: appointmentsQuery.data.value ?? [],
        familyId: selectedFamilyId.value,
        now: now.value
    }),
    recipientFilter.value
))
const byDay = computed(() => groupByDay(events.value))
const dayEvents = computed(() => byDay.value[selectedDay.value] ?? [])
const monthCount = computed(() => events.value.filter((event) => monthOf(event.day) === month.value).length)

function dayAria(day) {
    const count = byDay.value[day.key]?.length ?? 0
    return `${dayLabel(day.key)}, ${count ? `${count} ${count === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}` : 'nothing planned'}`
}

function stateText(event) {
    if (event.who && event.state === 'completed') return `Done by ${event.who}`
    if (event.who) return `${STATE_LABELS[event.state]} by ${event.who}`
    return STATE_LABELS[event.state]
}

// ---- New task on a day ----
// Tasks can't start in the past (the form's date picker stops at today too)
const isPast = (key) => key < today.value
const newTaskDay = ref('')

function addTaskOn(key) {
    if (isPast(key)) return
    selectedDay.value = key
    newTaskDay.value = key
}

// A new task jumps the calendar to its day
function onCreated(task) {
    const key = dayKey(task.startAt)
    month.value = monthOf(key)
    selectedDay.value = key
}

// ---- Keep it current ----
let clock
const onAssistantUpdate = () => refetch()
onMounted(() => {
    // Other pages may have cached the task list a while ago; others in the family may have added tasks since
    refetch()
    clock = setInterval(() => { now.value = Date.now() }, 60 * 1000)
    window.addEventListener('carecircle:task-updated', onAssistantUpdate)
})
onUnmounted(() => {
    clearInterval(clock)
    window.removeEventListener('carecircle:task-updated', onAssistantUpdate)
})

const familyName = computed(() => selectedFamily.value?.name || 'Your family')
const legend = ['open', 'missed', 'claimed', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'appointment']
</script>

<template>
    <div class="calendar-page">
        <header class="calendar-header">
            <div>
                <div class="calendar-eyebrow">{{ familyName }}</div>
                <h1>Calendar</h1>
                <p>Every family task and follow-up appointment, in one place.</p>
            </div>
        </header>

        <FamilyEmptyState
            v-if="isLoading || errorMessage || !selectedFamily"
            :loading="isLoading"
            :error="errorMessage"
            @retry="loadFamilies"
        />

        <template v-else>
            <div class="calendar-toolbar">
                <div class="month-nav">
                    <button type="button" class="icon-button" aria-label="Previous month" @click="showMonth(shiftMonth(month, -1))">
                        <i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                    <h2 aria-live="polite" data-testid="calendar-month">{{ monthLabel(month) }}</h2>
                    <button type="button" class="icon-button" aria-label="Next month" @click="showMonth(shiftMonth(month, 1))">
                        <i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" class="today-button" :disabled="month === monthOf(today) && selectedDay === today" @click="goToday">
                        Today
                    </button>
                </div>

                <label class="recipient-filter">
                    <span>Show</span>
                    <select v-model="recipientFilter" data-testid="calendar-filter">
                        <option value="all">Everyone</option>
                        <option v-for="recipient in recipients" :key="recipient._id" :value="recipient._id">
                            {{ displayName(recipient) }}
                        </option>
                        <option value="household">Household tasks</option>
                    </select>
                </label>
            </div>

            <div v-if="tasksError" class="calendar-error" role="alert">
                {{ tasksError }}
                <button type="button" @click="refetch()">Try again</button>
            </div>

            <div class="calendar-layout">
                <section class="calendar-card month-card" :aria-label="`${monthLabel(month)}, ${monthCount} items`">
                    <div class="weekday-row" aria-hidden="true">
                        <span v-for="weekday in WEEKDAYS" :key="weekday">{{ weekday }}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="month-grid" :class="{ 'is-loading': tasksLoading }">
                        <button
                            v-for="day in days"
                            :key="day.key"
                            type="button"
                            class="day-cell"
                            :class="{
                                'is-outside': !day.inMonth,
                                'is-today': day.key === today,
                                'is-selected': day.key === selectedDay
                            }"
                            :aria-pressed="day.key === selectedDay"
                            :aria-label="dayAria(day)"
                            :data-testid="`calendar-day-${day.key}`"
                            @click="selectedDay = day.key"
                            @dblclick="addTaskOn(day.key)"
                        >
                            <span class="day-number">{{ day.day }}</span>

                            <!-- Wide screens: the first few items -->
                            <span class="day-chips">
                                <span
                                    v-for="event in (byDay[day.key] ?? []).slice(0, MAX_CHIPS)"
                                    :key="event.id"
                                    class="chip"
                                    :class="`state-${event.state}`"
                                >
                                    <span class="chip-time">{{ shortTime(event.time) }}</span>
                                    <span class="chip-title">{{ event.title }}</span>
                                </span>
                                <span v-if="(byDay[day.key]?.length ?? 0) > MAX_CHIPS" class="chip-more">
                                    +{{ byDay[day.key].length - MAX_CHIPS }} more
                                </span>
                            </span>

                            <!-- Phones: one dot per item -->
                            <span v-if="byDay[day.key]?.length" class="day-dots" aria-hidden="true">
                                <span v-for="event in byDay[day.key].slice(0, 4)" :key="event.id" class="dot" :class="`state-${event.state}`"></span>
                            </span>
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <p class="calendar-hint">Double-click a day to add a task on it.</p>

                    <ul class="legend" aria-label="Colour key">
                        <li v-for="state in legend" :key="state">

FILE: client/src/features/contributions/analytics.js
================================================
const DAY = 86400000
const idOf = person => String(person?._id || person?.id || person || '')
// Singapore calendar days keep periods and streaks consistent across devices.
export const dayKey = date => new Date(new Date(date).getTime() + 8 * 3600000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
const dayNumber = date => Date.parse(dayKey(date)) / DAY

export function contributionPoints(task) {
  const delay = new Date(task.claimedAt) - new Date(task.createdAt)
  return 1 + Number(task.category === 'appointment' && task.needsTransit === true)
    + Number(Boolean(task.claimedAt && task.createdAt) && delay >= 0 && delay <= 3600000)
}

export function analyzeContributions(tasks, members, familyId, period = 'month', now = new Date()) {
  const today = dayNumber(now)
  const start = period === 'week' ? today - ((new Date(today * DAY).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7)
    : period === 'month' ? Date.parse(`${dayKey(now).slice(0, 7)}-01`) / DAY : -Infinity
  const completed = tasks.filter(task => idOf(task.family) === String(familyId)
    && task.status === 'completed' && task.completedAt && task.claimedBy
    && Number.isFinite(new Date(task.completedAt).getTime()) && new Date(task.completedAt) <= now)
  const recent = completed.filter(task => dayNumber(task.completedAt) >= start)
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt) - new Date(a.completedAt))
  const people = new Map(members.filter(m => m.user).map(m => {
    const id = idOf(m.user)
    return [id, { id, person: m.user, count: 0, points: 0, appointments: 0, quick: 0, evenings: 0, streak: 0 }]
  }))
  for (const task of recent) {
    const id = idOf(task.claimedBy)
    if (!people.has(id)) people.set(id, { id, person: typeof task.claimedBy === 'object' ? task.claimedBy : { name: 'Former member' }, count: 0, points: 0, appointments: 0, quick: 0, evenings: 0, streak: 0 })
    const row = people.get(id)
    row.count++
    row.points += contributionPoints(task)
    row.appointments += Number(task.category === 'appointment')
    const delay = new Date(task.claimedAt) - new Date(task.createdAt)
    row.quick += Number(Boolean(task.claimedAt && task.createdAt) && delay >= 0 && delay <= 3600000)
    row.evenings += Number(new Date(new Date(task.completedAt).getTime() + 8 * 3600000).getUTCHours() >= 18)
  }
  for (const row of people.values()) {
    const days = new Set(completed.filter(t => idOf(t.claimedBy) === row.id).map(t => dayNumber(t.completedAt)))
    let cursor = days.has(today) ? today : today - 1
    while (days.has(cursor)) { row.streak++; cursor-- }
    row.share = recent.length ? Math.round(row.count / recent.length * 100) : 0
    row.badges = [row.appointments >= 3 && 'Appointment hero', row.quick >= 3 && 'Quick to help', row.evenings >= 5 && 'Night owl'].filter(Boolean)
  }
  const rows = [...people.values()].sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points || b.count - a.count || (a.person.name || '').localeCompare(b.person.name || '') || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
  rows.forEach((row, i) => { row.rank = row.count > 0 ? i + 1 : null })
  return { rows, recent, total: recent.length, points: rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.points, 0), helpers: rows.filter(row => row.count > 0).length }
}

FILE: client/src/features/contributions/__tests__/ContributionsView.spec.js
================================================
import { it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router'
import { QueryClient, VueQueryPlugin } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import ContributionsView from '../ContributionsView.vue'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'

it('links contributor avatars, gives ties distinct ranks, and orders a two-person podium first then second', async () => {
  const active = useActiveFamily()
  active.families.value = [{ id: 'one', name: 'Family' }]
  active.selectFamily('one')
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: Infinity, retry: false } } })
  const people = ['Alex', 'Jasmine', 'May', 'Mia'].map((name, index) => ({ _id: `user-${index}`, name }))
  const tasks = people.slice(0, 3).map((person, index) => ({ _id: `task-${index}`, family: 'one', title: 'Help out', status: 'completed', claimedBy: person, completedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000).toISOString() }))
  client.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks('one'), tasks)
  client.setQueryData(['contribution-members', 'one'], people.map(user => ({ user })))
  const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [
    { path: '/contributions', component: ContributionsView },
    { path: '/profile/:userId', component: { template: '<div />' } },
    { path: '/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId', name: 'task-detail', component: { template: '<div />' } },
  ] })
  await router.push('/contributions')
  const wrapper = mount(ContributionsView, { global: {
    plugins: [router, [VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient: client }]],
    provide: { [Symbol.for('carecircle:family-workspace')]: { ...active, user: ref({ id: 'me' }), loadFamilies: vi.fn() } },
  } })
  try {
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.findAll('.contributions-step').map(node => node.text())).toEqual(['1', '2', '3'])
    expect(wrapper.findAll('.contributions-rank').map(node => node.text())).toEqual(['1', '2', '3', 'â€”'])
    expect(wrapper.get('.contributions-winner a').attributes('href')).toBe('/profile/user-0')
    expect(wrapper.get('.contributions-ranking a').attributes('href')).toBe('/profile/user-0')
    expect(wrapper.get('.contributions-completion a').attributes('href')).toMatch(/^\/profile\//)
    expect(wrapper.findAll('a a')).toHaveLength(0)
    client.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks('one'), tasks.slice(0, 2))
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.get('.contributions-podium').classes()).toContain('contributions-podium--compact')
    expect(wrapper.findAll('.contributions-winner strong').map(node => node.text())).toEqual(['Alex', 'Jasmine'])
  } finally { wrapper.unmount(); client.clear(); active.clearFamilies() }
})

# Family Dashboard
Owner: SangYoon (B)

`views/FamilyHomeView.vue` imports the individual panels in `components/`. Data and actions live in `composables/`; API calls live in `services/`. The authenticated route is `/home`; fictional-data preview is `/preview/home`.

import { beforeEach, afterEach, describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { VueQueryPlugin } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import FamilyHomeView from '../views/FamilyHomeView.vue'
import TodayTasks from '../components/TodayTasks.vue'
import MobileHomeNavigation from '../components/MobileHomeNavigation.vue'
import MobileTodayTasks from '../components/MobileTodayTasks.vue'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { queryClient, queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'

let wrapper, router, active, tasks
const findButton = (component, label) => component.findAll('button').find(button => button.text().trim() === label)
beforeEach(async () => {
  sessionStorage.setItem('token', 'test-only')
  sessionStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({ id: 'alex', name: 'Alex Tan' }))
  active = useActiveFamily()
  active.clearFamilies()
  active.families.value = [{ id: 'one', name: 'Tan family', members: [{ userId: 'alex', role: 'admin' }] }]
  active.selectFamily('one')
  const startAt = new Date().toISOString()
  tasks = [
    { _id: 'today', family: 'one', title: 'Buy groceries', startAt, status: 'open' },
    { _id: 'future', family: 'one', title: 'Future appointment', startAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString(), status: 'open' },
    { _id: 'done', family: 'one', title: 'Completed walk', startAt, status: 'completed', claimedBy: { _id: 'alex', name: 'Alex Tan' } },
  ]
  queryClient.clear()
  queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks('one'), tasks)
  vi.spyOn(http, 'get').mockImplementation(async path => {
    if (path.endsWith('/transit')) return { data: { transitSessions: [] } }
    if (path.endsWith('/notifications')) return { data: { notifications: [] } }
    if (path.endsWith('/tasks')) return { data: { tasks } }
    throw new Error(`Unexpected request: ${path}`)
  })
  const workspace = {
    ...active, user: ref({ id: 'alex', name: 'Alex Tan' }), isPreview: false,
    isAdmin: computed(() => true), recipients: ref([]), recipientsLoading: ref(false), recipientsError: ref(''),
    loadRecipients: async () => {}, homePath: '/home', settingsPath: '/settings',
  }
  router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [
    { path: '/home', name: 'home', component: FamilyHomeView },
    { path: '/family-tasks', redirect: '/home' },
    { path: '/my-tasks', name: 'my-tasks', component: { template: '<p>My tasks</p>' } },
    { path: '/settings', component: { template: '<p>Settings</p>' } },
    { path: '/contributions', component: { template: '<p>Contributions</p>' } },
    { path: '/tasks/new', name: 'task-new', component: { template: '<p>New task</p>' } },
    { path: '/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId', name: 'task-detail', component: { template: '<p>Task detail</p>' } },
  ] })
  await router.push('/home')
  wrapper = mount({ template: '<RouterView />' }, { global: {
    plugins: [router, [VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient }]],
    provide: { [Symbol.for('carecircle:family-workspace')]: workspace },
  } })
  await flushPromises()
})
afterEach(() => { wrapper?.unmount(); queryClient.clear() })

describe('Family home task board and navigation', () => {
  it('separates expired unclaimed tasks from tasks that still need someone', async () => {
    const past = new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString()
    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks('one'), [...tasks,
      { _id: 'expired', family: 'one', title: 'Missed appointment', status: 'open', startAt: past },
      { _id: 'already-claimed', family: 'one', title: 'Claimed appointment', status: 'claimed', startAt: past, claimedBy: { _id: 'alex', name: 'Alex' } },
      { _id: 'cancelled', family: 'one', title: 'Cancelled appointment', status: 'cancelled', startAt: past },
    ])
    await flushPromises()
    const board = wrapper.getComponent(TodayTasks)
    await findButton(board, 'Needs someone').trigger('click')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Future appointment')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Missed appointment')
    await findButton(board, 'Overdue').trigger('click')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Missed appointment')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Overdue Â· Claiming closed')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Future appointment')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Claimed appointment')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Cancelled appointment')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Completed walk')
  })

  it('keeps all task filters and claiming inside the existing home dashboard', async () => {
    const board = wrapper.getComponent(TodayTasks)
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Today across the family')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Buy groceries')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Future appointment')
    await findButton(board, 'Needs someone').trigger('click')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Future appointment')
    expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Completed walk')
    vi.spyOn(http, 'post').mockImplementation(async path => {
      expect(path).toBe('/families/one/tasks/future/claim')
      const saved = { ...tasks[1], status: 'claimed', claimedBy: { _id: 'alex', name: 'Alex Tan' } }
      tasks[1] = saved
      return { data: { task: saved } }
    })
    await board.findAll('article').find(row => row.text().includes('Future appointment')).get('button').trigger('click')
    await flushPromises()
    // The claim button shows a check for ~400ms before the row leaves the filtered list
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(board.text()).not.toContain('Future appointment'))
    await findButton(board, 'Claimed').trigger('click')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Future appointment')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Alex Tan')
    await findButton(board, 'Completed').trigger('click')
    expect(board.text()).toContain('Completed walk')
    expect(router.currentRoute.value.path).toBe('/home')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Recent updates')
  })

  it('opens mobile tasks within Home and supports navigating away and back', async () => {
    wrapper.getComponent(MobileHomeNavigation).vm.$emit('select', 'tasks')
    await flushPromises()
    expect(router.currentRoute.value.path).toBe('/home')
    const lists = wrapper.findAllComponents(MobileTodayTasks)
    expect(lists.some(list => list.text().includes('Future appointment'))).toBe(true)
    await router.push('/my-tasks')
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toBe('My tasks')
    await router.push('/home')
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Today across the family')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Recent updates')
  })
})

FILE: client/src/features/family/__tests__/MobileTodayTasks.spec.js
================================================
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import MobileTodayTasks from '../components/MobileTodayTasks.vue'

const openTask = { _id: 'task-one', title: 'Collect medicine', startAt: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(), status: 'open', recipient: { name: 'Grandpa' } }
const claimButton = wrapper => wrapper.findAll('button').find(button => button.text() === 'Iâ€™ll take it')

describe('Mobile today task list with its real child cards', () => {
  it('closes claiming automatically when the scheduled start time arrives', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const startAt = new Date(Date.now() + 1000).toISOString()
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { tasks: [{ ...openTask, startAt }] } })
    expect(claimButton(wrapper)).toBeDefined()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000)
    expect(claimButton(wrapper)).toBeUndefined()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Overdue Â· Claiming closed')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('claim')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('does not offer claiming for a task already overdue', () => {
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { tasks: [{ ...openTask, startAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000).toISOString() }] } })
    expect(claimButton(wrapper)).toBeUndefined()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Overdue Â· Claiming closed')
  })
  it('passes a claim from a child card to the page with the correct task', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { tasks: [openTask] } })
    expect(wrapper.get('article').text()).toContain('Collect medicine')
    await claimButton(wrapper).trigger('click')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('claim')[0]).toEqual([openTask])
  })

  it('prevents a second claim while another task is being saved', () => {
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { tasks: [openTask], busyId: 'another-task' } })
    expect(claimButton(wrapper).element.disabled).toBe(true)
  })

  it('replaces the claim action with the saved claimer and status', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { tasks: [openTask] } })
    await wrapper.setProps({ tasks: [{ ...openTask, status: 'claimed', claimedBy: { name: 'Alex Tan' } }] })
    expect(claimButton(wrapper)).toBeUndefined()
    expect(wrapper.get('article').text()).toContain('Alex Tan')
    expect(wrapper.get('article').text()).toContain('Claimed')
  })

  it('provides retry after a failed load and shows tasks after recovery', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(MobileTodayTasks, { props: { error: 'Server unavailable' } })
    await wrapper.findAll('button').find(button => button.text() === 'Try again').trigger('click')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('retry')).toHaveLength(1)
    await wrapper.setProps({ error: '', tasks: [openTask] })
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Server unavailable')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Collect medicine')
  })
})

FILE: client/src/features/family/__tests__/singapore-dates.spec.js
================================================
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { singaporeDay } from '../composables/useFamilyDashboard.js'
import { ageLabel, dateKey } from '../../recipients/recipientLabels.js'

describe('Singapore dates used by the family dashboard', () => {
  it.each([
    ['2026-10-20T15:59:59Z', '2026-10-20'],
    ['2026-10-20T16:00:00Z', '2026-10-21'],
    ['2026-12-31T16:00:00Z', '2027-01-01'],
  ])('groups %s under %s, regardless of the computer timezone', (input, day) => {
    expect(singaporeDay(input)).toBe(day)
    expect(dateKey(input)).toBe(day)
  })

  it('changes a babyâ€™s age on the Singapore birthday boundary', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-20T16:30:00Z'))
    expect(ageLabel('2026-09-20T16:00:00Z')).toBe('1 month')
    expect(ageLabel('2024-10-20T16:00:00Z')).toBe('2')
  })

  it('does not show an age for a missing or future birth date', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-20T16:30:00Z'))
    expect(ageLabel(null)).toBe('')
    expect(ageLabel('2026-10-22T00:00:00Z')).toBe('')
  })
})

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'
import ProfileAvatar from '../../../components/common/ProfileAvatar.vue'
import TaskStatusBadge from '../../tasks/components/TaskStatusBadge.vue'
import RecurringTaskBadge from '../../tasks/components/RecurringTaskBadge.vue'
import { useTaskOverdue } from '../../tasks/composables/useTaskOverdue.js'
const props = defineProps({
  task: { type: Object, required: true },
  busyId: { type: String, default: '' },
  showDate: Boolean,
  allowClaim: { type: Boolean, default: true },
})
defineEmits(['claim'])
const overdue = useTaskOverdue(() => props.task)
const recipient = computed(() =>
  typeof props.task.recipient === 'object' && props.task.recipient
    ? props.task.recipient
    : { name: 'Household', avatar: '🏡' },
)
const time = computed(() =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', {
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: true,
    timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore',
  })
    .format(new Date(props.task.startAt))
    .replace(/\s+/g, ''),
)
const date = computed(() =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore',
  }).format(new Date(props.task.startAt)),
)
const context = computed(() =>
  props.task.status === 'open'
    ? 'nobody yet'
    : props.task.status === 'in_progress'
      ? props.task.location?.name || props.task.claimedBy?.name || ''
      : props.task.claimedBy?.name || props.task.location?.name || '',
)
</script>

<template>
  <article
    class="care-mobile-task"
    :class="{ 'care-mobile-task--open': task.status === 'open' }"
  >
    <div class="care-mobile-task-row">
      <ProfileAvatar :person="recipient" recipient size="small" />
      <div class="care-mobile-task-copy">
        <h3>{{ task.title }}</h3>
        <RecurringTaskBadge :task="task" />
        <p>
          <template v-if="showDate">{{ date }} ·</template>
          {{ time }}
          <template v-if="context">· {{ context }}</template>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div v-if="task.status !== 'open'" class="care-mobile-task-status">
        <ProfileAvatar
          v-if="task.claimedBy"
          :person="task.claimedBy"
          size="tiny"
        />
        <TaskStatusBadge
          :status="task.status"
          :needs-transit="task.needsTransit"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="task.status === 'open' && overdue" class="care-muted care-small">Overdue · Claiming closed</p>
    <button
      v-else-if="task.status === 'open' && allowClaim"
      class="care-mobile-claim"
      :disabled="Boolean(busyId)"
      @click="$emit('claim', task)"
    >
      {{ busyId === task._id ? 'Claiming…' : 'I’ll take it' }}
    </button>
  </article>
</template>

FILE: client/src/features/family/components/RecipientOverview.vue
================================================
<script setup>
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import RecipientCard from './RecipientCard.vue'
const props = defineProps({
  recipients: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  loading: Boolean,
  error: { type: String, default: '' },
  tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  tasksAvailable: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  preview: Boolean,
})
defineEmits(['retry', 'open', 'show-open-tasks'])
const id = (value) =>
  typeof value === 'object' && value ? value._id || value.id : value
const page = ref(1)
const pageSize = 3
const pageCount = computed(() => Math.ceil(props.recipients.length / pageSize))
const visibleRecipients = computed(() => props.recipients.slice((page.value - 1) * pageSize, page.value * pageSize))
watch(() => props.recipients.map(id).join(','), () => { page.value = 1 })
function recipientTasks(tasks, recipient) {
  return tasks
    .filter(
      (task) =>
        id(task.recipient) === id(recipient) &&
        !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(task.status),
    )
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.startAt) - new Date(b.startAt))
}
function nextTask(tasks, recipient) {
  const task = recipientTasks(tasks, recipient).find(
    (entry) => entry.status === 'open' || new Date(entry.startAt) >= new Date(),
  )
  if (!task) return ''
  const date = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore',
  }).format(new Date(task.startAt))
  return `${task.title}, ${date}`
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="care-recipient-overview" aria-labelledby="recipients-heading">
    <h2 id="recipients-heading" class="care-section-title">
      Who are we caring for?
    </h2>
    <div v-if="loading" class="care-inline-state" role="status">
      Loading care recipientsâ€¦
    </div>
    <div v-else-if="error" class="care-inline-state" role="alert">
      {{ error }}
      <button class="care-text-button" @click="$emit('retry')">
        Try again
      </button>
    </div>
    <div v-else-if="!recipients.length" class="care-inline-state">
      No care recipients yet. Your familyâ€™s care profiles will appear here.
      <RouterLink v-if="!preview" to="/recipients/new" class="care-text-button">
        Add care recipient
      </RouterLink>
    </div>
    <div v-else>
    <div class="care-recipient-grid">
      <RecipientCard
        v-for="recipient in visibleRecipients"
        :key="recipient._id || recipient.id"
        :recipient="recipient"
        :tasks-available="tasksAvailable"
        :next-task="
          tasksAvailable ? nextTask(tasks, recipient) : 'Tasks unavailable'
        "
        :open-count="
          recipientTasks(tasks, recipient).filter(
            (task) => task.status === 'open',
          ).length
        "
        @open="$emit('open', $event)"
        @show-open-tasks="$emit('show-open-tasks', $event)"
      />
    </div>
    <nav v-if="pageCount > 1" class="care-recipient-pagination" aria-label="Care recipient pages">
      <span class="care-recipient-page-summary" role="status">{{ (page - 1) * pageSize + 1 }}â€“{{ Math.min(page * pageSize, recipients.length) }} of {{ recipients.length }}</span>
      <button type="button" :disabled="page === 1" aria-label="Previous recipients page" @click="page--"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
      <button v-for="number in pageCount" :key="number" type="button" :class="{ selected: page === number }" :aria-label="`Recipients page ${number}`" :aria-current="page === number ? 'page' : undefined" @click="page = number">{{ number }}</button>
      <button type="button" :disabled="page === pageCount" aria-label="Next recipients page" @click="page++"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
    </nav>
    </div>
  </section>
</template>

FILE: client/src/features/family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js
================================================
import { computed, inject, provide, ref } from 'vue'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { useRecipients } from '../../../composables/useRecipients.js'
import { previewState, previewUser } from '../data/previewFamily.js'

// Keep the injection key stable when Vite replaces this module during editing.
const WORKSPACE = Symbol.for('carecircle:family-workspace')

export function provideFamilyWorkspace(isPreview) {
  const active = useActiveFamily()
  // Keep C's shared query cache, including create/edit/archive invalidations.
  // An isolated preview never starts authenticated queries.
  const recipientQuery = useRecipients({ enabled: !isPreview })
  const recipientsLoading = isPreview ? ref(false) : recipientQuery.isLoading
  const recipientsError = isPreview ? ref('') : recipientQuery.errorMessage
  const user = isPreview
    ? computed(() => ({
        ...previewUser,
        ...previewState.members.find(
          (member) => member.user._id === previewUser.id,
        )?.user,
        id: previewUser.id,
      }))
    : ref({})
  function refreshUser() {
    if (isPreview) return
    try {
      user.value = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user') || '{}')
    } catch {
      user.value = {}
    }
  }
  refreshUser()
  const families = isPreview
    ? computed(() => [
        {
          ...previewState.family,
          members: previewState.members.map((member) => ({
            userId: member.user._id,
            role: member.role,
          })),
        },
      ])
    : active.families
  const selectedFamilyId = isPreview
    ? computed(() => previewState.family.id)
    : active.selectedFamilyId
  const selectedFamily = isPreview
    ? computed(() => families.value[0])
    : active.selectedFamily
  const recipients = isPreview
    ? computed(() => previewState.recipients)
    : recipientQuery.recipients
  const isAdmin = computed(
    () =>
      selectedFamily.value?.members?.find(
        (member) => member.userId === user.value.id,
      )?.role === 'admin',
  )
  async function loadRecipients() {
    if (isPreview) return
    await recipientQuery.refresh()
  }
  const workspace = {
    isPreview,
    user,
    refreshUser,
    families,
    selectedFamily,
    selectedFamilyId,
    isAdmin,
    recipients,
    recipientsLoading,
    recipientsError,
    loadRecipients,
    isLoading: isPreview ? ref(false) : active.isLoading,
    errorMessage: isPreview ? ref('') : active.errorMessage,
    loadFamilies: isPreview ? async () => {} : active.loadFamilies,
    selectFamily: isPreview ? () => {} : active.selectFamily,
    homePath: isPreview ? '/preview/home' : '/home',
    settingsPath: isPreview ? '/preview/settings' : '/settings',
  }
  provide(WORKSPACE, workspace)
  return workspace
}

export function useFamilyWorkspace() {
  const workspace = inject(WORKSPACE)
  if (!workspace)
    throw new Error('Family pages must be rendered inside AppLayout.')
  return workspace
}

FILE: client/src/features/family/services/dashboardApi.js
================================================
// B composes existing C/D/E/F endpoints; it does not own their schemas.
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { askRecurringClaim } from '../../tasks/composables/recurringClaimDialog.js'

export function authConfig(extra = {}) {
  const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
  if (!token) throw new Error('Please log in first.')
  return {
    ...extra,
    timeout: 10000,
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  }
}

export function apiError(error, feature = 'This feature') {
  const status = error.response?.status
  if (status === 401) return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
  if (
    status === 404 &&
    (error.response?.data?.error || error.response?.data?.message)
  ) {
    return error.response.data.error || error.response.data.message
  }
  if (status === 404 || status === 501)
    return `${feature} is not connected yet.`
  return (
    error.response?.data?.error ||
    error.response?.data?.message ||
    error.message ||
    'Please try again.'
  )
}

export async function listRecipients(familyId) {
  const { data } = await http.get(
    `/families/${familyId}/recipients`,
    authConfig(),
  )
  if (!Array.isArray(data.recipients))
    throw new Error('Invalid recipient data from server.')
  return data.recipients
}

export async function listDashboardTasks(familyId, filters) {
  const { data } = await http.get(
    `/families/${familyId}/tasks`,
    authConfig({ params: filters }),
  )
  if (!Array.isArray(data.tasks))
    throw new Error('Invalid task data from server.')
  return data.tasks
}

export async function claimDashboardTask(familyId, taskId, task) {
  const scope = task?.recurringSeries ? await askRecurringClaim(task) : undefined
  if (scope === null) return null
  const { data } = await http.post(
    `/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}/claim`,
    scope ? { scope } : {},
    authConfig(),
  )
  return data.task
}

export async function createDashboardTask(familyId, task) {
  const { data } = await http.post(
    `/families/${familyId}/tasks`,
    task,
    authConfig(),
  )
  return data.task
}

FILE: client/src/features/family/services/familyApi.js
================================================

import axios from 'axios'

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL

// Create a family
export async function createFamily(name) {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    const response = await axios.post(
        `${API_URL}/families`,
        { name },
        {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        }
        }
    )

    return response.data
}

// Get all families belonging to the user
export async function getMyFamilies() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    const response = await axios.get(
        `${API_URL}/families/mine`,
        {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        }
        }
    )

    return response.data.families
}

// Return friendly error messages
export function getFamilyErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    }

    return (
        error.response?.data?.message ||
        error.message ||
        'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
    )
}


export async function joinFamily(inviteCode) {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    const response = await axios.post(
        `${API_URL}/families/join`,
        { inviteCode },
        {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        }
        }
    )

    return response.data
}

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// The small green confirmation at the top of the screen, shared by every care log action.
// A page renders <SavedToast /> once; anything can then call showSaved('...').
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { displayName } from '../recipients/recipientLabels.js'

export const savedToast = ref({ id: 0, text: '' })

export function showSaved(text) {
    savedToast.value = { id: savedToast.value.id + 1, text }
}

export function hideSaved() {
    savedToast.value = { ...savedToast.value, text: '' }
}

// "Grandpa's log", or "the care log" when the note has no recipient name
export function logName(log) {
    const name = displayName(log?.recipient)
    return name ? `${name}'s log` : 'the care log'
}

FILE: client/src/features/logs/useLogActions.js
================================================
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// Edit, delete and translate for a list of care log notes.
// Shared by the recipient's Log page and "Notes from this visit" on the task pages.
//
//   const actions = useLogActions(familyId, logs)
//   <LogList :logs="logs" :can-change="actions.canChange" :translate="actions.translate" ... />
import { computed, ref, unref } from 'vue'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../services/queryClient.js'
import { updateLog, deleteLog, translateLog, getLogErrorMessage, TRANSLATION_NOT_CONNECTED } from './services/logsApi.js'
import { showSaved, logName } from './savedToast.js'

function readUser() {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user') || '{}')
    } catch {
        return {}
    }
}

// familyId: a ref or getter; logs: the ref holding the notes on screen
export function useLogActions(familyId, logs) {
    const currentFamilyId = () => (typeof familyId === 'function' ? familyId() : unref(familyId))
    const user = readUser()
    const { families } = useActiveFamily()

    const isAdmin = computed(() => {
        const family = families.value.find((f) => f.id === currentFamilyId())
        return family?.members?.some((m) => m.userId === user.id && m.role === 'admin') ?? false
    })

    function canChange(log) {
        return log.author?._id === user.id || isAdmin.value
    }

    // Other pages (e.g. the recipient Overview) cache this family's notes. Mark them
    // out of date after any change so they show it next time.
    const queryClient = useQueryClient()
    function invalidateCachedLogs() {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.logs(currentFamilyId()) })
    }

    async function translate(log, lang) {
        try {
            return await translateLog(currentFamilyId(), log._id, lang)
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error(error.message === TRANSLATION_NOT_CONNECTED ? error.message : getLogErrorMessage(error))
        }
    }

    const editingId = ref('')
    const isSavingEdit = ref(false)
    const editError = ref('')
    const actionError = ref('')

    function startEdit(log) {
        editingId.value = log._id
        editError.value = ''
    }

    function cancelEdit() {
        editingId.value = ''
    }

    async function saveEdit(log, changes) {
        isSavingEdit.value = true
        editError.value = ''
        try {
            const updated = await updateLog(currentFamilyId(), log._id, changes)
            logs.value = logs.value.map((item) => (item._id === updated._id ? updated : item))
            invalidateCachedLogs()
            editingId.value = ''
            showSaved(`Note updated in ${logName(updated)}`)
        } catch (error) {
            editError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
        } finally {
            isSavingEdit.value = false
        }
    }

    async function removeLog(log) {
        if (!window.confirm('Delete this note? This cannot be undone.')) return

        actionError.value = ''
        try {
            await deleteLog(currentFamilyId(), log._id)
            logs.value = logs.value.filter((item) => item._id !== log._id)
            invalidateCachedLogs()
            showSaved(`Note deleted from ${logName(log)}`)
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.response?.status === 404) {
                logs.value = logs.value.filter((item) => item._id !== log._id)
            }
            actionError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
        }
    }

    return {
        canChange,
        translate,
        invalidateCachedLogs,
        editingId,
        isSavingEdit,
        editError,
        actionError,
        startEdit,
        cancelEdit,
        saveEdit,
        removeLog
    }
}

FILE: client/src/features/logs/components/ConsultationNoteModal.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// "Add consultation note" on the Task detail and Transit pages.
// The note is written without leaving the page (so a live trip keeps sharing its
// location), saved to the recipient's care log and linked to the task.
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import CareModal from '../../../components/common/CareModal.vue'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
import LogForm from './LogForm.vue'
import { createLog, getLogErrorMessage } from '../services/logsApi.js'
import { showSaved, logName } from '../savedToast.js'

const props = defineProps({
    familyId: { type: String, required: true },
    recipientId: { type: String, required: true },
    recipientName: { type: String, default: '' },
    taskId: { type: String, required: true }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['close', 'saved'])

const queryClient = useQueryClient()
const isSaving = ref(false)
const saveError = ref('')

async function save(payload) {
    isSaving.value = true
    saveError.value = ''
    try {
        const log = await createLog(props.familyId, { ...payload, recipient: props.recipientId, task: props.taskId })
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.logs(props.familyId) })
        emit('saved', log)
        showSaved(`Note saved to ${logName(log)}`)
    } catch (error) {
        saveError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isSaving.value = false
    }
}

function close() {
    if (!isSaving.value) emit('close')
}
</script>

<template>
    <CareModal class="consultation-note-modal" title="Add consultation note" @close="close">
        <p class="modal-intro">
            Saved to {{ recipientName ? `${recipientName}'s` : 'the' }} care log and linked to this visit.
        </p>
        <LogForm
            :recipient-name="recipientName"
            :is-saving="isSaving"
            :error-message="saveError"
            @submit="save"
        />
    </CareModal>
</template>

<style scoped>
.consultation-note-modal :deep(.care-modal) {
    width: min(100%, 640px);
}

.modal-intro {
    margin: 0 0 12px;
    color: var(--theme-muted, #7B8391);
    font-size: 14px;
}

/* The modal already has a title and a frame */
.consultation-note-modal :deep(.log-form) {
    padding: 0;

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { computed, ref, watch, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { logTypeLabel, MEDICATION_CHANGE_LABELS, LANGUAGE_LABELS, languageLabel } from '../logTypes.js'

const props = defineProps({
    log: { type: Object, required: true },
    canChange: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    translate: { type: Function, default: null },
    // Narrow columns (the task pages): icon-only buttons so they fit beside the name
    compact: { type: Boolean, default: false }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['edit', 'delete'])

const TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Singapore'

function formatDate(value, withTime = false) {
    if (!value) return ''
    return new Date(value).toLocaleString('en-SG', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        ...(withTime ? { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true } : {}),
        timeZone: TIME_ZONE
    })
}

const authorName = computed(() => props.log.author?.name || 'Family member')

const initials = computed(() =>
    authorName.value.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase()
)

const context = computed(() => {
    const parts = []
    if (props.log.type === 'consultation' && props.log.consultation?.clinic) {
        parts.push(props.log.consultation.clinic)
    }
    if (props.log.inputMethod === 'voice') parts.push('voice note')
    return parts.join(' Â· ')
})

const consultation = computed(() => {
    const c = props.log.consultation
    if (props.log.type !== 'consultation' || !c) return null
    if (!c.doctorName && !c.nextAppointment) return null
    return c
})

const fetchedTranslations = ref({})
const shownLanguage = ref('')
const menuOpen = ref(false)
const translatingTo = ref('')
const translateError = ref('')
let translationVersion = 0

watch([() => props.log._id, () => props.log.content], () => {
    translationVersion++
    fetchedTranslations.value = {}
    shownLanguage.value = ''
    translatingTo.value = ''
    translateError.value = ''
    menuOpen.value = false
})
onUnmounted(() => { translationVersion++ })

const translations = computed(() => ({ ...(props.log.translations || {}), ...fetchedTranslations.value }))

const languageOptions = computed(() =>
    Object.keys(LANGUAGE_LABELS)
        .filter((code) => code !== (props.log.originalLang || 'en'))
        .map((code) => ({ code, label: languageLabel(code), cached: Boolean(translations.value[code]) }))
)

function onTranslateButton() {
    translateError.value = ''
    if (shownLanguage.value) {
        shownLanguage.value = ''
        return
    }
    menuOpen.value = !menuOpen.value
}

async function chooseLanguage(code) {
    const current = ++translationVersion
    menuOpen.value = false
    translateError.value = ''

    if (translations.value[code]) {
        shownLanguage.value = code
        return
    }

    if (!props.translate) return

    translatingTo.value = code
    try {
        const text = await props.translate(props.log, code)
        if (current !== translationVersion) return
        fetchedTranslations.value = { ...fetchedTranslations.value, [code]: text }
        shownLanguage.value = code
    } catch (error) {
        if (current === translationVersion)
            translateError.value = error.message || 'Could not translate this note. Please try again.'
    } finally {
        if (current === translationVersion) translatingTo.value = ''
    }
}

const translateLabel = computed(() => {
    if (translatingTo.value) return 'Translating...'
    return shownLanguage.value ? `Showing ${languageLabel(shownLanguage.value)}. Show the original` : 'Translate'
})

function closeMenuOnFocusOut(event) {
    if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) menuOpen.value = false
}
</script>

================================================
FILE: client/src/features/logs/components/LogForm.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { LOG_TYPES, MEDICATION_CHANGE_LABELS } from '../logTypes.js'
import { speechInput } from '../services/speechInput.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipientName: { type: String, default: '' },
    initialLog: { type: Object, default: null },
    isSaving: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    errorMessage: { type: String, default: '' },
    voice: { type: Object, default: () => speechInput }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['submit', 'cancel'])

const MAX_CONTENT = 5000
const isEdit = computed(() => Boolean(props.initialLog))

const type = ref('consultation')
const content = ref('')
const doctorName = ref('')
const clinic = ref('')
const nextAppointment = ref('')
const medications = ref([])
const inputMethod = ref('text')
const notifyFamily = ref(true)
const attempted = ref(false)

function toLocalInput(iso) {
    if (!iso) return ''
    const date = new Date(iso)
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')
    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
}

function emptyMedication() {
    return { name: '', change: 'added', details: '' }
}

function fillFrom(log) {
    type.value = log?.type || 'consultation'
    content.value = log?.content || ''
    doctorName.value = log?.consultation?.doctorName || ''
    clinic.value = log?.consultation?.clinic || ''
    nextAppointment.value = toLocalInput(log?.consultation?.nextAppointment)
    medications.value = log?.medicationChanges?.length
        ? log.medicationChanges.map((m) => ({ name: m.name, change: m.change, details: m.details || '' }))
        : []
    inputMethod.value = log?.inputMethod || 'text'
    notifyFamily.value = true
    attempted.value = false
}

watch(() => props.initialLog, fillFrom, { immediate: true })

watch(type, (value) => {
    if (value === 'medication_change' && medications.value.length === 0) {
        medications.value.push(emptyMedication())
    }
}, { immediate: true })

function addMedication() {
    medications.value.push(emptyMedication())
}

function removeMedication(index) {
    medications.value.splice(index, 1)
}

const contentError = computed(() => {
    if (!content.value.trim()) return 'Please write a short note.'
    if (content.value.length > MAX_CONTENT) return `Keep the note under ${MAX_CONTENT} characters.`
    return ''
})

const filledMedications = computed(() =>
    medications.value.filter((m) => m.name.trim() || m.details.trim())
)
const medicationError = computed(() => {
    if (type.value !== 'medication_change') return ''
    if (filledMedications.value.some((m) => !m.name.trim())) return 'Each medication needs a name.'
    return ''
})

const heading = computed(() => {
    if (isEdit.value) return 'Edit note'
    return props.recipientName ? `Add an update for ${props.recipientName}` : 'Add an update'
})

function buildPayload() {
    const payload = {
        type: type.value,
        content: content.value.trim(),
        medicationChanges: type.value === 'medication_change'
            ? filledMedications.value.map((m) => ({ name: m.name.trim(), change: m.change, details: m.details.trim() }))
            : []
    }

    if (type.value === 'consultation') {
        payload.consultation = {
            doctorName: doctorName.value.trim(),
            clinic: clinic.value.trim(),
            nextAppointment: nextAppointment.value ? new Date(nextAppointment.value).toISOString() : null
        }
    }

    if (!isEdit.value) {
        payload.inputMethod = inputMethod.value
        payload.notify = notifyFamily.value
    }

    return payload
}

function submit() {
    attempted.value = true
    if (contentError.value || medicationError.value || props.isSaving) return
    emit('submit', buildPayload())
}

const voiceState = ref('idle')
const voiceError = ref('')

const voiceLabel = computed(() => ({
    idle: 'Speak your note',
    listening: 'Stop and use what I said',
    transcribing: 'Turning speech into text'
})[voiceState.value])

async function toggleVoice() {
    voiceError.value = ''

    if (voiceState.value === 'idle') {
        try {
            await props.voice.start()
            voiceState.value = 'listening'
        } catch (error) {
            voiceError.value = error.message || 'Could not start the microphone.'
        }
        return
    }

    if (voiceState.value === 'listening') {
        voiceState.value = 'transcribing'
        try {
            const transcript = (await props.voice.stop()).trim()
            if (transcript) {
                content.value = content.value.trim() ? `${content.value.trim()} ${transcript}` : transcript
                inputMethod.value = 'voice'
            } else {
                voiceError.value = "We didn't catch that. Please try again."
            }
        } catch (error) {
            voiceError.value = error.message || 'Could not turn your voice into text.'
        } finally {
            voiceState.value = 'idle'
        }
    }
}

function cancelVoice() {
    if (voiceState.value === 'listening') props.voice.cancel()
    voiceState.value = 'idle'
}

onBeforeUnmount(cancelVoice)

function reset() {
    cancelVoice()
    voiceError.value = ''
    fillFrom(null)
    if (type.value === 'medication_change') medications.value.push(emptyMedication())
}

defineExpose({ reset })
</script>

<template>
    <form class="log-form" :class="{ 'is-edit': isEdit }" novalidate data-testid="log-form" @submit.prevent="submit">
        <h2 class="form-title">
            <i class="bi" :class="isEdit ? 'bi-pencil-square' : 'bi-journal-plus'" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            {{ heading }}
        </h2>

        <div class="type-chips" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Type of note">
            <button
                v-for="option in LOG_TYPES"
                :key="option.value"
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                class="type-chip"
                :class="{ 'is-selected': type === option.value }"
                :aria-checked="type === option.value"
                :data-testid="`log-type-${option.value}`"
                @click="type = option.value"
            >
                {{ option.label }}
            </button>
        </div>

        <label class="visually-hidden" :for="isEdit ? `log-content-${initialLog._id}` : 'log-content'">Note</label>
        <div class="content-wrap" :class="{ 'has-voice': !isEdit }">
            <textarea
                :id="isEdit ? `log-content-${initialLog._id}` : 'log-content'"
                v-model="content"
                class="content-input"
                :class="{ 'is-invalid': attempted && contentError }"
                rows="3"
                :maxlength="MAX_CONTENT"
                :readonly="voiceState !== 'idle'"
                :placeholder="voiceState === 'listening'
                    ? 'Listening... tap the microphone again when you are done.'
                    : 'What happened? e.g. what the doctor said, a change in diet, a new symptom'"
                data-testid="log-content"
            ></textarea>

            <button
                v-if="!isEdit"
                type="button"
                class="voice-button"
                :class="`is-${voiceState}`"
                :disabled="voiceState === 'transcribing' || isSaving"
                :aria-label="voiceLabel"
                :aria-pressed="voiceState === 'listening'"
                :title="voiceLabel"
                data-testid="log-voice"
                @click="toggleVoice"
            >
                <span v-if="voiceState === 'transcribing'" class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <i v-else class="bi" :class="voiceState === 'listening' ? 'bi-stop-fill' : 'bi-mic-fill'" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
        </div>

        <p v-if="voiceState === 'listening'" class="voice-status" role="status">
            <span class="rec-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span> Listening... tap
            <i class="bi bi-stop-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> when you're done.
            <button type="button" class="voice-cancel" @click="cancelVoice">Cancel</button>
        </p>
        <p v-else-if="voiceState === 'transcribing'" class="voice-status" role="status">
            Turning your voice into text...
        </p>
        <p v-else-if="inputMethod === 'voice' && !isEdit" class="voice-status is-done">
            <i class="bi bi-mic" aria-hidden="true"></i> Added from voice. Check the text before posting.
        </p>
        <p v-if="voiceError" class="field-error" role="alert">{{ voiceError }}</p>
        <p v-if="attempted && contentError" class="field-error">{{ contentError }}</p>

        <div v-if="type === 'consultation'" class="extra-fields">
            <div class="extra-field">
                <label for="log-doctor">Doctor <span class="optional">optional</span></label>
                <input id="log-doctor" v-model="doctorName" type="text" maxlength="100" placeholder="e.g. Dr Lim">
            </div>
            <div class="extra-field">
                <label for="log-clinic">Clinic <span class="optional">optional</span></label>
                <input id="log-clinic" v-model="clinic" type="text" maxlength="120" placeholder="e.g. Ang Mo Kio Polyclinic">
            </div>
            <div class="extra-field">
                <label for="log-next">Next appointment <span class="optional">optional</span></label>
                <input id="log-next" v-model="nextAppointment" type="datetime-local">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div v-if="type === 'medication_change'" class="medications">
            <div v-for="(med, index) in medications" :key="index" class="medication-row">
                <i class="bi bi-capsule" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <input
                    v-model="med.name"
                    type="text"
                    maxlength="100"
                    placeholder="Medicine"
                    :aria-label="`Medicine ${index + 1} name`"
                    class="med-name"
                >
                <select v-model="med.change" :aria-label="`Medicine ${index + 1} change`" class="med-change">

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import LogCard from './LogCard.vue'
import LogForm from './LogForm.vue'

defineProps({
    logs: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    errorMessage: { type: String, default: '' },
    emptyMessage: { type: String, default: 'No notes yet. Add the first update above.' },
    canChange: { type: Function, default: () => false },
    translate: { type: Function, default: null },
    compact: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    hasMore: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isLoadingMore: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    editingId: { type: String, default: '' },
    isSavingEdit: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    editError: { type: String, default: '' }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['retry', 'edit', 'delete', 'load-more', 'save-edit', 'cancel-edit'])
</script>
