    <div v-if="isLoading" class="log-list-status" role="status">
        <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-success" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        Loading notes...
    </div>

    <div v-else-if="errorMessage" class="log-list-status is-error" role="alert">
        <span>{{ errorMessage }}</span>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" @click="emit('retry')">
            Try again
        </button>
    </div>

    <div v-else-if="logs.length === 0" class="log-list-empty">
        <i class="bi bi-journal-text" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        <p>{{ emptyMessage }}</p>
    </div>

    <!-- New and deleted notes animate (motion.css care-list). TransitionGroup needs the key
         on each real element, so it sits on LogForm / LogCard rather than the template. -->
    <TransitionGroup v-else name="care-list" tag="div" class="log-list" data-testid="log-list">
        <template v-for="log in logs">
            <LogForm
                v-if="log._id === editingId"
                :key="log._id"
                :initial-log="log"
                :is-saving="isSavingEdit"
                :error-message="editError"
                @submit="emit('save-edit', log, $event)"
                @cancel="emit('cancel-edit')"
            />
            <LogCard
                v-else
                :key="log._id"
                :log="log"
                :can-change="canChange(log)"
                :translate="translate"
                :compact="compact"
                @edit="emit('edit', $event)"
                @delete="emit('delete', $event)"
            />
        </template>

        <button
            v-if="hasMore"
            key="load-more"
            type="button"
            class="load-more"
            :disabled="isLoadingMore"
            @click="emit('load-more')"
        >
            <span v-if="isLoadingMore" class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            {{ isLoadingMore ? 'Loading...' : 'Load older notes' }}
        </button>
    </TransitionGroup>
</template>

})

    { value: '', label: 'All updates', count: props.logs.length },
    ...LOG_TYPES.map((type) => ({

        count: props.logs.filter((log) => log.type === type.value).length

])

                    :aria-pressed="modelValue === option.value"
                    :data-testid="`log-filter-${option.value || 'all'}`"
                    @click="emit('update:modelValue', option.value)"
                >
                    <span>{{ option.label }}</span>
                    <span class="filter-count">{{ option.count }}</span>

FILE: client/src/features/logs/components/SavedToast.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// Small green confirmation at the top of the screen, e.g. "Note saved to Grandma's log".
// Shows whatever showSaved() (../savedToast.js) was last called with, then hides itself.
import { computed, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue'
import { savedToast, hideSaved } from '../savedToast.js'

const message = computed(() => savedToast.value.text)

let timer = null
watch(() => savedToast.value.id, () => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    if (message.value) timer = setTimeout(hideSaved, 3500)
})
onUnmounted(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    hideSaved()
})
</script>

<template>
    <Teleport to="body">
        <Transition name="toast">
            <div v-if="message" class="saved-toast" role="status" data-testid="saved-toast">
                <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>{{ message }}</span>
                <button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" @click="hideSaved">
                    <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </Transition>
    </Teleport>
</template>

<style scoped>
.saved-toast {
    position: fixed;
    top: 16px;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 1200;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;

    gap: 8px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #3B7A4F;
    color: white;

FILE: client/src/features/logs/components/VisitNotesCard.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// "Notes from this visit" on the Task detail and Transit pages, desktop and phone.
// Shows the care log notes linked to the task (translate; edit and delete for the author
// or an admin), with "+ Add consultation note". Adding and editing both open a pop-up,
// so a narrow column never has to fit the whole form.
//   <VisitNotesCard :family-id="familyId" :task-id="taskId" :recipient-id="id" recipient-name="Grandpa" />
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import CareModal from '../../../components/common/CareModal.vue'
import { getLogs } from '../services/logsApi.js'
import { useLogActions } from '../useLogActions.js'
import LogList from './LogList.vue'
import LogForm from './LogForm.vue'
import ConsultationNoteModal from './ConsultationNoteModal.vue'

const props = defineProps({
    familyId: { type: String, required: true },
    taskId: { type: String, required: true },
    recipientId: { type: String, default: '' },     // empty for a household task
    recipientName: { type: String, default: '' },
    emptyText: { type: String, default: "No notes yet. Whoever goes can add what the doctor said, so the family doesn't need to ask." }
})

const notes = ref([])
const actions = useLogActions(() => props.familyId, notes)
const { editingId, isSavingEdit, editError, actionError } = actions

async function load() {
    try {
        notes.value = await getLogs(props.familyId, { task: props.taskId, limit: 10 })
    } catch {
        notes.value = [] // the page still works without its notes
    }
}
onMounted(load)
watch(() => [props.familyId, props.taskId], load)

// ---- Add ----
const isAdding = ref(false)
function added(log) {
    isAdding.value = false
    notes.value = [log, ...notes.value.filter((note) => note._id !== log._id)]
}

// ---- Edit (in a pop-up, not inside the list) ----
const editingNote = computed(() => notes.value.find((note) => note._id === editingId.value) || null)
function closeEdit() {
    if (!isSavingEdit.value) actions.cancelEdit()
}
</script>

<template>
    <section class="visit-notes-card" data-testid="visit-notes">
        <h2 class="visit-notes-title">Notes from this visit</h2>

        <p v-if="actionError" class="action-error" role="alert">
            {{ actionError }}
            <button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" @click="actionError = ''">
                <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
        </p>

        <LogList
            :logs="notes"
            :empty-message="emptyText"
            :can-change="actions.canChange"
            :translate="actions.translate"
            compact
            @edit="actions.startEdit"
            @delete="actions.removeLog"
        />

        <button
            v-if="recipientId"
            type="button"
            class="add-note-button"
            data-testid="task-add-note"
            @click="isAdding = true"
        >
            <i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i> Add consultation note
        </button>
        <p v-else class="visit-notes-hint">
            Consultation notes go in a care recipient's log, and this task isn't for one.
        </p>

        <ConsultationNoteModal
            v-if="isAdding"
            :family-id="familyId"
            :recipient-id="recipientId"
            :recipient-name="recipientName"
            :task-id="taskId"
            @close="isAdding = false"
            @saved="added"
        />

        <CareModal v-if="editingNote" class="note-modal" title="Edit note" @close="closeEdit">
            <LogForm
                :initial-log="editingNote"
                :is-saving="isSavingEdit"
                :error-message="editError"
                @submit="actions.saveEdit(editingNote, $event)"
                @cancel="closeEdit"
            />
        </CareModal>
    </section>
</template>

FILE: client/src/features/logs/services/logsApi.js

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'

function authHeaders() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
}

function logsUrl(familyId, logId = '') {
    return `/families/${familyId}/logs${logId ? `/${logId}` : ''}`
}

export async function getLogs(familyId, filters = {}) {
    const response = await http.get(logsUrl(familyId), {
        headers: authHeaders(),
        params: filters
    })

    return response.data.logs
}

export async function getLog(familyId, logId) {
    const response = await http.get(logsUrl(familyId, logId), { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.log
}

export const TRANSLATION_NOT_CONNECTED = "Translation isn't connected yet."

export async function translateLog(familyId, logId, lang) {
    const response = await http.post(
        `${logsUrl(familyId, logId)}/translate`,
        { lang },
        { headers: authHeaders() }
    )

    const text = response.data?.translation
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text.trim()) throw new Error(TRANSLATION_NOT_CONNECTED)
    return text
}

export async function createLog(familyId, log) {
    const response = await http.post(logsUrl(familyId), log, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.log
}

export async function updateLog(familyId, logId, changes) {
    const response = await http.patch(logsUrl(familyId, logId), changes, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.log
}

export async function deleteLog(familyId, logId) {
    await http.delete(logsUrl(familyId, logId), { headers: authHeaders() })
}

export function getLogErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    }

    if (error.response?.status === 403) {
        return 'Only the person who wrote this note or a family admin can change it.'
    }

    if (error.response?.status === 404) {
        return 'This note no longer exists. It may have been deleted.'
    }

    if (!error.response && error.message !== 'Please log in first.') {
        return 'Unable to reach the server. Please check your connection.'
    }

    const data = error.response?.data

    if (data?.errors?.length) {
        return data.errors.join(' ')
    }

    return (
        data?.error ||
        error.message ||
        'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
    )
}

FILE: client/src/features/logs/services/speechInput.js
================================================
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'

const AUDIO_TYPES = ['audio/webm;codecs=opus', 'audio/webm', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/ogg']

let recorder = null
let stream = null
let chunks = []

function pickAudioType() {
    return AUDIO_TYPES.find((type) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type)) || ''
}

function releaseMicrophone() {
    stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    stream = null
    recorder = null
    chunks = []
}

function microphoneErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
        return 'Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.'
    }
    if (error.name === 'NotFoundError') {
        return 'No microphone was found on this device.'
    }
    return 'Could not start the microphone.'
}

async function sendForTranscription(audio) {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
    if (!token) throw new Error('Please log in first.')

    try {
        const response = await http.post('/integrations/transcribe', audio, {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Content-Type': audio.type.split(';')[0]
            }
        })
        return response.data.text || ''
    } catch (error) {
        if (error.response?.status === 413) {
            throw new Error('That recording is too long. Please keep voice notes under a few minutes.')
        }
        throw new Error(error.response?.data?.error || 'Could not turn your voice into text.')
    }
}

export const speechInput = {
    available: typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
        !!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia &&
        typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined',

    async start() {
        if (!this.available) {
            throw new Error("Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Please type your note.")
        }

        try {
            stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
        } catch (error) {
            releaseMicrophone()
            throw new Error(microphoneErrorMessage(error))
        }

        const mimeType = pickAudioType()
        recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mimeType ? { mimeType } : undefined)
        chunks = []
        recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
            if (event.data.size) chunks.push(event.data)
        }
        recorder.start()
    },

    async stop() {
        if (!recorder) return ''

        const active = recorder
        const stopped = new Promise((resolve) => {
            active.onstop = resolve
        })
        active.stop()
        await stopped

        const audio = new Blob(chunks, { type: active.mimeType || 'audio/webm' })
        releaseMicrophone()

        if (!audio.size) return ''
        return sendForTranscription(audio)
    },

    cancel() {
        if (recorder && recorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            recorder.onstop = null
            recorder.stop()
        }
        releaseMicrophone()
    }
}

<script setup>
// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { useRecipient } from '../../../composables/useRecipients.js'
import LogForm from '../components/LogForm.vue'
import LogList from '../components/LogList.vue'
import LogTypeFilter from '../components/LogTypeFilter.vue'
import { getLogs, createLog, getLogErrorMessage } from '../services/logsApi.js'
import { useLogActions } from '../useLogActions.js'
import { showSaved, logName } from '../savedToast.js'
import SavedToast from '../components/SavedToast.vue'
import { displayName } from '../../recipients/recipientLabels.js'

const PAGE_SIZE = 20

const route = useRoute()
const { selectedFamilyId, selectedFamily } = useActiveFamily()

const recipientId = computed(() => route.params.recipientId)

const { recipient } = useRecipient(recipientId)
const recipientName = computed(() => displayName(recipient.value))

const logs = ref([])
const actions = useLogActions(selectedFamilyId, logs)
const { invalidateCachedLogs, editingId, isSavingEdit, editError, actionError } = actions
const isLoading = ref(false)
const loadError = ref('')
const hasMore = ref(false)
const isLoadingMore = ref(false)

function isCurrent(familyId, forRecipient) {
    return familyId === selectedFamilyId.value && forRecipient === recipientId.value
}

async function loadLogs() {
    const familyId = selectedFamilyId.value
    const forRecipient = recipientId.value
    loadError.value = ''
    editingId.value = ''

    if (!familyId) {
        logs.value = []
        return
    }

    isLoading.value = true
    try {
        const result = await getLogs(familyId, { recipient: forRecipient, limit: PAGE_SIZE })
        if (!isCurrent(familyId, forRecipient)) return
        logs.value = result
        hasMore.value = result.length === PAGE_SIZE
    } catch (error) {
        if (!isCurrent(familyId, forRecipient)) return
        logs.value = []
        loadError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        if (isCurrent(familyId, forRecipient)) isLoading.value = false
    }
}

async function loadMore() {
    const familyId = selectedFamilyId.value
    const forRecipient = recipientId.value
    const oldest = logs.value[logs.value.length - 1]
    if (!oldest || isLoadingMore.value) return

    isLoadingMore.value = true
    actionError.value = ''
    try {
        const older = await getLogs(familyId, {
            recipient: forRecipient,
            before: oldest.createdAt,
            limit: PAGE_SIZE
        })
        if (!isCurrent(familyId, forRecipient)) return
        logs.value = [...logs.value, ...older]
        hasMore.value = older.length === PAGE_SIZE
    } catch (error) {
        actionError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isLoadingMore.value = false
    }
}

onMounted(loadLogs)
watch([selectedFamilyId, recipientId], loadLogs)

const selectedType = ref('')
const shownLogs = computed(() =>
    selectedType.value ? logs.value.filter((log) => log.type === selectedType.value) : logs.value
)
const emptyMessage = computed(() =>
    selectedType.value
        ? 'No notes of this type yet.'
        : `No notes yet. Add the first update${recipientName.value ? ` for ${recipientName.value}` : ''} above.`
)

const form = ref(null)
const isPosting = ref(false)
const postError = ref('')

async function postUpdate(payload) {
    isPosting.value = true
    postError.value = ''
    try {
        const log = await createLog(selectedFamilyId.value, { ...payload, recipient: recipientId.value })
        logs.value = [log, ...logs.value]
        invalidateCachedLogs()
        selectedType.value = ''
        form.value?.reset()
        showSaved(`Note saved to ${logName(log)}`)
    } catch (error) {
        postError.value = getLogErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isPosting.value = false
    }
}

</script>

<template>
    <div class="log-page">
        <SavedToast />
        <nav class="breadcrumb-row" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
            <RouterLink to="/home">Family home</RouterLink>
            <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <span>{{ recipientName || 'Care recipient' }}</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <span class="current" aria-current="page">Log</span>
        </nav>

        <header class="log-header">
            <h1>{{ recipientName ? `${recipientName}'s care log` : 'Care log' }}</h1>
            <p>Notes after appointments, medication changes and daily updates, shared with the family.</p>
        </header>

        <section v-if="!selectedFamily" class="no-family">
            <p>Choose a family in the sidebar to see its care notes.</p>
        </section>

        <div v-else class="row g-3">
            <div class="col-lg-8 order-2 order-lg-1 d-flex flex-column gap-3">
                <LogForm
                    ref="form"
                    :recipient-name="recipientName"
                    :is-saving="isPosting"
                    :error-message="postError"
                    @submit="postUpdate"
                />

                <p v-if="actionError" class="action-error" role="alert">
                    <i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    {{ actionError }}
                    <button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" @click="actionError = ''">
                        <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                </p>

                <LogList
                    :logs="shownLogs"
                    :is-loading="isLoading"
                    :error-message="loadError"
                    :empty-message="emptyMessage"
                    :can-change="actions.canChange"
                    :translate="actions.translate"
                    :has-more="hasMore && !selectedType"
                    :is-loading-more="isLoadingMore"
                    :editing-id="editingId"
                    :is-saving-edit="isSavingEdit"
                    :edit-error="editError"
                    @retry="loadLogs"
                    @load-more="loadMore"
                    @edit="actions.startEdit"
                    @delete="actions.removeLog"
                    @save-edit="actions.saveEdit"
                    @cancel-edit="actions.cancelEdit"
                />
            </div>

            <aside class="col-lg-4 order-1 order-lg-2">
                <div class="filter-sticky">
                    <LogTypeFilter v-model="selectedType" :logs="logs" />
                </div>
            </aside>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

// The API sends UTC times; My Tasks and Transit must always show Singapore time.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { formatTime, formatDay, dayKey, initials, recipientName, familyColour } from '../utils/formatters.js'

describe('TestSuite: formatTime', () => {
    it('Test1: shows UTC 02:00 as 10:00am Singapore time', () => {
        expect(formatTime('2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z')).toBe('10:00am')
    })

    it('Test2: shows an afternoon time with pm', () => {
        expect(formatTime('2026-10-29T06:30:00.000Z')).toBe('2:30pm')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: formatDay and dayKey', () => {
    it('Test1: shows the short day name, date and month', () => {
        expect(formatDay('2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z')).toContain('29 Oct')
        expect(formatDay('2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z')).toContain('Thu')
    })

    it('Test2: puts 16:30 UTC on the next Singapore day (00:30am)', () => {
        // Grouping by day must follow Singapore midnight, not UTC midnight
        expect(dayKey('2026-10-28T16:30:00.000Z')).toBe('2026-10-29')
        expect(dayKey('2026-10-28T15:30:00.000Z')).toBe('2026-10-28')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: initials', () => {
    it('Test1: takes the first letter of the first two names', () => {
        expect(initials('Jasmine Tan')).toBe('JT')
        expect(initials('aunt may lim')).toBe('AM')
    })

    it('Test2: returns an empty string for no name', () => {
        expect(initials('')).toBe('')
        expect(initials()).toBe('')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: recipientName', () => {
    it('Test1: prefers the nickname, then the name', () => {
        expect(recipientName({ recipient: { name: 'Tan Ah Kow', nickname: 'Grandpa' } })).toBe('Grandpa')
        expect(recipientName({ recipient: { name: 'Baby Emma' } })).toBe('Baby Emma')
    })

    it('Test2: is empty for a household task or an unpopulated id', () => {
        expect(recipientName({ recipient: null })).toBe('')
        expect(recipientName({ recipient: '6ac8...' })).toBe('')
        expect(recipientName(null)).toBe('')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: familyColour', () => {
    it('Test1: always gives the same family the same colour', () => {
        const colour = familyColour('6ac889894757422a93937345')
        expect(familyColour('6ac889894757422a93937345')).toBe(colour)
        expect(['green', 'purple', 'blue', 'orange']).toContain(colour)
    })
})

        expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Claimed')
    })

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// "Connect Google Calendar" on My Tasks. After connecting once, the server keeps the
// person's Google Calendar in step with their claimed tasks by itself (like Zoom does).
// Hidden when the server isn't set up for Google (no GOOGLE_* lines in server/.env).
//   <GoogleCalendarSync compact />  (compact = smaller, for the phone layout)
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { getGoogleStatus, connectGoogle, syncGoogleNow, disconnectGoogle } from '../services/googleCalendarApi.js'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../services/myTasksApi.js'
import { formatTime } from '../utils/formatters.js'

defineProps({
    compact: { type: Boolean, default: false }
})
const emit = defineEmits(['synced'])

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const status = ref(null)
const busy = ref(false)
const message = ref('')
const isError = ref(false)
const menuOpen = ref(false)

const syncedText = computed(() =>
    status.value?.lastSyncedAt ? `Synced ${formatTime(status.value.lastSyncedAt)}` : 'Syncingâ€¦'
)

function say(text, error = false) {
    message.value = text
    isError.value = error
}

async function load() {
    try {
        status.value = await getGoogleStatus()
    } catch {
        status.value = null // hide the card if the server can't tell
    }
}

async function connect() {
    busy.value = true
    try {
        await connectGoogle() // leaves the page
    } catch (error) {
        say(getErrorMessage(error), true)
        busy.value = false
    }
}

async function syncNow() {
    busy.value = true
    menuOpen.value = false
    try {
        const result = await syncGoogleNow()
        await load()
        if (!result.connected) say('Google Calendar was disconnected. Connect it again to keep syncing.', true)
        else say('Google Calendar is up to date.')
        emit('synced')
    } catch (error) {
        say(getErrorMessage(error), true)
    } finally {
        busy.value = false
    }
}

async function disconnect() {
    menuOpen.value = false
    const removeEvents = window.confirm(
        'Stop syncing with Google Calendar?\n\nOK: also remove the CareCircle events from your calendar\nCancel: keep them'
    )
    busy.value = true
    try {
        await disconnectGoogle({ removeEvents })
        await load()
        say('Google Calendar disconnected.')
    } catch (error) {
        say(getErrorMessage(error), true)
    } finally {
        busy.value = false
    }
}

onMounted(async () => {
    await load()
    // Back from Google's page: /my-tasks?calendar=connected|cancelled|error
    const result = route.query.calendar
    if (result) {
        if (result === 'connected') say('Connected! Your tasks are now in Google Calendar and will stay in sync.')
        else if (result === 'cancelled') say('Google Calendar was not connected.')
        else say('Could not connect Google Calendar. Please try again.', true)
        router.replace({ query: { ...route.query, calendar: undefined } })
    }
})
</script>

<template>
    <div v-if="status?.available" class="gsync" :class="{ compact }">
        <!-- Not connected yet -->
        <button v-if="!status.connected" type="button" class="gsync-connect" :disabled="busy" @click="connect">
            <i class="bi bi-google" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span>
                <strong>Connect Google Calendar</strong>
                <small v-if="!compact">Your tasks appear in it automatically</small>
            </span>
        </button>

        <!-- Connected -->
        <div v-else class="gsync-on">
            <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="gsync-text">
                <strong>Google Calendar on</strong>
                <small :title="status.email">{{ status.lastError ? 'Last sync failed' : syncedText }}</small>
            </span>

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E). Matches Figma "CareCircle â€” Mobile prototype" â†’ "10 Â· My tasks".
// Phone layout of My Tasks. MyTasksView loads the data and passes it in.
// Tapping a task opens its Task detail page (Start the trip / Mark as done / Unclaim live there).
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import PersonAvatar from './PersonAvatar.vue'
import GoogleCalendarSync from './GoogleCalendarSync.vue'
import { formatTime, dayKey, recipientName, TIME_ZONE } from '../utils/formatters.js'

const props = defineProps({
    tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },        // all my tasks (after the family filter)
    activeTab: { type: String, default: 'claimed' },
    counts: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    visibleTasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    reminder: { type: Function, required: true },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    errorMessage: { type: String, default: '' },
    now: { type: Number, default: () => Date.now() }
})
const emit = defineEmits(['select-tab', 'retry', 'calendar'])

const router = useRouter()

const TABS = [
    { key: 'claimed', label: 'Upcoming' },
    { key: 'in_progress', label: 'In progress' },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Done' }
]
const EMPTY = {
    claimed: 'Nothing coming up. Claim a task from Family home.',
    in_progress: 'Nothing in progress right now.',
    completed: 'No completed tasks yet.'
}

// "This week Â· 3 of 5 done": my tasks starting Monday to Sunday of this week
const week = computed(() => {
    const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
    const weekday = new Date(props.now).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
    const offset = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].indexOf(weekday)
    const keys = new Set(Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => dayKey(props.now + (i - offset) * DAY)))
    const inWeek = props.tasks.filter((t) => keys.has(dayKey(t.startAt)))
    const done = inWeek.filter((t) => t.status === 'completed').length
    return { done, total: inWeek.length, percent: inWeek.length ? Math.round((done / inWeek.length) * 100) : 0 }
})

function datePill(task) {
    return new Date(task.startAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
        weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: TIME_ZONE
    })
}

// "Today, 2:00 PM Â· FairPrice, Junction 8" for due-soon tasks, "9:00 AM Â· Bethesda, Bedok" otherwise
function meta(task, flagged) {
    const time = formatTime(task.startAt).toUpperCase().replace(/(AM|PM)$/, ' $1')
    const isToday = dayKey(task.startAt) === dayKey(props.now)
    const when = flagged && isToday ? `Today, ${time}` : time
    const place = task.location?.name || task.location?.address || ''
    return [when, place].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')
}

function open(task) {
    router.push({ name: 'task-detail', params: { familyId: task.family._id, taskId: task._id } })
}
</script>

                <i class="bi bi-calendar-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Needs someone = D's open-tasks list; until it exists it goes to Family home -->
        <div class="segmented" role="tablist" aria-label="Task lists">

            </div>
            <div class="bar" role="progressbar" :aria-valuenow="week.percent" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100">
                <span :style="{ width: `${week.percent}%` }"></span>
            </div>
        </section>

        <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Task status">
            <button
                v-for="tab in TABS"
                :key="tab.key"
                type="button"

                :class="{ active: activeTab === tab.key }"

                    </span>

                        <PersonAvatar :name="recipientName(task)" :size="44" tone="yellow" />

                            <strong>{{ task.title }}</strong>

                        </span>

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// "Your week" (Figma frame 10): Monday to Sunday, today highlighted, a dot on days with tasks.
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { dayKey, TIME_ZONE } from '../utils/formatters.js'

const props = defineProps({
    tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    now: { type: Number, default: () => Date.now() }
})

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

const days = computed(() => {
    const todayKey = dayKey(props.now)
    const weekday = new Date(props.now).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
    const offset = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].indexOf(weekday)
    const busyDays = new Set(props.tasks.map((t) => dayKey(t.startAt)))

    return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
        const date = new Date(props.now + (i - offset) * DAY_MS)
        const key = dayKey(date)
        return {
            key,
            letter: date.toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { weekday: 'narrow', timeZone: TIME_ZONE }),
            number: date.toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { day: 'numeric', timeZone: TIME_ZONE }),
            isToday: key === todayKey,
            hasTasks: busyDays.has(key)
        }
    })
})
</script>

<template>
    <section class="week-card" aria-labelledby="week-title">
        <h2 id="week-title">Your week</h2>
        <ol class="week">
            <li v-for="day in days" :key="day.key" :class="{ today: day.isToday }">
                <span class="letter">{{ day.letter }}</span>
                <span class="number">{{ day.number }}</span>
                <span class="dot" :class="{ on: day.hasTasks }"></span>
                <span v-if="day.hasTasks" class="visually-hidden">has tasks</span>
            </li>
        </ol>
    </section>
</template>

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Google Calendar auto-sync: connect once, then claimed tasks appear in Google Calendar
// by themselves (and update / disappear when the task changes).
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { authHeaders } from './myTasksApi.js'

// { available, connected, email, lastSyncedAt, lastError }
export async function getGoogleStatus() {
    const response = await http.get('/me/google', { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data
}

// Sends the browser to Google's "Allow CareCircle toâ€¦" page
export async function connectGoogle() {
    const response = await http.get('/me/google/connect', { headers: authHeaders() })
    window.location.href = response.data.url
}

// { connected, added, updated, removed }
export async function syncGoogleNow() {
    const response = await http.post('/me/google/sync', null, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data
}

export async function disconnectGoogle({ removeEvents = false } = {}) {
    await http.delete('/me/google', { headers: authHeaders(), params: { removeEvents } })
}

FILE: client/src/features/my-tasks/services/myTasksApi.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// My Tasks: GET /api/me/tasks, plus D's start / unclaim / complete actions on a task.
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { queryClient, queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
import { askRecurringClaim } from '../../tasks/composables/recurringClaimDialog.js'

export function authHeaders() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
    if (!token) throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
}

// The logged-in user's claimed tasks across all their families.
// filters (all optional): { status: 'claimed,in_progress', from, to }
export async function getMyTasks(filters = {}) {
    const response = await http.get('/me/tasks', { headers: authHeaders(), params: filters })
    return response.data.tasks
}

async function taskAction(familyId, taskId, action, body = null) {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
    try {
        const response = await http.post(
            `/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}/${action}`, body, { headers: authHeaders() }
        )
        if (token !== sessionStorage.getItem('token')) return response.data
        const task = response.data.task
        await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.tasks(familyId) })
        if (token !== sessionStorage.getItem('token')) return response.data
        if (task) queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks(familyId), old => old?.map(row => row._id === taskId ? task : row))
        await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.tasks(familyId) })
        if (task?.recurringSeries) await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.family(familyId) })
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('carecircle:task-updated', { detail: { familyId, taskId, task, action } }))
        return response.data
    } catch (error) {
        if ([404, 409].includes(error.response?.status) && token === sessionStorage.getItem('token'))
            await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.tasks(familyId) })
        throw error
    }
}

// D's endpoints. Each returns { task } ("start" also returns transitSession)
export const startTask = (familyId, taskId) => taskAction(familyId, taskId, 'start')
export const unclaimTask = (familyId, taskId) => taskAction(familyId, taskId, 'unclaim')
export const completeTask = (familyId, taskId) => taskAction(familyId, taskId, 'complete')
export const claimTask = async (familyId, taskId, options = {}) => {
    const scope = options.task?.recurringSeries ? await askRecurringClaim(options.task) : undefined
    if (scope === null) return { cancelled: true }
    return taskAction(familyId, taskId, 'claim', scope ? { scope } : null)
}

// D's endpoint: DELETE a task (creator or admin)
export async function deleteTask(familyId, taskId) {
    const response = await http.delete(`/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}`, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data
}

// Works for both error shapes: { error, errors } (tasks, transit) and { message } (auth)
export function getErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    const data = error.response?.data
    if (data?.errors?.length) return data.errors.join(' ')
    return data?.error || data?.message || error.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
}

FILE: client/src/features/my-tasks/utils/formatters.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Shared helpers for My Tasks and Transit. The API sends UTC; we show Singapore time.
export const TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Singapore'

// "10:00am"
export function formatTime(value) {
    return new Date(value)
        .toLocaleTimeString('en-SG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        .replace(/\s/g, '')
        .toLowerCase()
}

// "Fri 9 Oct"
export function formatDay(value) {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-SG', {
        weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: TIME_ZONE
    })
}

// "2026-10-09" in Singapore time, for grouping by day
export function dayKey(value) {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

export function initials(name = '') {
    return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase()
}

// recipient is null for household tasks, and only an id until C's model populates it
export function recipientName(task) {
    const recipient = task?.recipient
    return recipient && typeof recipient === 'object' ? recipient.nickname || recipient.name : ''
}

// Same family always gets the same pill colour
const FAMILY_COLOURS = ['green', 'purple', 'blue', 'orange']
export function familyColour(familyId = '') {
    let sum = 0
    for (const char of String(familyId)) sum += char.charCodeAt(0)
    return FAMILY_COLOURS[sum % FAMILY_COLOURS.length]
}

FILE: client/src/features/my-tasks/utils/useIsMobile.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// true on phone-sized screens, so pages can switch to the Figma "Mobile prototype" layout.
//   const isMobile = useIsMobile()
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const QUERY = '(max-width: 767px)'

export function useIsMobile() {
    const media = window.matchMedia(QUERY)
    const isMobile = ref(media.matches)
    const update = (event) => { isMobile.value = event.matches }

    onMounted(() => media.addEventListener('change', update))
    onUnmounted(() => media.removeEventListener('change', update))
    return isMobile
}

FILE: client/src/features/my-tasks/views/MyTasksView.vue
================================================
<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E). Matches Figma frame "10 Â· My tasks" (CareCircle Wireframe).
// Every task I've claimed, across all my families: Upcoming / In progress / Completed,
// step-by-step progress, and a "due soon" flag for tasks starting within 24 hours.
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import MyTaskCard from '../components/MyTaskCard.vue'
import WeekStrip from '../components/WeekStrip.vue'
import MyTasksMobile from '../components/MyTasksMobile.vue'
import { useIsMobile } from '../utils/useIsMobile.js'
import { getMyTasks, startTask, unclaimTask, completeTask, getErrorMessage } from '../services/myTasksApi.js'
import AddToCalendar from '../../transit/components/AddToCalendar.vue'
import GoogleCalendarSync from '../components/GoogleCalendarSync.vue'
import { useTabIndicator } from '../../../composables/useTabIndicator.js'

const router = useRouter()
const isMobile = useIsMobile()

const TABS = [
    { key: 'claimed', label: 'Upcoming', empty: 'Nothing coming up. Claim a task from Family home.' },
    { key: 'in_progress', label: 'In progress', empty: 'Nothing in progress right now.' },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Done', empty: 'No completed tasks yet.' }
]
const DUE_SOON_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
const FAMILY_TONES = ['green', 'purple', 'blue', 'orange']

const tasks = ref([])
const activeTab = ref('claimed')
const familyFilter = ref('all')
const expandedId = ref('')
const isLoading = ref(false)
const errorMessage = ref('')
const actionError = ref('')
const notice = ref('')
const busyTaskId = ref('')
const now = ref(Date.now())

// One underline that slides to the active tab
const tabBar = ref(null)
const indicator = useTabIndicator(tabBar, () => activeTab.value)

// Families that appear in my tasks, in a stable order, each with its own pill colour
const families = computed(() => {
    const seen = new Map()
    for (const task of tasks.value) {
        if (task.family?._id && !seen.has(task.family._id)) seen.set(task.family._id, task.family.name)
    }
    return [...seen].map(([id, name], index) => ({ id, name, tone: FAMILY_TONES[index % FAMILY_TONES.length] }))
})
const toneFor = (task) => families.value.find((f) => f.id === task.family?._id)?.tone || 'green'

const filteredTasks = computed(() =>
    familyFilter.value === 'all'
        ? tasks.value
        : tasks.value.filter((t) => t.family?._id === familyFilter.value)
)

const counts = computed(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(TABS.map((tab) => [tab.key, filteredTasks.value.filter((t) => t.status === tab.key).length]))
)

const visibleTasks = computed(() => {
    const list = filteredTasks.value.filter((t) => t.status === activeTab.value)
    // Completed: most recent first. Others: soonest first (API order).
    return activeTab.value === 'completed'
        ? [...list].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt || b.startAt) - new Date(a.completedAt || a.startAt))
        : list
})

// Week strip and calendar export use the tasks still to do
const openTasks = computed(() => filteredTasks.value.filter((t) => t.status !== 'completed'))

// "Due in 18 hours" / "Overdue" flag for tasks not started yet
function reminder(task) {
    if (task.status !== 'claimed') return null
    const msUntil = new Date(task.startAt).getTime() - now.value
    if (msUntil < 0) return { type: 'late', label: 'Overdue' }
    if (msUntil > DUE_SOON_MS) return null
    const hours = Math.round(msUntil / 3600000)
    if (hours < 1) return { type: 'soon', label: 'Starting soon' }
    return { type: 'soon', label: `Due in ${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? '' : 's'}` }
}

function selectTab(key) {
    activeTab.value = key
    // Open the first task in the tab, like the design
    expandedId.value = visibleTasks.value[0]?._id || ''
}

function toggle(task) {
    expandedId.value = expandedId.value === task._id ? '' : task._id
}

// "Add to calendar" pop-up with the upcoming tasks (Google / Apple / Outlook on each)
const calendarOpen = ref(false)

async function loadTasks() {
    isLoading.value = true
    errorMessage.value = ''
    try {
        tasks.value = await getMyTasks({ status: 'claimed,in_progress,completed' })
        if (!visibleTasks.value.some((t) => t._id === expandedId.value)) {
            expandedId.value = visibleTasks.value[0]?._id || ''
        }
    } catch (error) {
        errorMessage.value = getErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false
    }
}

// D's replies have family as a plain id, so keep the one we already have (with its name)
function replaceTask(original, updated) {
    const merged = { ...original, ...updated, family: original.family }
    tasks.value = tasks.value.map((t) => (t._id === original._id ? merged : t))
    return merged
}

function openTrip(task) {
    router.push({ name: 'transit', params: { familyId: task.family._id, taskId: task._id } })
}

async function runAction(task, action) {
    if (action === 'give-back' && !window.confirm(task.recurringSeries ? `Give back only this date of "${task.title}"? You keep all your other sessions. Someone else can claim this date only.` : `Give back "${task.title}"? It goes back to the family as available.`)) return
    if (action === 'complete' && !window.confirm(`Mark "${task.title}" as done?`)) return

    busyTaskId.value = task._id
    actionError.value = ''
    try {
        if (action === 'start') {
            const { task: updated } = await startTask(task.family._id, task._id)
            const merged = replaceTask(task, updated)
            if (merged.needsTransit) return openTrip(merged)
            selectTab('in_progress')
            expandedId.value = merged._id
        } else if (action === 'give-back') {
            await unclaimTask(task.family._id, task._id)
            // No longer mine, so it leaves My Tasks
            tasks.value = tasks.value.filter((t) => t._id !== task._id)
        } else if (action === 'complete') {
            const { task: updated } = await completeTask(task.family._id, task._id)
            replaceTask(task, updated)
            selectTab('completed')
        }
    } catch (error) {
        actionError.value = getErrorMessage(error)
        // 409 / 404: someone changed it (e.g. cancelled it). Show the latest state.
        if ([404, 409].includes(error.response?.status)) await loadTasks()
    } finally {
        busyTaskId.value = ''
    }
}

// Keep "Due in 3 hours" accurate, and refresh when coming back to the browser tab
let clock = null
function onVisible() {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') loadTasks()
}
onMounted(() => {
    loadTasks()
    window.addEventListener('carecircle:task-updated', loadTasks)
    clock = setInterval(() => { now.value = Date.now() }, 60 * 1000)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible)
})
onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('carecircle:task-updated', loadTasks)
    clearInterval(clock)
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible)
})
</script>

<template>
    <!-- Phones: Figma "Mobile prototype" layout -->
    <MyTasksMobile
        v-if="isMobile"
        :tasks="filteredTasks"
        :active-tab="activeTab"
        :counts="counts"

// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Labels and small formatters shared by the recipient pages, the sidebar and Family home.
// Values match CARE_TYPES / MOBILITY_LEVELS / ALLERGY_SEVERITIES in server/src/constants.js.

const TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Singapore'

export const CARE_TYPES = [
    { value: 'elderly', label: 'Elderly', chip: 'Elderly care' },
    { value: 'pregnancy', label: 'Pregnancy', chip: 'Pregnancy care' },
    { value: 'postpartum', label: 'Postpartum', chip: 'Postpartum care' },
    { value: 'infant', label: 'Infant', chip: 'Infant care' },
    { value: 'injury', label: 'Injury recovery', chip: 'Injury recovery' },
    { value: 'other', label: 'Other', chip: 'Other care' }
]

export const MOBILITY_LEVELS = [
    { value: 'independent', label: 'Independent', chip: 'Independent' },
    { value: 'assisted', label: 'Assisted', chip: 'Assisted mobility' },
    { value: 'wheelchair', label: 'Wheelchair', chip: 'Wheelchair user' },
    { value: 'bedbound', label: 'Bed-bound', chip: 'Bed-bound' }
]

export const ALLERGY_SEVERITIES = ['mild', 'severe']

export function careTypeLabel(value) {
    return CARE_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === value)?.label || 'Other'
}

export function careTypeChip(value) {
    return CARE_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === value)?.chip || 'Other care'
}

export function mobilityLabel(value) {
    return MOBILITY_LEVELS.find((m) => m.value === value)?.label || ''
}

export function mobilityChip(value) {
    return MOBILITY_LEVELS.find((m) => m.value === value)?.chip || ''
}

// What the family calls them, falling back to the full name
export function displayName(recipient) {
    return recipient?.nickname || recipient?.name || ''
}

export function initials(name = '') {
    return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase()
}

// Calendar parts of a date in Singapore time, so ages don't shift near midnight UTC
function sgParts(date) {
    const [year, month, day] = date.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE }).split('-').map(Number)
    return { year, month, day }
}

// "82", or "4 months" for babies under 2
export function ageLabel(dateOfBirth) {
    if (!dateOfBirth) return ''
    const born = sgParts(new Date(dateOfBirth))
    const today = sgParts(new Date())

    let months = (today.year - born.year) * 12 + (today.month - born.month)
    if (today.day < born.day) months -= 1
    if (months < 0) return ''
    if (months < 24) return `${months} ${months === 1 ? 'month' : 'months'}`
    return String(Math.floor(months / 12))
}

export function formatDate(value, options = { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) {
    if (!value) return ''
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { ...options, timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

// YYYY-MM-DD in Singapore time, for grouping and for <input type="date">
export function dateKey(value) {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

FILE: client/src/features/recipients/components/RecipientForm.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Add / edit form for a care recipient. Pass a recipient to edit it; leave it out to create one.
//   <RecipientForm :recipient="recipient" @saved="onSaved" @cancel="close" />
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import ProfilePicturePicker from '../../../components/common/ProfilePicturePicker.vue'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { CARE_TYPES, MOBILITY_LEVELS, ALLERGY_SEVERITIES, dateKey } from '../recipientLabels.js'
import { createRecipient, updateRecipient, getRecipientErrorMessage } from '../services/recipientsApi.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipient: { type: Object, default: null }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['saved', 'cancel'])

const { selectedFamilyId } = useActiveFamily()

const isEdit = computed(() => Boolean(props.recipient))

// ---- Form state, copied from the recipient so Cancel leaves it untouched ----
const source = props.recipient || {}

const profilePicture = ref(source.profilePicture || '')
const name = ref(source.name || '')
const nickname = ref(source.nickname || '')
const dateOfBirth = ref(source.dateOfBirth ? dateKey(source.dateOfBirth) : '')
const careType = ref(source.careType || '')
const mobilityLevel = ref(source.mobility?.level || '')
const mobilityNotes = ref(source.mobility?.notes || '')
const allergies = ref((source.allergies || []).map((a) => ({ name: a.name, severity: a.severity || 'mild' })))
const conditions = ref([...(source.conditions || [])])
const dietaryRestrictions = ref([...(source.dietaryRestrictions || [])])
// startDate and notes aren't shown, but are sent back so an edit doesn't wipe them
const medications = ref((source.medications || []).map((m) => ({
    name: m.name || '',
    dosage: m.dosage || '',
    frequency: m.frequency || '',
    startDate: m.startDate || null,
    notes: m.notes || ''
})))
const emergencyContacts = ref((source.emergencyContacts || []).map((c) => ({
    name: c.name || '',
    relationship: c.relationship || '',
    phone: c.phone || ''
})))
const clinicName = ref(source.preferredClinic?.name || '')
const clinicAddress = ref(source.preferredClinic?.address || '')
const careNotes = ref(source.careNotes || '')
const linkedUser = ref(source.linkedUser?._id || source.linkedUser || '')

const userId = (() => {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user') || '{}').id
    } catch {
        return ''
    }
})()

// You can only link yourself; a link to someone else can only be removed
const isInfant = computed(() => careType.value === 'infant')
const linkedToOther = computed(() => Boolean(linkedUser.value) && linkedUser.value !== userId)
const linkedOtherName = source.linkedUser?.name || 'another family member'
const linkMe = computed({
    get: () => linkedUser.value === userId,
    set: (checked) => { linkedUser.value = checked ? userId : '' }
})

// ---- Chip lists ----
const newAllergy = ref('')
const newAllergySeverity = ref('mild')
const newCondition = ref('')
const newDiet = ref('')

function addAllergy() {
    const value = newAllergy.value.trim()
    if (!value) return
    allergies.value.push({ name: value, severity: newAllergySeverity.value })
    newAllergy.value = ''
    newAllergySeverity.value = 'mild'
}

function addCondition() {
    const value = newCondition.value.trim()
    if (value && !conditions.value.includes(value)) conditions.value.push(value)
    newCondition.value = ''
}

function addDiet() {
    const value = newDiet.value.trim()
    if (value && !dietaryRestrictions.value.includes(value)) dietaryRestrictions.value.push(value)
    newDiet.value = ''
}

function toggleMobility(level) {
    mobilityLevel.value = mobilityLevel.value === level ? '' : level
}

// ---- Saving ----
const isSaving = ref(false)
const errorMessage = ref('')

function buildPayload() {
    const clinic = clinicName.value.trim() || clinicAddress.value.trim()
        ? { ...(source.preferredClinic || {}), name: clinicName.value, address: clinicAddress.value }
        : null

    return {
        profilePicture: profilePicture.value,
        name: name.value,
        nickname: nickname.value,
        careType: careType.value,
        dateOfBirth: dateOfBirth.value || null,
        mobility: mobilityLevel.value || mobilityNotes.value.trim()
            ? { ...(mobilityLevel.value ? { level: mobilityLevel.value } : {}), notes: mobilityNotes.value }
            : null,
        allergies: allergies.value,
        conditions: conditions.value,
        dietaryRestrictions: dietaryRestrictions.value,
        medications: medications.value.filter((m) => m.name.trim()),
        emergencyContacts: emergencyContacts.value.filter((c) => c.name.trim() || c.phone.trim()),
        preferredClinic: clinic,
        careNotes: careNotes.value,
        // Infant profiles are never linked (the server rejects it too)
        linkedUser: isInfant.value ? null : linkedUser.value || null
    }
}

async function save() {
    errorMessage.value = ''

    const missing = []
    if (!name.value.trim()) missing.push('Full name is required.')
    if (!careType.value) missing.push('Choose a care type.')
    if (missing.length) {
        errorMessage.value = missing.join(' ')
        return
    }

    isSaving.value = true
    try {
        const payload = buildPayload()
        const saved = isEdit.value
            ? await updateRecipient(selectedFamilyId.value, props.recipient._id, payload)
            : await createRecipient(selectedFamilyId.value, payload)
        emit('saved', saved)
    } catch (error) {
        errorMessage.value = getRecipientErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isSaving.value = false
    }
}
</script>

<template>
    <form class="recipient-form" novalidate @submit.prevent="save">
        <ProfilePicturePicker v-model="profilePicture" :care-type="careType" :disabled="isSaving" />
        <div class="row g-3">
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <label class="field-label" for="recipient-name">Full name</label>
                <input id="recipient-name" v-model="name" class="form-control" maxlength="100"
                    placeholder="e.g. Lim Siew Lan" required>
            </div>
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <label class="field-label" for="recipient-nickname">What the family calls them</label>
                <input id="recipient-nickname" v-model="nickname" class="form-control" maxlength="50"
                    placeholder="e.g. Grandma">
            </div>
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <label class="field-label" for="recipient-dob">Date of birth</label>
                <input id="recipient-dob" v-model="dateOfBirth" type="date" class="form-control"
                    :max="dateKey(new Date())">
            </div>
        </div>

        <fieldset>
            <legend class="field-label">Care type</legend>
            <div class="chip-options">
                <button v-for="type in CARE_TYPES" :key="type.value" type="button" class="chip-option"
                    :class="{ selected: careType === type.value }" :aria-pressed="careType === type.value"
                    @click="careType = type.value">
                    {{ type.label }}
                </button>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset>
            <legend class="field-label">Mobility</legend>
            <div class="chip-options mb-2">
                <button v-for="level in MOBILITY_LEVELS" :key="level.value" type="button" class="chip-option"
                    :class="{ selected: mobilityLevel === level.value }" :aria-pressed="mobilityLevel === level.value"
                    @click="toggleMobility(level.value)">
                    {{ level.label }}
                </button>
            </div>
            <input v-model="mobilityNotes" class="form-control" maxlength="300" aria-label="Mobility notes"
                placeholder="Notes, e.g. walking stick, avoid stairs">
        </fieldset>

<script setup>
// Owner: Jhen (C)
// RecipientForm in a plain Vue overlay (no Bootstrap JS). Closes on Cancel, Escape
// and a successful save; emits "updated" with the saved recipient.
//   <RecipientFormModal v-if="editing" :recipient="recipient" @updated="replace" @close="editing = false" />
import { onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import RecipientForm from './RecipientForm.vue'
import { useRecipients } from '../../../composables/useRecipients.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipient: { type: Object, default: null }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['updated', 'close'])

const { refresh } = useRecipients()

function onSaved(recipient) {
    refresh()
    emit('updated', recipient)
    emit('close')
}

function onKeydown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') emit('close')
}

onMounted(() => {
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
})

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
    document.body.style.overflow = ''
})
</script>

<template>
    <div class="modal-overlay" @click.self="emit('close')">
        <section class="modal-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="recipient-modal-title">
            <header class="modal-header-row">
                <h2 id="recipient-modal-title">{{ props.recipient ? 'Edit care recipient' : 'Add care recipient' }}</h2>
                <button type="button" class="close-button" aria-label="Close" @click="emit('close')">
                    <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>
            </header>

            <RecipientForm :recipient="props.recipient" @saved="onSaved" @cancel="emit('close')" />
        </section>
    </div>
</template>

]

    return parts.join(' Â· ')
})

FILE: client/src/features/recipients/services/recipientsApi.js

// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Calls to /api/families/:familyId/recipients. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section C).
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'

function authHeaders() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
}

function recipientsUrl(familyId, recipientId = '') {
    return `/families/${familyId}/recipients${recipientId ? `/${recipientId}` : ''}`
}

// Get the family's care recipients, sorted by name.
// filters (optional): { includeArchived: true }
export async function getRecipients(familyId, filters = {}) {
    const response = await http.get(recipientsUrl(familyId), {
        headers: authHeaders(),
        params: filters
    })

    return response.data.recipients
}

export async function getRecipient(familyId, recipientId) {
    const response = await http.get(recipientsUrl(familyId, recipientId), { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.recipient
}

export async function createRecipient(familyId, recipient) {
    const response = await http.post(recipientsUrl(familyId), recipient, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.recipient
}

export async function updateRecipient(familyId, recipientId, changes) {
    const response = await http.patch(recipientsUrl(familyId, recipientId), changes, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.recipient
}

// Admin only. Recipients are archived, never deleted.
export async function archiveRecipient(familyId, recipientId) {
    const response = await http.post(`${recipientsUrl(familyId, recipientId)}/archive`, null, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.recipient
}

// Recipient errors come back as { error, errors? }, like tasks
export function getRecipientErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    }

    const data = error.response?.data

    if (data?.errors?.length) {
        return data.errors.join(' ')
    }

    return (
        data?.error ||
        error.message ||

// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Recipient hub shell at /recipients/:recipientId. Gets the recipient from the query cache
// and passes it to the tab views (Overview, Tasks, Profile) so they don't fetch it again.
import { computed, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { useRecipient } from '../../../composables/useRecipients.js'
import RecipientHubHeader from '../components/RecipientHubHeader.vue'
import { displayName } from '../recipientLabels.js'

const router = useRouter()
const { selectedFamilyId } = useActiveFamily()

const recipientId = computed(() => route.params.recipientId)

const TAB_LABELS = {
    'recipient-overview': 'Overview',
    'recipient-tasks': 'Tasks',
    'recipient-log': 'Log',
    'recipient-profile': 'Profile'
}

// Cached per recipient: each recipient has its own cache entry, so the previous
// one is never shown while another loads
const { recipient, isLoading: loading, notFound, errorMessage: error, refetch: loadRecipient, setRecipient } =
    useRecipient(recipientId)

// A recipient belongs to one family, so switching family leaves the hub
watch(selectedFamilyId, (newId, oldId) => {
    if (oldId && newId !== oldId) router.push('/home')
})

function replaceRecipient(updated) {
    setRecipient(updated)
}
</script>

                Try again
            </button>
        </div>

<script setup>
// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Hub "Overview" tab: next tasks, latest notes, and what to know before taking them out.
// The hub passes in the loaded recipient. Tasks and notes come from the query cache,
// so coming back to this tab shows them straight away instead of refetching.
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { useFamilyTasks, taskRecipientId } from '../../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
import SectionCard from '../../../components/common/SectionCard.vue'
import TaskList from '../../tasks/components/TaskList.vue'
import { getLogs, getLogErrorMessage } from '../../logs/services/logsApi.js'
import { logTypeLabel } from '../../logs/logTypes.js'
import { displayName, initials, mobilityLabel, formatDate } from '../recipientLabels.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipient: { type: Object, required: true }
})

defineEmits(['updated'])

const route = useRoute()
const { selectedFamilyId } = useActiveFamily()

const recipientId = computed(() => route.params.recipientId)
const name = computed(() => displayName(props.recipient))

// ---- Upcoming tasks (D): next 3 still-active tasks from the family's cached list ----
const ACTIVE_STATUSES = ['open', 'claimed', 'in_progress']
const { tasks: familyTasks, isLoading: tasksLoading, errorMessage: tasksError, refetch: reloadTasks } = useFamilyTasks()

const tasks = computed(() => {
    const now = Date.now()
    return familyTasks.value
        .filter((t) =>
            taskRecipientId(t) === recipientId.value &&
            ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(t.status) &&
            new Date(t.startAt).getTime() >= now
        )
        .slice(0, 3)
})

// ---- Latest notes (F's API): the 2 newest, cached per recipient ----
const LOG_FILTERS = { limit: 2 }
const logsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: computed(() => queryKeys.recipientLogs(selectedFamilyId.value, recipientId.value, LOG_FILTERS)),
    queryFn: ({ queryKey }) => getLogs(queryKey[1], { recipient: queryKey[3], ...LOG_FILTERS }),
    enabled: computed(() => Boolean(selectedFamilyId.value && recipientId.value))
})

const logs = computed(() => logsQuery.data.value ?? [])
const logsLoading = logsQuery.isLoading
const logsError = computed(() =>
    logsQuery.error.value && !logsQuery.data.value ? getLogErrorMessage(logsQuery.error.value) : ''
)

// ---- "Before you take them out" ----
const mobility = computed(() =>
    props.recipient.mobility?.notes || mobilityLabel(props.recipient.mobility?.level)
)
const allergies = computed(() =>
    (props.recipient.allergies || []).map((a) => `${a.name} (${a.severity})`).join(', ')
)
const hasSevereAllergy = computed(() =>
    (props.recipient.allergies || []).some((a) => a.severity === 'severe')
)
const conditions = computed(() => (props.recipient.conditions || []).join(', '))
const diet = computed(() => (props.recipient.dietaryRestrictions || []).join(', '))
const medications = computed(() => props.recipient.medications || [])
const contact = computed(() => props.recipient.emergencyContacts?.[0] || null)

const hasEssentials = computed(() =>
    Boolean(mobility.value || allergies.value || conditions.value || diet.value || medications.value.length || contact.value)
)
</script>

<template>
    <div class="row g-4">
        <div class="col-lg-8 d-flex flex-column gap-4">
            <SectionCard title="Upcoming">
                <template #actions>
                    <RouterLink class="card-link" :to="{ name: 'recipient-tasks', params: { recipientId } }">
                        See all tasks <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </RouterLink>
                </template>
                <TaskList :tasks="tasks" :is-loading="tasksLoading" :error-message="tasksError"
                    :empty-message="`Nothing coming up for ${name}.`" @retry="reloadTasks" />
            </SectionCard>

            <SectionCard title="Latest notes">
                <template #actions>
                    <RouterLink class="card-link" :to="{ name: 'recipient-log', params: { recipientId } }">
                        Open log <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </RouterLink>
                </template>

                <div v-if="logsLoading" class="list-status" role="status">
                    <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-success" aria-hidden="true"></div>
                    Loading notes...
                </div>

                <div v-else-if="logsError" class="list-status is-error" role="alert">
                    <span>{{ logsError }}</span>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" @click="logsQuery.refetch()">
                        Try again

                            </div>

                        </div>
                    </li>
                </ul>
            </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <div class="col-lg-4">
            <SectionCard :title="`Before you take ${name} out`">
                <p v-if="!hasEssentials" class="list-status">
                    Nothing noted yet. Add details from the Profile tab.
                </p>

                <dl v-else class="essentials">
                    <div v-if="mobility">
                        <dt>Mobility</dt>
                        <dd>{{ mobility }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="allergies">
                        <dt>Allergies</dt>
                        <dd :class="{ 'is-alert': hasSevereAllergy }">{{ allergies }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="conditions">
                        <dt>Conditions</dt>
                        <dd>{{ conditions }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="diet">
                        <dt>Diet</dt>
                        <dd>{{ diet }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="medications.length">
                        <dt>Medications</dt>
                        <dd>
                            <ul class="medication-list">
                                <li v-for="(medication, index) in medications" :key="index">
                                    <strong>{{ [medication.name, medication.dosage].filter(Boolean).join(' ') }}</strong>
                                    <span v-if="medication.frequency">{{ medication.frequency }}</span>
                                </li>
                            </ul>
                        </dd>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="contact">
                        <dt>Emergency contact</dt>
                        <dd>
                            {{ contact.name }}<template v-if="contact.relationship"> ({{ contact.relationship.toLowerCase() }})</template>
                            Â· <a :href="`tel:${contact.phone}`">{{ contact.phone }}</a>

        </div>
    </div>

<script setup>
// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Hub "Profile" tab: every detail about the recipient in three columns of cards.
// Each "Edit" opens the recipient form; admins can also archive the recipient here.
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { useRecipients } from '../../../composables/useRecipients.js'
import SectionCard from '../../../components/common/SectionCard.vue'
import RecipientFormModal from '../components/RecipientFormModal.vue'
import { archiveRecipient, getRecipientErrorMessage } from '../services/recipientsApi.js'
import { careTypeLabel, mobilityLabel, ageLabel, formatDate, initials } from '../recipientLabels.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipient: { type: Object, required: true }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['updated'])

const router = useRouter()
const { selectedFamilyId, selectedFamily } = useActiveFamily()
const { refresh } = useRecipients()

function readUser() {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user') || '{}')
    } catch {
        return {}
    }
}
const user = readUser()

// Same check as FamilySidebar.vue's userRole
const isAdmin = computed(() =>
    selectedFamily.value?.members?.find((member) => member.userId === user.id)?.role === 'admin'
)

function memberName(userId) {
    return selectedFamily.value?.members?.find((member) => member.userId === userId)?.name || 'a family member'
}

const dateOfBirth = computed(() => {
    if (!props.recipient.dateOfBirth) return ''
    const age = ageLabel(props.recipient.dateOfBirth)
    return `${formatDate(props.recipient.dateOfBirth)}${age ? ` (${age})` : ''}`
})

// Most recent medication change, for "Updated by â€¦ Â· date"
const lastMedicationUpdate = computed(() => {
    const stamped = (props.recipient.medications || []).filter((m) => m.updatedBy && m.updatedAt)
    if (!stamped.length) return null
    const latest = stamped.reduce((a, b) => (new Date(a.updatedAt) > new Date(b.updatedAt) ? a : b))
    return `Updated by ${memberName(latest.updatedBy)} Â· ${formatDate(latest.updatedAt, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}`
})

const clinic = computed(() => props.recipient.preferredClinic)

const editing = ref(false)

// ---- Archive (admin only) ----
const isArchiving = ref(false)
const archiveError = ref('')

async function archive() {
    if (!window.confirm(`Archive ${props.recipient.nickname || props.recipient.name}? They'll be hidden from the family's lists. Their tasks and notes are kept.`)) return

    isArchiving.value = true
    archiveError.value = ''
    try {
        await archiveRecipient(selectedFamilyId.value, props.recipient._id)
        await refresh()
        router.push('/home')
    } catch (error) {
        archiveError.value = getRecipientErrorMessage(error)
    } finally {
        isArchiving.value = false
    }
}
</script>

<template>
    <div>
        <div class="row g-4">
            <div class="col-lg-4 d-flex flex-column gap-4">
                <SectionCard title="Basic info" class="profile-card">
                    <template #actions>
                        <button type="button" class="edit-link" @click="editing = true">Edit</button>
                    </template>
                    <dl class="info-rows">
                        <div>
                            <dt>Full name</dt>
                            <dd>{{ recipient.name }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div v-if="recipient.nickname">
                            <dt>Called</dt>
                            <dd>{{ recipient.nickname }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div v-if="dateOfBirth">
                            <dt>Date of birth</dt>
                            <dd>{{ dateOfBirth }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <dt>Care type</dt>
                            <dd>{{ careTypeLabel(recipient.careType) }}</dd>
                        </div>
                    </dl>
                </SectionCard>

                <SectionCard title="Mobility" class="profile-card">
                    <template #actions>
                        <button type="button" class="edit-link" @click="editing = true">Edit</button>
                    </template>
                    <template v-if="recipient.mobility?.level || recipient.mobility?.notes">
                        <span v-if="recipient.mobility?.level" class="chip chip-green">
                            {{ mobilityLabel(recipient.mobility.level) }}
                        </span>
                        <p v-if="recipient.mobility?.notes" class="card-text mt-2">{{ recipient.mobility.notes }}</p>
                    </template>
                    <p v-else class="empty-text">Not added yet.</p>
                </SectionCard>

                <SectionCard v-if="recipient.linkedUser" title="Linked account" class="profile-card">
                    <p class="card-text">
                        <i class="bi bi-person-check text-success" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        Has a CareCircle account: <strong>{{ recipient.linkedUser.name }}</strong>
                    </p>
                    <RouterLink :to="{ name: 'public-profile', params: { userId: recipient.linkedUser._id || recipient.linkedUser.id } }">View account profile</RouterLink>
                </SectionCard>
            </div>

            <div class="col-lg-4 d-flex flex-column gap-4">
                <SectionCard title="Allergies and conditions" class="profile-card">
                    <template #actions>
                        <button type="button" class="edit-link" @click="editing = true">Edit</button>
                    </template>
                    <div v-if="recipient.allergies?.length" class="chip-row">
                        <span v-for="allergy in recipient.allergies" :key="allergy.name" class="chip"
                            :class="allergy.severity === 'severe' ? 'chip-coral' : 'chip-muted'">
                            {{ allergy.name }} Â· {{ allergy.severity }}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="recipient.conditions?.length" class="chip-row">
                        <span v-for="condition in recipient.conditions" :key="condition" class="chip chip-muted">

FILE: client/src/features/recipients/views/RecipientTasksView.vue
