<script setup>
// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Hub "Tasks" tab: this recipient's tasks grouped by day, with status filter chips
// and a "this week" summary. Reads the family's cached task list (shared with
// Overview and Family home) and filters it here, so switching tabs doesn't refetch.
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import SectionCard from '../../../components/common/SectionCard.vue'
import TaskList from '../../tasks/components/TaskList.vue'
import RecurringSeriesPanel from '../../tasks/components/RecurringSeriesPanel.vue'
import { useFamilyTasks, taskRecipientId } from '../../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js'
import { displayName, dateKey, formatDate } from '../recipientLabels.js'

const props = defineProps({
    recipient: { type: Object, required: true }
})

defineEmits(['updated'])

const route = useRoute()

const recipientId = computed(() => route.params.recipientId)
const name = computed(() => displayName(props.recipient))

const { tasks: familyTasks, isLoading: tasksLoading, errorMessage: tasksError, refetch: reloadTasks } = useFamilyTasks()
const tasks = computed(() => familyTasks.value.filter((t) => taskRecipientId(t) === recipientId.value))

// ---- Filter chips ----
const FILTERS = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', statuses: null },
    { value: 'open', label: 'Needs someone', statuses: ['open'] },
    { value: 'claimed', label: 'Claimed', statuses: ['claimed', 'in_progress'] },
    { value: 'completed', label: 'Completed', statuses: ['completed'] },
    { value: 'repeating', label: 'Repeating', statuses: null }
]

const filter = ref('all')

function matches(task, filterValue) {
    if (filterValue === 'repeating') return !!task.recurringSeries && !task.recurrenceDetached
    const statuses = FILTERS.find((f) => f.value === filterValue)?.statuses
    return !statuses || statuses.includes(task.status)
}

const counts = computed(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(FILTERS.map((f) => [f.value, tasks.value.filter((t) => matches(t, f.value)).length]))
)

const shownTasks = computed(() => tasks.value.filter((t) => matches(t, filter.value)))

// ---- Group by day: today and later in date order, then "Earlier" (newest first) ----
const groups = computed(() => {
    const today = dateKey(new Date())
    const byDay = new Map()
    const earlier = []

    for (const task of shownTasks.value) {
        const key = dateKey(task.startAt)
        if (key < today) {
            earlier.push(task)
            continue
        }
        if (!byDay.has(key)) {
            const label = formatDate(task.startAt, { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).toUpperCase()
            byDay.set(key, { key, label: key === today ? `TODAY Â· ${label}` : label, tasks: [] })
        }
        byDay.get(key).tasks.push(task)
    }

    const result = [...byDay.values()]
    if (earlier.length) result.push({ key: 'earlier', label: 'EARLIER', tasks: earlier.reverse() })
    return result
})

const emptyMessage = computed(() =>
    filter.value === 'all' ? `No tasks for ${name.value} yet.` : 'No tasks with this status.'
)

// ---- This week: the next 7 days, cancelled tasks left out ----
const week = computed(() => {
    const now = Date.now()
    const end = now + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
    const upcoming = tasks.value.filter((t) => {
        const start = new Date(t.startAt).getTime()
        return start >= now && start <= end && t.status !== 'cancelled'
    })
    return {
        total: upcoming.length,
        open: upcoming.filter((t) => t.status === 'open').length,
        transit: upcoming.filter((t) => t.needsTransit).length
    }
})
</script>

<template>
    <div class="row g-4">
        <div class="col-lg-8">
            <div class="filter-bar" role="group" aria-label="Filter tasks by status">
                <button v-for="option in FILTERS" :key="option.value" type="button" class="filter-chip"
                    :class="{ selected: filter === option.value }" :aria-pressed="filter === option.value"
                    @click="filter = option.value">
                    {{ option.label }} Â· {{ counts[option.value] }}
                </button>
            </div>

            <RecurringSeriesPanel v-if="tasks.some(task => task.recurringSeries)" :tasks="tasks" :recipient-id="recipientId" />
            <TaskList v-if="tasksLoading || tasksError || shownTasks.length === 0" :tasks="shownTasks"
                :is-loading="tasksLoading" :error-message="tasksError" :empty-message="emptyMessage"
                @retry="reloadTasks" />

            <div v-else class="task-groups">
                <section v-for="group in groups" :key="group.key" class="task-group">
                    <h2 class="group-heading">{{ group.label }}</h2>
                    <TaskList :tasks="group.tasks" />
                </section>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-lg-4">
            <SectionCard :title="`This week for ${name}`">
                <dl class="week-stats">
                    <div>
                        <dt>Tasks</dt>
                        <dd>{{ week.total }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <dt>Needs someone</dt>
                        <dd :class="{ 'is-alert': week.open }">{{ week.open }}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <dt>Trips needing transport</dt>
                        <dd>{{ week.transit }}</dd>
                    </div>
                </dl>
            </SectionCard>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<style scoped>

    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

    padding: 6px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--theme-border, #E4ECE5);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--theme-panel, white);
    color: var(--theme-text, #2F2F2F);
    font-size: 12px;

FILE: client/src/features/search/__tests__/searchFormat.spec.js

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
import HighlightText from '../components/HighlightText.vue'
import { highlightParts, dayLabel, describeResult, resultLink, flattenResults } from '../searchFormat.js'

// 10:00 on Thu 29 Oct 2026, Singapore time
const now = new Date('2026-10-29T10:00:00+08:00')

describe('search formatting', () => {
    it('splits every match without treating the word as a pattern', () => {
        expect(highlightParts('Eye check-up for the eye', 'eye')).toEqual([
            { text: 'Eye', match: true },
            { text: ' check-up for the ', match: false },
            { text: 'eye', match: true }
        ])
        expect(highlightParts('Costs $5 (cash)', '(cash)')).toEqual([
            { text: 'Costs $5 ', match: false },
            { text: '(cash)', match: true }
        ])
        expect(highlightParts('anything', '.*')).toEqual([{ text: 'anything', match: false }])
    })

    it('renders highlights as text, never as HTML', () => {
        const wrapper = mount(HighlightText, { props: { text: '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> eye drops', query: 'eye' } })
        expect(wrapper.find('img').exists()).toBe(false)
        expect(wrapper.find('mark').text()).toBe('eye')
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>')
    })

    it('labels task days like the Figma lead tile', () => {
        expect(dayLabel('2026-10-29T15:00:00+08:00', now)).toBe('TODAY')
        expect(dayLabel('2026-10-31T09:00:00+08:00', now)).toBe('SAT')
        expect(dayLabel('2026-10-14T09:00:00+08:00', now)).toBe('14 OCT')
    })

    it('describes care log rows by type', () => {
        const base = { id: 'l1', createdAt: '2026-10-14T03:00:00Z', recipient: { id: 'r1', name: 'Grandpa' }, author: { id: 'u1', name: 'Jasmine' }, snippet: 'continue the eye drops' }
        expect(describeResult('log', { ...base, type: 'consultation', doctorName: 'Dr Lim' }).title).toBe('Consultation Â· Dr Lim')
        expect(describeResult('log', { ...base, type: 'consultation' }).lead.text).toBe('Dr')
        const medication = describeResult('log', { ...base, type: 'medication_change', medication: { name: 'Eye drops', change: 'added', details: '2 drops' } })
        expect([medication.title, medication.lead.text]).toEqual(['Medication added Â· Eye drops', 'Rx'])
        expect(describeResult('log', { ...base, type: 'general' }).title).toBe('Note from Jasmine')
    })

    it('links each kind of result to its page', () => {
        expect(resultLink('task', { id: 't1' }, 'f1')).toEqual({ name: 'task-detail', params: { familyId: 'f1', taskId: 't1' } })
        expect(resultLink('log', { id: 'l1', recipient: { id: 'r1' } })).toEqual({ name: 'recipient-log', params: { recipientId: 'r1' }, hash: '#log-l1' })
        expect(resultLink('person', { id: 'r1', kind: 'recipient' }).name).toBe('recipient-overview')
        expect(resultLink('person', { id: 'u1', kind: 'member' }).name).toBe('public-profile')
        expect(resultLink('place', { name: 'TTSH Eye Centre' })).toEqual({ name: 'search', query: { q: 'TTSH Eye Centre', type: 'tasks' } })
    })

    it('flattens results for the page: tiers first, or by date', () => {
        const results = {
            tasks: [{ id: 't1', matchTier: 2, startAt: '2026-10-01' }],
            logs: [{ id: 'l1', matchTier: 0, createdAt: '2026-10-20' }],
            people: [],
            places: [{ name: 'Clinic', matchTier: 1 }]
        }
        expect(flattenResults(results, ['tasks', 'logs', 'places']).map((row) => row.key)).toEqual(['log-l1', 'place-Clinic', 'task-t1'])
        expect(flattenResults(results, ['tasks', 'logs', 'places'], 'newest').map((row) => row.key)).toEqual(['log-l1', 'task-t1', 'place-Clinic'])
        expect(flattenResults(results, ['logs']).map((row) => row.key)).toEqual(['log-l1'])
    })
})

FILE: client/src/features/search/composables/useFamilySearch.js
================================================
// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Search state shared by the search bar dropdown and the search page.
//
//   const search = useFamilySearch({ limit: 5 })
//   search.q.value = 'eye'            // searches 250ms after typing stops
//   search.filters.when = 'upcoming'  // filters search straight away
//   search.state.value                // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'results' | 'empty' | 'error'
//
// The family is the one selected in the sidebar (useFamilyWorkspace). An older request
// is cancelled when a newer one starts, so results never arrive out of order.
import { ref, reactive, computed, watch, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { useFamilyWorkspace } from '../../family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js'
import { searchFamily, getSearchErrorMessage } from '../services/searchApi.js'

export const MIN_QUERY = 2
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 250

export function useFamilySearch({ limit = 5, q: initialQuery = '', filters: initialFilters = {} } = {}) {
    const { selectedFamilyId } = useFamilyWorkspace()

    const q = ref(initialQuery)
    const filters = reactive({ recipient: '', when: 'any', status: 'any', sort: 'best', ...initialFilters })
    const data = ref(null)
    const errorMessage = ref('')
    const isLoading = ref(false)

    const trimmed = computed(() => q.value.trim())
    const isIdle = computed(() => trimmed.value.length < MIN_QUERY)

    const state = computed(() => {
        if (isIdle.value) return 'idle'
        if (errorMessage.value) return 'error'
        // While typing, the previous results stay up until the new ones arrive
        if (!data.value) return 'loading'
        return data.value.counts.all ? 'results' : 'empty'
    })

    let timer = null
    let controller = null

    function cancel() {
        clearTimeout(timer)
        controller?.abort()
        controller = null
    }

    async function run() {
        cancel()
        const familyId = selectedFamilyId.value
        if (isIdle.value || !familyId) return

        controller = new AbortController()
        const { signal } = controller
        isLoading.value = true
        errorMessage.value = ''
        try {
            const result = await searchFamily(familyId, {
                q: trimmed.value,
                limit,
                recipient: filters.recipient,
                when: filters.when === 'any' ? '' : filters.when,
                status: filters.status === 'any' ? '' : filters.status,
                sort: filters.sort === 'best' ? '' : filters.sort
            }, { signal })
            if (signal.aborted) return
            data.value = result
            isLoading.value = false
        } catch (error) {
            if (axios.isCancel(error) || signal.aborted) return
            errorMessage.value = getSearchErrorMessage(error)
            isLoading.value = false
        }
    }

    // Typing: wait until it stops. Keep showing the last results meanwhile, so they don't flash.
    watch(trimmed, () => {
        cancel()
        errorMessage.value = ''
        if (isIdle.value) {
            data.value = null
            isLoading.value = false
            return
        }
        isLoading.value = true
        timer = setTimeout(run, DEBOUNCE_MS)
    })

    // Filters and switching family: search again straight away
    watch([() => ({ ...filters }), selectedFamilyId], () => {
        data.value = null
        run()
    }, { deep: true })

    onBeforeUnmount(cancel)

    function clear() {
        cancel()
        q.value = ''
    }

    if (!isIdle.value) run()

    return {
        q,
        filters,
        data,
        state,
        isLoading,
        errorMessage,
        counts: computed(() => data.value?.counts ?? { all: 0, tasks: 0, logs: 0, people: 0, places: 0 }),
        results: computed(() => data.value?.results ?? { tasks: [], logs: [], people: [], places: [] }),
        retry: run,
        clear
    }
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Calls to /api/families/:familyId/search.
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'

function authHeaders() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
}

// Search the family's tasks, care log notes, people and places.
// params: { q, type?, recipient?, when?, status?, sort?, limit? } (empty values are left out)
// options.signal: an AbortSignal, so an older search can be cancelled
// Returns { query, counts: { all, tasks, logs, people, places }, results: { tasks, logs, people, places } }
export async function searchFamily(familyId, params, { signal } = {}) {
    const query = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(params).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '')
    )

    const response = await http.get(
        `/families/${familyId}/search`,
        { headers: authHeaders(), params: query, signal }
    )

    return response.data
}

export function getSearchErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    }

    return (
        error.response?.data?.error ||
        'Search is unavailable right now. Please try again.'
    )
}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { mount, RouterLinkStub } from '@vue/test-utils'
import FamilyMembersCard from '../components/FamilyMembersCard.vue'

const member = (id, name, role) => ({ user: { _id: id, name, email: `${id}@example.test`, preferredLang: 'en' }, role })
const alex = member('alex', 'Alex Tan', 'admin')
const jasmine = member('jasmine', 'Jasmine', 'admin')
function render(members = [alex, jasmine], extra = {}) {
  return mount(FamilyMembersCard, { attachTo: document.body, props: { members, userId: 'alex', isAdmin: true, ...extra }, global: { stubs: { RouterLink: RouterLinkStub } } })
}
const action = (wrapper, text) => wrapper.findAll('button').find(button => button.text() === text)

describe('Family member management', () => {
  it('offers admins a role action and emits the selected member and new role', async () => {
    const wrapper = render()
    await wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Manage Jasmine"]').trigger('click')
    await action(wrapper, 'Change to member').trigger('click')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('change-role')[0]).toEqual([jasmine, 'member'])
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Change to member')
  })

  it('closes the menu when the user clicks elsewhere on the page', async () => {
    const wrapper = render()
    const toggle = wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Manage Jasmine"]')
    await toggle.trigger('click')
    expect(toggle.attributes('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
    document.body.dispatchEvent(new Event('pointerdown', { bubbles: true }))
    await wrapper.vm.$nextTick()
    expect(toggle.attributes('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Change to member')
  })

  it('closes on Escape and returns focus to the menu button', async () => {
    const wrapper = render()
    const toggle = wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Manage Jasmine"]')
    await toggle.trigger('click')
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }))
    await wrapper.vm.$nextTick()
    expect(toggle.attributes('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(toggle.element)
  })

  it('prevents the last admin from being demoted or removed', async () => {
    const wrapper = render([alex, member('may', 'Aunt May', 'member')])
    await wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Manage Alex Tan"]').trigger('click')
    expect(action(wrapper, 'Change to member').element.disabled).toBe(true)
    expect(action(wrapper, 'Leave family').element.disabled).toBe(true)
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('At least one admin must stay.')
  })

  it('does not expose admin controls to an ordinary member', () => {
    const wrapper = render([alex, jasmine], { isAdmin: false })
    expect(wrapper.findAll('button[aria-label^="Manage"]')).toHaveLength(0)
    expect(action(wrapper, 'Invite member').element.disabled).toBe(true)
  })

  it('renders an error with a retry action instead of an empty list', async () => {
    const wrapper = render([], { error: 'Unable to load members' })
    expect(wrapper.get('[role="alert"]').text()).toContain('Unable to load members')
    await action(wrapper, 'Try again').trigger('click')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('retry')).toHaveLength(1)
  })
})

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import SectionCard from '../../../components/common/SectionCard.vue'
import CareAvatar from '../../../components/common/CareAvatar.vue'
import { useDismissibleMenu } from '../../../composables/useDismissibleMenu.js'
const props = defineProps({
  members: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  userId: { type: String, default: '' },
  isAdmin: Boolean,
  loading: Boolean,
  busy: Boolean,
  error: { type: String, default: '' },
})
const emit = defineEmits(['invite', 'change-role', 'remove', 'retry'])
const openMenu = ref('')
const menuNodes = ref([])
useDismissibleMenu(
  () => menuNodes.value.find(node => node.dataset.memberId === openMenu.value),
  () => { openMenu.value = '' },
)
const adminCount = computed(
  () => props.members.filter((member) => member.role === 'admin').length,
)
const languages = {
  en: 'English',
  zh: '中文',
  ms: 'Bahasa Melayu',
  ta: 'தமிழ்',
}
function changeRole(member) {
  emit('change-role', member, member.role === 'admin' ? 'member' : 'admin')
  openMenu.value = ''
}
function removeMember(member) {
  emit('remove', member)
  openMenu.value = ''
}
</script>
<template>
  <SectionCard :title="`Members · ${members.length}`" class="care-members-card">
    <template #actions>
      <button
        class="care-button"
        :disabled="!isAdmin || busy"
        @click="$emit('invite')"
      >
        Invite member
      </button>
    </template>
    <div v-if="loading" class="care-status" role="status">
      Loading family members…
    </div>
    <div v-else-if="error && !members.length" class="care-error" role="alert">
      {{ error }}
      <button class="care-text-button" @click="$emit('retry')">
        Try again
      </button>
    </div>
    <p v-else-if="!members.length" class="care-muted care-small">
      No members to show.
    </p>
    <ul v-else class="care-member-list">
      <li v-for="member in members" :key="member.user._id">
        <CareAvatar :person="member.user" size="small" />
        <div class="care-member-info">
          <strong>
            <RouterLink :to="{ name: 'public-profile', params: { userId: member.user._id } }">{{ member.user.name }}</RouterLink>
            <span v-if="member.user._id === userId">(you)</span>
          </strong>
          <p>
            <template v-if="member.relationship">
              {{ member.relationship }} ·
            </template>
            {{ member.user.email }}
          </p>
        </div>
        <span class="care-pill care-pill--neutral care-member-language">
          {{ languages[member.user.preferredLang] || 'English' }}
        </span>
        <span
          class="care-pill"
          :class="
            member.role === 'admin' ? 'care-pill--green' : 'care-pill--neutral'
          "
        >
          {{ member.role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'Member' }}
        </span>
        <div v-if="isAdmin" ref="menuNodes" :data-member-id="member.user._id" class="care-member-menu">
          <button
            class="care-icon-button"
            :aria-label="`Manage ${member.user.name}`"
            :aria-expanded="openMenu === member.user._id"
            :disabled="busy"
            @click="
              openMenu = openMenu === member.user._id ? '' : member.user._id
            "
          >
            <i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
          <div v-if="openMenu === member.user._id" class="care-member-popover">
            <button
              :disabled="busy || (member.role === 'admin' && adminCount === 1)"
              @click="changeRole(member)"
            >
              {{ member.role === 'admin' ? 'Change to member' : 'Make admin' }}
            </button>
            <button
              class="care-danger-text"
              :disabled="busy || (member.role === 'admin' && adminCount === 1)"
              @click="removeMember(member)"
            >
              {{
                member.user._id === userId
                  ? 'Leave family'
                  : 'Remove from family'
              }}
            </button>
            <p v-if="member.role === 'admin' && adminCount === 1">
              At least one admin must stay.
            </p>
            <button @click="openMenu = ''">Close</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <p v-if="!isAdmin" class="care-muted care-small mt-3 mb-0">
      Admins can invite members and manage roles.
    </p>
  </SectionCard>
</template>

async function copy(code) {
  error.value = ''

FILE: client/src/features/settings/components/MobileInviteCodeCard.vue

<script setup>
import { onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'
const props = defineProps({
  code: { type: String, default: '' },
  familyName: { type: String, default: 'Your family' },
  isAdmin: Boolean,
  preview: Boolean,
  busy: Boolean,
})
defineEmits(['regenerate'])
const copied = ref(false),
  sharing = ref(false),
  error = ref('')
let timer
async function shareCode() {
  if (!props.code || sharing.value) return
  sharing.value = true
  error.value = ''
  try {
    if (!props.preview && typeof navigator.share === 'function') {
      await navigator.share({
        title: `${props.familyName} on CareCircle`,
        text: `Join ${props.familyName} on CareCircle. Invite code: ${props.code}`,
      })
    } else {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code)
      copied.value = true
      clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        copied.value = false
      }, 3000)
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.name !== 'AbortError')
      error.value =
        'Select and copy the code above to share it with your family.'
  } finally {
    sharing.value = false
  }
}
onUnmounted(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>
<template>
  <section class="care-mobile-invite" aria-label="Family invite code">
    <div class="care-mobile-invite-row">
      <div class="care-mobile-invite-copy">
        <h3>INVITE CODE</h3>
        <p>{{ code || 'Unavailable' }}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="care-mobile-invite-actions">
        <button
          class="care-button care-button--primary"
          :disabled="!code || sharing"
          @click="shareCode"
        >
          {{ copied ? 'Copied!' : sharing ? 'Sharingâ€¦' : 'Share' }}
        </button>
        <button
          class="care-button care-mobile-regenerate"
          aria-label="Regenerate invite code"
          :disabled="!isAdmin || busy"
          @click="$emit('regenerate')"
        >
          <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="copied" class="care-mobile-invite-feedback" role="status">
      Invite code copied. Share it with your family.
    </p>
    <p v-if="error" class="care-error care-small" role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
  </section>
</template>

FILE: client/src/features/settings/composables/useAppearance.js
================================================
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'

const choice = ref(readChoice())
function readChoice() {
  try {
    const value = localStorage.getItem('carecircle:appearance')
    return ['light', 'dark', 'system'].includes(value) ? value : 'light'
  } catch {
    return 'light'
  }
}
export function useAppearance() {
  const media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
  const deviceDark = ref(media.matches)
  const theme = computed(() =>
    choice.value === 'system'
      ? deviceDark.value
        ? 'dark'
        : 'light'
      : choice.value,
  )
  function syncDevice(event) {
    deviceDark.value = event.matches
  }
  onMounted(() => media.addEventListener('change', syncDevice))
  onUnmounted(() => media.removeEventListener('change', syncDevice))
  function setAppearance(value) {
    if (!['light', 'dark', 'system'].includes(value)) return
    choice.value = value
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('carecircle:appearance', value)
    } catch {
      /* Keep the in-memory preference. */
    }
  }
  return { appearance: choice, theme, setAppearance }
}

// The app root owns the theme, so routes and dialogs teleported to <body>
// inherit the same palette. Page-level callers only read/change the preference.
export function useAppAppearance() {
  const appearance = useAppearance()
  watch(appearance.theme, theme => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme
    document.documentElement.dataset.bsTheme = theme
  }, { immediate: true, flush: 'sync' })
  function syncStorage(event) {
    if (event.key === 'carecircle:appearance' || event.key === null)
      choice.value = readChoice()
  }
  onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('storage', syncStorage))
  onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('storage', syncStorage))
  return appearance
}

FILE: client/src/features/settings/composables/useFamilySettings.js
================================================
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useFamilyWorkspace } from '../../family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js'
import { previewState } from '../../family/data/previewFamily.js'
import { apiError } from '../../family/services/dashboardApi.js'
import * as api from '../services/settingsApi.js'

export function useFamilySettings() {
  const workspace = useFamilyWorkspace()
  const realMembers = ref([]),
    loading = ref(false),
    membersError = ref(''),
    error = ref(''),
    busy = ref(false),
    feedback = ref(''),
    pendingLanguage = ref('')
  const members = workspace.isPreview
    ? computed(() => previewState.members)
    : realMembers
  const language = computed(() => pendingLanguage.value || workspace.user.value.preferredLang || 'en')
  let version = 0,
    languageVersion = 0
  async function loadMembers() {
    if (workspace.isPreview) return
    const current = ++version,
      familyId = workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    realMembers.value = []
    membersError.value = ''
    loading.value = Boolean(familyId)
    if (!familyId) return
    try {
      const result = await api.getMembers(familyId)
      if (current === version) {
        realMembers.value = result
        syncFamilyMembers()
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (current === version)
        membersError.value = apiError(err, 'Family members')
    } finally {
      if (current === version) loading.value = false
    }
  }
  function syncFamilyMembers() {
    if (!workspace.isPreview && workspace.selectedFamily.value)
      workspace.selectedFamily.value.members = realMembers.value.map(
        (member) => ({ userId: member.user._id, role: member.role }),
      )
  }
  async function changeRole(member, role) {
    const familyId = workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    if (workspace.isPreview) {
      if (!workspace.isAdmin.value)
        throw new Error('Only admins can change roles.')
      if (
        member.role === 'admin' &&
        role === 'member' &&
        members.value.filter((entry) => entry.role === 'admin').length <= 1
      )
        throw new Error('Your family needs at least one admin.')
      member.role = role
    } else {
      const updated = await api.changeMemberRole(
        familyId,
        member.user._id,
        role,
      )
      if (familyId !== workspace.selectedFamilyId.value) return
      const index = realMembers.value.findIndex(
        (entry) => entry.user._id === member.user._id,
      )
      if (index >= 0) realMembers.value[index] = updated
      syncFamilyMembers()
    }
    feedback.value = `${member.user.name} is now ${role === 'admin' ? 'an admin' : 'a member'}.`
  }
  async function deleteMember(member) {
    const familyId = workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    if (workspace.isPreview) {
      if (!workspace.isAdmin.value)
        throw new Error('Only admins can remove other members.')
      if (
        member.role === 'admin' &&
        members.value.filter((entry) => entry.role === 'admin').length <= 1
      )
        throw new Error('Your family needs at least one admin.')
      // Keep the preview account so the sample always remains navigable.
      if (member.user._id === workspace.user.value.id)
        throw new Error(
          'Keep the sample account in this preview. Try removing another member.',
        )
      previewState.members.splice(previewState.members.indexOf(member), 1)
    } else {
      await api.removeMember(familyId, member.user._id)
      if (familyId !== workspace.selectedFamilyId.value) return
      realMembers.value = realMembers.value.filter(
        (entry) => entry.user._id !== member.user._id,
      )
      syncFamilyMembers()
      if (member.user._id === workspace.user.value.id)
        await workspace.loadFamilies()
    }
    feedback.value = `${member.user.name} was removed from the family.`
  }
  async function regenerateCode() {
    const familyId = workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    let code
    if (workspace.isPreview) {
      if (!workspace.isAdmin.value)
        throw new Error('Only admins can regenerate the invite code.')
      code = [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(5))]
        .map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase()
      previewState.family.inviteCode = code
    } else {
      code = await api.regenerateInviteCode(familyId)
      if (familyId !== workspace.selectedFamilyId.value) return
      workspace.selectedFamily.value.inviteCode = code
    }
    feedback.value = 'New invite code ready. The previous code no longer works.'
  }
  async function changeLanguage(value) {
    if (value === language.value) return
    const current = ++languageVersion
    // Keep the user's selection visible while the request is pending. A native
    // select otherwise snaps back when the parent renders its disabled state.
    pendingLanguage.value = value
    try {
      if (workspace.isPreview) {
        const self = previewState.members.find(
          (member) => member.user._id === workspace.user.value.id,
        )
        if (self) self.user.preferredLang = value
      } else {
        const saved = await api.saveLanguage(value)
        workspace.refreshUser()
        updateOwnMember(saved)
      }
      feedback.value = 'Your language preference has been saved.'
    } finally {
      if (current === languageVersion) pendingLanguage.value = ''
    }
  }
  async function changeProfile({ name, phone }) {
    if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 80 || phone.length > 30) {
      throw new Error('Please check your profile details.')
    }
    if (workspace.isPreview) {
      const self = previewState.members.find(
        (member) => member.user._id === workspace.user.value.id,
      )
      if (self) Object.assign(self.user, { name, phone })
    } else {
      const saved = await api.saveProfile({ name, phone })
      workspace.refreshUser()
      updateOwnMember(saved)
    }
    feedback.value = 'Your profile has been saved.'
  }
  function updateOwnMember(profile) {
    // A profile save already returns the latest user. Patch this row in place
    // so changing a preference never blanks/reloads the family member list.
    const member = realMembers.value.find(entry => entry.user._id === profile.id)
    if (member) Object.assign(member.user, profile)
  }
  async function run(action) {
    if (busy.value) return false
    const familyId = workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    busy.value = true
    feedback.value = ''
    error.value = ''
    try {
      await action()
      return familyId === workspace.selectedFamilyId.value
    } catch (err) {
      if (familyId === workspace.selectedFamilyId.value) {
        error.value = apiError(err, 'Family settings')
        if (err.response?.status === 409) await loadMembers()
      }
      return false
    } finally {
      if (familyId === workspace.selectedFamilyId.value) busy.value = false
    }
  }
  watch(
    workspace.selectedFamilyId,
    () => {
      version++
      languageVersion++
      pendingLanguage.value = ''
      busy.value = false
      feedback.value = ''
      error.value = ''
      loadMembers()
    },
    { immediate: true },
  )
  return {
    members,
    membersError,
    loading,
    error,
    busy,
    feedback,
    language,
    loadMembers,
    changeRole,
    deleteMember,
    regenerateCode,
    changeLanguage,
    changeProfile,
    run,
  }
}

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// State for the Telegram card in Family settings, and the "Recent updates" feed on Family Home.
// API calls are in ../services/notificationsApi.js.
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { apiError } from '../../family/services/dashboardApi.js'
import { getNotifications, getNotifySettings, saveNotifyEvents, sendTestMessage, unlinkTelegram } from '../services/notificationsApi.js'

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Switches <-> events
// The settings card has five switches; the server stores event names (EVENTS in server/src/constants.js).
const GROUPS = {
  taskPosted: ['task.created', 'task.updated', 'task.deleted'],
  taskClaimed: ['task.claimed', 'task.unclaimed'],
  transitMilestone: ['transit.milestone'],
  careNote: ['log.created', 'log.updated', 'log.deleted', 'medication.changed'],
  taskCompleted: ['task.started', 'task.completed', 'task.cancelled'],
}
const ALL_EVENTS = Object.values(GROUPS).flat()

// A switch is on only when all of its events are on
const groupsFromEvents = (events) => {
  const on = new Set(events || [])
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(GROUPS).map(([key, list]) => [key, list.every((e) => on.has(e))]))
}
const eventsFromGroups = (state) =>
  Object.entries(GROUPS).filter(([key]) => state[key]).flatMap(([, list]) => list)

// `source` is a ref or a function returning the family id ('' = nothing to load)
const resolve = (source) => (typeof source === 'function' ? source() : source?.value)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Telegram card state
export function useTelegramSettings(source) {
  const loading = ref(false), saving = ref(false), testing = ref(false)
  const error = ref(''), feedback = ref('')
  const linked = ref(false), linkedAt = ref(''), linkedByName = ref(''), botUsername = ref('CareCircleBot')
  const groups = ref(groupsFromEvents(ALL_EVENTS))
  let version = 0

  async function load() {
    const familyId = resolve(source)
    const current = ++version
    error.value = ''
    feedback.value = ''
    linked.value = false
    linkedAt.value = ''
    linkedByName.value = ''
    if (!familyId) {
      loading.value = false
      return
    }
    loading.value = true
    try {
      const data = await getNotifySettings(familyId)
      if (current !== version) return
      linked.value = Boolean(data.telegram.linked)
      linkedAt.value = data.telegram.linkedAt || ''
      linkedByName.value = data.telegram.linkedBy?.name || ''
      if (data.botUsername) botUsername.value = data.botUsername
      groups.value = groupsFromEvents(data.notifyOn)
    } catch (err) {
      if (current === version) error.value = apiError(err, 'Telegram settings')
    } finally {
      if (current === version) loading.value = false
    }
  }

  // Admins only (the server checks too). Flips the switch straight away; puts it back if saving fails.
  async function toggle(key, value) {
    const familyId = resolve(source)
    if (!familyId || saving.value) return
    const previous = { ...groups.value }
    const next = { ...previous, [key]: value }
    groups.value = next
    saving.value = true
    error.value = ''
    feedback.value = ''
    try {
      const saved = await saveNotifyEvents(familyId, eventsFromGroups(next))
      if (familyId !== resolve(source)) return
      groups.value = groupsFromEvents(saved)
      feedback.value = 'Telegram preferences saved.'
    } catch (err) {
      if (familyId === resolve(source)) {
        groups.value = previous
        error.value = apiError(err, 'Telegram settings')
      }
    } finally {
      saving.value = false
    }
  }

  async function sendTest() {
    const familyId = resolve(source)
    if (!familyId || testing.value) return
    testing.value = true
    error.value = ''
    feedback.value = ''
    try {
      await sendTestMessage(familyId)
      if (familyId === resolve(source)) feedback.value = 'Test message sent. Check your Telegram group.'
    } catch (err) {
      if (familyId === resolve(source)) error.value = err.response?.data?.error || apiError(err, 'Telegram settings')
    } finally {
      testing.value = false
    }
  }

  async function unlink() {
    const familyId = resolve(source)
    if (!familyId) return
    error.value = ''
    feedback.value = ''
    try {
      await unlinkTelegram(familyId)
      if (familyId !== resolve(source)) return
      linked.value = false
      linkedAt.value = ''
      linkedByName.value = ''
      feedback.value = 'Telegram group unlinked.'
    } catch (err) {
      if (familyId === resolve(source)) error.value = apiError(err, 'Telegram settings')
    }
  }

  watch(() => resolve(source), load, { immediate: true })
  return { loading, saving, testing, error, feedback, linked, linkedAt, linkedByName, botUsername, groups, toggle, sendTest, unlink }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- "Recent updates" feed
// Polls every 20 s while the tab is visible (no Socket.IO, and the server is serverless).
const SG = 'Asia/Singapore'
const dayKey = (date) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: SG }).format(date)

function whenLabel(value) {
  const date = new Date(value)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return ''
  const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: SG }).format(date)
  if (dayKey(date) === dayKey(new Date())) return time
  return `${new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: SG }).format(date)}, ${time}`
}

export function useRecentNotifications(source, { intervalMs = 20000, limit = 8 } = {}) {
  const items = ref([])
  let version = 0
  let timer

  async function load() {
    const familyId = resolve(source)
    const current = ++version
    if (!familyId) {
      items.value = []
      return
    }
    try {
      const notes = await getNotifications(familyId, limit)
      // Same shape RecentUpdates.vue already expects
      if (current === version) items.value = notes.map((n) => ({ _id: n._id, actor: 'Family', text: n.text, time: whenLabel(n.createdAt) }))
    } catch {
      /* keep the last list; the task board has its own error handling */
    }
  }

  watch(() => resolve(source), () => { items.value = []; load() }, { immediate: true })
  onMounted(() => {
    timer = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load() }, intervalMs)
  })
  onUnmounted(() => clearInterval(timer))
  return { items }
}

FILE: client/src/features/settings/composables/useSettingsAccountActions.js
================================================
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useFamilyWorkspace } from '../../family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js'
import { useActiveFamily } from '../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js'
import { clearUserSession } from '../../auth/services/authApi.js'
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { apiError, authConfig } from '../../family/services/dashboardApi.js'

export function useSettingsAccountActions() {
  const { isPreview } = useFamilyWorkspace()
  const { clearFamilies } = useActiveFamily()
  const router = useRouter()
  const loggingOut = ref(false),
    logoutError = ref('')
  async function logOut() {
    if (loggingOut.value) return
    loggingOut.value = true
    logoutError.value = ''
    try {
      if (!isPreview) {
        const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
        if (token) {
          try {
            await http.post('/auth/logout', {}, authConfig())
          } catch (error) {
            if (error.response?.status !== 401) throw error
          }
          // A late reply for the previous account must not clear a newer login.
          const currentToken = sessionStorage.getItem('token')
          if (currentToken && currentToken !== token) return
        }
        clearUserSession()
        clearFamilies()
      }
      // The isolated sample preview must never revoke a real account's session.
      await router.replace('/login')
    } catch (error) {
      logoutError.value = apiError(error, 'Logging out')
    } finally {
      loggingOut.value = false
    }
  }
  return { loggingOut, logoutError, logOut }
}

import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { authConfig } from '../../family/services/dashboardApi.js'

export async function getNotifySettings(familyId) {
  const { data } = await http.get(`/families/${familyId}/notify-settings`, authConfig())
  if (!Array.isArray(data.notifyOn) || !data.telegram) throw new Error('Invalid notification settings from server.')
  return data // { notifyOn, telegram: { linked, linkedAt, linkedBy }, botUsername }
}
export async function saveNotifyEvents(familyId, notifyOn) {
  const { data } = await http.patch(`/families/${familyId}/notify-settings`, { notifyOn }, authConfig())
  return data.notifyOn
}
export async function sendTestMessage(familyId) {
  await http.post(`/families/${familyId}/notify-settings/test`, {}, authConfig())
}
export async function unlinkTelegram(familyId) {
  await http.delete(`/families/${familyId}/notify-settings/telegram`, authConfig())
}
export async function getNotifications(familyId, limit = 8) {
  const { data } = await http.get(`/families/${familyId}/notifications`, authConfig({ params: { limit } }))
  if (!Array.isArray(data.notifications)) throw new Error('Invalid notification data from server.')
  return data.notifications
}

import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { authConfig } from '../../family/services/dashboardApi.js'

export async function getMembers(familyId) {
  const { data } = await http.get(`/families/${familyId}/members`, authConfig())
  if (!Array.isArray(data.members))
    throw new Error('Invalid member data from server.')
  return data.members
}
export async function changeMemberRole(familyId, userId, role) {
  const { data } = await http.patch(
    `/families/${familyId}/members/${userId}`,
    { role },
    authConfig(),
  )
  return data.member
}
export async function removeMember(familyId, userId) {
  await http.delete(`/families/${familyId}/members/${userId}`, authConfig())
}
export async function regenerateInviteCode(familyId) {
  const { data } = await http.post(
    `/families/${familyId}/invite-code`,
    {},
    authConfig(),
  )
  return data.inviteCode
}
async function updateProfile(changes) {
  // A's current profile endpoint requires a complete profile, not a partial body.
  const config = authConfig()
  const authorization = config.headers.Authorization
  const assertSameSession = () => {
    if (`Bearer ${sessionStorage.getItem('token')}` !== authorization) {
      throw new Error('Your account changed while saving. Please try again.')
    }
  }
  const readProfile = (data) => {
    const profile = data?.user
    if (
      !profile ||
      typeof profile.id !== 'string' ||
      !profile.id ||
      typeof profile.name !== 'string'
    ) {
      throw new Error('Invalid profile data from the server. Please try again.')
    }
    return profile
  }
  const { data: current } = await http.get('/auth/me', config)
  assertSameSession()
  const user = readProfile(current)
  const { data } = await http.patch(
    '/auth/me',
    {
      name: user.name,
      phone: user.phone || '',
      telegramUsername: user.telegramUsername || '',
      isCaretaker: user.isCaretaker ?? false,
      preferredLang: user.preferredLang || 'en',
      ...changes,
    },
    config,
  )
  assertSameSession()
  const saved = readProfile(data)
  if (saved.id !== user.id)
    throw new Error('Invalid profile response. Please try again.')
  sessionStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(saved))
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('carecircle:profile-updated'))
  return saved
}
export function saveLanguage(preferredLang) {
  return updateProfile({ preferredLang })
}
export function saveProfile({ name, phone }) {
  return updateProfile({ name, phone })
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { defineComponent, ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
import TaskRepeatFields from '../components/new-task/TaskRepeatFields.vue'
import RecurringClaimDialog from '../components/RecurringClaimDialog.vue'
import RecurringTaskEditModal from '../components/RecurringTaskEditModal.vue'
import { askRecurringClaim, closeRecurringClaim, recurringClaim } from '../composables/recurringClaimDialog.js'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({ editTask: vi.fn(), invalidateQueries: vi.fn(), cancelQueries: vi.fn() }))
vi.mock('vue-router', () => ({ useRoute: () => ({ fullPath: '/home' }) }))
vi.mock('@tanstack/vue-query', async original => ({ ...await original(), useQueryClient: () => mocks }))
vi.mock('../services/tasksApi.js', () => ({ editTask: mocks.editTask, getTaskErrorMessage: err => err.message }))
const workspace = { selectedFamilyId: ref('family') }
const options = { global: { provide: { [Symbol.for('carecircle:family-workspace')]: workspace } } }
const button = (wrapper, text) => wrapper.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === text)
const task = { _id: 'task', title: 'Therapy', recurringSeries: 'series', startAt: '2026-11-03T06:30:00.000Z', endAt: '2026-11-03T07:30:00.000Z', updatedAt: '2026-11-01T01:00:00.000Z' }
afterEach(() => { closeRecurringClaim(); vi.clearAllMocks() })

describe('recurring task controls', () => {
  it('explains the selected monthly date before a time is entered and updates when it changes', async () => {
    const Host = defineComponent({ components: { TaskRepeatFields }, setup: () => ({ date: ref('2026-10-29'), rule: ref({ frequency: 'none', interval: 1, end: { mode: 'never' } }) }), template: '<TaskRepeatFields v-model="rule" :date="date" />' })
    const wrapper = mount(Host)
    await button(wrapper, 'Every month').trigger('click')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('On the 29th of every month')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('29 October 2026')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Months without a 29th are skipped')
    wrapper.vm.date = '2026-10-15'; await nextTick()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('On the 15th of every month')
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Months without a 29th')
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('offers a weekly schedule with selectable weekdays and end count', async () => {
    const Host = defineComponent({ components: { TaskRepeatFields }, setup: () => ({ rule: ref({ frequency: 'none', end: { mode: 'never' } }) }), template: '<TaskRepeatFields v-model="rule" date="2026-11-03" />' })
    const wrapper = mount(Host)
    await button(wrapper, 'Every 2 weeks').trigger('click')
    await wrapper.get('[aria-label="Fri"]').trigger('click')
    await button(wrapper, 'After a number of times').trigger('click')
    await wrapper.get('input[type=number]').setValue(14)
    expect(wrapper.vm.rule).toMatchObject({ frequency: 'weekly', interval: 2, weekdays: [1, 4], end: { mode: 'after', count: 14 } })
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('defaults to the whole series and resolves only on confirmation', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(RecurringClaimDialog, options)
    const pending = askRecurringClaim(task); await nextTick()
    expect(wrapper.get('input[value=series]').element.checked).toBe(true)
    await button(wrapper, "I'll take it").trigger('click')
    expect(await pending).toBe('series')
    expect(recurringClaim.value).toBe(null)
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('lets members choose next four, cancel, or claim an exception for one date only', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(RecurringClaimDialog, options)
    let pending = askRecurringClaim(task); await nextTick()
    await wrapper.get('input[value=next4]').setValue()
    await button(wrapper, "I'll take it").trigger('click')
    expect(await pending).toBe('next4')
    pending = askRecurringClaim(task); await nextTick()
    await button(wrapper, 'Not now').trigger('click'); expect(await pending).toBe(null)
    expect(await askRecurringClaim({ ...task, recurrenceDetached: true })).toBe('one')
    expect(recurringClaim.value).toBe(null)
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('dismisses a pending claim on family switch', async () => {
    const wrapper = mount(RecurringClaimDialog, options)
    const pending = askRecurringClaim(task); await nextTick()
    workspace.selectedFamilyId.value = 'other'; await nextTick()
    expect(await pending).toBe(null)
    workspace.selectedFamilyId.value = 'family'; wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('submits scoped edits with Singapore times and optimistic version protection', async () => {
    mocks.editTask.mockResolvedValue({ ...task, title: 'Physiotherapy' })
    const wrapper = mount(RecurringTaskEditModal, { props: { task, familyId: 'family' } })
    await wrapper.get('input[maxlength="120"]').setValue('Physiotherapy')
    await wrapper.get('input[type=datetime-local]').setValue('2026-11-03T15:00')
    await wrapper.get('input[value=future]').setValue()
    await wrapper.get('form').trigger('submit'); await flushPromises()
    expect(mocks.editTask).toHaveBeenCalledWith('family', 'task', expect.objectContaining({ title: 'Physiotherapy', scope: 'future', startAt: '2026-11-03T07:00:00.000Z', expectedUpdatedAt: task.updatedAt }))
    expect(mocks.editTask.mock.calls[0][2]).not.toHaveProperty('endAt')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('saved')).toHaveLength(1)
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('restricts exception editing to one date and displays save errors', async () => {
    mocks.editTask.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Only the creator can edit'))
    const wrapper = mount(RecurringTaskEditModal, { props: { task: { ...task, recurrenceDetached: true }, familyId: 'family' } })
    expect(wrapper.findAll('input[type=radio]')).toHaveLength(1)
    await wrapper.get('input[maxlength="120"]').setValue('Change')
    await wrapper.get('form').trigger('submit'); await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.get('[role=alert]').text()).toBe('Only the creator can edit')
    expect(wrapper.emitted('saved')).toBeUndefined()
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
})

FILE: client/src/features/tasks/__tests__/weeklyScheduling.spec.js

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
import { VueQueryPlugin, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { useTaskForm } from '../composables/useTaskForm.js'
import TaskWhenFields from '../components/new-task/TaskWhenFields.vue'
import { recurrenceDates, parseRecurrence, generationHorizon } from '../../../../../shared/recurrence.js'

vi.mock('../../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js', () => ({ useTaskCache: () => ({ upsertTask: vi.fn() }) }))
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())
function setup(options = {}) {
  vi.useFakeTimers(); vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-28T02:00:00Z'))
  const save = vi.fn(async payload => payload)
  const Host = defineComponent({ components: { TaskWhenFields }, setup() { return { form: useTaskForm({ ...options, save }) } }, template: '<TaskWhenFields v-model:date="form.date.value" v-model:start-time="form.startTime.value" v-model:end-time="form.endTime.value" :weekly="form.isWeekly.value" :first-date="form.scheduledDate.value" />' })
  const wrapper = mount(Host, { global: { plugins: [[VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient: new QueryClient() }]] } })
  const form = wrapper.vm.form
  form.title.value = 'School pickup'; form.startTime.value = '14:30'; form.endTime.value = '15:30'
  return { wrapper, form, save }
}
describe('weekly task scheduling shared by desktop and mobile forms', () => {
  it('hides quick dates and submits Monday dates matching the recurrence/calendar', async () => {
    const { wrapper, form, save } = setup()
    form.recurrence.value = { frequency: 'weekly', interval: 1, weekdays: [0], end: { mode: 'after', count: 3 } }
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Tomorrow')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Mon 2 Nov')
    expect(form.date.value).toBe('2026-10-28')
    expect(form.canSubmit.value).toBe(true)
    await form.submit('family')
    const payload = save.mock.calls[0][0]
    expect(payload.startAt).toBe('2026-11-02T06:30:00.000Z')
    expect(payload.endAt).toBe('2026-11-02T07:30:00.000Z')
    const dates = recurrenceDates(parseRecurrence(payload.recurrence, payload.startAt), payload.startAt, payload.endAt, generationHorizon(payload.startAt))
    expect(dates.map(date => date.startAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10))).toEqual(['2026-11-02', '2026-11-09', '2026-11-16'])
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('skips elapsed times today and recalculates when weekdays/time change', () => {
    const { wrapper, form } = setup()
    form.recurrence.value = { frequency: 'weekly', interval: 1, weekdays: [2, 4], end: { mode: 'never' } }
    expect(form.scheduledDate.value).toBe('2026-10-28')
    form.startTime.value = '09:00'
    expect(form.scheduledDate.value).toBe('2026-10-30')
    form.recurrence.value = { ...form.recurrence.value, weekdays: [2] }
    expect(form.scheduledDate.value).toBe('2026-11-04')
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
  it('preserves the calendar-selected lower bound and restores ordinary date choices', async () => {
    const { wrapper, form } = setup({ date: '2026-11-10' })
    form.recurrence.value = { frequency: 'weekly', interval: 2, weekdays: [0], end: { mode: 'never' } }
    await flushPromises()
    expect(form.scheduledDate.value).toBe('2026-11-16')
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Tomorrow')
    form.recurrence.value = { frequency: 'none' }
    await flushPromises()
    expect(form.scheduledDate.value).toBe('2026-11-10')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Tomorrow')
    wrapper.unmount()
  })
})

<script setup>
// "+ New task" button. At md and up it opens NewTaskModal; on phones it goes to the
// full-page form (/tasks/new). Pass a recipient to pre-fill "who is it for".
//   <NewTaskButton :recipient="recipient" />

import NewTaskModal from './NewTaskModal.vue'

    recipient: { type: Object, default: null },
    save: { type: Function, default: null }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['created'])

// Same breakpoint as Bootstrap's md

    familyId: { type: String, default: '' }      // the task's family, when it isn't the selected one
})

const emit = defineEmits(['created', 'saved', 'close'])
const isEdit = computed(() => Boolean(props.task))

const familyLabel = computed(() => {
    const name = selectedFamily.value?.name || 'your'
    return /family$/i.test(name) ? name : `${name} family`
})

// Opened from a hub: the person is fixed until "Change person" is clicked
const changingPerson = ref(false)
const isPrefilled = computed(() => Boolean(props.recipient) && !isEdit.value && !changingPerson.value)

const selectedRecipient = computed(() =>
    recipients.value.find((r) => r._id === form.recipient.value) ||
    (props.recipient?._id === form.recipient.value ? props.recipient : null)
)
const recipientName = computed(() => displayName(selectedRecipient.value))
const showHelperStrip = computed(() => isPrefilled.value && careFacts(selectedRecipient.value).length > 0)

async function post() {
    const task = await form.submit(props.familyId || selectedFamilyId.value)
    if (task) {
        emit(isEdit.value ? 'saved' : 'created', task)
        requestClose()
    }
}

// ---- Overlay behaviour: Escape closes, the page behind doesn't scroll ----
const titleInput = ref(null)

function onKeydown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') requestClose()
}

onMounted(() => {
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open')
    titleInput.value?.focus()
})

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open')
})

<script setup>
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { useFamilyWorkspace } from '../../family/composables/useFamilyWorkspace.js'
import { getRecurringSeries, pauseRecurringSeries, getTaskErrorMessage } from '../services/tasksApi.js'
import SectionCard from '../../../components/common/SectionCard.vue'
import ProfileAvatar from '../../../components/common/ProfileAvatar.vue'
import RecurringTaskEditModal from './RecurringTaskEditModal.vue'
import { recurrenceLabel } from '../../../../../shared/recurrence.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
const props = defineProps({ tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] }, recipientId: { type: String, default: '' } })
const { selectedFamilyId, user } = useFamilyWorkspace()
const client = useQueryClient(), editing = ref(null), busy = ref(''), actionError = ref('')
watch(selectedFamilyId, () => { editing.value = null; actionError.value = '' })
const query = useQuery({ queryKey: computed(() => ['families', selectedFamilyId.value, 'recurring-series']), queryFn: ({ queryKey }) => getRecurringSeries(queryKey[1]), enabled: computed(() => !!selectedFamilyId.value) })
const entries = computed(() => (query.data.value || []).filter(series => !props.recipientId || String(series.template.recipient) === props.recipientId))
const seriesTasks = series => props.tasks.filter(task => String(task.recurringSeries?._id || task.recurringSeries) === String(series._id))
const next = series => seriesTasks(series).filter(task => !task.recurrenceDetached && ['open', 'claimed'].includes(task.status) && +new Date(task.startAt) > Date.now()).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.startAt) - new Date(b.startAt))[0]
const canManage = series => String(series.createdBy?._id || series.createdBy) === user.value.id
async function toggle(series) {
  busy.value = series._id; actionError.value = ''
  try {
    await pauseRecurringSeries(selectedFamilyId.value, series._id, !series.paused)
    await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.family(selectedFamilyId.value) })
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('carecircle:task-updated', { detail: { familyId: selectedFamilyId.value, action: 'update', title: series.template.title } }))
  } catch (error) { actionError.value = getTaskErrorMessage(error) }
  finally { busy.value = '' }
}
</script>
<template>
  <SectionCard title="Repeating tasks" class="recurring-series-panel">
    <template #actions><small class="care-muted">Open-ended tasks are created four weeks ahead</small></template>
    <p v-if="query.isLoading.value" role="status">Loading repeating tasksâ€¦</p>
    <p v-else-if="query.isError.value" role="alert">Could not load repeating tasks. <button class="care-text-button" @click="query.refetch()">Try again</button></p>
    <p v-else-if="!entries.length" class="care-muted">No repeating tasks yet.</p>
    <div v-for="series in entries" :key="series._id" class="recurring-series-row">
      <i class="bi bi-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="recurring-series-text"><strong>{{ next(series)?.title || series.template.title }}</strong><small>{{ recurrenceLabel(series.rule) }}<template v-if="series.rule.end.mode === 'on'"> Â· until {{ series.rule.end.until }}</template><template v-if="series.rule.end.mode === 'after'"> Â· {{ series.rule.end.count }} sessions</template><template v-if="series.paused"> Â· Paused</template></small><span v-if="series.usualHelper" class="recurring-helper"><ProfileAvatar :person="series.usualHelper" size="tiny" />{{ series.usualHelper.name }} is the usual helper</span><small v-else>Taken session by session</small></div>
      <div v-if="canManage(series)" class="recurring-series-buttons"><button class="care-button" :disabled="!next(series) || !!busy" @click="editing = next(series)">Edit</button><button class="care-button" :disabled="!!busy" @click="toggle(series)">{{ series.paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause' }}</button></div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="actionError" role="alert" class="text-danger">{{ actionError }}</p>
    <RecurringTaskEditModal v-if="editing" :key="editing._id" :task="editing" :family-id="selectedFamilyId" @close="editing = null" @saved="editing = null" />
  </SectionCard>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import CareModal from '../../../components/common/CareModal.vue'
import { editTask, getTaskErrorMessage } from '../services/tasksApi.js'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
const props = defineProps({ task: { type: Object, required: true }, familyId: { type: String, required: true } })
const emit = defineEmits(['close', 'saved'])
const local = value => value ? new Date(+new Date(value) + 8 * 3600000).toISOString().slice(0, 16) : ''
const title = ref(props.task.title), start = ref(local(props.task.startAt)), end = ref(local(props.task.endAt))
const notes = ref(props.task.description || ''), place = ref(props.task.location?.name || ''), scope = ref('one')
const busy = ref(false), error = ref('')
const client = useQueryClient()
const choices = computed(() => props.task.recurrenceDetached ? [{ key: 'one', title: 'Only this date', detail: 'This session is a one-day exception. Other dates are not affected.' }] : [
  { key: 'one', title: 'Only this date', detail: 'Other sessions keep their current details.' },
  { key: 'future', title: 'This date and every session after', detail: 'Update upcoming sessions from this occurrence onward.' },
  { key: 'all', title: 'Every upcoming session', detail: 'Update all upcoming sessions in the series. Started, completed and detached sessions stay unchanged.' },
])
async function save() {
  if (busy.value) return
  busy.value = true; error.value = ''
  try {
    if (!title.value.trim() || !start.value) throw new Error('Add a title and start time.')
    const changes = { scope: scope.value, expectedUpdatedAt: props.task.updatedAt }
    if (title.value.trim() !== props.task.title) changes.title = title.value.trim()
    if (notes.value !== (props.task.description || '')) changes.description = notes.value
    if (start.value !== local(props.task.startAt)) changes.startAt = new Date(`${start.value}+08:00`).toISOString()
    if (end.value !== local(props.task.endAt)) changes.endAt = end.value ? new Date(`${end.value}+08:00`).toISOString() : null
    if (place.value !== (props.task.location?.name || '')) changes.location = place.value.trim() ? { name: place.value.trim() } : null
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 2) throw new Error('Change a task detail before saving.')
    const task = await editTask(props.familyId, props.task._id, changes)
    await client.cancelQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.tasks(props.familyId) })
    await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.family(props.familyId) })
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('carecircle:task-updated', { detail: { familyId: props.familyId, task, action: 'update' } }))
    emit('saved', task)
  } catch (err) { error.value = getTaskErrorMessage(err) }
  finally { busy.value = false }
}
</script>
<template>
  <CareModal title="Edit repeating task" @close="!busy && emit('close')">
    <form class="recurring-edit" @submit.prevent="save">
      <label>What needs doing?<input v-model="title" maxlength="120" required :disabled="busy"></label>
      <div class="recurring-edit-times"><label>Starts (Singapore time)<input v-model="start" type="datetime-local" required :disabled="busy"></label><label>Ends (optional)<input v-model="end" type="datetime-local" :disabled="busy"></label></div>
      <label>Place<input v-model="place" maxlength="120" :disabled="busy"></label>
      <label>Notes<textarea v-model="notes" maxlength="2000" :disabled="busy"></textarea></label>
      <h3>Apply this change toâ€¦</h3>
      <label v-for="choice in choices" :key="choice.key" class="recurring-scope-option" :class="{ selected: scope === choice.key }"><input v-model="scope" type="radio" name="recurring-edit-scope" :value="choice.key" :disabled="busy"><span><strong>{{ choice.title }}</strong><small>{{ choice.detail }}</small></span></label>
      <p v-if="error" role="alert" class="text-danger">{{ error }}</p>
      <div class="recurring-dialog-buttons"><button type="button" class="care-button" :disabled="busy" @click="emit('close')">Cancel</button><button type="submit" class="care-button care-button--green" :disabled="busy">{{ busy ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save change' }}</button></div>
    </form>
  </CareModal>
</template>
<style scoped>
.recurring-edit>label{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px}.recurring-edit input:not([type=radio]),.recurring-edit textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--theme-border,#e4ece5);border-radius:8px;background:var(--theme-panel,#fff);color:inherit}.recurring-edit-times{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.recurring-edit-times label{font-size:12px;min-width:0}.recurring-edit h3{font-size:17px;margin:18px 0 8px}.recurring-edit>.recurring-scope-option{display:flex}.recurring-edit .recurring-scope-option input{width:auto}@media(max-width:500px){.recurring-edit-times{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

<script setup>
// A list of tasks with loading, error and empty states.
// The parent loads the tasks and passes them in; this component only displays them.
//   <TaskList :tasks="tasks" :is-loading="loading" :error-message="error" @retry="loadTasks" />
// Rows added or removed after the first render animate in and out (motion.css care-list).
// Pass flashIds for rows someone else just changed: they flash once (motion.css care-flash).
import { reactive, watch } from 'vue'
import TaskListItem from './TaskListItem.vue'
import TaskClaimActions from './TaskClaimActions.vue'

const props = defineProps({
    tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    errorMessage: { type: String, default: '' },
    emptyMessage: { type: String, default: 'No tasks yet. Add one with "New task".' },
    // e.g. '60vh': the list scrolls inside this height instead of growing the page
    maxHeight: { type: String, default: '' },
    // Ids of rows that just changed through a live update (never the user's own changes)
    flashIds: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['retry'])

// A row keeps the flash class until its animation ends, so it can flash again next time
const flashing = reactive(new Set())
watch(() => props.flashIds, (ids) => ids.forEach((taskId) => flashing.add(taskId)))

function endFlash(event, taskId) {
    if (event.animationName === 'care-flash') flashing.delete(taskId)
}
</script>

<template>
    <div v-if="isLoading" class="task-list-status" role="status">
        <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-success" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        Loading tasks...
    </div>

    <div v-else-if="errorMessage" class="task-list-status is-error" role="alert">
        <span>{{ errorMessage }}</span>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" @click="emit('retry')">
            Try again
        </button>
    </div>

    <template v-else>
        <p v-if="tasks.length === 0" class="task-list-status">
            {{ emptyMessage }}
        </p>

        <!-- Stays mounted when empty, so the last row can still animate out -->
        <TransitionGroup name="care-list" tag="div" class="task-list overflow-y-auto pe-1"
            :style="{ maxHeight: maxHeight || null }">
            <TaskListItem v-for="task in tasks" :key="task._id" :task="task"
                :class="{ 'care-flash': flashing.has(task._id) }" @animationend="endFlash($event, task._id)">
                <template #actions="{ task: rowTask }">
                    <slot name="actions" :task="rowTask"><TaskClaimActions :task="rowTask" /></slot>
                </template>
            </TaskListItem>
        </TransitionGroup>
    </template>
</template>

    position: relative;
    display: flex;

}

FILE: client/src/features/tasks/components/new-task/careFacts.js
================================================
// Owner: Marcus (D)
// What a helper should know before taking a recipient out, as chips:
// severe allergies (coral), mobility (lavender), care notes (amber).
import { mobilityLabel } from '../../../recipients/recipientLabels.js'

// First sentence only, so a long note still fits on one chip
function short(text = '', max = 40) {
    const first = text.split(/[.;\n]/)[0].trim()
    return first.length > max ? `${first.slice(0, max - 1).trim()}â€¦` : first
}

export function careFacts(recipient) {
    if (!recipient) return []

    const facts = (recipient.allergies || [])
        .filter((allergy) => allergy.severity === 'severe')
        .map((allergy) => ({ tone: 'coral', icon: 'bi-exclamation-triangle', text: `${allergy.name} Â· severe` }))

    const mobility = recipient.mobility?.notes ? short(recipient.mobility.notes) : mobilityLabel(recipient.mobility?.level)
    if (mobility) facts.push({ tone: 'lavender', text: mobility })

    if (recipient.careNotes) facts.push({ tone: 'amber', text: short(recipient.careNotes) })

    return facts
}

<script setup>
// Owner: Marcus (D)
// "Where? (optional)": OneMap search, with the recipient's preferred clinic suggested first.
// The chosen place shows as a green card with "Change".
//   <TaskPlacePicker v-model="form.location.value" :suggestion="recipient.preferredClinic" suggestion-label="Grandpa's preferred clinic" />
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, useId } from 'vue'
import { searchPlaces } from '../../services/oneMapApi.js'

const props = defineProps({
    // { name, address, postal, lat, lng }, e.g. the recipient's preferred clinic
    suggestion: { type: Object, default: null },
    suggestionLabel: { type: String, default: '' },
    error: { type: String, default: '' }
})

const model = defineModel({ type: Object, default: null })

const id = useId()
const searchInput = ref(null)
const query = ref('')
const results = ref([])
const isSearching = ref(false)
const searchError = ref('')
const isOpen = ref(false)

const hasSuggestion = computed(() => Boolean(props.suggestion?.name || props.suggestion?.address))

function placeLine(place) {
    return [place.address, place.postal ? `S${place.postal}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')
}

// ---- Search, 300ms after typing stops; an older request is cancelled ----
let timer = null
let controller = null

watch(query, (value) => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    controller?.abort()
    searchError.value = ''

    if (!value.trim()) {
        results.value = []
        isSearching.value = false
        return
    }

    isSearching.value = true
    timer = setTimeout(async () => {
        controller = new AbortController()
        try {
            results.value = await searchPlaces(value, { signal: controller.signal })
            isSearching.value = false
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.name === 'AbortError') return
            results.value = []
            searchError.value = 'Place search is unavailable. Try again in a moment.'
            isSearching.value = false
        }
    }, 300)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    controller?.abort()
})

function choose(place) {
    model.value = { name: place.name || '', address: place.address || '', postal: place.postal || '', lat: place.lat, lng: place.lng }
    query.value = ''
    isOpen.value = false
}

async function change() {
    model.value = null
    await nextTick()
    searchInput.value?.focus()
    isOpen.value = true
}

// Close the list when focus leaves the search box and its results
function onFocusOut(event) {
    if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) isOpen.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="task-field">
        <label class="task-label" :for="model ? null : `${id}-search`">
            Where? <span class="task-optional">(optional)</span>
        </label>

        <div v-if="model" class="place-card">
            <span class="place-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i></span>
            <span class="place-text">
                <strong>{{ model.name || model.address }}</strong>
                <small v-if="placeLine(model)">{{ placeLine(model) }}</small>
            </span>
            <button type="button" class="place-change" @click="change">Change</button>
        </div>

        <div v-else class="place-search" @focusout="onFocusOut">
            <div class="search-box" :class="{ 'is-invalid': error }">
                <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <input :id="`${id}-search`" ref="searchInput" v-model="query" type="search" autocomplete="off"
                    placeholder="Search OneMap, e.g. Tan Tock Seng" role="combobox"
                    :aria-expanded="isOpen" :aria-controls="`${id}-results`" @focus="isOpen = true"
                    @keydown.escape.stop="isOpen = false">
            </div>

            <ul v-if="isOpen && (hasSuggestion || query.trim())" :id="`${id}-results`" class="place-results" role="listbox">
                <li v-if="hasSuggestion" role="option" aria-selected="false">
                    <button type="button" class="place-result" @click="choose(suggestion)">
                        <i class="bi bi-star" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        <span>
                            <strong>{{ suggestion.name || suggestion.address }}</strong>
                            <small>{{ suggestionLabel || placeLine(suggestion) }}</small>
                        </span>
                    </button>
                </li>
                <li v-if="isSearching" class="place-status" role="status">
                    <span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-success" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                    Searching OneMap...
                </li>
                <li v-else-if="searchError" class="place-status is-error">{{ searchError }}</li>
                <li v-else-if="query.trim() && !results.length" class="place-status">No places found.</li>
                <li v-for="(place, index) in results" :key="`${place.postal}-${index}`" role="option" aria-selected="false">
                    <button type="button" class="place-result" @click="choose(place)">
                        <i class="bi bi-geo-alt" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        <span>
                            <strong>{{ place.name }}</strong>
                            <small>{{ placeLine(place) }}</small>
                        </span>
                    </button>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <p v-if="error" class="task-field-error" role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
        <p v-else-if="hasSuggestion && !model" class="task-hint">
            Suggested: {{ suggestionLabel || suggestion.name }} Â· or search OneMap
        </p>
    </div>
</template>
