<script setup>
import { computed, useId } from 'vue'
import { recurrenceLabel } from '../../../../../../shared/recurrence.js'
const rule = defineModel({ type: Object, required: true })
const props = defineProps({ date: String, preview: { type: Object, default: () => ({ dates: [], error: '' }) } })
const uid = useId()
const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']
const presets = [{ key: 'none', label: "Doesn't repeat" }, { key: 'daily', label: 'Every day' }, { key: 'weekly', label: 'Every week' }, { key: 'biweekly', label: 'Every 2 weeks' }, { key: 'monthly', label: 'Every month' }, { key: 'custom', label: 'Customâ€¦' }]
const choice = computed(() => rule.value.preset || (rule.value.frequency === 'weekly' && rule.value.interval === 2 ? 'biweekly' : rule.value.frequency))
function patch(update) { rule.value = { ...rule.value, ...update } }
function choose(key) {
  const weekday = (new Date(`${props.date}T12:00:00+08:00`).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
  patch({ preset: key, frequency: key === 'biweekly' || key === 'custom' ? 'weekly' : key,
    interval: key === 'biweekly' ? 2 : 1, weekdays: [weekday], end: rule.value.end || { mode: 'never' } })
}
function toggleDay(day) {
  const current = rule.value.weekdays || []
  patch({ weekdays: current.includes(day) ? current.filter(value => value !== day) : [...current, day].sort() })
}
function end(mode) { patch({ end: { mode, ...(mode === 'after' ? { count: 4 } : {}), ...(mode === 'on' ? { until: props.date } : {}) } }) }
const monthlyDay = computed(() => {
  const day = Number(props.date?.slice(8, 10))
  if (!day) return ''
  const suffix = day >= 11 && day <= 13 ? 'th' : ({ 1: 'st', 2: 'nd', 3: 'rd' }[day % 10] || 'th')
  return `${day}${suffix}`
})
const monthlySchedule = computed(() => `On the ${monthlyDay.value} ${rule.value.interval > 1 ? `every ${rule.value.interval} months` : 'of every month'}`)
const summary = computed(() => {
  if (rule.value.frequency === 'monthly') return monthlySchedule.value
  if (rule.value.frequency === 'none' || !props.preview.dates.length) return ''
  return recurrenceLabel({ ...rule.value, weekdays: rule.value.weekdays || [] })
})
</script>
<template>
  <fieldset class="task-repeat">
    <legend class="task-label"><i class="bi bi-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i> Repeat</legend>
    <div class="repeat-choices"><button v-for="preset in presets" :key="preset.key" type="button" :aria-pressed="choice === preset.key" :class="{ selected: choice === preset.key }" @click="choose(preset.key)">{{ preset.label }}</button></div>
    <template v-if="rule.frequency !== 'none'">
      <div v-if="choice === 'custom'" class="repeat-custom"><label :for="`${uid}-interval`">Every</label><input :id="`${uid}-interval`" type="number" min="1" max="365" :value="rule.interval" @input="patch({ interval: Number($event.target.value) })"><select aria-label="Repeat interval unit" :value="rule.frequency" @change="patch({ frequency: $event.target.value })"><option value="daily">days</option><option value="weekly">weeks</option><option value="monthly">months</option></select></div>
      <div v-if="rule.frequency === 'weekly'" class="repeat-section"><span class="task-sublabel">On</span><div class="repeat-choices"><button v-for="(day, index) in days" :key="day" type="button" :aria-label="day" :aria-pressed="rule.weekdays?.includes(index) || false" :class="{ selected: rule.weekdays?.includes(index) }" @click="toggleDay(index)">{{ day }}</button></div></div>
      <div v-if="rule.frequency === 'monthly'" class="repeat-summary" aria-live="polite">
        <strong>{{ monthlySchedule }}</strong>
        <small>First session: {{ new Date(`${date}T12:00:00+08:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' }) }}. Change the date above to choose a different day of the month.</small>
        <small v-if="Number(date?.slice(8, 10)) > 28">Months without a {{ monthlyDay }} are skipped; the task does not move to the last day of the month.</small>
      </div>
      <div class="repeat-section"><span class="task-sublabel">Ends</span><div class="repeat-choices"><button v-for="option in [{ key: 'never', label: 'Never' }, { key: 'on', label: 'On a date' }, { key: 'after', label: 'After a number of times' }]" :key="option.key" type="button" :aria-pressed="rule.end?.mode === option.key" :class="{ selected: rule.end?.mode === option.key }" @click="end(option.key)">{{ option.label }}</button></div>
        <label v-if="rule.end?.mode === 'on'" class="repeat-end">Last date <input type="date" :min="date" :value="rule.end.until" @input="patch({ end: { mode: 'on', until: $event.target.value } })"></label>
        <label v-if="rule.end?.mode === 'after'" class="repeat-end">Sessions <input type="number" min="1" max="500" :value="rule.end.count" @input="patch({ end: { mode: 'after', count: Number($event.target.value) } })"></label>
      </div>
      <p v-if="preview.error" class="task-field-error" role="alert">{{ preview.error }}</p>
      <div v-else-if="rule.frequency !== 'monthly'" class="repeat-summary" aria-live="polite"><strong>{{ summary || 'Choose a start time to preview' }}</strong><small v-if="preview.dates.length">First session: {{ new Date(preview.dates[0].startAt).toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' }) }}. {{ preview.dates.length }} sessions{{ rule.end?.mode === 'never' ? ' in the initial four-week window; more are created as the window moves forward.' : '.' }} Claiming the series covers upcoming dates. A released date can be taken by someone else for that day only.</small></div>
    </template>
  </fieldset>
</template>

import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
export const recurringClaim = shallowRef(null)
let resolveClaim
export function closeRecurringClaim(scope = null) {
  const resolve = resolveClaim
  resolveClaim = null; recurringClaim.value = null
  resolve?.(scope)
}
export function askRecurringClaim(task) {
  if (!task?.recurringSeries || task.recurrenceDetached) return Promise.resolve('one')
  closeRecurringClaim()
  recurringClaim.value = task
  return new Promise(resolve => { resolveClaim = resolve })
}

FILE: client/src/features/tasks/composables/useTaskForm.js
================================================
// Owner: Marcus (D)
// State, validation and submit for the New task form. NewTaskModal (md and up) and
// NewTaskView (phones) both use this, so the two layouts always behave the same.
//
//   const form = useTaskForm({ recipientId: 'abc' })   // or {} for "anyone"
//   const form = useTaskForm({ task })                 // edit: fields start from the task, submit saves it
//   const form = useTaskForm({ date: '2026-10-30' })   // new task on a day picked in the Calendar
//   form.title.value = 'Eye check-up'
//   const task = await form.submit(familyId)          // null if it failed
//
// Pass save to post somewhere other than the API (the /preview page's sample data):
//   useTaskForm({ save: async (payload) => task })
//
// Validation mirrors TaskModel.js so most problems are caught before posting.
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import { createTask, updateTask, getTaskErrorMessage } from '../services/tasksApi.js'
import { useTaskCache } from '../../../composables/useFamilyTasks.js'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
import { queryKeys } from '../../../services/queryClient.js'
import { parseRecurrence, recurrenceDates, generationHorizon, nextWeeklyDate } from '../../../../../shared/recurrence.js'

const TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Singapore'
// Singapore has no daylight saving, so the offset is always +08:00
const SG_OFFSET = '+08:00'

export const TASK_CATEGORIES = [
    { value: 'appointment', label: 'Appointment', icon: 'bi-calendar-event' },
    { value: 'therapy', label: 'Therapy', icon: 'bi-activity' },
    { value: 'medication', label: 'Medication', icon: 'bi-capsule' },
    { value: 'companionship', label: 'Company', icon: 'bi-people' },
    { value: 'errand', label: 'Errand', icon: 'bi-bag' },
    { value: 'groceries', label: 'Groceries', icon: 'bi-cart' },
    { value: 'childcare', label: 'Childcare', icon: 'bi-emoji-smile' },
    { value: 'other', label: 'Other', icon: 'bi-three-dots' }
]

const TITLE_MAX = 120
const DESCRIPTION_MAX = 2000

// ---- Dates, always in Singapore time ----

// YYYY-MM-DD for today in Singapore
export function todayKey() {
    return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

export function addDays(dateKey, days) {
    const date = new Date(`${dateKey}T12:00:00${SG_OFFSET}`)
    date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days)
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

// "Wed 21 Oct"
export function dateLabel(dateKey) {
    return new Date(`${dateKey}T12:00:00${SG_OFFSET}`)
        .toLocaleDateString('en-SG', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        .replace(',', '')
}

// "2:30pm"
export function timeLabel(date) {
    return date
        .toLocaleTimeString('en-SG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        .replace(' ', '')
}

// Date -> "HH:mm" in Singapore time, for <input type="time">
function timeInput(value) {
    if (!value) return ''
    return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false, timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
}

// Date + time typed in Singapore time -> Date (sent to the API as an ISO string)
function combine(dateKey, time) {
    if (!dateKey || !time) return null
    const date = new Date(`${dateKey}T${time}:00${SG_OFFSET}`)
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date
}

// Today, Tomorrow and the day after, then "Pick a dateâ€¦"
export function quickDates() {
    const today = todayKey()
    return [
        { value: today, label: 'Today' },
        { value: addDays(today, 1), label: 'Tomorrow' },
        { value: addDays(today, 2), label: dateLabel(addDays(today, 2)) }
    ]
}

// Which input a server message belongs to, e.g. "Title is required" -> title
const SERVER_FIELDS = [
    [/^title/i, 'title'],
    [/start/i, 'startAt'],
    [/^end/i, 'endAt'],
    [/^description/i, 'description'],
    [/^category/i, 'category'],
    [/^recipient/i, 'recipient'],
    [/^location|postal/i, 'location'],
    [/needsTransit/i, 'needsTransit']
]

export function useTaskForm({ recipientId = null, save = null, task = null, date: initialDate = null } = {}) {
    const { upsertTask } = useTaskCache()
    const queryClient = useQueryClient()

    // ---- Fields ----
    const recipient = ref(recipientId)       // recipient id, or null for "Household"
    const title = ref('')
    const category = ref('other')
    const date = ref(initialDate || todayKey())
    const startTime = ref('')                // "HH:mm" from <input type="time">
    const endTime = ref('')
    const location = ref(null)               // { name, address, postal, lat?, lng? }
    const needsTransit = ref(false)
    const description = ref('')
    const recurrence = ref({ frequency: 'none', interval: 1, end: { mode: 'never' } })

    // Editing: start from the task as it is now
    if (task) {
        const idOf = (value) => (value && typeof value === 'object' ? value._id : value)
        const place = task.location
        recipient.value = idOf(task.recipient) || null
        title.value = task.title || ''
        category.value = task.category || 'other'
        date.value = new Date(task.startAt).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TIME_ZONE })
        startTime.value = timeInput(task.startAt)
        endTime.value = timeInput(task.endAt)
        location.value = place && (place.name || place.address || place.postal) ? { ...place } : null
        needsTransit.value = Boolean(location.value && task.needsTransit)
        description.value = task.description || ''
    }

    // Transit mode needs somewhere to go
    watch(location, (place) => {
        if (!place) needsTransit.value = false
    })

    const isWeekly = computed(() => recurrence.value.frequency === 'weekly')
    const scheduledDate = computed(() => isWeekly.value
        ? nextWeeklyDate(date.value, startTime.value, recurrence.value.weekdays)
        : date.value)
    const startAt = computed(() => combine(scheduledDate.value, startTime.value))
    const endAt = computed(() => combine(scheduledDate.value, endTime.value))
    const repeatPreview = computed(() => {
        if (recurrence.value.frequency === 'none' || !startAt.value) return { dates: [], error: '' }
        try {
            const rule = parseRecurrence(recurrence.value, startAt.value)
            if (+startAt.value <= Date.now()) return { dates: [], error: 'The first repeating session must be in the future' }
            return { dates: recurrenceDates(rule, startAt.value, endAt.value, generationHorizon(startAt.value)), error: '' }
        } catch (error) { return { dates: [], error: error.message } }
    })

    // ---- Validation (same rules as TaskModel.js) ----
    const errors = computed(() => {
        const result = {}
        const trimmedTitle = title.value.trim()

        if (!trimmedTitle) result.title = 'Add what needs doing'
        else if (trimmedTitle.length > TITLE_MAX) result.title = `Keep it under ${TITLE_MAX} characters`

        if (description.value.length > DESCRIPTION_MAX) {
            result.description = `Notes must be at most ${DESCRIPTION_MAX} characters`
        }
        if (!TASK_CATEGORIES.some((c) => c.value === category.value)) result.category = 'Pick a category'

        if (!startAt.value) result.startAt = 'Add a start time'
        if (startAt.value && endAt.value && endAt.value < startAt.value) {
            result.endAt = 'End time must be after the start time'
        }

        if (location.value && !/^(\d{6})?$/.test(location.value.postal || '')) {
            result.location = 'Postal code must be 6 digits'
        }
        if (needsTransit.value && !location.value) result.needsTransit = 'Pick a place first'
        if (repeatPreview.value.error) result.recurrence = repeatPreview.value.error

        return result
    })

    const canSubmit = computed(() => Object.keys(errors.value).length === 0)

    // One line for the footer: what's still missing before you can post
    const verb = task ? 'save' : 'post'
    const missingMessage = computed(() => {
        const missingTitle = Boolean(errors.value.title) && !title.value.trim()
        const missingStart = Boolean(errors.value.startAt)
        if (missingTitle && missingStart) return `Add what needs doing and a start time to ${verb}`
        if (missingTitle) return `Add what needs doing to ${verb}`
        if (missingStart) return `Add a start time to ${verb}`
        return Object.values(errors.value)[0] || ''
    })

    function toPayload() {
        const place = location.value
        return {
            title: title.value.trim(),
            description: description.value.trim(),
            category: category.value,
            startAt: startAt.value?.toISOString(),
            endAt: endAt.value ? endAt.value.toISOString() : null,
            recipient: recipient.value || null,
            location: place
                ? {
                    name: place.name || '',
                    address: place.address || '',
                    postal: place.postal || '',
                    ...(Number.isFinite(place.lat) ? { lat: place.lat } : {}),
                    ...(Number.isFinite(place.lng) ? { lng: place.lng } : {})
                }
                : null,
            needsTransit: place ? needsTransit.value : false,
            ...(recurrence.value.frequency !== 'none' ? { recurrence: recurrence.value } : {})
        }
    }

    // ---- Submit ----
    const isSubmitting = ref(false)
    const serverErrors = ref({})   // field -> message, shown under the matching input
    const submitError = ref('')    // anything that doesn't belong to one input

    // Errors to show under an input: the server's first, then our own
    function fieldError(field) {
        return serverErrors.value[field] || ''
    }

    function applyServerErrors(error) {
        const messages = error.response?.data?.errors || []
        const byField = {}
        const other = []

        for (const message of messages) {
            const match = SERVER_FIELDS.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(message))
            if (match && !byField[match[1]]) byField[match[1]] = message
            else other.push(message)
        }

        serverErrors.value = byField
        submitError.value = other.length
            ? other.join(' ')
            : messages.length ? '' : getTaskErrorMessage(error)
    }

    // Posts the task and puts it in the shared task cache. Returns the task, or null.
    async function submit(familyId) {
        if (!canSubmit.value || isSubmitting.value) return null

        isSubmitting.value = true
        serverErrors.value = {}
        submitError.value = ''
        try {
            if (save) return await save(toPayload())
            const saved = task
                ? await updateTask(familyId, task._id, toPayload())
                : await createTask(familyId, toPayload())
            upsertTask(familyId, saved)
            if (saved.recurringSeries) await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.family(familyId) })
            return saved
        } catch (error) {
            applyServerErrors(error)
            return null
        } finally {
            isSubmitting.value = false
        }
    }

    // A field the server complained about is cleared as soon as it is edited
    watch([title, category, startTime, endTime, date, location, recipient, description], () => {
        if (Object.keys(serverErrors.value).length) serverErrors.value = {}
    })

    return {
        recipient,
        title,
        category,
        date,
        startTime,
        endTime,
        location,
        needsTransit,
        description,
        recurrence,
        isWeekly,
        scheduledDate,
        repeatPreview,
        postLabel: computed(() => recurrence.value.frequency === 'none' ? 'Post task' : `Post ${repeatPreview.value.dates.length} tasks`),
        startAt,
        endAt,
        errors,
        canSubmit,
        missingMessage,
        toPayload,
        isSubmitting,
        serverErrors,
        submitError,
        fieldError,
        submit
    }
}

FILE: client/src/features/tasks/composables/useTaskOverdue.js

import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, toValue } from 'vue'

export function isTaskOverdue(task, now = Date.now()) {
  return Boolean(task?.startAt) && new Date(task.startAt).getTime() <= now
}

// Recheck while a task is on screen, so an open tab cannot keep offering an
// expired claim. The server also checks its own clock on every claim.
export function useTaskClock() {
  const now = ref(Date.now())
  let timer
  onMounted(() => { now.value = Date.now(); timer = setInterval(() => { now.value = Date.now() }, 1000) })
  onUnmounted(() => clearInterval(timer))
  return now
}

export function useTaskOverdue(task) {
  const now = useTaskClock()
  return computed(() => isTaskOverdue(toValue(task), now.value))
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Place search through OneMap (Singapore Land Authority). Called straight from the
// browser: the search endpoint needs no token and allows any origin.
//   const places = await searchPlaces('tan tock seng', { signal })
const SEARCH_URL = 'https://www.onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search'
const MAX_RESULTS = 5

// OneMap returns everything in capitals: "TAN TOCK SENG HOSPITAL" -> "Tan Tock Seng Hospital"
function titleCase(text = '') {
    return text.toLowerCase().replace(/\b([a-z])/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())
}

function toPlace(result) {
    const postal = /^\d{6}$/.test(result.POSTAL) ? result.POSTAL : ''
    const name = result.BUILDING && result.BUILDING !== 'NIL' ? result.BUILDING : result.SEARCHVAL
    // Block + road reads best ("21 Ang Mo Kio Central 2"). ADDRESS repeats the building
    // name and ends with "SINGAPORE 123456", so it's only the fallback.
    const street = [result.BLK_NO, result.ROAD_NAME].filter((part) => part && part !== 'NIL').join(' ')
    const address = street || (result.ADDRESS || '').replace(/\s*SINGAPORE\s+\d{6}$/i, '')

    return {
        name: titleCase(name),
        address: titleCase(address),
        postal,
        lat: Number(result.LATITUDE),
        lng: Number(result.LONGITUDE)
    }
}

// Up to 5 places as { name, address, postal, lat, lng }, the same shape as a task's location
export async function searchPlaces(query, { signal } = {}) {
    const searchVal = query.trim()
    if (!searchVal) return []

    const params = new URLSearchParams({ searchVal, returnGeom: 'Y', getAddrDetails: 'Y', pageNum: '1' })
    const response = await fetch(`${SEARCH_URL}?${params}`, { signal })

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Place search is unavailable right now.')
    }

    const data = await response.json()
    return (data.results || []).slice(0, MAX_RESULTS).map(toPlace)
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Calls to /api/families/:familyId/tasks. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section D).
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'

function authHeaders() {
    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('token')

    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('Please log in first.')
    }

    return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
}

// Get the family's tasks, sorted by start time.
// filters (all optional): { status: 'open,claimed', recipient, claimedBy, from, to }
export async function getFamilyTasks(familyId, filters = {}) {
    const response = await http.get(
        `/families/${familyId}/tasks`,
        { headers: authHeaders(), params: filters }
    )

    return response.data.tasks
}

// Post a new task. It always starts as "open"; the server ignores status and claimedBy.
// task: { title, startAt, endAt?, description?, category?, recipient?, location?, needsTransit? }
export async function createTask(familyId, task) {
    const response = await http.post(
        `/families/${familyId}/tasks`,
        task,
        { headers: authHeaders() }
    )

    return response.data.task
}

export async function getRecurringSeries(familyId) {
    const { data } = await http.get(`/families/${familyId}/tasks/recurring`, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return data.series
}
export async function pauseRecurringSeries(familyId, seriesId, paused) {
    await http.patch(`/families/${familyId}/tasks/recurring/${seriesId}`, { paused }, { headers: authHeaders() })
}
export async function editTask(familyId, taskId, changes) {
    const { data } = await http.patch(`/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}`, changes, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return data.task
}
// Edit a task (creator only). Same fields as createTask; status and claimedBy are ignored.
export async function updateTask(familyId, taskId, changes) {
    const response = await http.patch(
        `/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}`,
        changes,
        { headers: authHeaders() }
    )

    return response.data.task
}

// Task errors come back as { error, errors? }, unlike family/auth's { message }
export function getTaskErrorMessage(error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        return 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'
    }

    const data = error.response?.data

    if (data?.errors?.length) {
        return data.errors.join(' ')
    }

    return (
        data?.error ||
        error.message ||
        'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
    )
}

<script setup>
// Owner: Marcus (D)
// New task as a full page, for phones (below md). /tasks/new, optionally ?recipient=<id>.
// Same form as NewTaskModal (useTaskForm), laid out as numbered cards with a live preview.

import { careFacts } from '../components/new-task/careFacts.js'

const id = useId()
const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const { selectedFamilyId, selectedFamily } = useActiveFamily()
const { recipients } = useRecipients()

const form = useTaskForm({ recipientId: route.query.recipient || null })

const familyLabel = computed(() => {
    const name = selectedFamily.value?.name || 'your'
    return /family$/i.test(name) ? name : `${name} family`
})

const selectedRecipient = computed(() => recipients.value.find((r) => r._id === form.recipient.value) || null)
const recipientName = computed(() => displayName(selectedRecipient.value))

// ---- Preview ----
const startDate = computed(() => form.startAt.value)
const previewWeekday = computed(() => dateLabel(form.scheduledDate.value).split(' ')[0].toUpperCase())
const previewDay = computed(() => Number(form.scheduledDate.value.split('-')[2]))
const previewTime = computed(() => {
    if (!startDate.value) return ''
    return form.endAt.value ? `${timeLabel(startDate.value)}â€“${timeLabel(form.endAt.value)}` : timeLabel(startDate.value)
})
const previewMeta = computed(() =>
    [recipientName.value || 'Household', previewTime.value, form.location.value?.name].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')
)
const categoryLabel = computed(() => TASK_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === form.category.value)?.label)

// The message the family's Telegram group gets (no health details, see the design doc)
const telegramText = computed(() => {
    const what = form.title.value.trim() || 'a task'
    const forWhom = recipientName.value ? `${recipientName.value}'s ${what.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${what.slice(1)}` : what
    const when = [dateLabel(form.scheduledDate.value), startDate.value ? timeLabel(startDate.value) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
    const transit = form.needsTransit.value ? ' Needs someone to take them there.' : ''
    return `New task: ${forWhom}, ${when}.${transit} Who can take it?`
})

const hasFacts = computed(() => careFacts(selectedRecipient.value).length > 0)

// One line for the sticky footer
const summary = computed(() => {
    if (!form.canSubmit.value) return form.missingMessage.value
    return [form.title.value.trim(), recipientName.value || 'Household', `${dateLabel(form.scheduledDate.value)} ${previewTime.value}`]
        .join(' Â· ')
})

const preview = ref(null)
function showPreview() {
    preview.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
}

// ---- Leaving ----
function goBack() {
    if (window.history.state?.back) router.back()
    else if (route.query.recipient) router.push({ name: 'recipient-overview', params: { recipientId: route.query.recipient } })
    else router.push('/home')
}

async function post() {
    const task = await form.submit(selectedFamilyId.value)
    if (task) goBack()
}

// A task belongs to one family; switching family leaves the form
watch(selectedFamilyId, (newId, oldId) => {
    if (oldId && newId !== oldId) router.push('/home')
})
</script>

<template>
    <form class="new-task-page" novalidate @submit.prevent="post">
        <header class="page-header">
            <button type="button" class="back-button" aria-label="Back" @click="goBack">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
            <div>
                <h1>{{ recipientName ? `New task for ${recipientName}` : 'New task' }}</h1>
                <p>Posted to the {{ familyLabel }}. Anyone can claim it.</p>
            </div>
        </header>

        <p v-if="!selectedFamily" class="task-submit-error">Choose a family in the sidebar first.</p>

        <template v-else>
            <section class="step-card" aria-labelledby="step-1">

                        placeholder="Anything the helper should bring or know"></textarea>
                    <p v-if="form.fieldError('description') || form.errors.value.description" class="task-field-error">
                        {{ form.fieldError('description') || form.errors.value.description }}
                    </p>
                </div>
            </section>

            <section ref="preview" class="preview" aria-labelledby="preview-title">
                <h2 id="preview-title" class="preview-title">Preview Â· how the family sees it</h2>

                <article class="preview-row">
                    <div class="date-badge">
                        <span class="date-weekday">{{ previewWeekday }}</span>
                        <span class="date-day">{{ previewDay }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="preview-text">
                        <h3 :class="{ placeholder: !form.title.value.trim() }">
                            {{ form.title.value.trim() || 'What needs doing?' }}
                        </h3>
                        <p>{{ previewMeta }}</p>
                        <div class="preview-badges">
                            <span v-if="form.needsTransit.value" class="badge-transit">Needs transit</span>
                            <span class="badge-open">Open</span>
                            <span v-if="categoryLabel" class="badge-category">{{ categoryLabel }}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </article>

                <div class="telegram-preview">
                    <span class="preview-label"><i class="bi bi-send" aria-hidden="true"></i> Telegram message</span>
                    <p>{{ telegramText }}</p>
                </div>

                <div v-if="hasFacts" class="facts-preview">
                    <span class="preview-label">Shown to whoever claims it</span>
                    <TaskCareFacts :recipient="selectedRecipient" />
                </div>
            </section>

            <p v-if="form.submitError.value" class="task-submit-error" role="alert">
                <i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                {{ form.submitError.value }}
            </p>

                    {{ summary }}
                </button>
                <button type="submit" class="post-button" :disabled="!form.canSubmit.value || form.isSubmitting.value">
                    <span v-if="form.isSubmitting.value" class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                    {{ form.isSubmitting.value ? 'Posting...' : form.postLabel.value }}
                </button>
            </footer>
        </template>
    </form>
</template>

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
import TransitBanner from '../../family/components/TransitBanner.vue'
import { useActiveTransit } from '../utils/useActiveTransit.js'
import { getActiveTransitSessions } from '../services/transitApi.js'

vi.mock('../services/transitApi.js', () => ({ getActiveTransitSessions: vi.fn() }))
const deferred = () => { let resolve; const promise = new Promise(done => { resolve = done }); return { promise, resolve } }
const trip = (id, name = 'Grandpa') => ({ _id: `session-${id}`, task: { _id: id, recipient: { name }, location: { name: 'Clinic' } },
  companion: { name: 'Jasmine' }, startedAt: '2026-10-26T02:00:00Z', milestones: [{ type: 'arrived', at: '2026-10-26T02:10:00Z' }] })
async function render(options = {}) {
  const family = ref('family-a')
  const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [
    { path: '/', component: { template: '<p>Home</p>' } },
    { path: '/transit/:familyId/:taskId', name: 'transit', component: { template: '<p>Trip</p>' } },
  ] })
  await router.push('/')
  const Host = defineComponent({ components: { TransitBanner }, setup() {
    return useActiveTransit(family, options)
  }, template: '<TransitBanner v-for="banner in liveTransits" :key="banner.taskId" :session="banner" @view="openLiveTransit(banner)" />' })
  const wrapper = mount(Host, { global: { plugins: [router] } })
  await flushPromises()
  return { wrapper, family, router }
}

describe('Live trips follow the selected family', () => {
  it('renders the real banner and opens its family-scoped trip', async () => {
    getActiveTransitSessions.mockResolvedValue([trip('trip-a')])
    const { wrapper, router } = await render()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Grandpa arrived at Clinic with Jasmine')
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('1 of 5 milestones')
    await wrapper.get('button').trigger('click')
    await flushPromises()
    expect(router.currentRoute.value.path).toBe('/transit/family-a/trip-a')
  })

  it('ignores a previous familyâ€™s late reply after switching families', async () => {
    const old = deferred()
    getActiveTransitSessions.mockReturnValueOnce(old.promise).mockResolvedValueOnce([trip('trip-b', 'Grandma')])
    const { wrapper, family } = await render()
    family.value = 'family-b'
    await flushPromises()
    old.resolve([trip('trip-a')])
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Grandma')
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Grandpa')
  })

  it('keeps banners empty when a family is cleared before its reply arrives', async () => {
    const old = deferred()
    getActiveTransitSessions.mockReturnValue(old.promise)
    const { wrapper, family } = await render()
    family.value = ''
    await flushPromises()
    old.resolve([trip('trip-a')])
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.find('[aria-label="Active transit"]').exists()).toBe(false)
    expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Grandpa')
  })

  it('never fetches real trips in an isolated preview', async () => {
    const { wrapper } = await render({ enabled: false })
    expect(getActiveTransitSessions).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(wrapper.find('button').exists()).toBe(false)
  })

  it('refreshes visible banners on a poll and stops polling after unmount', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    vi.spyOn(document, 'visibilityState', 'get').mockReturnValue('visible')
    getActiveTransitSessions.mockResolvedValueOnce([trip('trip-a')]).mockResolvedValue([])
    const { wrapper } = await render()
    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Grandpa')
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(15000)
    await flushPromises()
    expect(wrapper.find('button').exists()).toBe(false)
    expect(getActiveTransitSessions).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    wrapper.unmount()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(45000)
    expect(getActiveTransitSessions).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })
})

// Owner: Chaithra (E) Â· Week 10a: unit tests for plain functions
// toBanner() turns a live trip from the API into the Family Home banner text.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { toBanner } from '../utils/useActiveTransit.js'
import { TRIP_STEPS, WORDS, extraUpdates } from '../utils/wording.js'

const session = (milestones = [], extra = {}) => ({
    task: {
        _id: 'task1',
        title: 'Physio',
        location: { name: 'Tan Tock Seng Hospital' },
        recipient: { _id: 'r1', name: 'Grandpa', careType: 'elderly' }
    },
    companion: { _id: 'u1', name: 'Jasmine Tan' },
    startedAt: '2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z',
    milestones,
    ...extra
})
const step = (type, label = type, at = '2026-10-29T02:30:00.000Z') => ({ type, label, at })

describe('TestSuite: toBanner (Family Home live trip banner)', () => {
    it('Test1: says the trip has started when there are no updates yet', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session(), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.mobileHeadline).toBe("Grandpa's trip has started")
        expect(banner.headline).toBe("Grandpa's trip has started with Jasmine")
        expect(banner.detail).toContain('0 of 5 milestones Â· next: arrived at clinic')
    })

    it('Test2: shows where they are going after "Departed home"', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session([step('departed', 'Departed home')]), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.mobileHeadline).toBe('Grandpa is on the way to Tan Tock Seng Hospital')
        expect(banner.detail).toContain('1 of 5 milestones Â· next: arrived at clinic')
    })

    it('Test3: shows a custom update word for word', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session([step('departed'), step('custom', 'Collecting medicine')]), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.mobileHeadline).toBe('Grandpa: Collecting medicine')
        // A custom update doesn't count as one of the 5 fixed steps
        expect(banner.detail).toContain('1 of 5 milestones')
    })

    it('Test4: counts fixed steps and names the next one', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session([step('departed'), step('arrived'), step('consultation_done')]), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.mobileHeadline).toBe("Grandpa's consultation is done")
        expect(banner.detail).toContain('3 of 5 milestones Â· next: heading home')
    })

    it('Test5: keeps the ids needed to open the trip', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session(), 'fam1')
        expect(banner).toMatchObject({ familyId: 'fam1', taskId: 'task1' })
    })

    it('Test6: picks the right sample photo by name (not the default face)', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session(), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.recipient.profilePicture).toBe('/avatars/people/grandpa.png')
        expect(banner.companion.profilePicture).toBe('/avatars/people/jasmine.png')
    })

    it('Test7: keeps a photo the person chose themselves', () => {
        const banner = toBanner(session([], { companion: { name: 'Jasmine', profilePicture: '/me.png' } }), 'fam1')
        expect(banner.companion.profilePicture).toBe('/me.png')
    })

    it('Test8: returns null when there is no trip', () => {
        expect(toBanner(null, 'fam1')).toBeNull()
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: wording shared by the laptop and phone layouts', () => {
    it('Test1: has the 5 fixed trip steps in order, ending with "Safely back home"', () => {
        expect(TRIP_STEPS.map((s) => s.type)).toEqual(['departed', 'arrived', 'consultation_done', 'heading_home', 'home'])
        expect(TRIP_STEPS[4].label).toBe(WORDS.safelyHome)
    })

    it('Test2: names the person in the "Picked up" quick update', () => {
        expect(extraUpdates('Grandpa')).toContain('Picked up Grandpa')
        expect(extraUpdates('')).toContain('Picked up')
        expect(extraUpdates('Grandpa')).toHaveLength(4)
    })
})

// Owner: Chaithra (E) Â· Week 10b: component test ("Add to calendar" pop-up on its own)
// Only the Google sync status call is doubled; the calendar links are the real ones.
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'

vi.mock('../../my-tasks/services/googleCalendarApi.js', () => ({ getGoogleStatus: vi.fn() }))
import { getGoogleStatus } from '../../my-tasks/services/googleCalendarApi.js'

const task = (extra = {}) => ({
    _id: 'task1',
    title: 'Physio',
    startAt: '2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z',
    status: 'claimed',
    claimedBy: 'me1',
    location: { name: 'Tan Tock Seng Hospital' },
    family: { name: 'Tan family' },
    ...extra
})

// The component reads who is logged in when it loads, so import it after setting that
async function render(props) {
    vi.resetModules()
    const { default: AddToCalendar } = await import('../components/AddToCalendar.vue')
    const wrapper = mount(AddToCalendar, { attachTo: document.body, props: { modelValue: false, ...props } })
    if (props.modelValue) {
        await wrapper.setProps({ modelValue: false })
        await wrapper.setProps({ modelValue: true }) // opening runs the sync check
        await flushPromises()
    }
    return wrapper
}
const dialog = () => document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]')

beforeEach(() => {
    sessionStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({ id: 'me1' }))
    getGoogleStatus.mockResolvedValue({ connected: false })
})

describe('TestSuite: AddToCalendar pop-up', () => {
    it('Test1: shows nothing while closed', async () => {
        await render({ modelValue: false, tasks: [task()] })
        expect(dialog()).toBeNull()
    })

    it('Test2: one task shows Google, Apple and Outlook with the task filled in', async () => {
        await render({ modelValue: true, tasks: [task()] })

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { googleCalendarUrl, outlookCalendarUrl } from '../utils/calendarLinks.js'

const task = { title: 'Eye check & review', startAt: '2026-12-31T23:30:00+08:00',
  description: 'Bring card; call before arrival.', family: { name: 'Tan family' },
  location: { name: 'Clinic A & B', address: '1 Test Road', postal: '123456' } }

describe('Calendar links preserve the taskâ€™s time and text', () => {
  it('uses UTC and a one-hour default duration when there is no end time', () => {
    const url = new URL(googleCalendarUrl(task))
    expect(url.origin).toBe('https://calendar.google.com')
    expect(url.searchParams.get('dates')).toBe('20261231T153000Z/20261231T163000Z')
    expect(url.searchParams.get('text')).toBe(task.title)
    expect(url.searchParams.get('location')).toBe('Clinic A & B, 1 Test Road, S123456')
  })

  it('preserves an explicit end time across midnight and URL-encodes special text', () => {
    const url = new URL(outlookCalendarUrl({ ...task, endAt: '2027-01-01T01:15:00+08:00' }))
    expect(url.searchParams.get('startdt')).toBe('2026-12-31T15:30:00.000Z')
    expect(url.searchParams.get('enddt')).toBe('2026-12-31T17:15:00.000Z')
    expect(url.searchParams.get('subject')).toBe(task.title)
    expect(url.searchParams.get('body')).toContain(task.description)
  })
})

// Owner: Chaithra (E) Â· Week 10a: unit tests for plain functions
// "Add to calendar" links: the task's title, time and place must reach the calendar app.
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { googleCalendarUrl, outlookCalendarUrl, openInAppleCalendar } from '../utils/calendarLinks.js'

// 10:00am Singapore time = 02:00 UTC
const task = {
    _id: 'task1',
    title: 'Physio for Grandpa',
    startAt: '2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z',
    endAt: '2026-10-29T03:30:00.000Z',
    location: { name: 'Tan Tock Seng Hospital', address: '11 Jalan Tan Tock Seng', postal: '308433' },
    family: { name: 'Tan family' },
    description: 'Bring the pink folder'
}
const params = (url) => new URL(url).searchParams

describe('TestSuite: googleCalendarUrl', () => {
    it('Test1: fills in the title, the place and the family', () => {
        const query = params(googleCalendarUrl(task))
        expect(query.get('action')).toBe('TEMPLATE')
        expect(query.get('text')).toBe('Physio for Grandpa')
        expect(query.get('location')).toBe('Tan Tock Seng Hospital, 11 Jalan Tan Tock Seng, S308433')
        expect(query.get('details')).toContain('Tan family')
        expect(query.get('details')).toContain('Bring the pink folder')
    })

    it('Test2: sends the start and end time in UTC', () => {
        expect(params(googleCalendarUrl(task)).get('dates')).toBe('20261029T020000Z/20261029T033000Z')
    })

    it('Test3: makes the event 1 hour long when the task has no end time', () => {
        const query = params(googleCalendarUrl({ ...task, endAt: null }))
        expect(query.get('dates')).toBe('20261029T020000Z/20261029T030000Z')
    })

    it('Test4: leaves the place empty for a task with no location', () => {
        expect(params(googleCalendarUrl({ ...task, location: null })).get('location')).toBe('')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: outlookCalendarUrl', () => {
    it('Test1: opens Outlook compose with the same title and times', () => {
        const url = outlookCalendarUrl(task)
        expect(url).toContain('https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose')
        const query = params(url)
        expect(query.get('subject')).toBe('Physio for Grandpa')
        expect(query.get('startdt')).toBe('2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z')
        expect(query.get('enddt')).toBe('2026-10-29T03:30:00.000Z')
    })
})

describe('TestSuite: openInAppleCalendar', () => {
    it('Test1: downloads a .ics event with the task details', async () => {
        let saved = null
        vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockImplementation((blob) => { saved = blob; return 'blob:test' })
        vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {})
        const clicks = []
        vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(function () { clicks.push(this.download) })

        openInAppleCalendar(task)

        expect(clicks).toEqual(['Physio for Grandpa.ics'])
        // jsdom's Blob has no .text(), so read it the older way
        const text = await new Promise((resolve) => {
            const reader = new FileReader()
            reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result)
            reader.readAsText(saved)
        })
        expect(text).toContain('BEGIN:VEVENT')
        expect(text).toContain('SUMMARY:Physio for Grandpa')
        expect(text).toContain('DTSTART:20261029T020000Z')
        // Commas in the place are escaped so calendar apps read it as one value
        expect(text).toContain('LOCATION:Tan Tock Seng Hospital\\, 11 Jalan Tan Tock Seng\\, S308433')
    })
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'

function render(props = {}) {

        expect(wrapper.emitted('start')).toHaveLength(1)
    })

        })

        expect(chips[0]).toBe('Arrived at clinic')

        expect(chips).toHaveLength(4)
    })

        const wrapper = render({ session: activeSession(), isCompanion: true })
        await wrapper.findAll('.chip')[0].trigger('click')
        expect(wrapper.emitted('post')[0]).toEqual([{ type: 'departed', label: 'Departed home' }])
    })

        expect(wrapper.get('input[aria-label="Your own update"]').element.value).toBe('')
    })

    })

    })

    it('Test9: an ended trip that is not done can be resumed', async () => {
        const wrapper = render({
            session: { status: 'ended', path: [], milestones: [step('departed', 'Departed home')] },
            isCompanion: true,
            canResume: true
        })

    })

// Owner: Chaithra (E) Â· Week 10b: integration test
// The real TransitView page and its real TransitMobile child (phone layout) working together:
// a tap in the child -> the page saves it -> the child shows the saved result.
// Only the HTTP calls (transitApi / myTasksApi) are doubled, with an in-memory "server".
// The map is a stub: OneMap pictures are outside this test.
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router'

vi.mock('../services/transitApi.js', () => ({
    getTask: vi.fn(),
    getTransitSession: vi.fn(),
    postMilestone: vi.fn(),
    removeMilestone: vi.fn(),
    endTransit: vi.fn(),
    resumeTransit: vi.fn(),
    updateLocation: vi.fn(),
    getActiveTransitSessions: vi.fn()
}))
vi.mock('../../my-tasks/services/myTasksApi.js', () => ({
    startTask: vi.fn(),
    getErrorMessage: (error) => error.response?.data?.error || error.message
}))
vi.mock('../../../composables/useActiveFamily.js', async () => {
    const { ref } = await import('vue')
    return { useActiveFamily: () => ({ families: ref([{ id: 'fam1', name: 'Tan family' }]) }) }
})

import * as api from '../services/transitApi.js'
import { startTask } from '../../my-tasks/services/myTasksApi.js'
import TransitView from '../views/TransitView.vue'

const JASMINE = 'u-jasmine'
const ALEX = 'u-alex'
let server // in-memory stand-in for the API's data

function freshServer() {
    return {
        task: {
            _id: 'task1',
            title: 'Physio',
            status: 'claimed',
            needsTransit: true,
            claimedBy: { _id: JASMINE, name: 'Jasmine Tan' },
            recipient: { _id: 'r1', name: 'Grandpa' },
            location: { name: 'Tan Tock Seng Hospital' }
        },
        session: null
    }
}
const copy = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))
let clock = Date.parse('2026-10-29T02:00:00.000Z')
const nextTime = () => new Date((clock += 60000)).toISOString()

beforeEach(() => {
    server = freshServer()
    api.getTask.mockImplementation(async () => copy(server.task))
    api.getTransitSession.mockImplementation(async () => copy(server.session))
    api.getActiveTransitSessions.mockResolvedValue([])
    startTask.mockImplementation(async () => {
        server.task.status = 'in_progress'
        server.session = { status: 'active', companion: { _id: JASMINE, name: 'Jasmine Tan' }, milestones: [], path: [], startedAt: nextTime() }
        return { task: copy(server.task), transitSession: copy(server.session) }
    })
    api.postMilestone.mockImplementation(async (_f, _t, { type, label }) => {
        server.session.milestones.push({ type, label, at: nextTime() })
        if (type === 'home') {
            server.session.status = 'ended'
            server.task.status = 'completed'
        }
        return copy(server.session)
    })
    api.removeMilestone.mockImplementation(async (_f, _t, at) => {
        server.session.milestones = server.session.milestones.filter((m) => m.at !== at)
        return copy(server.session)
    })
    // Phone-sized screen, so TransitView shows TransitMobile
    window.matchMedia = vi.fn((query) => ({
        media: query, matches: true, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {}
    }))
})

async function openAs(userId) {
    sessionStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({ id: userId }))
    const router = createRouter({
        history: createMemoryHistory(),
        routes: [
            { path: '/transit/:familyId/:taskId', name: 'transit', component: TransitView, props: true },
            { path: '/tasks/:familyId/:taskId', name: 'task-detail', component: { template: '<p>Task detail</p>' } }
        ]
    })
    router.push('/transit/fam1/task1')
    await router.isReady()
    const wrapper = mount({ template: '<RouterView />' }, {
        attachTo: document.body,
        global: { plugins: [router], stubs: { OneMapTiles: true, VisitNotesCard: true } } // notes (F) have their own tests
    })
    await flushPromises()
    return wrapper
}
const button = (wrapper, text) => wrapper.findAll('button').find((b) => b.text().trim() === text)
const steps = (wrapper) => wrapper.findAll('.steps li.done strong').map((s) => s.text())

describe('TestSuite: TransitView + TransitMobile working together', () => {
    it('Test1: the claimer starts the trip and the live trip appears', async () => {
        const wrapper = await openAs(JASMINE)
        await button(wrapper, 'Start the trip').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()
        expect(startTask).toHaveBeenCalledWith('fam1', 'task1')
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Live')
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Post the next update')
    })

    it('Test2: posting quick and typed updates shows them on the timeline', async () => {
        const wrapper = await openAs(JASMINE)
        await button(wrapper, 'Start the trip').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()

        await wrapper.findAll('.chip')[0].trigger('click') // "Departed home"
        await flushPromises()
        await wrapper.get('input[aria-label="Your own update"]').setValue('Stuck in traffic')
        await wrapper.get('form').trigger('submit')
        await flushPromises()

        expect(steps(wrapper)).toEqual(['Departed home', 'Stuck in traffic'])
        expect(api.postMilestone).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('fam1', 'task1', { type: 'custom', label: 'Stuck in traffic' })
    })

    it('Test3: Ã— removes a wrong update after the person confirms', async () => {
        const wrapper = await openAs(JASMINE)
        await button(wrapper, 'Start the trip').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()
        await wrapper.get('input[aria-label="Your own update"]').setValue('asdfgh')
        await wrapper.get('form').trigger('submit')
        await flushPromises()

        vi.spyOn(window, 'confirm').mockReturnValue(true)
        await wrapper.get('button[aria-label="Remove asdfgh"]').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()

        expect(steps(wrapper)).not.toContain('asdfgh')
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Update removed.')
    })

    it('Test4: "safely back home" ends the trip and shows the task is done', async () => {
        const wrapper = await openAs(JASMINE)
        await button(wrapper, 'Start the trip').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()

        vi.spyOn(window, 'confirm').mockReturnValue(true)
        await button(wrapper, 'Grandpa is safely back home').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()

        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Grandpa is safely back home. The task is done.')
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Ended')
        expect(button(wrapper, 'Grandpa is safely back home')).toBeFalsy()
    })

    it('Test5: another family member only follows along', async () => {
        server.task.status = 'in_progress'
        server.session = {
            status: 'active', companion: { _id: JASMINE, name: 'Jasmine Tan' }, path: [],
            milestones: [{ type: 'departed', label: 'Departed home', at: nextTime() }]
        }
        const wrapper = await openAs(ALEX)
        expect(steps(wrapper)).toEqual(['Departed home'])
        expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('Only Jasmine can post updates')
        expect(button(wrapper, 'Start the trip')).toBeFalsy()
        expect(wrapper.find('.chip').exists()).toBe(false)
    })

    it('Test6: a failed save shows the server\'s message and keeps the timeline', async () => {
        const wrapper = await openAs(JASMINE)
        await button(wrapper, 'Start the trip').trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()
        api.postMilestone.mockRejectedValueOnce({ response: { status: 403, data: { error: 'Only the person on this trip can post updates' } } })

        await wrapper.findAll('.chip')[0].trigger('click')
        await flushPromises()

        expect(wrapper.get('[role="alert"]').text()).toBe('Only the person on this trip can post updates')
        expect(steps(wrapper)).toEqual([])
    })
})

FILE: client/src/features/transit/components/AddToCalendar.vue

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// "Add to calendar" pop-up: pick Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook and the
// app opens with the task filled in. One task shows big buttons; several tasks
// (My Tasks â†’ "Add to calendar") show a list with the three buttons on each row.
//   <AddToCalendar v-model="calendarOpen" :tasks="[task]" />
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { googleCalendarUrl, outlookCalendarUrl, openInAppleCalendar } from '../utils/calendarLinks.js'
import { formatDay, formatTime } from '../../my-tasks/utils/formatters.js'
import { getGoogleStatus } from '../../my-tasks/services/googleCalendarApi.js'

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue'])

const closeButton = ref(null)
// With Google Calendar auto-sync on, claimed tasks are already in Google Calendar
const googleSynced = ref(false)
let myId = ''
try { myId = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user') || '{}').id || '' } catch { myId = '' }
// Only tasks I've claimed are synced
function isSynced(task) {
    const claimer = task?.claimedBy?._id || task?.claimedBy
    return googleSynced.value && Boolean(myId) && String(claimer) === myId &&
        ['claimed', 'in_progress', 'completed'].includes(task.status)
}
const single = computed(() => (props.tasks.length === 1 ? props.tasks[0] : null))

function when(task) {
    return `${formatDay(task.startAt)} Â· ${formatTime(task.startAt)}`
}
function where(task) {
    return task.location?.name || task.location?.address || ''
}

function close() {
    emit('update:modelValue', false)
}
function onKey(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') close()
}

watch(() => props.modelValue, async (open) => {
    if (open) {
        getGoogleStatus().then((s) => { googleSynced.value = Boolean(s.connected) }).catch(() => {})
        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
        await nextTick()
        closeButton.value?.focus()
    } else {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
})
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey))
</script>

<template>
    <Teleport to="body">
        <div v-if="modelValue" class="cal-backdrop" @click.self="close">
            <div class="cal-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="cal-title">
                <header class="cal-head">
                    <h2 id="cal-title">Add to calendar</h2>
                    <button ref="closeButton" type="button" class="cal-close" aria-label="Close" @click="close">
                        <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                </header>

                <p v-if="!tasks.length" class="cal-empty">No upcoming tasks to add.</p>

                <!-- One task: big app buttons -->
                <template v-else-if="single">
                    <div class="cal-task">
                        <strong>{{ single.title }}</strong>
                        <span>{{ when(single) }}<template v-if="where(single)"> Â· {{ where(single) }}</template></span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="cal-apps">
                        <div v-if="isSynced(single)" class="cal-app synced">
                            <span class="cal-icon google"><i class="bi bi-google" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
                            <span class="synced-text">
                                Google Calendar
                                <small>Already added automatically (sync is on)</small>
                            </span>
                            <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill go" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        </div>
                        <a v-else :href="googleCalendarUrl(single)" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="cal-app" @click="close">
                            <span class="cal-icon google"><i class="bi bi-google" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
                            Google Calendar
                            <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right go" aria-hidden="true"></i>

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E), CC-19
// Search clinics and places with OneMap. Emits "select" with a location in the
// same shape as task.location, so D's task form can use it too:
//   <ClinicSearch @select="(loc) => (form.location = loc)" />
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { searchClinics } from '../services/transitApi.js'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../my-tasks/services/myTasksApi.js'

defineProps({
    placeholder: { type: String, default: 'Search a clinic or hospital, e.g. "TTSH"' }
})
const emit = defineEmits(['select'])

const query = ref('')
const results = ref([])
const showingOthers = ref(false) // true when no clinic matched and these are other places
const isSearching = ref(false)
const errorMessage = ref('')
const hasSearched = ref(false)

async function search() {
    const q = query.value.trim()
    if (q.length < 2) {
        errorMessage.value = 'Type at least 2 characters.'
        return
    }
    isSearching.value = true
    errorMessage.value = ''
    try {
        const found = await searchClinics(q)
        showingOthers.value = !found.clinics.length && found.otherPlaces.length > 0
        results.value = found.clinics.length ? found.clinics : found.otherPlaces
        hasSearched.value = true
    } catch (error) {
        errorMessage.value = getErrorMessage(error)
        results.value = []
    } finally {
        isSearching.value = false
    }
}

function choose(place) {
    emit('select', place)
    results.value = []
    hasSearched.value = false
    query.value = place.name
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="clinic-search">
        <form class="search-row" role="search" @submit.prevent="search">
            <input
                v-model="query"
                type="search"
                class="form-control"
                :placeholder="placeholder"
                aria-label="Search clinics"
                maxlength="100"
            />
            <button type="submit" class="search-button" :disabled="isSearching">
                <span v-if="isSearching" class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <i v-else class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span class="visually-hidden">Search</span>
            </button>
        </form>

        <p v-if="errorMessage" class="hint is-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage }}</p>
        <p v-else-if="hasSearched && !results.length" class="hint">No clinics or places found. Try another name.</p>
        <p v-else-if="showingOthers" class="hint">No clinics matched, so these are other places with that name.</p>

        <ul v-if="results.length" class="results">
            <li v-for="place in results" :key="`${place.name}-${place.lat}-${place.lng}`">
                <button type="button" class="result" @click="choose(place)">
                    <i class="bi bi-geo-alt" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    <span>
                        <strong>{{ place.name }}</strong>
                        <small>{{ place.address }}</small>
                    </span>
                </button>
            </li>
        </ul>
        <p class="credit">Search by OneMap, Singapore Land Authority</p>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E). Matches Figma "02 Â· Family home" â†’ "Live transit banner".
// Shows on Family Home while someone in the selected family is in transit mode.
// Hidden when nobody is in transit. Refreshes every 15 seconds.
//   <LiveTransitBanner :family-id="selectedFamilyId" />
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import PersonAvatar from '../../my-tasks/components/PersonAvatar.vue'
import { getActiveTransitSessions } from '../services/transitApi.js'
import { formatTime } from '../../my-tasks/utils/formatters.js'

const props = defineProps({
    familyId: { type: String, default: '' }
})

const router = useRouter()
const POLL_MS = 15 * 1000
const STEPS = [
    { type: 'departed', label: 'on the way' },
    { type: 'arrived', label: 'arrived' },
    { type: 'consultation_done', label: 'consultation done' },
    { type: 'heading_home', label: 'heading home' },
    { type: 'home', label: 'safely back home' }
]

const sessions = ref([])

const banners = computed(() => sessions.value
    .filter((s) => s.task) // skip sessions whose task was deleted
    .map((session) => {
        const task = session.task
        const recipient = task.recipient && typeof task.recipient === 'object'
            ? task.recipient.nickname || task.recipient.name
            : ''
        const companion = (session.companion?.name || '').split(' ')[0]
        const place = task.location?.name || task.location?.address || ''
        const milestones = session.milestones || []
        const latest = milestones[milestones.length - 1]
        const subject = recipient || task.title

        let headline = `${companion || 'Someone'} started transit for ${task.title}`
        if (latest) {
            const withWho = companion ? ` with ${companion}` : ''
            headline = {
                departed: `${companion || 'Someone'} is on the way${recipient ? ` to fetch ${recipient}` : ''}`,
                arrived: `${subject} arrived${place ? ` at ${place}` : ''}${withWho}`,
                consultation_done: `${subject}'s consultation is done${withWho}`,
                heading_home: `${subject} is heading home${withWho}`
            }[latest.type] || `${latest.label}${companion ? ` Â· ${companion}` : ''}`
        }

        const posted = new Set(milestones.map((m) => m.type))
        const done = STEPS.filter((s) => posted.has(s.type)).length
        const next = STEPS.find((s) => !posted.has(s.type))
        const detail = [
            latest ? formatTime(latest.at) : `started ${formatTime(session.startedAt)}`,
            `${done} of ${STEPS.length} milestones`,
            next ? `next: ${next.label}` : ''
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')

        return { id: session._id, taskId: task._id, recipient, companion: session.companion?.name || '', headline, detail }
    }))

async function load() {
    if (!props.familyId) {
        sessions.value = []
        return
    }
    const familyId = props.familyId
    try {
        const result = await getActiveTransitSessions(familyId)
        // Ignore the reply if the family was switched while loading
        if (familyId === props.familyId) sessions.value = result
    } catch {
        // The banner is optional: on errors just don't show it
        sessions.value = []
    }
}

function viewLive(banner) {
    router.push({ name: 'transit', params: { familyId: props.familyId, taskId: banner.taskId } })
}

let timer = null
onMounted(() => {
    load()
    timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load()
    }, POLL_MS)
})
onUnmounted(() => clearInterval(timer))
watch(() => props.familyId, load)
</script>

<template>
    <div v-if="banners.length" class="live-banners">
        <button
            v-for="banner in banners"
            :key="banner.id"
            type="button"
            class="live-banner"
            :aria-label="`${banner.headline}. View live`"
            @click="viewLive(banner)"
        >
            <span class="people">
                <PersonAvatar :name="banner.recipient" :size="48" />
                <PersonAvatar v-if="banner.companion" :name="banner.companion" :size="48" tone="peach" class="second" />
            </span>

            <span class="text">
                <span class="eyebrow">LIVE Â· TRANSIT MODE</span>
                <strong>{{ banner.headline }}</strong>
                <span class="detail">{{ banner.detail }}</span>
            </span>

            <span class="view-live">View live</span>
        </button>
    </div>
</template>
