FILE: client/src/features/transit/components/OneMapTiles.vue
================================================
<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E), CC-19
// A real OneMap map (Singapore Land Authority's official map tiles). No library needed:
// it lays out the map tiles around the points.
//   Destination pin:  :lat / :lng            (the task's location)
//   Live person dot:  :live-lat / :live-lng  (the companion during a trip, optional)
//   Trail:            :trail="[{ lat, lng }, ...]"  (where they've been, oldest first, optional)
//   Route ahead:      :route="[{ lat, lng }, ...]"  (road route to the destination, green, optional)
// Anything put inside <OneMapTiles>...</OneMapTiles> floats on top (e.g. the ETA card).
// The map zooms out until everything fits. With nothing to show, it shows the green Figma placeholder.
// People can drag to move around, zoom with the +/- buttons, pinch (phone/trackpad) or
// double-click, and "Recentre" brings the map back to the person on the trip.
//   <OneMapTiles :lat="1.3214" :lng="103.8458" label="OneMap Â· TTSH Eye Centre" :height="220" />
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import PersonAvatar from '../../my-tasks/components/PersonAvatar.vue'

const props = defineProps({
    lat: { type: Number, default: null },
    lng: { type: Number, default: null },
    liveLat: { type: Number, default: null },
    liveLng: { type: Number, default: null },
    liveLabel: { type: String, default: '' }, // e.g. "Jasmine" (also picks their photo)
    liveTime: { type: String, default: '' },  // bubble line 1, e.g. "12:25 AM Tue"
    liveNote: { type: String, default: '' },  // bubble line 2, e.g. "Arrived at TTSH Eye Centre"
    trail: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    route: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    label: { type: String, default: '' },
    height: { type: Number, default: 220 },
    fitWidth: { type: Number, default: 480 },
    bottomSpace: { type: Number, default: 0 }, // px covered by a card at the bottom; points stay above it // roughly how wide the card is, for fitting both points
    zoom: { type: Number, default: 17 } // OneMap supports 12 to 19
})

const TILE = 256
// OneMap basemap tiles: /maps/tiles/<style>/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Falls back to Grey_HD if Default fails.
const TILE_BASE = 'https://www.onemap.gov.sg/maps/tiles'
const STYLES = ['Default', 'Grey_HD']
const MIN_ZOOM = 12 // OneMap has no map pictures below zoom 12
const MAX_ZOOM = 19
const COLS = 7 // enough tiles to fill wide cards
const ROWS = 5
const FIT_MARGIN = 50 // keep both points at least this far from the card's edges
// OneMap only has map pictures for Singapore. Tiles outside this box aren't requested
// (they'd fail and show broken images), and the map can't be dragged far out of it.
const SG = { north: 1.48, south: 1.15, west: 103.59, east: 104.1 }

const failedTiles = ref(0)
const styleIndex = ref(0)

const isNum = (v) => Number.isFinite(v)
const dest = computed(() => (isNum(props.lat) && isNum(props.lng) ? { lat: props.lat, lng: props.lng } : null))
const live = computed(() => (isNum(props.liveLat) && isNum(props.liveLng) ? { lat: props.liveLat, lng: props.liveLng } : null))
// The trail, ending at the live dot so the line reaches it
const trailPoints = computed(() => {
    const points = props.trail.filter((p) => isNum(p?.lat) && isNum(p?.lng))
    return live.value ? [...points, live.value] : points
})
// Room above the points for the photo pin (about 55 px) and its bubble (about 55 px)
const topSpace = computed(() => (live.value ? (props.liveTime || props.liveNote ? 110 : 55) : 0))

const routePoints = computed(() => props.route.filter((p) => isNum(p?.lat) && isNum(p?.lng)))
// What the map has to fit: the person, where they're going and the route ahead.
// (The trail behind them isn't included, so an old far-away point can't zoom the map out.)
const allPoints = computed(() => [dest.value, live.value, ...routePoints.value].filter(Boolean))

// Standard web-map maths: a point's position in pixels on the whole world map at zoom z
function toPixels(point, z) {
    const size = TILE * 2 ** z
    const latRad = (point.lat * Math.PI) / 180
    return {
        x: ((point.lng + 180) / 360) * size,
        y: ((1 - Math.log(Math.tan(latRad) + 1 / Math.cos(latRad)) / Math.PI) / 2) * size
    }
}

// The box around all points, in pixels at zoom z
function bounds(points, z) {
    const px = points.map((p) => toPixels(p, z))
    const xs = px.map((p) => p.x)
    const ys = px.map((p) => p.y)
    return { minX: Math.min(...xs), maxX: Math.max(...xs), minY: Math.min(...ys), maxY: Math.max(...ys) }
}

// Closest zoom at which everything fits on the card
const zoomLevel = computed(() => {
    if (allPoints.value.length < 2) return props.zoom
    const fitX = Math.max(40, props.fitWidth / 2 - FIT_MARGIN)
    const fitY = Math.max(40, (props.height - props.bottomSpace - topSpace.value) / 2 - FIT_MARGIN)
    for (let z = props.zoom; z > MIN_ZOOM; z--) {
        const box = bounds(allPoints.value, z)
        if ((box.maxX - box.minX) / 2 <= fitX && (box.maxY - box.minY) / 2 <= fitY) return z
    }
    return MIN_ZOOM
})

// Where the map looks when nobody has moved it: everything in view (see zoomLevel)
const autoView = computed(() => {
    if (!allPoints.value.length) return null
    const z = zoomLevel.value
    // Centre of everything (or the only point)
    const box = bounds(allPoints.value, z)
    const fitX = Math.max(40, props.fitWidth / 2 - FIT_MARGIN)
    const fitY = Math.max(40, (props.height - props.bottomSpace - topSpace.value) / 2 - FIT_MARGIN)
    const fits = (box.maxX - box.minX) / 2 <= fitX && (box.maxY - box.minY) / 2 <= fitY
    // Too far apart to fit even fully zoomed out (e.g. Yishun -> Novena on a phone):
    // keep the person in view and let the destination sit off the edge
    const focus = !fits && live.value ? toPixels(live.value, z) : null
    const cx = focus ? focus.x : (box.minX + box.maxX) / 2
    // Shift so the points sit in the free part of the card: above the bottom card and
    // below the room kept for the photo pin and its bubble
    const cy = (focus ? focus.y : (box.minY + box.maxY) / 2) + (props.bottomSpace - topSpace.value) / 2
    return { z, cx, cy }
})

// Once someone drags or zooms, the map stays where they put it ({ z, cx, cy } in world
// pixels) until they press Recentre. Live updates still move the pins and trail.
const manual = ref(null)
const view = computed(() => manual.value || autoView.value)

// Singapore's box in pixels at zoom z
function sgBox(z) {
    const nw = toPixels({ lat: SG.north, lng: SG.west }, z)
    const se = toPixels({ lat: SG.south, lng: SG.east }, z)
    return { minX: nw.x, maxX: se.x, minY: nw.y, maxY: se.y }
}
// Keep the centre of a moved map inside Singapore
function clampView(v) {
    const box = sgBox(v.z)
    return {
        z: v.z,
        cx: Math.min(box.maxX, Math.max(box.minX, v.cx)),
        cy: Math.min(box.maxY, Math.max(box.minY, v.cy))
    }
}
const isMoved = computed(() => Boolean(manual.value))

const grid = computed(() => {
    if (!view.value) return null
    const { z, cx, cy } = view.value

    const firstX = Math.floor(cx / TILE) - Math.floor(COLS / 2)
    const firstY = Math.floor(cy / TILE) - Math.floor(ROWS / 2)
    const tiles = []
    const sg = sgBox(z)
    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
        for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
            const tx = (firstX + col) * TILE
            const ty = (firstY + row) * TILE
            // Outside Singapore: OneMap has no picture, so don't ask for one
            if (tx + TILE < sg.minX || tx > sg.maxX || ty + TILE < sg.minY || ty > sg.maxY) continue
            tiles.push({
                key: `${z}-${firstX + col}-${firstY + row}`,
                src: `${TILE_BASE}/${STYLES[styleIndex.value]}/${z}/${firstX + col}/${firstY + row}.png`,
                left: col * TILE,
                top: row * TILE
            })
        }
    }
    // Offsets from the card's centre, in pixels
    const offset = (p) => (p ? { x: toPixels(p, z).x - cx, y: toPixels(p, z).y - cy } : null)
    return {
        tiles,
        shiftX: cx - firstX * TILE,
        shiftY: cy - firstY * TILE,
        dest: offset(dest.value),
        live: offset(live.value),
        // SVG polyline points, e.g. "-12,40 -8,31 0,0"
        trail: trailSegments(trailPoints.value).map((part) => toPolyline(part, offset)).filter(Boolean),
        route: toPolyline(routePoints.value, offset)
    }
})

// Split the trail where two points are far apart (a gap, e.g. the page was closed or
// the phone had no GPS), so the map never draws a straight line across a gap
const MAX_STEP_M = 3000 // the server already fills normal gaps along the roads
function metres(a, b) {
    const rad = (d) => (d * Math.PI) / 180
    const h = Math.sin(rad(b.lat - a.lat) / 2) ** 2 +
        Math.cos(rad(a.lat)) * Math.cos(rad(b.lat)) * Math.sin(rad(b.lng - a.lng) / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * 6371000 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h))
}
function trailSegments(points) {
    const parts = []
    let current = []
    points.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (i > 0 && metres(points[i - 1], p) > MAX_STEP_M) {
            parts.push(current)
            current = []
        }
        current.push(p)
    })
    parts.push(current)
    return parts
}

function toPolyline(points, offset) {
    if (points.length < 2) return ''
    return points.map((p) => { const o = offset(p); return `${o.x.toFixed(1)},${o.y.toFixed(1)}` }).join(' ')
}

const showMap = computed(() => Boolean(grid.value))
// OneMap's pictures failed (OneMap down, Wi-Fi blocking it, or outside Singapore):
// keep the pins and trail on a plain background instead of hiding everything
const tilesFailed = computed(() => styleIndex.value >= STYLES.length)

// If most tiles of a style fail, try the next style; after the last, show the placeholder
function onTileError(event) {
    // Hide the broken picture (otherwise it draws a white outline)
    if (event?.target) event.target.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    failedTiles.value++
    if (failedTiles.value >= Math.max(1, (grid.value?.tiles.length || 0) / 2)) {
        failedTiles.value = 0
        styleIndex.value++
    }
}

// ---------- Moving the map ----------
const mapEl = ref(null)
const dragging = ref(false)
const instant = ref(false) // switches off the pins' glide while the map itself moves
let instantTimer = null
function noGlide() {
    instant.value = true
    clearTimeout(instantTimer)
    instantTimer = setTimeout(() => { instant.value = dragging.value }, 80)
}

function takeOver() {
    if (!manual.value && autoView.value) manual.value = { ...autoView.value }
}

// Zoom in (+1) or out (-1), keeping the spot under `anchor` (px from the card's centre) still
function zoomBy(step, anchor = { x: 0, y: 0 }) {
    takeOver()
    const m = manual.value
    if (!m) return
    const z = Math.min(MAX_ZOOM, Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, m.z + step))
    if (z === m.z) return
    const f = 2 ** (z - m.z)
    noGlide()
    manual.value = clampView({ z, cx: (m.cx + anchor.x) * f - anchor.x, cy: (m.cy + anchor.y) * f - anchor.y })
}

function recentre() {
    noGlide()
    manual.value = null
}

function fromCentre(event) {
    const rect = mapEl.value.getBoundingClientRect()
    return { x: event.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2, y: event.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2 }
}

// Drag with one finger/mouse, pinch with two fingers
const pointers = new Map()
let pinchStart = 0
function isControl(event) {
    return Boolean(event.target.closest?.('.map-controls, .map-overlay, a, button'))
}
function onPointerDown(event) {
    if (!autoView.value || isControl(event) || (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0)) return
    pointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY })
    try { mapEl.value.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId) } catch { /* fine without it */ }
    dragging.value = true
    instant.value = true
    if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()]
        pinchStart = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
    }
}
function onPointerMove(event) {
    const last = pointers.get(event.pointerId)
    if (!last) return
    const now = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }
    pointers.set(event.pointerId, now)
    if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const dx = now.x - last.x
        const dy = now.y - last.y
        if (!dx && !dy) return
        takeOver()
        manual.value = clampView({ ...manual.value, cx: manual.value.cx - dx, cy: manual.value.cy - dy })
    } else if (pointers.size === 2 && pinchStart) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()]
        const distance = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
        const mid = fromCentre({ clientX: (a.x + b.x) / 2, clientY: (a.y + b.y) / 2 })
        if (distance / pinchStart > 1.5) { zoomBy(1, mid); pinchStart = distance }
        else if (distance / pinchStart < 0.66) { zoomBy(-1, mid); pinchStart = distance }
    }
}
function onPointerUp(event) {
    pointers.delete(event.pointerId)
    if (pointers.size < 2) pinchStart = 0
    if (!pointers.size) {
        dragging.value = false
        noGlide()
    }
}

// Trackpad pinch (and Ctrl + scroll) zooms; plain scrolling still scrolls the page
let wheelSum = 0
function onWheel(event) {
    if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) return
    event.preventDefault()
    wheelSum += event.deltaY
    if (Math.abs(wheelSum) >= 60) {
        zoomBy(wheelSum < 0 ? 1 : -1, fromCentre(event))
        wheelSum = 0
    }
}
function onDoubleClick(event) {
    if (!autoView.value || isControl(event)) return
    zoomBy(1, fromCentre(event))
}

// A different place (new task): start from the automatic view again
watch(() => [props.lat, props.lng], () => { manual.value = null })

const recentreLabel = computed(() => (props.liveLabel && live.value ? `Recentre on ${props.liveLabel}` : 'Recentre map'))

// The map moved to a different area (new place, or the live dot moved far): try the tiles again.
// OneMap only has tiles for Singapore, so a point outside Singapore shows the placeholder.
watch(() => grid.value?.tiles[0]?.key, () => {
    failedTiles.value = 0
    styleIndex.value = 0
})
</script>

<template>
    <div
        ref="mapEl"
        class="onemap"
        :class="{ interactive: showMap, dragging, instant, 'no-tiles': tilesFailed }"
        :style="{ height: `${height}px` }"
        @pointerdown="onPointerDown"
        @pointermove="onPointerMove"
        @pointerup="onPointerUp"
        @pointercancel="onPointerUp"
        @wheel="onWheel"
        @dblclick="onDoubleClick"
    >
        <template v-if="showMap">
            <div
                v-if="!tilesFailed"

            <!-- Lines: where they've been (coral) and the road route still to go (green, like Grab) -->
            <svg v-if="grid.trail.length || grid.route" class="trail" aria-hidden="true">

            <div

                    <i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="map-btn" aria-label="Zoom out" title="Zoom out" :disabled="view.z <= 12" @click="zoomBy(-1)">
                    <i class="bi bi-dash-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>

                    type="button"
                    class="map-btn recentre"

                    @click="recentre"
                >
                    <i class="bi bi-crosshair" aria-hidden="true"></i>

            <span v-if="tilesFailed" class="credit">Map pictures unavailable right now</span>
            <span v-else class="credit">New OneMap | Map data Â© contributors, Singapore Land Authority</span>

        ? `${start.replace(/ (AM|PM)$/, start.slice(-2) === end.slice(-2) ? '' : ' $1')} â€“ ${end}`
        : start
    return `${day(props.task.startAt, { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}, ${range}`
})
// Trips: suggest leaving 30 minutes early
const leaveBy = computed(() =>
    props.task.needsTransit ? `Leave home by ${time(new Date(props.task.startAt).getTime() - 30 * 60 * 1000)}` : ''
)
const addressLine = computed(() => {
    const loc = props.task.location
    if (!loc) return ''
    return [loc.address, loc.postal].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
})
const mapsUrl = computed(() => {
    const loc = props.task.location
    if (!loc) return ''
    const target = Number.isFinite(loc.lat) && Number.isFinite(loc.lng)
        ? `${loc.lat},${loc.lng}`
        : [loc.name, loc.address].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
    return target ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(target)}` : ''
})

// Segmented progress: Claimed / In progress / Done
const progress = computed(() => {
    const reached = { claimed: 0, in_progress: 1, completed: 2 }[status.value] ?? -1
    return [WORDS.claimed, WORDS.inProgress, WORDS.done].map((label, i) => ({ label, on: i <= reached }))
})

// Main green button
const mainButton = computed(() => {
    if (status.value === 'open') return overdue.value ? null : { label: "I'll take it", event: 'claim', icon: 'bi-hand-thumbs-up' }
    if (props.task.needsTransit && props.isClaimer && status.value === 'claimed') {
        return { label: WORDS.startTrip, event: 'start', icon: 'bi-arrow-right' }
    }
    if (props.task.needsTransit && session.value) {
        return { label: isLive.value ? WORDS.openTrip : WORDS.viewTrip, event: 'open-trip', icon: 'bi-geo-alt' }
    }
    return null
})

async function loadSession() {
    if (!props.task.needsTransit) {
        session.value = null
        return
    }
    try {
        session.value = await getTransitSession(props.familyId, props.task._id)
    } catch {
        session.value = null
    }
}
watch(() => [props.task._id, props.task.status], loadSession, { immediate: true })
</script>

<script setup>
// Owner: Chaithra (E). Matches Figma "Mobile prototype" â†’ "16 Â· Transit mode".
// Phone layout of Transit mode. TransitView loads the data and does the posting;
// this component only shows it and sends events back.
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { formatTime } from '../../my-tasks/utils/formatters.js'
import OneMapTiles from './OneMapTiles.vue'
import PersonAvatar from '../../my-tasks/components/PersonAvatar.vue'
import { WORDS, TRIP_STEPS, extraUpdates } from '../utils/wording.js'

const props = defineProps({
    task: { type: Object, required: true },
    session: { type: Object, default: null },
    who: { type: String, default: '' },
    companionFirst: { type: String, default: '' },
    isCompanion: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    canStart: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isPosting: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    actionError: { type: String, default: '' },
    notice: { type: String, default: '' },
    liveSpot: { type: Object, default: null },    // { lat, lng, at } while the trip is live
    locationNote: { type: String, default: '' },  // companion only: "Sharing your locationâ€¦"
    liveCaption: { type: String, default: '' },   // "Live Â· updated 1:42 PM" or "Location paused Â· â€¦"
    canResume: { type: Boolean, default: false }, // companion, after an accidental End transit
    liveTime: { type: String, default: '' },       // photo-pin bubble: "12:25 AM Tue"
    liveNote: { type: String, default: '' },       // photo-pin bubble: "Heading home"
    otherTrips: { type: Array, default: () => [] } // other family members on a trip right now
})
const emit = defineEmits(['back', 'post', 'start', 'dismiss', 'resume', 'open-trip', 'remove'])

// The fixed steps in order, with the labels used on the phone design
// Same steps and quick updates as the laptop layout (utils/wording.js)
const PRESETS = TRIP_STEPS
const EXTRA_CHIPS = computed(() => extraUpdates(props.who))

const customText = ref('')

const milestones = computed(() => props.session?.milestones || [])
const isActive = computed(() => props.session?.status === 'active')
const isEnded = computed(() => props.session?.status === 'ended')
const trail = computed(() => props.session?.path || [])
const hasPlace = computed(() => Number.isFinite(props.task.location?.lat) && Number.isFinite(props.task.location?.lng))
const placeName = computed(() => props.task.location?.name || 'the clinic')

// Done steps (as posted) followed by the preset steps still to come
const steps = computed(() => {
    const done = milestones.value.map((m) => ({ ...m, done: true }))
    const lastPreset = Math.max(-1, ...milestones.value.map((m) => PRESETS.findIndex((p) => p.type === m.type)))
    const todo = isEnded.value ? [] : PRESETS.slice(lastPreset + 1).map((p) => ({ ...p, done: false }))
    return [...done, ...todo]
})
const currentIndex = computed(() => milestones.value.length - 1)
const nextIndex = computed(() => steps.value.findIndex((s) => !s.done))

// Four chips: the next preset step (highlighted), two common custom ones, then later steps
const chips = computed(() => {
    const posted = new Set(milestones.value.map((m) => m.label.toLowerCase()))
    const upcoming = steps.value.filter((s) => !s.done && s.type !== 'home')
    const list = []
    if (upcoming[0]) list.push({ type: upcoming[0].type, label: upcoming[0].label, suggested: true })
    for (const label of EXTRA_CHIPS.value) {
        if (!posted.has(label.toLowerCase())) list.push({ type: 'custom', label })
    }
    for (const step of upcoming.slice(1)) list.push({ type: step.type, label: step.label })
    return list.slice(0, 4)
})

const subtitle = computed(() => {
    if (!props.session) return 'Transit not started yet'
    const withWho = props.who ? `With ${props.who}` : props.companionFirst ? `With ${props.companionFirst}` : ''
    return [withWho, isActive.value ? 'family can see this live' : 'trip ended'].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')
})

const time = (value) => formatTime(value).toUpperCase().replace(/(AM|PM)$/, ' $1')

function postChip(chip) {
    emit('post', { type: chip.type, label: chip.label })
}

function postCustom() {
    const label = customText.value.trim()
    if (!label) return
    emit('post', { type: 'custom', label })
    customText.value = ''
}

function safelyHome() {
    if (window.confirm(`Is ${props.who || 'everyone'} safely back home? This finishes the task and tells the family.`)) {
        emit('post', { type: 'home', label: WORDS.safelyHome })
    }
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="m-transit">
        <!-- Green header -->
        <header class="bar">
            <button type="button" class="back" aria-label="Back" @click="emit('back')">
                <i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            </button>
            <div class="bar-text">
                <strong>{{ task.title }}</strong>
                <span>{{ subtitle }}</span>
            </div>
            <span v-if="isActive" class="live">{{ WORDS.live }}</span>
            <span v-else-if="isEnded" class="live ended">{{ WORDS.ended }}</span>
        </header>

        <div v-if="otherTrips.length" class="also-live body">
            <span>{{ WORDS.alsoOnTrip }}</span>
            <button v-for="trip in otherTrips" :key="trip.taskId" type="button" class="also-live-chip" @click="emit('open-trip', trip)">
                <PersonAvatar :name="trip.companion?.name || ''" :size="24" tone="peach" />

                <span class="also-live-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </button>
        </div>

        <div v-if="notice" class="msg" role="status" @click="emit('dismiss')">{{ notice }}</div>
        <div v-if="actionError" class="msg is-error" role="alert">{{ actionError }}</div>

        <!-- Not started -->
        <div v-if="!session" class="body">
            <p class="hint">Transit starts when {{ companionFirst || 'the person who claimed this task' }} taps "{{ WORDS.startTrip }}".</p>
            <button v-if="canStart" type="button" class="btn-start" :disabled="isPosting" @click="emit('start')">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ WORDS.startTrip }}
            </button>
        </div>

        <template v-else>
            <!-- Map: always on a trip with a place (the clinic pin), plus the person once they share location -->
            <section v-if="liveSpot || trail.length > 1 || hasPlace" class="live-map body" aria-label="Live map">
                <OneMapTiles
                    :lat="task.location?.lat ?? null"
                    :lng="task.location?.lng ?? null"
                    :live-lat="liveSpot?.lat ?? null"
                    :live-lng="liveSpot?.lng ?? null"
                    :live-label="companionFirst"
                    :trail="trail"
                    :live-time="liveTime"
                    :live-note="liveNote"
                    :label="liveSpot ? (liveCaption || `Live Â· updated ${time(liveSpot.at)}`) : trail.length > 1 ? 'Route travelled' : (task.location?.name || 'Destination')"
                    :height="260"
                    :fit-width="320"
                />
            </section>

            <!-- Checklist -->
            <ol class="steps body" aria-label="Trip progress">
                <li
                    v-for="(step, index) in steps"
                    :key="step.done ? `${step.type}-${step.at}` : step.type"
                    :class="{ done: step.done, current: index === currentIndex, after: index > currentIndex }"
                >
                    <span class="rail" aria-hidden="true"><span class="dot"></span><span class="line"></span></span>
                    <span class="step-text">
                        <strong>{{ step.type === 'arrived' && step.done && step.label === 'Arrived at clinic' ? `Arrived at ${placeName}` : step.label }}</strong>
                        <small v-if="step.done">{{ time(step.at) }}</small>
                        <small v-else-if="index === nextIndex && isActive">Next</small>
                    </span>
                    <button
                        v-if="step.done && isCompanion && step.type !== 'home'"
                        type="button"
                        class="remove-step"
                        :disabled="isPosting"
                        :aria-label="`Remove ${step.label}`"
                        @click="emit('remove', step)"
                    >
                        <i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                </li>
            </ol>

            <!-- Companion: post the next update -->
            <section v-if="isActive && isCompanion" class="post body" aria-labelledby="m-post-title">
                <h2 id="m-post-title">Post the next update</h2>
                <div class="chips">
                    <button
                        v-for="chip in chips"
                        :key="`${chip.type}-${chip.label}`"
                        type="button"
                        class="chip"
                        :class="{ suggested: chip.suggested }"
                        :disabled="isPosting"
                        @click="postChip(chip)"
                    >
                        {{ chip.label }}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <form class="own" @submit.prevent="postCustom">
                    <input v-model="customText" type="text" maxlength="80" placeholder="Or type your own update" aria-label="Your own update" />
                    <button type="submit" class="send" :disabled="isPosting || !customText.trim()" aria-label="Post update">
                        <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    </button>
                </form>
                <p v-if="locationNote" class="location-note">{{ locationNote }}</p>
            </section>

            <p v-else-if="isActive" class="hint body">
                You're following live. Only {{ companionFirst || 'the companion' }} can post updates.
            </p>
            <p v-else-if="isEnded" class="hint body done-note">
                {{ task.status === 'completed' ? `${who || 'Everyone'} is safely back home. The task is done.` : WORDS.tripEnded }}
            </p>
            <div v-if="canResume" class="body">
                <button type="button" class="btn-resume" :disabled="isPosting" @click="emit('resume')">
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ WORDS.resumeTrip }}
                </button>
            </div>
        </template>

        <!-- F (SeungHak): "Notes from this visit" (consultation notes), filled in by TransitView -->
        <div v-if="$slots.notes && task" class="visit-notes body">
            <slot name="notes" />
        </div>

        <!-- Bottom: finish the trip -->
        <footer v-if="isActive && isCompanion" class="footer">
            <button type="button" class="btn-home" :disabled="isPosting" @click="safelyHome">
                <i class="bi bi-house" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                {{ who || 'Everyone' }} is safely back home
            </button>
            <small>This finishes the task and tells the family.</small>
        </footer>
    </div>
</template>

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Calls for Transit Mode and the OneMap clinic search.
import { http } from '../../../services/http.js'
import { authHeaders } from '../../my-tasks/services/myTasksApi.js'

const base = (familyId, taskId) => `/families/${familyId}/tasks/${taskId}`

// D's endpoint: the task itself (title, time, location, who claimed it)
export async function getTask(familyId, taskId) {
    const response = await http.get(base(familyId, taskId), { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.task
}

// Returns null if the trip hasn't been started yet (404)
export async function getTransitSession(familyId, taskId) {
    try {
        const response = await http.get(`${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit`, { headers: authHeaders() })
        return response.data.transitSession
    } catch (error) {
        if (error.response?.status === 404) return null
        throw error
    }
}

// Preset step: { type: 'arrived' }. Custom step: { type: 'custom', label: 'Going for lunch' }
export async function postMilestone(familyId, taskId, milestone) {
    const response = await http.post(
        `${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit/milestones`, milestone, { headers: authHeaders() }
    )
    return response.data.transitSession
}

// Remove a step posted by mistake. `at` is the step's own time (steps have no id).
export async function removeMilestone(familyId, taskId, at) {
    const response = await http.delete(`${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit/milestones`, {
        headers: authHeaders(),
        params: { at }
    })
    return response.data.transitSession
}

// "End transit": stops the trip without completing the task
export async function endTransit(familyId, taskId) {
    const response = await http.post(`${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit/end`, null, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.transitSession
}

// Live location: the companion's browser sends { lat, lng } while the trip is active
export async function updateLocation(familyId, taskId, position) {
    const response = await http.patch(`${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit/location`, position, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.lastLocation
}

// For the live banner on Family Home
export async function getActiveTransitSessions(familyId) {
    const response = await http.get(`/families/${familyId}/transit`, {
        headers: authHeaders(),
        params: { status: 'active' }
    })
    return response.data.transitSessions
}

// OneMap search through our backend. Each clinic: { name, address, postal, lat, lng }
// { clinics, otherPlaces }: medical places first; otherPlaces is for when nothing medical matched
export async function searchClinics(query) {
    const response = await http.get('/integrations/clinics', { headers: authHeaders(), params: { q: query } })
    return { clinics: response.data.clinics || [], otherPlaces: response.data.otherPlaces || [] }
}

// Undo an accidental "End transit": the same trip carries on
export async function resumeTransit(familyId, taskId) {
    const response = await http.post(`${base(familyId, taskId)}/transit/resume`, null, { headers: authHeaders() })
    return response.data.transitSession
}

FILE: client/src/features/transit/utils/calendarLinks.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// "Add to calendar" for one task, in the person's own calendar app. No login or API key:
//   Google Calendar  -> opens Google Calendar (app or website) with the event filled in
//   Outlook          -> opens Outlook on the web with the event filled in
//   Apple Calendar   -> opens the event in Calendar on iPhone / Mac (an .ics event, which
//                       Safari hands straight to the Calendar app)
// Used by AddToCalendar.vue.

const HOUR = 60 * 60 * 1000

function times(task) {
    const start = new Date(task.startAt)
    const end = task.endAt ? new Date(task.endAt) : new Date(start.getTime() + HOUR)
    return { start, end }
}

function place(task) {
    const loc = task.location || {}
    return [loc.name, loc.address, loc.postal ? `S${loc.postal}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
}

function details(task) {
    const family = task.family?.name ? `${task.family.name} Â· ` : ''
    return [`${family}From CareCircle`, task.description].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n')
}

// 2026-10-09T02:00:00.000Z -> 20261009T020000Z
function compactUtc(date) {
    return date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d{3}/, '')
}

export function googleCalendarUrl(task) {
    const { start, end } = times(task)
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        action: 'TEMPLATE',
        text: task.title,
        dates: `${compactUtc(start)}/${compactUtc(end)}`,
        details: details(task),
        location: place(task)
    })
    return `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?${params.toString()}`
}

export function outlookCalendarUrl(task) {
    const { start, end } = times(task)
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        path: '/calendar/action/compose',
        rru: 'addevent',
        subject: task.title,
        startdt: start.toISOString(),
        enddt: end.toISOString(),
        body: details(task),
        location: place(task)
    })
    return `https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?${params.toString()}`
}

function escapeText(text = '') {
    return String(text).replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/;/g, '\\;').replace(/,/g, '\\,').replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
}

// Opens one event in Apple Calendar. On iPhone/iPad and Mac Safari this shows the
// "Add to Calendar" screen; other browsers save a small calendar file instead.
export function openInAppleCalendar(task) {
    const { start, end } = times(task)
    const where = place(task)
    const event = [
        'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
        'VERSION:2.0',
        'PRODID:-//CareCircle//Task//EN',
        'BEGIN:VEVENT',
        `UID:${task._id}@carecircle`,
        `DTSTAMP:${compactUtc(new Date())}`,
        `DTSTART:${compactUtc(start)}`,
        `DTEND:${compactUtc(end)}`,
        `SUMMARY:${escapeText(task.title)}`,
        where ? `LOCATION:${escapeText(where)}` : '',
        `DESCRIPTION:${escapeText(details(task))}`,
        'END:VEVENT',
        'END:VCALENDAR'
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\r\n')

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([event], { type: 'text/calendar' }))
    const link = Object.assign(document.createElement('a'), {
        href: url,
        download: `${task.title.replace(/[^\w -]/g, '').trim() || 'task'}.ics`
    })
    document.body.appendChild(link)
    link.click()
    link.remove()
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
}

FILE: client/src/features/transit/utils/useActiveTransit.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// The family's live trips, shaped for the Family Home banners (B's TransitBanner and
// MobileTransitCard). Several people can be on a trip at once, so there's one banner each.
// Polls every 15 s, like the rest of Transit mode.
//   const { liveTransits, openLiveTransit } = useActiveTransit(selectedFamilyId)
//   liveTransits -> [{ recipient, companion, headline, mobileHeadline, detail, familyId, taskId }]
//   openLiveTransit(banner) opens that trip's Transit page
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, unref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { getActiveTransitSessions } from '../services/transitApi.js'
import { formatTime } from '../../my-tasks/utils/formatters.js'

const POLL_MS = 15 * 1000
const STEPS = ['departed', 'arrived', 'consultation_done', 'heading_home', 'home']
const NEXT_LABEL = {
    departed: 'arrived at clinic',
    arrived: 'consultation done',
    consultation_done: 'heading home',
    heading_home: 'safely back home'
}

// Without a chosen profile picture, the shared avatar falls back by care type (every elderly
// person becomes Grandpa, every user becomes Alex). Pick the sample picture by name first.
const PICTURES = { grandpa: 'grandpa', grandma: 'grandma', emma: 'baby-emma', jasmine: 'jasmine', alex: 'alex', may: 'aunt-may', mia: 'mia' }
function withPicture(person) {
    if (!person || person.profilePicture) return person || {}
    const words = String(person.nickname || person.name || '').toLowerCase().split(/\s+/)
    const key = Object.keys(PICTURES).find((k) => words.includes(k))
    return key ? { ...person, profilePicture: `/avatars/people/${PICTURES[key]}.png` } : person
}

const idOf = (value) => (value && typeof value === 'object' ? value._id : value)

// Exported for the unit tests (__tests__/activeTransitBanner.spec.js)
export function toBanner(session, familyId) {
    if (!session) return null
    const task = session.task || {}
    const recipient = task.recipient && typeof task.recipient === 'object' ? task.recipient : null
    const who = recipient?.nickname || recipient?.name || task.title || 'Your family'
    const companion = session.companion || {}
    const companionFirst = (companion.name || 'someone').split(' ')[0]
    const place = task.location?.name || task.location?.address || 'the clinic'
    const steps = session.milestones || []
    const latest = steps[steps.length - 1]

    let mobileHeadline
    switch (latest?.type) {
        case 'departed': mobileHeadline = `${who} is on the way to ${place}`; break
        case 'arrived': mobileHeadline = `${who} arrived at ${place}`; break
        case 'consultation_done': mobileHeadline = `${who}'s consultation is done`; break
        case 'heading_home': mobileHeadline = `${who} is heading home`; break
        case 'custom': mobileHeadline = `${who}: ${latest.label}`; break
        default: mobileHeadline = `${who}'s trip has started`
    }

    const done = new Set(steps.map((s) => s.type))
    const doneCount = STEPS.filter((t) => done.has(t)).length
    const lastPreset = [...steps].reverse().find((s) => NEXT_LABEL[s.type])
    const next = lastPreset ? NEXT_LABEL[lastPreset.type] : 'arrived at clinic'
    const when = formatTime(latest?.at || session.startedAt)

    return {
        recipient: withPicture(recipient),
        companion: withPicture(companion),
        mobileHeadline,
        // MobileTransitCard shows the part before " with " and the part before the first " Â· "
        headline: `${mobileHeadline} with ${companionFirst}`,
        detail: `${when} Â· ${doneCount} of ${STEPS.length} milestones Â· next: ${next}`,
        familyId,
        taskId: idOf(session.task)
    }
}

export function useActiveTransit(familyIdRef, { enabled = true } = {}) {
    const router = useRouter()
    const sessions = ref([])
    let timer = null
    let version = 0

    async function load() {
        // Clearing the selected family also invalidates a request already in flight.
        const current = ++version
        const familyId = unref(familyIdRef)
        if (!enabled || !familyId) {
            sessions.value = []
            return
        }
        try {
            const list = await getActiveTransitSessions(familyId)
            if (current === version) sessions.value = list || []
        } catch {
            // Keep the last banner; the next poll tries again
        }
    }

    // Newest trip first (the server sorts by startedAt)
    const liveTransits = computed(() => sessions.value.map((s) => toBanner(s, unref(familyIdRef))).filter(Boolean))
    const liveTransit = computed(() => liveTransits.value[0] || null)

    function openLiveTransit(banner = liveTransit.value) {
        if (banner?.taskId) {
            router.push({ name: 'transit', params: { familyId: banner.familyId, taskId: banner.taskId } })
        }
    }

    watch(() => unref(familyIdRef), () => {
        sessions.value = []
        load()
    })
    onMounted(() => {
        load()
        timer = setInterval(() => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load()
        }, POLL_MS)
    })
    onUnmounted(() => { version++; clearInterval(timer) })

    return { liveTransits, liveTransit, openLiveTransit, reload: load }
}

FILE: client/src/features/transit/utils/useLiveLocation.js
================================================
// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Shares the companion's position while a trip is active.
//   const live = useLiveLocation({ enabled, send })
//   live.position  -> { lat, lng, at } | null   (this device's latest fix)
//   live.status    -> 'off' | 'waiting' | 'sharing' | 'denied' | 'unsupported'
// The browser asks "Allow location?" the first time. Positions are sent to the server
// at most every SEND_MS; the map on everyone else's screen picks them up on its next poll.
// Browsers can't share location in the background: it pauses when this page is closed or
// the phone locks. To help, the screen is kept awake while sharing (where supported).
import { ref, watch, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const SEND_MS = 20 * 1000

export function useLiveLocation({ enabled, send }) {
    const position = ref(null)
    const status = ref('off')
    let watchId = null
    let lastSent = 0
    let wakeLock = null

    // Keep the screen on while sharing; the browser drops this when the tab is hidden
    async function keepAwake() {
        try {
            if ('wakeLock' in navigator && !wakeLock && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                wakeLock = await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')
                wakeLock.addEventListener('release', () => { wakeLock = null })
            }
        } catch {
            wakeLock = null // not supported or not allowed: sharing still works
        }
    }
    function onVisible() {
        if (watchId !== null && document.visibilityState === 'visible') keepAwake()
    }

    function stop() {
        if (watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId)
        watchId = null
        wakeLock?.release().catch(() => {})
        wakeLock = null
        document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible)
        if (status.value !== 'denied' && status.value !== 'unsupported') status.value = 'off'
    }

    function onFix(fix) {
        const point = { lat: fix.coords.latitude, lng: fix.coords.longitude, at: new Date().toISOString() }
        position.value = point
        status.value = 'sharing'
        if (Date.now() - lastSent >= SEND_MS) {
            lastSent = Date.now()
            // A failed send is fine: the next fix tries again
            send({ lat: point.lat, lng: point.lng }).catch(() => { lastSent = 0 })
        }
    }

    function onError(error) {
        // 1 = the user said no. 2/3 = no signal or timed out: keep watching
        if (error.code === 1) {
            status.value = 'denied'
            stop()
        }
    }

    function start() {
        if (!('geolocation' in navigator) || !window.isSecureContext) {
            status.value = 'unsupported'
            return
        }
        if (watchId !== null) return
        status.value = 'waiting'
        lastSent = 0
        watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(onFix, onError, {
            enableHighAccuracy: true,
            maximumAge: 10 * 1000,
            timeout: 30 * 1000
        })
        keepAwake()
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible)
    }

    watch(enabled, (on) => (on ? start() : stop()), { immediate: true })
    onUnmounted(stop)

    return { position, status }
}

import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'
import AppLayout from '../components/layout/AppLayout.vue'
import LoginView from '../features/auth/views/LoginView.vue'
import SignupView from '../features/auth/views/SignupView.vue'
import JoinFamilyView from '../features/auth/views/JoinFamilyView.vue'
import CreateFamilyView from '../features/family/views/CreateFamilyView.vue'
import FamilyHomeView from '../features/family/views/FamilyHomeView.vue'
import FamilySettingsView from '../features/settings/views/FamilySettingsView.vue'
import ProfileView from '../features/auth/views/ProfileView.vue'
import PublicProfileView from '../features/auth/views/PublicProfileView.vue'
import PetDressupView from '../features/auth/views/PetDressupView.vue'
import AvatarStudioView from '../features/avatar/views/AvatarStudioView.vue'
import RecipientLogView from '../features/logs/views/RecipientLogView.vue'

import MyTasksView from '../features/my-tasks/views/MyTasksView.vue'
import ContributionsView from '../features/contributions/ContributionsView.vue'
import TransitView from '../features/transit/views/TransitView.vue'
import TaskDetailView from '../features/transit/views/TaskDetailView.vue'

import RecipientHubView from '../features/recipients/views/RecipientHubView.vue'
import RecipientOverviewView from '../features/recipients/views/RecipientOverviewView.vue'
import RecipientTasksView from '../features/recipients/views/RecipientTasksView.vue'
import RecipientProfileView from '../features/recipients/views/RecipientProfileView.vue'
import RecipientNewView from '../features/recipients/views/RecipientNewView.vue'
import NewTaskView from '../features/tasks/views/NewTaskView.vue'
import CalendarView from '../features/calendar/views/CalendarView.vue'
import SearchView from '../features/search/views/SearchView.vue'
import { verifySession, clearUserSession } from '../features/auth/services/authApi.js'
const routes = [
  {path:'/login',component:LoginView},
  {path:'/signup',component:SignupView},
  {path:'/create-family',name:'create-family',component:CreateFamilyView,meta:{requiresAuth:true}},
  {path:'/join-family',component:JoinFamilyView,meta:{requiresAuth:true}},
  {path:'/',component:AppLayout,meta:{requiresAuth:true},children:[
    {path:'',redirect:'/home'},
    {path:'home',name:'home',component:FamilyHomeView},
    {path:'settings',name:'family-settings',component:FamilySettingsView},
    {path:'family/settings',redirect:'/settings'},
    {path:'family',redirect:'/home'},
    {path:'profile',name:'profile',component:ProfileView},
    {path:'profile/:userId',name:'public-profile',component:PublicProfileView},
    {path:'dress-up',name:'dress-up',component:PetDressupView,meta:{search:false}},
    {path:'avatar-studio',name:'avatar-studio',component:AvatarStudioView,meta:{search:false}},
    {path:'tasks/new',name:'task-new',component:NewTaskView},
    {path:'my-tasks',name:'my-tasks',component:MyTasksView},
    {path:'family-tasks',redirect:'/home'},
    {path:'contributions',name:'contributions',component:ContributionsView},
    {path:'calendar',name:'calendar',component:CalendarView},
    // meta.search: false hides the search bar at the top of the page (AppLayout)
    {path:'search',name:'search',component:SearchView,meta:{search:false}},
    {path:'transit/:familyId/:taskId',name:'transit',component:TransitView,props:true,meta:{search:false}},
    {path:'families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId',name:'task-detail',component:TaskDetailView,props:true},
    {path:'recipients/new',name:'recipient-new',component:RecipientNewView},
    {path:'recipients/:recipientId',component:RecipientHubView,children:[
      {path:'',name:'recipient-overview',component:RecipientOverviewView},
      {path:'tasks',name:'recipient-tasks',component:RecipientTasksView},
      {path:'log',name:'recipient-log',component:RecipientLogView},
      {path:'profile',name:'recipient-profile',component:RecipientProfileView}
    ]}
  ]},
  // Explicit fictional-data preview, independent from real authentication/families.
  {path:'/preview',component:AppLayout,meta:{preview:true},children:[
    {path:'',redirect:'/preview/home'},
    {path:'home',name:'preview-home',component:FamilyHomeView},
    {path:'settings',name:'preview-settings',component:FamilySettingsView}
  ]},
  {path:'/:pathMatch(.*)*',redirect:'/home'}
]
const router=createRouter({history:createWebHistory(),routes})
router.beforeEach(async to=>{
  if (to.meta.preview) return true
  const token=sessionStorage.getItem('token')
  const protectedRoute=to.matched.some(record=>record.meta.requiresAuth)
  const authPage=to.path==='/login'||to.path==='/signup'
  if (!token) return protectedRoute ? {path:'/login'} : true
  const result=await verifySession()
  if(result.status==='invalid') {
    clearUserSession()
    return protectedRoute ? {path:'/login'} : true
  }
  if(result.status==='unavailable') return protectedRoute ? {path:'/login',query:{serviceUnavailable:'1'}} : true
  if(authPage) return {path:'/home'}
  return true
})
export default router

// Shared TanStack Query cache for data from the API.
// Every page reads server data through a query, so switching tabs or pages
// reuses what is already loaded instead of fetching it again.
//
// Rules for the whole app:
// - Data counts as fresh for 1 minute. While fresh, opening a page uses the cache
//   with no request. Once stale, the cached data shows straight away and a
//   background refetch quietly updates it.
// - Unused data is dropped from memory after 10 minutes.
// - Coming back to the browser tab refetches stale data.
// - 401/403/404 are not retried: retrying won't change the answer.
import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/vue-query'

const NO_RETRY_STATUSES = [401, 403, 404]

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
        queries: {
            staleTime: 60 * 1000,
            gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
            refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
            retry: (failureCount, error) =>
                !NO_RETRY_STATUSES.includes(error?.response?.status) && failureCount < 1
        }
    }
})

// Query keys. Everything for a family sits under ['families', familyId], so
// invalidating that prefix refreshes all of one family's data at once.
export const queryKeys = {
    family: (familyId) => ['families', familyId],
    tasks: (familyId) => ['families', familyId, 'tasks'],
    recipients: (familyId) => ['families', familyId, 'recipients'],
    recipientList: (familyId) => ['families', familyId, 'recipients', 'list'],
    recipient: (familyId, recipientId) => ['families', familyId, 'recipients', 'detail', recipientId],
    logs: (familyId) => ['families', familyId, 'logs'],
    recipientLogs: (familyId, recipientId, filters) => ['families', familyId, 'logs', recipientId, filters]
}

FILE: client/src/styles/motion.css

/* Shared motion for the whole app. Calm and short: some of our users are elderly.
   Use these classes with Vue's <Transition> / <TransitionGroup> instead of writing
   new ones in components. Exits run at about 70% of the enter duration.
   Everything here turns into a short opacity fade under "Reduce motion" (bottom of file). */
:root {
  --motion-fast: 150ms; /* chips, toggles, tabs, dropdowns */
  --motion-base: 220ms; /* pages, panels, cards */
  --motion-slow: 300ms; /* modals, transit mode, podium */
  --ease-enter: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  --ease-exit: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1);
}

/* ---- Pages: <Transition name="care-page" mode="out-in"> around the RouterView ----
   Pages move with `top` rather than transform: a transform would make the page the
   containing block for its position: fixed children (phone bottom nav, toasts),
   and they would jump for the length of the animation. */
.care-page-enter-active {
  position: relative;
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter),
    top var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-page-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 150ms var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-page-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  top: 8px;
}
.care-page-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* ---- Transit mode: slides up like a sheet ---- */
.care-sheet-enter-active {
  position: relative;
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-slow) var(--ease-enter),
    top var(--motion-slow) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-sheet-leave-active {
  transition: opacity calc(var(--motion-slow) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-sheet-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  top: 24px;
}
.care-sheet-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* ---- Crossfade (recipient hub tab content) ---- */
.care-fade-enter-active {
  transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-fade-leave-active {
  transition: opacity calc(var(--motion-fast) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-fade-enter-from,
.care-fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* ---- Modal backdrop ---- */
.care-backdrop-enter-active {
  transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-backdrop-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* ---- Modal panel (care-pop) ---- */
.care-pop-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter),
    transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-pop-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit),
    transform calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-pop-enter-from,
.care-pop-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

/* Modals are mounted with v-if by their parents, so they can't use a leave transition.
   They add these classes instead, wait for animationend, then emit 'close'. */
.care-pop-closing {
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: care-pop-out calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit) forwards;
}
.care-backdrop-closing {
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: care-fade-out calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit) forwards;
}
@keyframes care-pop-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.96);
  }
}
@keyframes care-fade-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ---- Panel that grows from its launcher (assistant). Set transform-origin on the panel. ---- */
.care-grow-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter),
    transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-grow-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit),
    transform calc(var(--motion-base) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-grow-enter-from,
.care-grow-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.9);
}

/* ---- Lists: <TransitionGroup name="care-list">, never with `appear` ----
   The list element needs position: relative so leaving rows are placed inside it. */
.care-list-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-enter),
    transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-list-leave-active {
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  transition: opacity calc(var(--motion-fast) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-list-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(6px);
}
.care-list-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}
.care-list-move {
  transition: transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter);
}

/* ---- Dropdowns (search results etc.) ---- */
.care-drop-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-enter),
    transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-enter);
}
.care-drop-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity calc(var(--motion-fast) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit),
    transform calc(var(--motion-fast) * 0.7) var(--ease-exit);
}
.care-drop-enter-from,
.care-drop-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

/* ---- Sliding tab underline (useTabIndicator). The tab bar needs position: relative. ---- */
.care-tab-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--care-green);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.care-tab-indicator.is-ready {
  transition:
    transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter),
    width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-enter);
}

/* ---- Row changed by someone else (live update). Remove the class on animationend. ---- */
.care-flash {
  animation: care-flash 1.5s var(--ease-exit);
}
@keyframes care-flash {
  /* No `to`: it fades back to the row's own background */
  from {
    background-color: var(--care-soft);
  }
}

/* ---- Check mark drawn once (claim button). Use on an <svg> with a <polyline>. ---- */
.care-check polyline {
  stroke-dasharray: 24;
  stroke-dashoffset: 24;
  animation: care-check-draw 250ms var(--ease-enter) forwards;
}
@keyframes care-check-draw {
  to {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
}

/* ---- Reduce motion: every class above becomes a 100ms opacity fade, nothing moves ---- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .care-page-enter-active,
  .care-page-leave-active,
  .care-sheet-enter-active,
  .care-sheet-leave-active,
  .care-fade-enter-active,
  .care-fade-leave-active,
  .care-backdrop-enter-active,
  .care-pop-enter-active,
  .care-pop-leave-active,
  .care-grow-enter-active,
  .care-grow-leave-active,
  .care-list-enter-active,
  .care-list-leave-active,
  .care-drop-enter-active,
  .care-drop-leave-active {
    transition: opacity 100ms linear;
  }
  .care-page-enter-from,
  .care-sheet-enter-from {
    top: 0;
  }
  .care-pop-enter-from,
  .care-pop-leave-to,
  .care-grow-enter-from,
  .care-grow-leave-to,
  .care-list-enter-from,
  .care-drop-enter-from,
  .care-drop-leave-to {
    transform: none;
  }
  /* Rows don't glide; a leaving row just fades where it is */
  .care-list-leave-active {
    position: static;
  }
  .care-list-move,
  .care-tab-indicator.is-ready {
    transition: none;
  }
  .care-pop-closing,
  .care-backdrop-closing {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 100ms linear;
  }
  .care-check polyline {
    animation: none;
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
  /* The flash is a colour fade only (nothing moves), so it stays, just quicker */
  .care-flash {
    animation-duration: 600ms;
  }
}

# CareCircle API contract

All endpoints, by package. **Implemented** means the endpoint is merged and tested; **Planned** means it is agreed but not built. If you change an endpoint, update this file in the same PR. Owners are listed in [OWNERSHIP.md](OWNERSHIP.md).

| Pkg | Owner | Base path | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Sera | `/api/auth`, `/api/families` | Planned (middleware and models done) |
| B | SangYoon | `/api/families/:familyId` (members, invitations); language via A's `/api/auth/me` | Member/invite code complete with local HTTP tests; MongoDB integration pending |
| C | Jhen | `/api/families/:familyId/recipients` | Implemented |
| D | Marcus | `/api/families/:familyId/tasks` | Planned (model and routes done; controller stubs return 501) |
| E | Chaithra | `/api/me/tasks`, `/api/me/google`, `/api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit`, `/api/families/:familyId/transit`, `/api/integrations/clinics` | Implemented |
| F | SeungHak | `/api/families/:familyId/logs`, `/api/families/:familyId/notifications`, `/api/integrations` | Logs and voice transcription implemented; notifications and Telegram planned |

Every package router is mounted in `server/src/routes/index.js` at the path listed in this file. Endpoints that are still placeholders return `501`.

---

## Conventions

**Base URL.** Express runs on `http://localhost:3000`. In development the Vue app calls `/api/...` and Vite proxies it. `GET /api/health` returns `{ status: 'ok' }`.

**Authentication.** Log in to get a JWT, then send it on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

The token is signed with `jwt.sign({ userId }, process.env.JWT_SECRET)`; `requireAuth` reads `userId` from it. `services/http.js` should add this header to every request.

**Tenancy.** Family data lives under `/api/families/:familyId/...`. Each of these routes runs `requireAuth` and then `requireFamilyMember`, which:
- loads the family;
- returns 404 if it doesn't exist, or 403 if the user isn't a member;
- sets `req.user`, `req.family` and `req.memberRole` (`admin` or `member`).

Always filter queries by `family: req.family._id`. Never take a family ID, user ID or role from the request body.

**Requests and responses**
- Bodies are JSON in both directions.
- IDs are MongoDB `_id` strings.
- References are named after the thing they point to: `recipient`, `claimedBy`, not `recipientId`.
- Dates are ISO 8601 strings in UTC, e.g. `2026-10-10T02:00:00.000Z`. Convert to Singapore time only in Vue.
- Responses wrap the data in a named key: `{ task }`, `{ tasks }`, `{ recipient }`, `{ recipients }`. A bare array is never returned.
- When a reference is populated, it comes back as a small object, e.g. `claimedBy: { _id, name, telegramUsername }`. When it isn't set, it is `null`.

**Errors.** Every error response looks like this:

```json
{ "error": "Validation failed", "errors": ["Title is required"] }
```

`errors` is only present for validation failures.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | Invalid input |
| 401 | Not logged in, or the token is invalid |
| 403 | Logged in, but not allowed (not a member, or wrong role) |
| 404 | Not found in this family. A malformed ID also returns 404. |
| 409 | Conflict: someone else changed it first, or the action isn't allowed in its current state. Refresh, then show the latest state. |
| 501 | Placeholder, not implemented yet |

**Enums and event names** live in `server/src/constants.js`. Import them; don't hard-code strings.

---

## A: Authentication & Families (Sera)

| Method | Path | Who | Body | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/auth/register` | public | `{ name, email, password, preferredLang? }` | `201 { token, user }` | Planned |
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | public | `{ email, password }` | `{ token, user }`; `401` if wrong | Planned |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | logged in | none | `204`. JWTs are stateless, so the client deletes its token. | Planned |
| GET | `/api/auth/me` | logged in | none | `{ user }` | Planned |
| GET | `/api/families` | logged in | none | `{ families: [{ _id, name, role, memberCount }] }`, used by the family switcher | Planned |
| POST | `/api/families` | logged in | `{ name, relationship? }` | `201 { family }`. The creator becomes `admin`, and a 6-character `inviteCode` is generated. | Planned |
| POST | `/api/families/join` | logged in | `{ inviteCode, relationship? }` | `{ family }`. `404` for an unknown code, `409` if already a member. | Planned |
| GET | `/api/families/:familyId` | member | none | `{ family }`, with member names populated | Planned |

- **`user` never includes `passwordHash`.** The schema marks it `select: false`.
- **Already done:**
  - Middleware: `requireAuth`, `requireFamilyMember`, `requireFamilyAdmin` in `server/src/middleware/authMiddleware.js`.
  - Models: `UserModel.js`, `FamilyModel.js` in `server/src/models/`.
  - Remaining work: the routes above, and hashing passwords with bcrypt on register.
- **Seed users:** `alex@`, `jasmine@`, `may@` and `mia@carecircle.test`, password `password123`. Family invite code: `7925C4A333`.

## B: Family Dashboard & Settings (SangYoon)

| Method | Path | Who | Body | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/families/:familyId/members` | member | none | `{ members: [{ user: { _id, name, email, preferredLang, telegramUsername }, role, joinedAt }] }` | Code + local HTTP tests; live DB pending |
| PATCH | `/api/families/:familyId/members/:userId` | admin | `{ role }` | `{ member }`. `409` if it would remove the last admin or access changed during the request. | Code + local HTTP tests; live DB pending |
| DELETE | `/api/families/:familyId/members/:userId` | admin, or the user themself (leaving) | none | `204`. `409` if it would remove the last admin or access changed during the request. | Code + local HTTP tests; live DB pending |

Family names are set at creation and cannot be changed. There is no family-renaming endpoint.
| POST | `/api/families/:familyId/invite-code` | admin | none | `{ inviteCode }` (10 hexadecimal characters; the old one stops working) | Code + local HTTP tests; live DB pending |
| PATCH | `/api/users/me` | logged in | `{ name?, phone?, preferredLang?, telegramUsername? }` | `{ user }` | Planned |

- **Dashboard:** Family Home doesn't need its own endpoint. It shares C's `GET /recipients` and D's `GET /tasks` query caches with the recipient pages, then filters the seven-day active-task window locally.
- **Light and dark mode:** handled in the browser only, saved in `localStorage`. No API.
- **`preferredLang`:** a LibreTranslate language code, e.g. `en` or `zh`. F's logs use it to decide which translation to show.
- **Current UI language save:** uses the existing `PATCH /api/auth/me` endpoint. It fetches `/api/auth/me` first and sends the complete profile fields required by A's controller. `/api/users/me` remains planned.
- **Current membership schema:** contains `userId`, `role`, `joinedAt`; no relationship field. The role endpoint accepts only `role` and rejects additional fields. Relationship editing requires an agreed schema extension with A.
- **Dashboard implementation:** Home filters active tasks from Singapore midnight to seven days later, shows today's tasks, and polls every 20 seconds while visible. Persistent activity, active transit and Telegram preference delivery remain E/F integration work. See [FAMILY-UI.md](FAMILY-UI.md).

## C: Care Recipient Management (Jhen)

Base: `/api/families/:familyId/recipients`

| Method | Path | Who | Body | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | member | Query: `includeArchived=true` (optional) | `{ recipients }`, sorted by `name`, `linkedUser` populated. Active only by default. | Implemented |
| POST | `/` | member | `{ name, nickname?, careType, dateOfBirth?, mobility?, allergies?, conditions?, dietaryRestrictions?, medications?, emergencyContacts?, preferredClinic?, careNotes?, linkedUser? }` | `201 { recipient }`. Always `isActive: true`; `family` and `isActive` in the body are ignored. | Implemented |
| GET | `/:recipientId` | member | none | `{ recipient }`, `linkedUser` populated | Implemented |
| PATCH | `/:recipientId` | member | any of the POST fields, including `linkedUser?` | `{ recipient }`. `family`, `isActive` and timestamps can't change; an empty body is `400 Nothing to update`. New or edited `medications` entries get `updatedBy` and `updatedAt`. Will send `medication.changed` if the list changed, once `notify()` exists. | Implemented |
| POST | `/:recipientId/archive` | admin | none | `{ recipient }` with `isActive: false` and `linkedUser: null`, so the account can be linked again. Archiving twice just returns it. Recipients are archived, never deleted. | Implemented |

- **Model:** `server/src/features/recipients/CareRecipient.model.js`, registered as `CareRecipient` in the `carerecipients` collection. C owns it.
- **`linkedUser`:** optional user id for a recipient who also has an account (e.g. a pregnant member). `null` or `''` unlinks, and anyone can do that. You can only link your own account (`403` otherwise); re-sending the current link unchanged is fine. Infant recipients can't be linked, including changing a linked recipient's `careType` to `infant` (`400`). It must be a member of this family, otherwise `400`. One account links to at most one recipient per family; a second link returns `409`.
- **Sub-documents:** `mobility: { level, notes }`, `allergies: [{ name, severity }]`, `medications: [{ name, dosage, frequency, startDate, notes }]`, `emergencyContacts: [{ name, relationship, phone }]`, `preferredClinic: { name, address, postal, lat, lng }`. Sending `null` for a list clears it. `updatedBy`/`updatedAt` on medications are set by the server.
- **Overview tab:** combines D's `GET /tasks?recipient=<id>&from=<now>`, F's `GET /logs?recipient=<id>&limit=1`, and this profile.
- **Tasks tab:** "Add task" goes to D's form with the recipient filled in. C doesn't need a task endpoint.

## D: Task Management (Marcus)

Base: `/api/families/:familyId/tasks`. **Implemented.**
- Routes, model and handlers live in `server/src/features/tasks/`.
- Local API integration tests exercise persistence, creator-only writes, concurrent claims and transit completion. Deployment and external notifications are separate validation work.

| Method | Path | Who | Body / query | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | member | Query (all optional): `status=open,claimed`, `recipient=<id>` or `none` (household tasks), `claimedBy=me` or `<userId>`, `from=<date>`, `to=<date>` (on `startAt`) | `{ tasks }`, sorted by `startAt` |
| GET | `/:taskId` | member | none | `{ task }` |
| POST | `/` | member | `{ title, startAt, endAt?, description?, category?, recipient?, location?, needsTransit? }` | `201 { task }`, always `open`. Sends `task.created`. |
| PATCH | `/:taskId` | creator only | any subset of the fields above | `{ task }`. `status` and `claimedBy` are ignored. `409` once a task is completed or cancelled. |
| DELETE | `/:taskId` | creator only | none | `200 { message, taskId }`. `409` for `in_progress` and `completed` tasks; cancel those instead. |
| POST | `/:taskId/claim` | member | none | open â†’ claimed. `409 { error: 'Task already claimed' }` if someone got there first. Sends `task.claimed`. |
| POST | `/:taskId/unclaim` | creator or claimer | none | claimed â†’ open. Sends `task.unclaimed`. |
| POST | `/:taskId/start` | claimer | none | claimed â†’ in_progress, `{ task, transitSession }`. A transit session is created only when `needsTransit` is true. |
| POST | `/:taskId/complete` | claimer | none | claimed or in_progress â†’ completed. Ends any transit session. Sends `task.completed`. |
| POST | `/:taskId/cancel` | creator, claimer or admin | none | open, claimed or in_progress â†’ cancelled. Ends any transit session. Sends `task.cancelled`. |

**Task shape**

```json
{
  "_id": "â€¦", "family": "â€¦",
  "recipient": { "_id": "â€¦", "name": "Tan Ah Kow", "nickname": "Grandpa", "careType": "elderly" },
  "title": "Eye check-up", "description": "â€¦", "category": "appointment",
  "startAt": "2026-10-09T02:00:00.000Z", "endAt": "2026-10-09T03:30:00.000Z",
  "location": { "name": "TTSH Eye Centre", "address": "â€¦", "postal": "308433", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.84 },
  "needsTransit": true, "status": "in_progress",
  "createdBy": { "_id": "â€¦", "name": "Aunt May", "telegramUsername": "auntmay" },
  "claimedBy": { "_id": "â€¦", "name": "Jasmine Tan", "telegramUsername": "jasminetan" },
  "claimedAt": "â€¦", "completedAt": null, "createdAt": "â€¦", "updatedAt": "â€¦"
}
```

**Enum values**
- `category`: `appointment`, `therapy`, `errand`, `groceries`, `childcare`, `medication`, `companionship`, `other`.
- `status`: `open`, `claimed`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `cancelled`. In the UI, `open` is shown as "Available".

### Live updates (Socket.IO): Planned

Proposal: the frontend updates the list in place from socket events. It doesn't reload the page, and it doesn't refetch on every event.

1. After login, the client connects with `io({ auth: { token } })` and emits `family:join` with `familyId`. The server checks the user is a member before adding them to room `family:<familyId>`.
2. After every successful task write, the server emits to that room:

| Event | Payload | Client does |
|---|---|---|
| `task.created` | `{ task }` | Add it to the list if it matches the current filter |
| `task.updated` | `{ task }` | Replace by `_id`, or add it if it now matches the filter |
| `task.claimed`, `task.unclaimed`, `task.completed`, `task.cancelled` | `{ task }` | Same as `task.updated` |
| `task.deleted` | `{ taskId }` | Remove by `_id` |

3. On reconnect, refetch the current list once, in case events were missed while offline.
4. Each `{ task }` payload has the same shape as the REST response, so one `upsertTask(task)` function in the Vue store handles all of them.

`task.updated`, `task.deleted` and `task.started` are also notify() events: they show in Recent updates and go to Telegram like the others.

---

## E: My Tasks & Transit (Chaithra)

### My Tasks (across all families)

| Method | Path | Who | Query | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/me/tasks` | logged in | `status=claimed,in_progress,completed`, `from`, `to` (all optional) | `{ tasks }` (task shape above, plus `family: { _id, name }`), sorted by `startAt` | Implemented |

- **Scope:** only `requireAuth` (no `familyId`). Filters on `claimedBy = req.user.userId` and on `family` being one of the user's families, so a user who left a family stops seeing its tasks.
- **Tabs:** Upcoming = `claimed`, In Progress = `in_progress`, Completed = `completed`.
- **"Due soon" flag:** worked out in the client (`startAt` within the next 24 hours). F's Telegram reminders handle the push side.
- **Actions on My Tasks** use D's endpoints: Start task = `POST /start`, Give back = `POST /unclaim`, Mark as done = `POST /complete`.
- Opening My Tasks also refreshes the user's Google Calendar (at most once a minute; see Google Calendar sync).
- **Code:** `server/src/features/my-tasks/`, mounted at `/api/me` in `routes/index.js`. Reads D's `tasks` collection only.

### Transit

Base: `/api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit` (mounted before D's tasks router, `Router({ mergeParams: true })`).

| Method | Path | Who | Body | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/families/:familyId/transit?status=active` | member | none | `{ transitSessions }` with task and companion populated, newest first. `status` is `active` or `ended` (optional). For the live banner on Home. | Implemented |
| GET | `/` | member | none | `{ transitSession }` (includes `lastLocation` and `path`); `404` if the task has no session | Implemented |
| POST | `/milestones` | companion | `{ type, label?, lat?, lng? }` | `201 { transitSession }`. The server sets `at`. `403` if not the companion, `409` if the trip has ended. | Implemented |
| DELETE | `/milestones?at=<step at>` | companion | none | `{ transitSession }` without that step. For removing a mistake (e.g. a typo). `404` if no step has that `at`, `409` for "Safely back home" (it completed the task). | Implemented |
| POST | `/end` | companion | none | `{ transitSession }` with `status: 'ended'`. "End transit": stops the trip **without** completing the task (it stays `in_progress`). `409` if already ended. | Implemented |
| POST | `/resume` | companion | none | `{ transitSession }` back to `active`, keeping its steps. Undoes an accidental End transit. `409` unless the task is still `in_progress` and the trip has ended. | Implemented |
| PATCH | `/location` | companion | `{ lat, lng }` | `{ lastLocation }`. Sent every ~20 s by the companion's browser while active. Also adds the point to `path`. `403` if not the companion, `409` if ended. | Implemented |

- **Starting a session:** D's `POST /tasks/:taskId/start` creates it (`TaskModel.startTransitSession`). Starting again after an unclaim is a new journey: steps, `path`, `lastLocation`, `startedAt` and `endedAt` are reset. E never creates a session directly.
- **Step types:** `MILESTONE_TYPES` = `departed`, `arrived`, `consultation_done`, `heading_home`, `home`, `custom`. Preset steps send a type (label optional; the server fills a default). Custom steps send `type: 'custom'` and the text the user typed as `label` (required, max 80 characters).
- **UI presets** (Transit mode chips): "On the way to fetch â€¦" (`departed`), "Fetched â€¦" (custom), "Reached hospital" (`arrived`), "Seeing the doctor", "Collecting medicine", "Going for lunch" (custom), "Heading home" (`heading_home`), "Safely back home" (`home`).
- **"Safely back home":** completes the task **first** through D's exported `completeTask()` (same rules as `POST /complete`). If that fails, nothing has been saved and the error is returned. Then the home step, `status: 'ended'` and `endedAt` are saved in one update (retried once).
- **Live location and trail:** `lastLocation` is the latest position; `path` is the trail drawn on the map (`[{ lat, lng, at }]`, oldest first, capped at 500 points). A gap over 150 m is filled in along the roads (OSRM, OpenStreetMap routing, no API key); an impossible jump (over 2 km at over 120 km/h) starts the trail again. Browsers only share location while the Transit page is open, so the UI shows "Location paused" after 2 minutes without an update.
- **Live timeline:** Transit mode polls `GET /` every 10 seconds while the trip is active (Socket.IO isn't set up, and the server runs serverless). When F's `notify()` exists, replace `announce()` in `journeys/controller.js` with `notify(familyId, 'transit.milestone', { transitSession })`.
- **Model:** `server/src/features/journeys/Journey.model.js`, registered as `TransitSession` (collection `transitsessions`). E owns it.
- **Demo helper:** `node server/simulate-trail.js [taskId]` draws a pretend trail on an active trip (for testing and demos).

### Google Calendar sync

| Method | Path | Who | Body | Response | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/me/google` | logged in | none | `{ available, connected, email, lastSyncedAt, lastError }`. `available: false` when the server has no Google settings. | Implemented |
| GET | `/api/me/google/connect` | logged in | none | `{ url }`: Google's sign-in page. `503` if not set up. | Implemented |
| GET | `/api/google/callback` | public (Google redirects here) | `code`, `state` | Saves the link, syncs, then redirects to `/my-tasks?calendar=connected` (or `cancelled` / `error`). | Implemented |
| POST | `/api/me/google/sync` | logged in | none | `{ connected, added, updated, removed }`. `502` if Google can't be reached. | Implemented |
| DELETE | `/api/me/google?removeEvents=true` | logged in | none | `204`. Stops syncing; with `removeEvents=true` also deletes the CareCircle events. | Implemented |

- **What syncs:** the user's tasks that are `claimed`, `in_progress` or `completed` (from the last 30 days on) appear in their Google Calendar; given back, cancelled, deleted or left-family tasks are removed. Completed tasks get a âœ“.
- **When:** after any successful change to a task (`calendarAutoSync` middleware in front of D's tasks router, so D's code doesn't change), after "Safely back home", when the user opens My Tasks, and on "Sync now".
- **Server settings** (`server/.env`, never committed): `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:5173/api/google/callback`; deployed, also `APP_URL=<website address>` if the website and API are on different addresses. While the Google app is in testing, only Gmails added as test users can connect.
- **Model:** `server/src/features/calendar-sync/GoogleCalendarLink.model.js` (collection `googlecalendarlinks`): refresh token (never sent to the browser), Google email, and taskId â†’ event id.
- **Code:** `server/src/features/calendar-sync/`, `client/src/features/my-tasks/components/GoogleCalendarSync.vue`.

### Clinic search (OneMap, CC-19)

| Method | Path | Who | Query | Response | Status |

- **Message text:**
  - Every message ends with a deep link to the related page.
  - Keep health details out of the text, because group chats get forwarded. Write "Grandpa's medication was updated", not the drug and dose.
- **Reminders:** a scheduled job sends reminders for tasks starting soon.
