// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Connect / disconnect Google Calendar, and the page Google sends people back to.
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken'
import GoogleCalendarLink from './GoogleCalendarLink.model.js'
import { isConfigured, consentUrl, exchangeCode, revoke, appOrigin } from './google.js'
import { syncUser, removeAllEvents } from './sync.js'

const STATE_PURPOSE = 'google-calendar'

// GET /api/me/google   -> { available, connected, email, lastSyncedAt, lastError }
export async function getStatus(req, res, next) {
    try {
        if (!isConfigured()) return res.json({ available: false, connected: false })
        const link = await GoogleCalendarLink.findOne({ user: req.user.userId })
        return res.json({
            available: true,
            connected: Boolean(link),
            email: link?.googleEmail || '',
            lastSyncedAt: link?.lastSyncedAt || null,
            lastError: link?.lastError || ''
        })
    } catch (error) {
        return next(error)
    }
}

// GET /api/me/google/connect   -> { url }  (the browser then goes to Google)
export function getConnectUrl(req, res) {
    if (!isConfigured()) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Google Calendar sync is not set up on this server' })
    }
    // "state" proves who started the sign-in, since Google's redirect has no login token
    const state = jwt.sign({ userId: req.user.userId, purpose: STATE_PURPOSE }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '10m' })
    return res.json({ url: consentUrl(state) })
}

// GET /api/google/callback?code=...&state=...   (public: Google sends the browser here)
export async function oauthCallback(req, res) {
    // There may be no redirect URI at all when this optional integration is off.
    if (!isConfigured()) return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Google Calendar sync is not set up on this server' })
    const back = (result) => res.redirect(`${appOrigin()}/my-tasks?calendar=${result}`)
    try {
        if (req.query.error) return back('cancelled') // they clicked Cancel on Google's page

        const payload = jwt.verify(String(req.query.state || ''), process.env.JWT_SECRET, { algorithms: ['HS256'] })
        if (payload?.purpose !== STATE_PURPOSE || !payload.userId) return back('error')

        const { refreshToken, email } = await exchangeCode(String(req.query.code || ''))
        if (!refreshToken) return back('error')

        await GoogleCalendarLink.findOneAndUpdate(
            { user: payload.userId },
            { $set: { refreshToken, googleEmail: email, connectedAt: new Date(), lastError: '' } },
            { upsert: true, setDefaultsOnInsert: true }
        )

        // Put their current tasks in right away
        await syncUser(payload.userId).catch(() => {})
        return back('connected')
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Google Calendar connect failed:', error.message)
        return back('error')
    }
}

// POST /api/me/google/sync   -> { connected, added, updated, removed }
export async function syncNowHandler(req, res) {
    try {
        const result = await syncUser(req.user.userId)
        return res.json(result)
    } catch (error) {
        return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Could not reach Google Calendar. Please try again.' })
    }
}

// DELETE /api/me/google?removeEvents=true   -> 204
export async function disconnect(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const link = await GoogleCalendarLink.findOne({ user: req.user.userId }).select('+refreshToken')
        if (link) {
            if (req.query.removeEvents === 'true') await removeAllEvents(link).catch(() => {})
            await revoke(link.refreshToken)
            await GoogleCalendarLink.deleteOne({ _id: link._id })
        }
        return res.status(204).end()
    } catch (error) {
        return next(error)
    }
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Talking to Google: "Sign in with Google" (OAuth) and the Google Calendar API.
// Plain fetch calls, no extra packages. Needs three lines in server/.env:
//   GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=...apps.googleusercontent.com
//   GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=...
//   GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:5173/api/google/callback
// Without them, Google Calendar sync is simply switched off (the button doesn't show).

const AUTH_URL = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth'
const TOKEN_URL = 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token'
const REVOKE_URL = 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke'
const EVENTS_URL = 'https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events'

// Only what's needed: add/change/remove events, and the person's email to show "Connected as â€¦"
const SCOPES = ['openid', 'email', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events']

export function isConfigured() {
    return Boolean(process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID && process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET && process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI)
}

// Where to send the person back to after Google (the website, not the API)
export function appOrigin() {
    return new URL(process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI).origin
}

export function consentUrl(state) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client_id: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
        redirect_uri: process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI,
        response_type: 'code',
        scope: SCOPES.join(' '),
        access_type: 'offline', // gives a refresh token, so syncing works later without them
        prompt: 'consent',      // always ask, so Google always sends the refresh token
        include_granted_scopes: 'true',
        state
    })
    return `${AUTH_URL}?${params.toString()}`
}

async function tokenRequest(body) {
    const response = await fetch(TOKEN_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({
            client_id: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
            client_secret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
            ...body
        }),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000)
    })
    const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
    if (!response.ok) {
        const error = new Error(data.error_description || data.error || `Google token error ${response.status}`)
        error.google = data.error
        throw error
    }
    return data
}

// After "Allow": swap the one-time code for tokens. Returns { refreshToken, email }
export async function exchangeCode(code) {
    const data = await tokenRequest({
        code,
        grant_type: 'authorization_code',
        redirect_uri: process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
    })
    let email = ''
    try {
        // The id_token is a JWT from Google; its middle part holds the email
        email = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(data.id_token.split('.')[1], 'base64url').toString()).email || ''
    } catch { /* email is only for display */ }
    return { refreshToken: data.refresh_token, accessToken: data.access_token, expiresIn: data.expires_in, email }
}

// Short-lived access tokens, cached per refresh token until just before they expire
const accessCache = new Map()
export async function accessTokenFor(refreshToken) {
    const cached = accessCache.get(refreshToken)
    if (cached && cached.expiresAt > Date.now() + 60 * 1000) return cached.token
    const data = await tokenRequest({ refresh_token: refreshToken, grant_type: 'refresh_token' })
    accessCache.set(refreshToken, { token: data.access_token, expiresAt: Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000 })
    return data.access_token
}

export async function revoke(refreshToken) {
    accessCache.delete(refreshToken)
    await fetch(`${REVOKE_URL}?token=${encodeURIComponent(refreshToken)}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000)
    }).catch(() => {})
}

// One Calendar API call. Returns the JSON (or null for an empty reply).
// Throws an error with .status (e.g. 404 if the person deleted the event themselves).
export async function calendarRequest(accessToken, method, eventId, body) {
    const url = eventId ? `${EVENTS_URL}/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}` : EVENTS_URL
    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
            ...(body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {})
        },
        body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000)
    })
    if (response.status === 204) return null
    const data = await response.json().catch(() => null)
    if (!response.ok) {
        const error = new Error(data?.error?.message || `Google Calendar error ${response.status}`)
        error.status = response.status
        throw error
    }
    return data
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Keeps a person's Google Calendar in step with the CareCircle tasks they've claimed:
//   - claimed / in progress / done  -> event added (or updated if the time/place changed)
//   - given back, cancelled, deleted, or they left the family -> event removed
// Runs after task changes (see autoSync.js) and when they open My Tasks.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Task from '../tasks/TaskModel.js'
import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import GoogleCalendarLink from './GoogleCalendarLink.model.js'
import { isConfigured, accessTokenFor, calendarRequest, appOrigin } from './google.js'

const KEEP_STATUSES = ['claimed', 'in_progress', 'completed']
const LOOK_BACK_DAYS = 30 // older tasks are left alone
const HOUR = 60 * 60 * 1000

function eventFor(task) {
    const start = new Date(task.startAt)
    const end = task.endAt ? new Date(task.endAt) : new Date(start.getTime() + HOUR)
    const loc = task.location || {}
    const who = task.recipient?.nickname || task.recipient?.name
    const done = task.status === 'completed'
    const link = `${appOrigin()}/families/${task.family._id || task.family}/tasks/${task._id}`

    return {
        summary: `${done ? 'âœ“ ' : ''}${task.title}${who ? ` Â· ${who}` : ''}`,
        location: [loc.name, loc.address, loc.postal ? `S${loc.postal}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(', '),
        description: [
            task.family?.name ? `${task.family.name} Â· CareCircle` : 'CareCircle',
            task.description || '',
            `Open in CareCircle: ${link}`
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n'),
        start: { dateTime: start.toISOString(), timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' },
        end: { dateTime: end.toISOString(), timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' },
        reminders: { useDefault: true },
        extendedProperties: { private: { careCircleTaskId: String(task._id) } }
    }
}

// The tasks that should be in this person's calendar right now
async function tasksToShow(userId) {
    const families = await Family.find({ 'members.userId': userId }).select('_id')
    const query = Task.find({
        claimedBy: userId,
        status: { $in: KEEP_STATUSES },
        family: { $in: families.map((f) => f._id) },
        startAt: { $gte: new Date(Date.now() - LOOK_BACK_DAYS * 24 * HOUR) }
    }).populate('family', 'name')
    if (mongoose.models.CareRecipient) query.populate('recipient', 'name nickname')
    return query
}

async function syncNow(userId) {
    const link = await GoogleCalendarLink.findOne({ user: userId }).select('+refreshToken')
    if (!link) return { connected: false }

    let token
    try {
        token = await accessTokenFor(link.refreshToken)
    } catch (error) {
        // invalid_grant: they removed CareCircle's access in their Google account
        if (error.google === 'invalid_grant') {
            await GoogleCalendarLink.deleteOne({ _id: link._id })
            return { connected: false }
        }
        throw error
    }

    const tasks = await tasksToShow(userId)
    const wanted = new Set(tasks.map((t) => String(t._id)))
    const events = new Map(link.events)
    let added = 0
    let updated = 0
    let removed = 0

    for (const task of tasks) {
        const id = String(task._id)
        const body = eventFor(task)
        const eventId = events.get(id)
        if (eventId) {
            try {
                await calendarRequest(token, 'PATCH', eventId, body)
                updated++
                continue
            } catch (error) {
                // They deleted it in Google Calendar themselves: add it again below
                if (![404, 410].includes(error.status)) throw error
            }
        }
        const created = await calendarRequest(token, 'POST', null, body)
        events.set(id, created.id)
        added++
    }

    for (const [taskId, eventId] of events) {
        if (wanted.has(taskId)) continue
        try {
            await calendarRequest(token, 'DELETE', eventId)
        } catch (error) {
            if (![404, 410].includes(error.status)) throw error // already gone is fine
        }
        events.delete(taskId)
        removed++
    }

    link.events = events
    link.lastSyncedAt = new Date()
    link.lastError = ''
    await link.save()
    return { connected: true, added, updated, removed }
}

// One sync per person at a time; a request that comes in during a sync waits for it
// and then runs once more, so the last change always lands.
const running = new Map()
export function syncUser(userId) {
    if (!isConfigured() || !userId) return Promise.resolve({ connected: false })
    const key = String(userId)
    const current = running.get(key)
    if (current) {
        current.again = true
        return current.promise
    }
    const state = { again: false }
    state.promise = (async () => {
        try {
            let result = await syncNow(key)
            while (state.again) {
                state.again = false
                result = await syncNow(key)
            }
            return result
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Google Calendar sync failed:', error.message)
            await GoogleCalendarLink.updateOne({ user: key }, { $set: { lastError: error.message } }).catch(() => {})
            throw error
        } finally {
            running.delete(key)
        }
    })()
    running.set(key, state)
    return state.promise
}

// Fire-and-forget version for background syncs (never throws)
export function syncInBackground(...userIds) {
    if (!isConfigured()) return
    for (const id of new Set(userIds.filter(Boolean).map(String))) {
        syncUser(id).catch(() => {})
    }
}

// Removes every CareCircle event from their calendar (used when disconnecting)
export async function removeAllEvents(link) {
    const token = await accessTokenFor(link.refreshToken)
    for (const eventId of link.events.values()) {
        await calendarRequest(token, 'DELETE', eventId).catch(() => {})
    }
}

// Owner: Su Myat Myat Htay

import {
  createFamilyForUser,
  getFamiliesForUser, 
  joinFamilyForUser
} from './service.js'

// POST /api/families
export async function createFamily(req, res) {
    try {
        const { name } = req.body ?? {}
        if (
            typeof name !== 'string' ||
            name.trim().length < 2 ||
            name.trim().length > 80
        ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            success: false,
            message: 'Family name must be 2â€“80 characters'
        })
        }

        const family = await createFamilyForUser(
            name,
            req.user.userId
        )

        return res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Family created successfully',
        family
        })

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Create family error:', error)

        return res.status(error.status || 500).json({
        success: false,
        message: error.status
            ? error.message
            : 'Unable to create family'
        })
    }
}

// GET /api/families/mine
export async function getMyFamilies(req, res) {
    try {
        const families = await getFamiliesForUser(
        req.user.userId
        )

        return res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        families
        })

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Get families error:', error)

        return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unable to retrieve families'
        })
    }
}


export async function joinFamily(req, res) {
  try {
    const { inviteCode } = req.body ?? {}

    // Validate invitation code
    if (
      typeof inviteCode !== 'string' ||
      !/^[A-F0-9]{10}$/i.test(inviteCode.trim())
    ) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Please enter a valid 10-character invitation code.'
      })
    }

    const family = await joinFamilyForUser(
      inviteCode,
      req.user.userId
    )

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'You have joined the family successfully!',
      family
    })

  } catch (error) {
    if (!error.status || error.status >= 500) {
      console.error('Join family error:', error)
    }

    return res.status(error.status || 500).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.status
        ? error.message
        : 'Unable to join family. Please try again.'
    })
  }
}

// Owner: Su Myat Myat Htay 
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Family from './Family.model.js'
import User from '../auth/User.model.js'
import { syncAccountRecipientInFamily } from '../recipients/syncAccountRecipient.js'

// This function is to generate a random invitation code
function generateInviteCode() {
    return randomBytes(5).toString('hex').toUpperCase()
}

// This function is to format the family before sending to Vue
function formatFamily(family) {
    return {
        id: family._id.toString(),
        name: family.name,
        inviteCode: family.inviteCode,
        createdBy: family.createdBy.toString(),
        // userId is populated with the member's name in getFamiliesForUser only
        members: family.members.map(member => ({
        userId: (member.userId._id ?? member.userId).toString(),
        name: member.userId.name ?? '',
        profilePicture: member.userId.profilePicture || '',
        role: member.role,
        joinedAt: member.joinedAt
        })),
        createdAt: family.createdAt
    }
}

// Create family
export async function createFamilyForUser(name, userId) {

  // 1. Validate authenticated user ID
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(userId)) {
        throw Object.assign(
        new Error('Invalid user ID'),
        { status: 401 }
        )
    }

    // 2. Check whether the user still exists
    const user = await User.findById(userId)
    if (!user) {
        throw Object.assign(
        new Error('User not found'),
        { status: 401 }
        )
    }

    // 3. Create family. Reply if an invite code collides
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
        try {
        const family = await Family.create({
            name: name.trim(),
            inviteCode: generateInviteCode(),
            createdBy: userId,
            members: [
            {
                userId,
                role: 'admin'
            }
            ]
        })

        // 4. Return the created family
        if (user.isCaretaker) await syncAccountRecipientInFamily(user, family._id)
        return formatFamily(family)

        } catch (error) {
        if (
            error.code === 11000 &&
            error.keyPattern?.inviteCode
        ) {
            continue
        }

        throw error
        }
    }

    throw new Error('Unable to generate unique invite code')
}

// This function is to retrieve all families that the logged-in user belongs to
export async function getFamiliesForUser(userId) {
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(userId)) {
        return []
    }

    const families = await Family.find({
        'members.userId': userId
    })
        .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
        .populate('members.userId', 'name profilePicture')

    return families.map(formatFamily)
}


export async function joinFamilyForUser(inviteCode, userId) {
  // 1. Validate authenticated user
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(userId)) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('Invalid user ID'),
      { status: 401 }
    )
  }

  const user = await User.findById(userId)

  if (!user) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('User not found'),
      { status: 401 }
    )
  }

  // 2. Normalize invitation code
  const code = inviteCode.trim().toUpperCase()

  // 3. Find the family
  const family = await Family.findOne({ inviteCode: code })

  if (!family) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('Invalid invitation code. Please check and try again.'),
      { status: 404 }
    )
  }

  // 4. Prevent duplicate membership
  const alreadyMember = family.members.some(
    member => member.userId.toString() === userId
  )

  if (alreadyMember) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('You are already a member of this family.'),
      { status: 409 }
    )
  }

  // 5. Atomically add member if not already present.
  // This protects against two simultaneous join requests.
  const updatedFamily = await Family.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: family._id,
      'members.userId': { $ne: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(userId) }
    },
    {
      $push: {
        members: {
          userId,
          role: 'member',
          joinedAt: new Date()
        }
      }
    },
    { new: true }
  )

  if (!updatedFamily) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('You are already a member of this family.'),
      { status: 409 }
    )
  }

  if (user.isCaretaker) await syncAccountRecipientInFamily(user, updatedFamily._id)
  return formatFamily(updatedFamily)
}

// Package B: member management and invitations on A's existing Family model.
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Family from './Family.model.js'

const PUBLIC_FIELDS = 'name email preferredLang telegramUsername profilePicture'
const adminCount = {
  $size: {
    $filter: {
      input: '$members',
      as: 'member',
      cond: { $eq: ['$$member.role', 'admin'] },
    },
  },
}

function publicMember(member) {
  const user = member.userId
  return {
    user: {
      _id: user._id.toString(),
      name: user.name,
      profilePicture: user.profilePicture || '',
      email: user.email,
      preferredLang: user.preferredLang || 'en',
      telegramUsername: user.telegramUsername || '',
    },
    role: member.role,
    joinedAt: member.joinedAt,
  }
}
function findMember(req) {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(req.params.userId)) return null
  return req.family.members.find(
    (member) => member.userId.toString() === req.params.userId,
  )
}
function writeFilter(req, targetId, protectAdmin) {
  // Recheck the actor's membership/role at write time, after the route guards.
  // This also prevents concurrent admin demotions/removals leaving no admin.
  const actor = { userId: req.user.userId }
  if (req.memberRole === 'admin') actor.role = 'admin'
  const clauses = [
    { members: { $elemMatch: actor } },
    { members: { $elemMatch: { userId: targetId } } },
  ]
  if (protectAdmin)
    clauses.push({
      $or: [
        {
          members: { $elemMatch: { userId: targetId, role: { $ne: 'admin' } } },
        },
        { $expr: { $gt: [adminCount, 1] } },
      ],
    })
  return { _id: req.family._id, $and: clauses }
}

export async function listMembers(req, res, next) {
  try {
    await req.family.populate('members.userId', PUBLIC_FIELDS)
    return res.json({
      members: req.family.members
        .filter((member) => member.userId)
        .map(publicMember),
    })
  } catch (error) {
    next(error)
  }
}
export async function updateMember(req, res, next) {
  try {
    if (req.memberRole !== 'admin')
      return res
        .status(403)
        .json({ error: 'Only family admins can change roles' })
    const keys = Object.keys(req.body || {})
    if (
      keys.length !== 1 ||
      keys[0] !== 'role' ||
      !['admin', 'member'].includes(req.body.role)
    )
      return res
        .status(400)
        .json({ error: 'Provide a role of admin or member' })
    if (!findMember(req))
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Member not found in this family' })
    const family = await Family.findOneAndUpdate(
      writeFilter(req, req.params.userId, req.body.role === 'member'),
      { $set: { 'members.$[target].role': req.body.role } },
      {
        new: true,
        runValidators: true,
        arrayFilters: [
          { 'target.userId': new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(req.params.userId) },
        ],
      },
    ).populate('members.userId', PUBLIC_FIELDS)
    if (!family)
      return res.status(409).json({
        error:
          'The family needs at least one admin, or membership changed. Refresh and try again.',
      })
    const member = family.members.find(
      (entry) => entry.userId?._id.toString() === req.params.userId,
    )
    if (!member) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Member not found' })
    return res.json({ member: publicMember(member) })
  } catch (error) {
    next(error)
  }
}
export async function deleteMember(req, res, next) {
  try {
    if (req.memberRole !== 'admin' && req.params.userId !== req.user.userId)
      return res
        .status(403)
        .json({ error: 'Only admins can remove other members' })
    if (!findMember(req))
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Member not found in this family' })
    const family = await Family.findOneAndUpdate(
      writeFilter(req, req.params.userId, true),
      { $pull: { members: { userId: req.params.userId } } },
      { new: true },
    )
    if (!family)
      return res.status(409).json({
        error:
          'The last admin cannot leave or be removed. Refresh and try again.',
      })
    return res.status(204).end()
  } catch (error) {
    next(error)
  }
}
export async function regenerateInviteCode(req, res, next) {
  try {
    if (req.memberRole !== 'admin')
      return res
        .status(403)
        .json({ error: 'Only family admins can regenerate invite codes' })
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
      try {
        const inviteCode = randomBytes(5).toString('hex').toUpperCase()
        if (inviteCode === req.family.inviteCode) continue
        const family = await Family.findOneAndUpdate(
          {
            _id: req.family._id,
            members: { $elemMatch: { userId: req.user.userId, role: 'admin' } },
          },
          { $set: { inviteCode } },
          { new: true, runValidators: true },
        )
        if (!family)
          return res.status(409).json({
            error: 'Your admin membership changed. Refresh and try again.',
          })
        return res.json({ inviteCode: family.inviteCode })
      } catch (error) {
        if (error.code === 11000 && error.keyPattern?.inviteCode) continue
        throw error
      }
    }
    return res.status(503).json({
      error: 'Couldnâ€™t create a unique invite code. Please try again.',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    next(error)
  }
}

// Runs on the server only, so the API key never reaches the browser.
// App language code -> LibreTranslate language code.
// The keys must match LANGUAGE_LABELS in client/src/features/logs/logTypes.js.
// If a language fails, check https://libretranslate.com/languages
const LANGUAGE_CODES = {
    en: 'en',
    zh: 'zh-Hans',
    ms: 'ms',
    ta: 'ta'
}

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = Object.keys(LANGUAGE_CODES)

export function isSupportedLanguage(lang) {
    // Object.hasOwn avoids false positives from keys like "constructor"
    return Object.hasOwn(LANGUAGE_CODES, lang)
}

export async function translateText(text, targetLang, sourceLang = 'en') {
    const apiKey = process.env.AZURE_TRANSLATOR_KEY
    const region = process.env.AZURE_TRANSLATOR_REGION

    if (!apiKey || !region) {
        throw new Error('Azure Translation credentials are not configured in environment variables.')
    }

    // The endpoint is fixed; languages go in the query string.
    // URLSearchParams handles the encoding, so no hand-built URL can go wrong.
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        'api-version': '3.0',
        to: LANGUAGE_CODES[targetLang],
        textType: 'plain' // keep the note as plain text, not HTML
    })
    // Leaving `from` out makes Azure detect the source language itself
    const from = LANGUAGE_CODES[sourceLang]
    if (from) params.set('from', from)

    const response = await fetch(`https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/translate?${params}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': apiKey,
            'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region': region,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        // Azure expects an array of objects with a "Text" key
        body: JSON.stringify([{ Text: text }]),
        // Don't let a slow service hang the request forever
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)
    })


    if (!response.ok) {
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
        throw new Error(body.error || `Azure responded with ${response.status}`)
    }

    const data = await response.json()
    const translatedText = data?.[0]?.translations?.[0]?.text
    if (!translatedText) {
        throw new Error('Azure Translator returned an empty or unexpected payload structure')
    }
    return translatedText
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E), CC-19
// GET /api/integrations/clinics?q=<search text>
// Searches OneMap (Singapore Land Authority) and returns places in the same
// shape as a task's location, so the result can be saved on a task directly.
const ONEMAP_SEARCH_URL = 'https://www.onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search'

// OneMap's search covers every building and street in Singapore, not only clinics.
// Results whose name or address looks medical go in `clinics`; the rest go in
// `otherPlaces`, which the UI only shows when no clinic matched (e.g. a home address).
const MEDICAL_WORDS = /\b(clinic|clinics|polyclinic|hospital|medical|medicine|medic|health|healthcare|dental|dentist|surgery|surgical|specialist|eye|heart|cancer|kidney|dialysis|rehab|rehabilitation|hospice|nursing|physio|physiotherapy|tcm|pharmacy|chas|family practice|gp)\b/i
const PAGES = 2 // OneMap returns 10 results per page

// OneMap sends 'NIL' when there's no value, and numbers as strings
function clean(value) {
    return value && value !== 'NIL' ? String(value).trim() : ''
}

function toLocation(result) {
    const postal = clean(result.POSTAL)
    return {
        name: clean(result.BUILDING) || clean(result.SEARCHVAL),
        address: clean(result.ADDRESS),
        postal: /^\d{6}$/.test(postal) ? postal : '',
        lat: Number.parseFloat(result.LATITUDE),
        lng: Number.parseFloat(result.LONGITUDE)
    }
}

function isMedical(place) {
    return MEDICAL_WORDS.test(`${place.name} ${place.address}`)
}

async function searchPage(q, pageNum) {
    const url = new URL(ONEMAP_SEARCH_URL)
    url.searchParams.set('searchVal', q.slice(0, 100))
    url.searchParams.set('returnGeom', 'Y')
    url.searchParams.set('getAddrDetails', 'Y')
    url.searchParams.set('pageNum', String(pageNum))

    const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`OneMap responded ${response.status}`)
    const data = await response.json()
    return { results: data.results || [], totalPages: Number(data.totalNumPages) || 1 }
}

export async function searchClinics(req, res) {
    const q = typeof req.query.q === 'string' ? req.query.q.trim() : ''
    if (q.length < 2) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Validation failed', errors: ['Type at least 2 characters'] })
    }

    try {
        const first = await searchPage(q, 1)
        let results = first.results
        if (first.totalPages > 1 && PAGES > 1) {
            // A second page gives the clinic filter more to work with; skip it if it fails
            const second = await searchPage(q, 2).catch(() => ({ results: [] }))
            results = results.concat(second.results)
        }

        const seen = new Set()
        const places = results
            .map(toLocation)
            .filter((place) => place.name && Number.isFinite(place.lat) && Number.isFinite(place.lng))
            .filter((place) => {
                const key = `${place.name}|${place.postal}`
                if (seen.has(key)) return false
                seen.add(key)
                return true
            })

        const clinics = places.filter(isMedical).slice(0, 10)
        const otherPlaces = places.filter((place) => !isMedical(place)).slice(0, 5)

        return res.json({ clinics, otherPlaces })
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('OneMap search failed:', error.message)
        return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Location search is unavailable right now. Please try again.' })
    }
}

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
// POST /api/integrations/transcribe
// Body: raw audio (Content-Type audio/webm, audio/mp4, ...), sent by the voice button.
// Sends the recording to Groq's Whisper model and returns { text }.
import express from 'express'

const GROQ_TRANSCRIBE_URL = 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions'
const GROQ_MODEL = 'whisper-large-v3-turbo'
const MAX_AUDIO_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024

const EXTENSIONS = {
    'audio/webm': 'webm',
    'audio/ogg': 'ogg',
    'audio/mp4': 'mp4',
    'audio/mpeg': 'mp3',
    'audio/wav': 'wav',
    'audio/x-wav': 'wav'
}

export const readAudio = express.raw({ type: 'audio/*', limit: MAX_AUDIO_BYTES })

export async function transcribe(req, res) {
    if (!process.env.GROQ_API_KEY) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Voice input is not set up on the server.' })
    }

    if (!Buffer.isBuffer(req.body) || !req.body.length) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Validation failed', errors: ['Send an audio recording'] })
    }

    const mimeType = (req.headers['content-type'] || '').split(';')[0].trim()
    const extension = EXTENSIONS[mimeType] || 'webm'

    const form = new FormData()
    form.append('file', new Blob([req.body], { type: mimeType }), `note.${extension}`)
    form.append('model', GROQ_MODEL)
    form.append('response_format', 'json')

    try {
        const response = await fetch(GROQ_TRANSCRIBE_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.GROQ_API_KEY}` },
            body: form,
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000)
        })

        if (response.status === 429) {
            return res.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many voice notes right now. Please wait a minute and try again.' })
        }
        if (response.status === 400) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: "We couldn't read that recording. Please try again." })
        }
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Groq responded ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`)
        }

        const data = await response.json()
        return res.json({ text: (data.text || '').trim() })
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Groq transcription failed:', error.message)
        return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Voice input is unavailable right now. Please type your note.' })
    }
}

// POST /api/integrations/telegram/webhook (what happens when someone types in the family group).
// Webhook commands:
//   /link <inviteCode>   run in the family's group: connects the group to the family
//   /unlink              run in a linked group: disconnects it
//   /start, /help        short instructions
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'
import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import User from '../auth/User.model.js'
 
const API = 'https://api.telegram.org'
const GROUP_TYPES = ['group', 'supergroup']
 
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Bot API
export async function callTelegram(method, body = {}) {
  const token = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
  if (!token) throw new Error('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not set')
 
  const response = await fetch(`${API}/bot${token}/${method}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000), // serverless: don't let a slow Telegram hold the request open
  })
  const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
  if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.description || `Telegram HTTP ${response.status}`)
  return data.result
}
 
// Plain text on purpose (no parse_mode): names and titles can't break the formatting
export function sendTelegramMessage(chatId, text) {
  return callTelegram('sendMessage', { chat_id: chatId, text, link_preview_options: { is_disabled: true } })
}
 
// Telegram sends the secret we gave setWebhook in this header on every update
function isValidWebhookSecret(req) {
  const expected = process.env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
  if (!expected) return false // refuse everything until a secret is configured
  const a = Buffer.from(String(req.get('x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token') || ''))
  const b = Buffer.from(expected)
  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b)
}
 
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Webhook
const HELP = [
  'Hi! I send CareCircle updates to your family group.',
  '1. Open Family settings in CareCircle and copy your invite code.',
  '2. Add me to your family group.',
  '3. In the group, send: /link YOURCODE',
].join('\n')
 
async function reply(chatId, text) {
  try {
    await sendTelegramMessage(chatId, text)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Telegram reply failed:', error.message)
  }
}
 
const escapeRegex = (text) => text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
 
// Match the Telegram username to a family member, so we can record who linked the group
async function findLinker(family, username) {
  if (!username) return null
  return User.findOne({
    _id: { $in: family.members.map((member) => member.userId) },
    telegramUsername: new RegExp(`^@?${escapeRegex(username)}$`, 'i'),
  }).select('_id')
}
 
async function linkGroup(chat, from, code) {
  if (!GROUP_TYPES.includes(chat.type)) {
    return reply(chat.id, 'Please add me to your family group, then send /link YOURCODE there.')
  }
  const inviteCode = String(code || '').trim().toUpperCase()
  if (!inviteCode) {
    return reply(chat.id, 'Send /link followed by your invite code, for example /link ABC123. You can find it in Family settings.')
  }
  const family = await Family.findOne({ inviteCode }).select('name members')
  if (!family) return reply(chat.id, "I couldn't find that invite code. Check Family settings and try again.")
 
  const linker = await findLinker(family, from?.username)
  const chatId = String(chat.id)
 
  // One group belongs to one family, otherwise two families' updates would mix in one chat
  await Family.updateMany({ 'telegram.chatId': chatId, _id: { $ne: family._id } }, { $set: { telegram: {} } })
  await Family.updateOne(
    { _id: family._id },
    { $set: { telegram: { chatId, linkedBy: linker?._id ?? null, linkedAt: new Date() } } },
  )
  return reply(chat.id, `Linked to ${family.name}. I'll post task and care updates here.`)
}
 
async function unlinkGroup(chat) {
  const result = await Family.updateOne({ 'telegram.chatId': String(chat.id) }, { $set: { telegram: {} } })
  return reply(chat.id, result.modifiedCount
    ? 'Unlinked. This group will no longer get CareCircle updates.'
    : 'This group is not linked to a family.')
}
 
async function handleUpdate(update) {
  const message = update?.message
  if (!message?.text || !message.chat) return
  const [first, ...rest] = message.text.trim().split(/\s+/)
  const command = first.toLowerCase().replace(/@.*$/, '') // "/link@CareCircleBot" -> "/link"
  if (command === '/link') return linkGroup(message.chat, message.from, rest[0])
  if (command === '/unlink') return unlinkGroup(message.chat)
  if (command === '/start' || command === '/help') return reply(message.chat.id, HELP)
}
 
export async function telegramWebhook(req, res) {
  if (!isValidWebhookSecret(req)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid secret token' })
  try {
    await handleUpdate(req.body)
  } catch (error) {
    // Always answer 200, otherwise Telegram keeps retrying the same update
    console.error('Telegram webhook error:', error.message)
  }
  return res.json({ ok: true })
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// Handlers for transit sessions. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section E).
//
// requireAuth + requireFamilyMember run before every handler, so these are always set:
//   req.user.userId, req.family, req.memberRole
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import TransitSession, { MILESTONE_LABELS, PATH_LIMIT } from './Journey.model.js'
import { completeTask } from '../tasks/controller.js'
import { syncInBackground } from '../calendar-sync/sync.js'
import { MILESTONE_TYPES, TRANSIT_STATUS, EVENTS } from '../../constants.js'
import { notify } from '../../utils/notify.js'
// ---------- Helpers ----------

function httpError(status, message, errors) {
    return Object.assign(new Error(message), { status, errors })
}

function handleError(error, res, next) {
    if (error instanceof mongoose.Error.ValidationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Validation failed',
            errors: Object.values(error.errors).map((e) => e.message)
        })
    }
    if (error.status) {
        const body = { error: error.message }
        if (error.errors) body.errors = error.errors
        return res.status(error.status).json(body)
    }
    return next(error)
}

// Placeholder until F adds utils/notify.js and Socket.IO exists.
// Replace the body with: notify(familyId, eventType, payload)
// replaced
async function announce(eventType, transitSession) {
     await notify(transitSession.family, eventType, transitSession)
}

const USER_FIELDS = 'name telegramUsername profilePicture'
const TASK_FIELDS = 'title startAt endAt location status category recipient claimedBy'

function populateSession(query) {
    const taskPopulate = { path: 'task', select: TASK_FIELDS }
    // Recipient model belongs to C; only populate once it is registered
    if (mongoose.models.CareRecipient) {
        taskPopulate.populate = { path: 'recipient', select: 'name nickname careType profilePicture linkedUser' }
    }
    return query.populate('companion', USER_FIELDS).populate(taskPopulate)
}

function getTaskId(req) {
    const { taskId } = req.params
    // A malformed id is treated as not found
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(taskId)) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')
    return taskId
}

// Body: { type, label?, lat?, lng? }
function parseMilestone(body) {
    const input = body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {}
    const errors = []

    if (!MILESTONE_TYPES.includes(input.type)) {
        errors.push(`Type must be one of: ${MILESTONE_TYPES.join(', ')}`)
    }

    let label = typeof input.label === 'string' ? input.label.trim() : ''
    if (input.type === 'custom' && !label) errors.push('Please type what is happening')
    if (input.type !== 'custom' && !label) label = MILESTONE_LABELS[input.type] || ''
    if (label.length > 80) errors.push('Label must be at most 80 characters')

    const milestone = { type: input.type, label, at: new Date() }

    // Optional position from the browser's geolocation
    const hasLat = typeof input.lat === 'number' && Number.isFinite(input.lat)
    const hasLng = typeof input.lng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(input.lng)
    if (hasLat && hasLng) {
        milestone.lat = input.lat
        milestone.lng = input.lng
    }

    if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)
    return milestone
}

// ---------- Handlers ----------

// GET /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit
export async function getTransitSession(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const transitSession = await populateSession(
            TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: req.family._id })
        )
        if (!transitSession) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')
        return res.json({ transitSession })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit/milestones   (companion only)
// A "home" milestone completes the task and ends the session (see the comments inside).
export async function addMilestone(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const familyId = req.family._id
        const userId = req.user.userId

        const session = await TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: familyId })
        if (!session) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')

        if (session.companion.toString() !== userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the person on this trip can post updates')
        }
        if (session.status !== TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE) {
            throw httpError(409, 'This trip has already ended')
        }

        const milestone = parseMilestone(req.body)
        const point = milestone.lat !== undefined ? { lat: milestone.lat, lng: milestone.lng, at: milestone.at } : null
        const location = point ? { lastLocation: point } : {}
        const trail = point ? { path: { $each: [point], $slice: -PATH_LIMIT } } : {}

        if (milestone.type === 'home') {
            // "Safely back home" changes two things: the task (completed) and the session
            // (home step + ended). Order matters so a failure never leaves them disagreeing:
            //  1. Complete the task with D's shared function. It checks the same rules as
            //     POST /tasks/:taskId/complete and ends the session. If it fails, nothing
            //     has been written yet, so the error is returned and the trip carries on.
            //  2. Add the home step and set endedAt in ONE atomic update. If that fails, it is
            //     retried once. Even if it still fails, the task is completed and the session
            //     is ended, which is consistent; only the "home" line is missing.
            await completeTask({ familyId, taskId, userId, memberRole: req.memberRole })
            syncInBackground(userId) // shows as done (âœ“) in their Google Calendar

            const finish = {
                $push: { milestones: milestone, ...trail },
                $set: { status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ENDED, endedAt: milestone.at, ...location }
            }
            try {
                await TransitSession.updateOne({ _id: session._id }, finish, { runValidators: true })
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Retrying home milestone:', error.message)
                await TransitSession.updateOne({ _id: session._id }, finish, { runValidators: true })
            }
        } else {
            const update = { $push: { milestones: milestone, ...trail } }
            if (location.lastLocation) update.$set = location

            // Only matches while still active, so a step can't land after the trip ended
            const updated = await TransitSession.findOneAndUpdate(
                { _id: session._id, status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE },
                update,
                { new: true, runValidators: true }
            )
            if (!updated) throw httpError(409, 'This trip has already ended')
        }

        const transitSession = await populateSession(TransitSession.findById(session._id))
        await announce(EVENTS.TRANSIT_MILESTONE, transitSession)
        return res.status(201).json({ transitSession })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// DELETE /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit/milestones?at=<the step's at>   (companion only)
// Remove a step posted by mistake (e.g. a typo in a custom update). Steps have no id, so
// the step's own `at` time picks it. "Safely back home" can't be removed: it completed the task.
export async function removeMilestone(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const at = new Date(req.query.at)
        if (!req.query.at || Number.isNaN(at.getTime())) {
            throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['at must be the time of the step to remove'])
        }

        const session = await TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: req.family._id })
        if (!session) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')
        if (session.companion.toString() !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the person on this trip can remove updates')
        }

        const step = session.milestones.find((m) => m.at && m.at.getTime() === at.getTime())
        if (!step) throw httpError(404, 'Update not found')
        if (step.type === 'home') throw httpError(409, '"Safely back home" finished the task, so it can\'t be removed')

        await TransitSession.updateOne(
            { _id: session._id },
            { $pull: { milestones: { at, type: { $ne: 'home' } } } }
        )

        const transitSession = await populateSession(TransitSession.findById(session._id))
        return res.json({ transitSession })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// GET /api/families/:familyId/transit?status=active
// For the live banner on Family Home.
export async function listTransitSessions(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const filter = { family: req.family._id }
        const { status } = req.query

        if (status !== undefined) {
            if (!Object.values(TRANSIT_STATUS).includes(status)) {
                throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['Status must be active or ended'])
            }
            filter.status = status
        }

        const transitSessions = await populateSession(
            TransitSession.find(filter).sort({ startedAt: -1 })
        )
        return res.json({ transitSessions })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit/end   (companion only)
// "End transit": stops the trip without completing the task (e.g. the appointment was
// called off on the way). The task stays in progress, so it can still be marked done or
// cancelled from My Tasks / Task Detail. "Safely back home" is the normal way to finish.
export async function endTransit(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const session = await TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: req.family._id })
        if (!session) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')

        if (session.companion.toString() !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the person on this trip can end it')
        }

        const ended = await TransitSession.findOneAndUpdate(
            { _id: session._id, status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE },
            { $set: { status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ENDED, endedAt: new Date() } },
            { new: true }
        )
        if (!ended) throw httpError(409, 'This trip has already ended')

        const transitSession = await populateSession(TransitSession.findById(session._id))
        return res.json({ transitSession })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// ---------- Trail helpers ----------

// Straight-line distance in metres between two { lat, lng }
function metres(a, b) {
    const R = 6371000
    const rad = (d) => (d * Math.PI) / 180
    const dLat = rad(b.lat - a.lat)
    const dLng = rad(b.lng - a.lng)
    const h = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(rad(a.lat)) * Math.cos(rad(b.lat)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h))
}

// Road points between two places (without the two ends), or [] if the lookup fails
async function roadBetween(a, b) {
    try {
        const url = `${OSRM_URL}/${a.lng},${a.lat};${b.lng},${b.lat}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`
        const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) })
        const data = await response.json()
        const coords = data.routes?.[0]?.geometry?.coordinates || []
        return thinLine(coords, 60).slice(1, -1).map(([lng, lat]) => ({ lat, lng, at: b.at }))
    } catch {
        return []
    }
}

// How a new position is added to the trail (and saved as lastLocation):
//  - an impossible jump (over 2 km at more than 120 km/h, e.g. a phone that had no GPS fix,
//    or switching devices) starts the trail again from here instead of drawing a straight
//    line across Singapore
//  - a gap of over 150 m (e.g. the page was closed for a while) is filled in along the roads
//  - otherwise the point is simply added
// Returns the whole MongoDB update, including the new lastLocation.
async function trailUpdate(path, point) {
    const last = path?.length ? path[path.length - 1] : null
    const add = (points) => ({
        $set: { lastLocation: point },
        $push: { path: { $each: points, $slice: -PATH_LIMIT } }
    })
    if (!last) return add([point])

    const gap = metres(last, point)
    const seconds = Math.max(1, (point.at - new Date(last.at)) / 1000)
    if (gap > 2000 && gap / seconds > 33) return { $set: { lastLocation: point, path: [point] } }

    const between = gap > 150 ? await roadBetween(last, point) : []
    return add([...between, point])
}

// PATCH /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit/location   (companion only)
// Body: { lat, lng }. The companion's browser sends this every ~20 s while the trip is
// active, so the family's map shows where they are and the trail they've travelled.
export async function updateLocation(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const { lat, lng } = req.body || {}
        const errors = []
        if (typeof lat !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90) {
            errors.push('lat must be a number between -90 and 90')
        }
        if (typeof lng !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(lng) || lng < -180 || lng > 180) {
            errors.push('lng must be a number between -180 and 180')
        }
        if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)

        const session = await TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: req.family._id })
        if (!session) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')

        if (session.companion.toString() !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the person on this trip can share their location')
        }

        // Only while active, so a late update can't land after the trip ended.
        // The point also goes on the trail (oldest points drop off after PATH_LIMIT),
        // following the roads from the previous point (see trailUpdate).
        const point = { lat, lng, at: new Date() }
        const updated = await TransitSession.findOneAndUpdate(
            { _id: session._id, status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE },
            await trailUpdate(session.path, point),
            { new: true }
        )
        if (!updated) throw httpError(409, 'This trip has already ended')

        return res.json({ lastLocation: updated.lastLocation })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/transit/resume   (companion only)
// Undo an accidental "End transit": the same trip carries on with its steps so far.
// Only while the task is still in progress (a completed or cancelled task can't resume).
export async function resumeTransit(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const taskId = getTaskId(req)
        const session = await TransitSession.findOne({ task: taskId, family: req.family._id })
        if (!session) throw httpError(404, 'Transit session not found')

        if (session.companion.toString() !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the person on this trip can resume it')
        }

        const Task = mongoose.models.Task
        const task = Task ? await Task.findOne({ _id: taskId, family: req.family._id }).select('status claimedBy') : null
        if (!task || task.status !== 'in_progress' || String(task.claimedBy) !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(409, 'Only a trip for a task that is still in progress can be resumed')
        }

        const resumed = await TransitSession.findOneAndUpdate(
            { _id: session._id, status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ENDED },
            { $set: { status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE, endedAt: null } },
            { new: true }
        )
        if (!resumed) throw httpError(409, 'This trip is already active')

        const transitSession = await populateSession(TransitSession.findById(session._id))
        return res.json({ transitSession })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// ---------- Road helpers (OSRM) ----------
// OSRM is the free routing service on OpenStreetMap data (no API key). Only used to
// fill a gap in the trail along the roads (see trailUpdate).
const OSRM_URL = 'https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving'

function thinLine(coords, max = 300) {
    if (coords.length <= max) return coords
    const step = Math.ceil(coords.length / max)
    const kept = coords.filter((_, i) => i % step === 0)
    kept.push(coords[coords.length - 1])
    return kept
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// One transit session per appointment task. D's POST /tasks/:taskId/start creates it
// (TaskModel.startTransitSession looks this model up by the name 'TransitSession').
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { MILESTONE_TYPES, TRANSIT_STATUS, TRANSIT_STATUSES } from '../../constants.js'

// Most points kept in `path`: one every ~20 s is about 3 hours of travel
export const PATH_LIMIT = 500

// Default label for each preset step. Custom steps use the text the user typed.
export const MILESTONE_LABELS = {
    departed: 'Departed home',
    arrived: 'Arrived at clinic',
    consultation_done: 'Consultation done',
    heading_home: 'Heading home',
    home: 'Safely back home'
}

const milestoneSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    type: { type: String, enum: MILESTONE_TYPES, required: true },
    label: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        required: [true, 'Label is required'],
        maxlength: [80, 'Label must be at most 80 characters']
    },
    at: { type: Date, default: Date.now }, // always set by the server
    lat: { type: Number, min: -90, max: 90 },
    lng: { type: Number, min: -180, max: 180 }
}, { _id: false })

const transitSessionSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    family: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Family', required: true },
    task: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Task', required: true, unique: true },
    companion: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
    status: { type: String, enum: TRANSIT_STATUSES, default: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE },
    milestones: { type: [milestoneSchema], default: [] },
    lastLocation: {
        lat: { type: Number, min: -90, max: 90 },
        lng: { type: Number, min: -180, max: 180 },
        at: Date
    },
    // The trail drawn on the map (like Grab): every shared position, oldest first.
    // Capped at PATH_LIMIT points so the document stays small.
    path: {
        type: [{
            lat: { type: Number, min: -90, max: 90, required: true },
            lng: { type: Number, min: -180, max: 180, required: true },
            at: { type: Date, default: Date.now },
            _id: false
        }],
        default: []
    },
    startedAt: { type: Date, default: Date.now },
    endedAt: { type: Date, default: null }
}, {
    timestamps: true,
    collection: 'transitsessions'
})

// Live banner on Family Home: active sessions in a family
transitSessionSchema.index({ family: 1, status: 1 })

export default mongoose.models.TransitSession ||
    mongoose.model('TransitSession', transitSessionSchema, 'transitsessions')

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { LOG_TYPES, INPUT_METHODS, MEDICATION_CHANGES } from '../../constants.js'

const medicationChangeSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Medication name is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [100, 'Medication name must be at most 100 characters']

        type: String,
        enum: {
            values: MEDICATION_CHANGES,
            message: `Medication change must be one of: ${MEDICATION_CHANGES.join(', ')}`
        },

    },
    details: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [300, 'Medication details must be at most 300 characters'],

    family: {

    },

        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,

    type: {
        type: String,
        enum: {
            values: LOG_TYPES,

    content: {
        type: String,

        trim: true,

        type: String,

// Owner: SeungHak (F)

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import LogEntry from './CareLog.model.js'
import User from '../auth/User.model.js'
import { EVENTS, LOG_TYPES } from '../../constants.js'
import { translateText, isSupportedLanguage, SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES } from '../integrations/azureTranslate.js'
import { notify } from '../../utils/notify.js'
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 20
const MAX_LIMIT = 50

const USER_FIELDS = 'name telegramUsername profilePicture'
const RECIPIENT_FIELDS = 'name nickname careType profilePicture'

function httpError(status, message, errors) {
    return Object.assign(new Error(message), { status, errors })
}

function handleError(error, res, next) {
    if (error instanceof mongoose.Error.ValidationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Validation failed',
            errors: Object.values(error.errors).map((e) => e.message)
        })
    }

    if (error.status) {
        const body = { error: error.message }
        if (error.errors) body.errors = error.errors
        return res.status(error.status).json(body)
    }

    return next(error)
}

function parseDate(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' && typeof value !== 'number') return null
    const date = new Date(value)
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date
}

function populateRefs(query) {
    query.populate('author', USER_FIELDS)
    if (mongoose.models.CareRecipient) query.populate('recipient', RECIPIENT_FIELDS)
    return query
}

async function announce(eventType, log, options) {
    await notify(log.family, eventType, log, options)
}

// Compares medication lists, so editing only the text of a note isn't "medication was updated"
function medicationKey(list = []) {
    return JSON.stringify(list.map((m) => [m.name, m.change, m.details || '']))
}

// Edits and deletes name the person who did them, who may not be the author (an admin)
async function announceChange(eventType, log, req) {
    const changedBy = await User.findById(req.user.userId).select('name').lean()
    await announce(eventType, { ...log.toObject(), changedBy })
}

function parseLogInput(body, { partial }) {
    const input = body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {}
    const data = {}
    const errors = []
    const has = (key) => input[key] !== undefined

    if (!partial) {
        if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(input.recipient)) {
            errors.push('Recipient is required')
        } else {
            data.recipient = input.recipient
        }

        if (has('task') && input.task !== null && input.task !== '') {
            if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(input.task)) data.task = input.task
            else errors.push('Task is invalid')
        }

        if (has('inputMethod')) data.inputMethod = input.inputMethod
        if (typeof input.originalLang === 'string' && input.originalLang.trim()) {
            data.originalLang = input.originalLang
        }
    }

    if (has('type') || !partial) {
        if (!LOG_TYPES.includes(input.type)) {
            errors.push(`Type must be one of: ${LOG_TYPES.join(', ')}`)
        } else {
            data.type = input.type
        }
    }

    if (has('content') || !partial) {
        if (typeof input.content !== 'string' || !input.content.trim()) {
            errors.push('Content is required')
        } else {
            data.content = input.content
        }
    }

    if (has('consultation')) {
        if (input.consultation === null) {
            data.consultation = null
        } else if (typeof input.consultation === 'object' && !Array.isArray(input.consultation)) {
            data.consultation = input.consultation
        } else {
            errors.push('Consultation must be an object')
        }
    }

    if (has('medicationChanges')) {
        if (Array.isArray(input.medicationChanges)) data.medicationChanges = input.medicationChanges
        else errors.push('medicationChanges must be a list')
    }

    if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)
    return data
}

function dropConsultationUnlessConsultation(data, type) {
    if (type !== 'consultation') data.consultation = null
    return data
}

async function findLogInFamily(familyId, logId) {
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(logId)) throw httpError(404, 'Log not found')

    const log = await LogEntry.findOne({ _id: logId, family: familyId })
    if (!log) throw httpError(404, 'Log not found')
    return log
}

function assertCanChange(log, req) {
    const isAuthor = log.author.toString() === req.user.userId
    if (!isAuthor && req.memberRole !== 'admin') {
        throw httpError(403, 'Only the author or a family admin can change this log')
    }
}

async function assertRefsInFamily(data, familyId) {
    const errors = []
    const { CareRecipient, Task } = mongoose.models

    if (CareRecipient && !(await CareRecipient.exists({ _id: data.recipient, family: familyId }))) {
        errors.push('Recipient not found in this family')
    }
    if (data.task && Task && !(await Task.exists({ _id: data.task, family: familyId }))) {
        errors.push('Task not found in this family')
    }

    if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)
}

export async function listLogs(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const { recipient, task, before, limit, appointmentFrom, appointmentTo } = req.query
        const filter = { family: req.family._id }
        const errors = []

        if (recipient !== undefined) {
            if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(recipient)) filter.recipient = recipient
            else errors.push('Recipient is invalid')
        }

        if (task !== undefined) {
            if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(task)) filter.task = task
            else errors.push('Task is invalid')
        }

        // The Calendar: consultation notes whose next appointment falls in a date range
        if (appointmentFrom !== undefined || appointmentTo !== undefined) {
            const range = {}
            if (appointmentFrom !== undefined) {
                const fromDate = parseDate(appointmentFrom)
                if (!fromDate) errors.push('appointmentFrom must be a valid date')
                else range.$gte = fromDate
            }
            if (appointmentTo !== undefined) {
                const toDate = parseDate(appointmentTo)
                if (!toDate) errors.push('appointmentTo must be a valid date')
                else range.$lte = toDate
            }
            filter['consultation.nextAppointment'] = range
        }

        if (before !== undefined) {
            const beforeDate = parseDate(before)
            if (!beforeDate) errors.push('before must be a valid date')
            else filter.createdAt = { $lt: beforeDate }
        }

        let pageSize = DEFAULT_LIMIT
        if (limit !== undefined) {
            pageSize = Number(limit)
            if (!Number.isInteger(pageSize) || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > MAX_LIMIT) {
                errors.push(`limit must be a whole number from 1 to ${MAX_LIMIT}`)
            }
        }

        if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)

        const logs = await populateRefs(
            LogEntry.find(filter).sort({ createdAt: -1 }).limit(pageSize)
        )

        return res.json({ logs })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

export async function createLog(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const parsed = parseLogInput(req.body, { partial: false })
        const data = dropConsultationUnlessConsultation(parsed, parsed.type)
        await assertRefsInFamily(data, req.family._id)

        const log = await LogEntry.create({
            ...data,
            family: req.family._id,
            author: req.user.userId
        })

        const populated = await populateRefs(LogEntry.findById(log._id))
        // notify: false ("Notify the family Telegram group" unticked) still shows in Recent updates
        const options = { send: req.body?.notify !== false }
        // One message per note: a medication change says so, anything else is a new care note
        const event = populated.medicationChanges.length ? EVENTS.MEDICATION_CHANGED : EVENTS.LOG_CREATED
        await announce(event, populated, options)

        return res.status(201).json({ log: populated })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

export async function getLog(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const log = await findLogInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.logId)
        return res.json({ log: await populateRefs(LogEntry.findById(log._id)) })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

export async function updateLog(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const log = await findLogInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.logId)
        assertCanChange(log, req)

        const data = parseLogInput(req.body, { partial: true })
        if (!Object.keys(data).length) {
            throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', [
                'Send at least one of: content, type, consultation, medicationChanges'
            ])
        }

        const nextType = data.type ?? log.type
        if (nextType !== 'consultation') data.consultation = null

        if (data.content !== undefined && data.content.trim() !== log.content) {
            log.translations = new Map()
        }

        const medicationsBefore = medicationKey(log.medicationChanges)
        log.set(data)
        await log.save()

        const populated = await populateRefs(LogEntry.findById(log._id))
        // One message per edit: "medication was updated" only when the list really changed
        const medicationsChanged = populated.medicationChanges.length > 0 &&
            medicationKey(populated.medicationChanges) !== medicationsBefore
        if (medicationsChanged) await announce(EVENTS.MEDICATION_CHANGED, populated)
        else await announceChange(EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED, populated, req)

        return res.json({ log: populated })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

export async function deleteLog(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const log = await findLogInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.logId)
        assertCanChange(log, req)

        // Load the recipient's name now: it can't be looked up once the note is gone
        const populated = await populateRefs(LogEntry.findById(log._id))
        await log.deleteOne()
        await announceChange(EVENTS.LOG_DELETED, populated, req)
        return res.status(204).end()
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// using the translation api
export async function translateLog(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const log = await findLogInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.logId)

        // Only accept languages we know about
        const lang = req.body?.lang
        if (typeof lang !== 'string' || !isSupportedLanguage(lang)) {
            throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', [
                `lang must be one of: ${SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.join(', ')}`
            ])
        }
        if (lang === log.originalLang) {
            throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['This note is already in that language'])
        }

        // Cache hit: each text is only translated once per language
        const cached = log.translations?.get(lang)
        if (cached) return res.json({ lang, translation: cached, cached: true })

        let translation
        try {
            translation = await translateText(log.content, lang, log.originalLang)
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Translation failed:', error.message)
            throw httpError(502, 'Translation service is unavailable. Please try again later.')
        }
        
        await LogEntry.updateOne(
            { _id: log._id, content: log.content },
            { $set: { [`translations.${lang}`]: translation } },
            { timestamps: false }
        )

        return res.json({ lang, translation, cached: false })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// Owner: Chaithra (E)
// GET /api/me/tasks: the logged-in user's claimed tasks across all their families.
// Reads D's tasks collection and extends open-ended recurring schedules.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Task from '../tasks/TaskModel.js'
import { ensureRecurringTasks } from '../tasks/recurringService.js'
import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import { TASK_STATUSES } from '../../constants.js'
import { syncInBackground } from '../calendar-sync/sync.js'

// Opening My Tasks also refreshes Google Calendar (at most once a minute per person)
const lastCalendarSync = new Map()
function refreshCalendar(userId) {
    const last = lastCalendarSync.get(userId) || 0
    if (Date.now() - last < 60 * 1000) return
    lastCalendarSync.set(userId, Date.now())
    syncInBackground(userId)
}

const USER_FIELDS = 'name telegramUsername profilePicture'

function parseDate(value) {
    const date = new Date(value)
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date
}

// Query (all optional): status=claimed,in_progress,completed  from=<date>  to=<date>
export async function getMyTasks(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const userId = req.user.userId
        const { status, from, to } = req.query
        refreshCalendar(userId)
        const errors = []

        // Only families the user still belongs to, so leaving a family hides its tasks
        const families = await Family.find({ 'members.userId': userId }).select('_id')
        for (const family of families) await ensureRecurringTasks(family._id)
        const filter = {
            claimedBy: userId,
            family: { $in: families.map((f) => f._id) }
        }

        if (status !== undefined) {
            const statuses = String(status).split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
            if (!statuses.length || statuses.some((s) => !TASK_STATUSES.includes(s))) {
                errors.push(`Status must be one or more of: ${TASK_STATUSES.join(', ')}`)
            } else {
                filter.status = { $in: statuses }
            }
        }

        if (from !== undefined || to !== undefined) {
            filter.startAt = {}
            if (from !== undefined) {
                const fromDate = parseDate(from)
                if (!fromDate) errors.push('from must be a valid date')
                else filter.startAt.$gte = fromDate
            }
            if (to !== undefined) {
                const toDate = parseDate(to)
                if (!toDate) errors.push('to must be a valid date')
                else filter.startAt.$lte = toDate
            }
        }

        if (errors.length) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Validation failed', errors })
        }

        const query = Task.find(filter)
            .sort({ startAt: 1, createdAt: 1 })
            .populate('family', 'name')
            .populate('createdBy', USER_FIELDS)
            .populate('claimedBy', USER_FIELDS)
        // Recipient model belongs to C; only populate once it is registered
        if (mongoose.models.CareRecipient) query.populate('recipient', 'name nickname careType profilePicture')

        const tasks = await query
        return res.json({ tasks })
    } catch (error) {
        return next(error)
    }
}
