// Handlers for /api/families/:familyId/notifications and /api/families/:familyId/notify-settings.
// See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section F). The notify() function other packages call is in utils/notify.js.

// requireAuth + requireFamilyMember run before every handler, so these are always set:
//   req.user.userId, req.family, req.memberRole
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import User from '../auth/User.model.js'
import Notification from './Notifications.model.js'
import { effectiveEvents, parseNotifyOn } from '../../utils/notify.js'
import { sendTelegramMessage } from '../integrations/telegram.js'
import { NOTIFICATION_STATUSES } from '../../constants.js'

// GET /api/families/:familyId/notifications?limit=20&status=sent
// Newest first. Feeds "Recent updates" on Family Home.
export async function listNotifications(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 20, 1), 50)
    const filter = { family: req.family._id }
    if (req.query.status !== undefined) {
      if (!NOTIFICATION_STATUSES.includes(req.query.status)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Validation failed', errors: [`Status must be one of: ${NOTIFICATION_STATUSES.join(', ')}`] })
      }
      filter.status = req.query.status
    }
    // Telegram error text is for admins only
    const fields = req.memberRole === 'admin'
      ? 'eventType refType refId text status error sentAt createdAt'
      : 'eventType refType refId text status sentAt createdAt'
    const notifications = await Notification.find(filter).select(fields).sort({ createdAt: -1 }).limit(limit).lean()
    return res.json({ notifications })
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// GET /api/families/:familyId/notify-settings   (any member)
// The chat id is never sent to the browser.
export async function getNotifySettings(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const telegram = req.family.telegram || {}
    const linked = Boolean(telegram.chatId)
    let linkedBy = null
    if (linked && mongoose.isValidObjectId(telegram.linkedBy)) {
      const user = await User.findById(telegram.linkedBy).select('name')
      if (user) linkedBy = { _id: user._id.toString(), name: user.name }
    }
    return res.json({
      notifyOn: effectiveEvents(req.family.notifyOn),
      telegram: { linked, linkedAt: linked ? telegram.linkedAt || null : null, linkedBy },
      botUsername: process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME || null,
    })
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// PATCH /api/families/:familyId/notify-settings   (admin)   { notifyOn: [eventType] }
export async function updateNotifySettings(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const parsed = parseNotifyOn(req.body?.notifyOn)
    if (parsed.error) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Validation failed', errors: [parsed.error] })
    const family = await Family.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: req.family._id }, { $set: { notifyOn: parsed.value } }, { new: true })
    if (!family) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Family not found' })
    return res.json({ notifyOn: effectiveEvents(family.notifyOn) })
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/notify-settings/test   (admin)
// One harmless message, so an admin can check the group is connected.
export async function sendTestMessage(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const chatId = req.family.telegram?.chatId
    if (!chatId) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'No Telegram group is linked yet' })
    try {
      await sendTelegramMessage(chatId, `CareCircle test: updates for ${req.family.name} will appear in this group.`)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Telegram test message failed:', error.message)
      return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Telegram did not accept the message. Is the bot still in the group?' })
    }
    return res.json({ ok: true })
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// DELETE /api/families/:familyId/notify-settings/telegram   (admin)
export async function unlinkTelegram(req, res, next) {
  try {
    await Family.updateOne({ _id: req.family._id }, { $set: { telegram: {} } })
    return res.status(204).end()
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// The Telegram outbox: one row per message. Nobody writes here directly; everyone calls
// notify() in utils/notify.js, which saves a row and sends it.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { EVENT_TYPES, NOTIFICATION_REF_TYPES, NOTIFICATION_STATUS, NOTIFICATION_STATUSES } from '../../constants.js'
 
const notificationSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
  family: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'Family', required: true },
  eventType: { type: String, enum: EVENT_TYPES, required: true },
  refType: { type: String, enum: NOTIFICATION_REF_TYPES }, // what the event is about (for the deep link)
  refId: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId },
  text: { type: String, required: true }, // the message without its link (the link is added when sending)
  status: { type: String, enum: NOTIFICATION_STATUSES, default: NOTIFICATION_STATUS.PENDING },
  error: { type: String, default: null },
  sentAt: { type: Date, default: null },
}, { timestamps: true, collection: 'notifications' })
 
notificationSchema.index({ family: 1, createdAt: -1 })
notificationSchema.index({ status: 1 })
 
export default mongoose.models.Notification || mongoose.model('Notification', notificationSchema)

# recipients
Owner: Jhen (C)

Care recipients of a family. Mounted at `/api/families/:familyId/recipients`, behind `requireAuth` and `requireFamilyMember`. Full request and response shapes are in [docs/API-CONTRACT.md](../../../../docs/API-CONTRACT.md), section C.

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | member | List recipients, sorted by name. Active only unless `?includeArchived=true`. |
| POST | `/` | member | Create a recipient. `name` and `careType` are required. |
| GET | `/:recipientId` | member | One recipient. |
| PATCH | `/:recipientId` | member | Edit any field except `family` and `isActive`. Changed medications are stamped with `updatedBy`/`updatedAt`. |
| POST | `/:recipientId/archive` | admin | Set `isActive: false` and clear `linkedUser`. There is no DELETE. |

- `linkedUser` can only be set to your own account (`403` otherwise), never on an infant (`400`), and must be a member of the family. Anyone can unlink. One account links to at most one recipient per family (`409` otherwise).
- The model is registered as `CareRecipient` in the `carerecipients` collection. Tasks (D) and logs (F) look it up by that name and populate `name nickname careType`, so keep those names.

// Owner: Jhen (C)
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { CARE_TYPES, MOBILITY_LEVELS, ALLERGY_SEVERITIES } from '../../constants.js'

// Same shape as locationSchema in TaskModel.js, so OneMap results fit both
const locationSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 120, default: '' },
    address: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 200, default: '' },
    postal: { type: String, trim: true, match: /^(\d{6})?$/, default: '' },
    lat: { type: Number, min: -90, max: 90 },
    lng: { type: Number, min: -180, max: 180 }
}, { _id: false })

const mobilitySchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    level: {
        type: String,
        enum: {
            values: MOBILITY_LEVELS,
            message: `Mobility level must be one of: ${MOBILITY_LEVELS.join(', ')}`
        }
    },
    notes: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [300, 'Mobility notes must be at most 300 characters'],
        default: ''
    }
}, { _id: false })

const allergySchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Allergy name is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [100, 'Allergy name must be at most 100 characters']
    },
    severity: {
        type: String,
        enum: {
            values: ALLERGY_SEVERITIES,
            message: `Allergy severity must be one of: ${ALLERGY_SEVERITIES.join(', ')}`
        },
        default: 'mild'
    }
}, { _id: false })

// Current list only; the history of changes lives in logEntries (F)
const medicationSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Medication name is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [100, 'Medication name must be at most 100 characters']
    },
    dosage: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 100, default: '' },
    frequency: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 100, default: '' },
    startDate: { type: Date, default: null },
    notes: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 300, default: '' },
    // Set by the controller, never taken from the request body
    updatedBy: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', default: null },
    updatedAt: { type: Date, default: null }
}, { _id: false })

const emergencyContactSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Emergency contact name is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [100, 'Emergency contact name must be at most 100 characters']
    },
    relationship: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 50, default: '' },
    phone: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Emergency contact phone is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [30, 'Emergency contact phone must be at most 30 characters']
    }
}, { _id: false })

const careRecipientSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    family: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'Family',
        required: true
    },

    name: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Name is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [100, 'Name must be at most 100 characters']
    },

    // What the family calls them, e.g. "Grandpa"; shown in the UI
    nickname: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [50, 'Nickname must be at most 50 characters'],
        default: ''
    },

    profilePicture: { type: String, default: '' },
    careType: {
        type: String,
        enum: {
            values: CARE_TYPES,
            message: `Care type must be one of: ${CARE_TYPES.join(', ')}`
        },
        required: [true, 'Care type is required']
    },

    dateOfBirth: {
        type: Date,
        default: null,
        validate: {
            validator: (value) => !value || value <= new Date(),
            message: 'Date of birth cannot be in the future'
        }
    },

    mobility: { type: mobilitySchema, default: null },
    allergies: { type: [allergySchema], default: [] },
    conditions: {
        type: [{ type: String, trim: true, maxlength: [100, 'Conditions must be at most 100 characters each'] }],
        default: []
    },
    dietaryRestrictions: {
        type: [{ type: String, trim: true, maxlength: [100, 'Dietary restrictions must be at most 100 characters each'] }],
        default: []
    },
    medications: { type: [medicationSchema], default: [] },
    emergencyContacts: { type: [emergencyContactSchema], default: [] },
    preferredClinic: { type: locationSchema, default: null },

    careNotes: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [2000, 'Care notes must be at most 2000 characters'],
        default: ''
    },

    // Archive instead of delete, so old tasks and logs keep their recipient
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: true
    },

    // Set when the recipient also has a CareCircle account (e.g. a pregnant member).
    // The controller checks they belong to the same family.
    linkedUser: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'User',
        default: null
    }
}, {
    timestamps: true,
    collection: 'carerecipients'
})

// Recipient list, active only by default
careRecipientSchema.index({ family: 1, isActive: 1 })
// One account links to at most one recipient per family; unlinked (null) ones don't count
careRecipientSchema.index(
    { family: 1, linkedUser: 1 },
    { unique: true, partialFilterExpression: { linkedUser: { $type: 'objectId' } } }
)

// ---------- Database operations ----------
// Every query on care recipients lives here; controller.js only calls these statics.

const USER_FIELDS = 'name telegramUsername profilePicture'

function populateLinkedUser(query) {
    return query.populate('linkedUser', USER_FIELDS)
}

// Sorted by name; archived recipients only when asked for
careRecipientSchema.statics.getRecipientsByFamily = function (familyId, { includeArchived = false } = {}) {
    const filter = { family: familyId }
    if (!includeArchived) filter.isActive = true
    return populateLinkedUser(this.find(filter).sort({ name: 1 }))
}

// Raw document, for existence checks and comparing medications
careRecipientSchema.statics.getRecipientInFamily = function (familyId, recipientId) {
    return this.findOne({ _id: recipientId, family: familyId })
}

careRecipientSchema.statics.getPopulatedRecipientById = function (recipientId) {
    return populateLinkedUser(this.findById(recipientId))
}

careRecipientSchema.statics.createRecipient = function (recipientData) {
    return this.create(recipientData)
}

// Returns null if the recipient isn't in this family
careRecipientSchema.statics.updateRecipient = function (familyId, recipientId, changes) {
    return this.findOneAndUpdate(
        { _id: recipientId, family: familyId },
        { $set: changes },
        { new: true, runValidators: true }
    )
}

// Archiving twice is harmless: it just sets isActive to false again.
// Retain the account link so opting back into receiving care restores this id.
careRecipientSchema.statics.archiveRecipient = function (familyId, recipientId) {
    return this.findOneAndUpdate(
        { _id: recipientId, family: familyId },
        { $set: { isActive: false } },
        { new: true }
    )
}

export default mongoose.models.CareRecipient ||
    mongoose.model('CareRecipient', careRecipientSchema, 'carerecipients')

// Owner: Jhen (C)
// Handlers for /api/families/:familyId/recipients. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section C).
//
// All database access goes through the statics in CareRecipient.model.js.
//
// requireAuth + requireFamilyMember run before every handler, so these are always set:
//   req.user.userId, req.family, req.memberRole

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { validProfilePicture } from '../../utils/profilePicture.js'
import CareRecipient from './CareRecipient.model.js'
import { CARE_TYPES, EVENTS } from '../../constants.js'
import { notify } from '../../utils/notify.js'
// ---------- Helpers ----------

function httpError(status, message, errors) {
    return Object.assign(new Error(message), { status, errors })
}

// Send known errors as { error, errors? }; pass anything else to the global handler
function handleError(error, res, next) {
    if (error instanceof mongoose.Error.ValidationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Validation failed',
            errors: Object.values(error.errors).map((e) => e.message)
        })
    }

    // The only unique index here is { family, linkedUser }
    if (error.code === 11000) {
        return res.status(409).json({
            error: 'This user is already linked to another care recipient in this family'
        })
    }

    if (error.status) {
        const body = { error: error.message }
        if (error.errors) body.errors = error.errors
        return res.status(error.status).json(body)
    }

    return next(error)
}

// Placeholder until F adds utils/notify.js and D adds Socket.IO.
// Every medication change already calls this, so wiring them up is a one-line change.
// replaced
async function announce(eventType, recipient) {
    await notify(recipient.family, eventType, recipient)
}

async function findRecipientInFamily(familyId, recipientId) {
    // A malformed id is treated as not found, same as requireFamilyMember
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(recipientId)) {
        throw httpError(404, 'Care recipient not found')
    }

    const recipient = await CareRecipient.getRecipientInFamily(familyId, recipientId)
    if (!recipient) throw httpError(404, 'Care recipient not found')
    return recipient
}

function parseDate(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' && typeof value !== 'number') return null
    const date = new Date(value)
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date
}

function isPlainObject(value) {
    return Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
}

// Copy only the listed text fields, so extra keys (e.g. updatedBy) are dropped
function pickText(source, keys, label, errors) {
    const picked = {}
    for (const key of keys) {
        if (source[key] === undefined || source[key] === null) continue
        if (typeof source[key] !== 'string') errors.push(`${label} ${key} must be text`)
        else picked[key] = source[key]
    }
    return picked
}

// null clears the list. Returns undefined if the value isn't a list of objects.
function parseObjectList(value, label, pick, errors) {
    if (value === null) return []
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || !value.every(isPlainObject)) {
        errors.push(`${label} must be a list of objects`)
        return undefined
    }
    return value.map(pick)
}

// null clears the list; blank entries are dropped
function parseTextList(value, label, errors) {
    if (value === null) return []
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || !value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string')) {
        errors.push(`${label} must be a list of text`)
        return undefined
    }
    return value.filter((item) => item.trim())
}

function parseLocation(value, errors) {
    if (value === null || value === '') return null

    if (!isPlainObject(value)) {
        errors.push('Preferred clinic must be an object')
        return undefined
    }

    const location = pickText(value, ['name', 'address', 'postal'], 'Preferred clinic', errors)
    for (const key of ['lat', 'lng']) {
        if (value[key] === undefined || value[key] === null) continue
        if (typeof value[key] !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value[key])) {
            errors.push(`Preferred clinic ${key} must be a number`)
        } else {
            location[key] = value[key]
        }
    }
    return location
}

// Pick and type-check the editable fields from a request body.
// partial = true for PATCH (only the fields sent), false for POST.
// family, isActive and timestamps are never picked. Length/enum limits
// inside sub-documents are left to the schema validators.
function parseRecipientInput(body, { partial }) {
    const input = isPlainObject(body) ? body : {}
    const data = {}
    const errors = []
    const has = (key) => input[key] !== undefined

    if (has('profilePicture')) {
        if (!validProfilePicture(input.profilePicture)) errors.push('Choose a valid profile picture')
        else data.profilePicture = input.profilePicture
    }

    if (has('name') || !partial) {
        if (typeof input.name !== 'string' || !input.name.trim()) errors.push('Name is required')
        else data.name = input.name
    }

    if (has('careType') || !partial) {
        if (!CARE_TYPES.includes(input.careType)) {
            errors.push(`Care type must be one of: ${CARE_TYPES.join(', ')}`)
        } else {
            data.careType = input.careType
        }
    }

    for (const [key, label] of [['nickname', 'Nickname'], ['careNotes', 'Care notes']]) {
        if (!has(key)) continue
        if (input[key] === null) data[key] = ''
        else if (typeof input[key] !== 'string') errors.push(`${label} must be text`)
        else data[key] = input[key]
    }

    if (has('dateOfBirth')) {
        if (input.dateOfBirth === null || input.dateOfBirth === '') {
            data.dateOfBirth = null
        } else {
            const dateOfBirth = parseDate(input.dateOfBirth)
            if (!dateOfBirth) errors.push('Date of birth must be a valid date')
            else data.dateOfBirth = dateOfBirth
        }
    }

    if (has('mobility')) {
        if (input.mobility === null) data.mobility = null
        else if (!isPlainObject(input.mobility)) errors.push('Mobility must be an object')
        else data.mobility = pickText(input.mobility, ['level', 'notes'], 'Mobility', errors)
    }

    if (has('allergies')) {
        const allergies = parseObjectList(input.allergies, 'Allergies',
            (item) => pickText(item, ['name', 'severity'], 'Allergy', errors), errors)
        if (allergies !== undefined) data.allergies = allergies
    }

    for (const [key, label] of [['conditions', 'Conditions'], ['dietaryRestrictions', 'Dietary restrictions']]) {
        if (!has(key)) continue
        const list = parseTextList(input[key], label, errors)
        if (list !== undefined) data[key] = list
    }

    if (has('medications')) {
        const medications = parseObjectList(input.medications, 'Medications', (item) => {
            const medication = pickText(item, ['name', 'dosage', 'frequency', 'notes'], 'Medication', errors)
            if (item.startDate === null || item.startDate === '') {
                medication.startDate = null
            } else if (item.startDate !== undefined) {
                const startDate = parseDate(item.startDate)
                if (!startDate) errors.push('Medication startDate must be a valid date')
                else medication.startDate = startDate
            }
            return medication
        }, errors)
        if (medications !== undefined) data.medications = medications
    }

    if (has('emergencyContacts')) {
        const contacts = parseObjectList(input.emergencyContacts, 'Emergency contacts',
            (item) => pickText(item, ['name', 'relationship', 'phone'], 'Emergency contact', errors), errors)
        if (contacts !== undefined) data.emergencyContacts = contacts
    }

    if (has('preferredClinic')) {
        const clinic = parseLocation(input.preferredClinic, errors)
        if (clinic !== undefined) data.preferredClinic = clinic
    }

    if (has('linkedUser')) {
        if (input.linkedUser === null || input.linkedUser === '') {
            data.linkedUser = null
        } else if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(input.linkedUser)) {
            errors.push('Linked user must be a member of this family')
        } else {
            data.linkedUser = input.linkedUser
        }
    }

    if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)
    return data
}

function assertLinkedUserInFamily(linkedUser, family) {
    if (!linkedUser) return
    const isMember = family.members.some((m) => m.userId.toString() === linkedUser.toString())
    if (!isMember) {
        throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['Linked user must be a member of this family'])
    }
}

// linkedUser means "this recipient is this person", so only that person can set it.
// Anyone can unlink, so a mistake can be fixed. Re-sending the current link is fine,
// because the edit form sends every field back.
function assertLinkAllowed({ linkedUser, careType, storedLinkedUser = null, userId }) {
    if (!linkedUser) return

    const isChange = linkedUser.toString() !== storedLinkedUser?.toString()
    if (isChange && linkedUser.toString() !== userId) {
        throw httpError(403, 'You can only link your own account')
    }
    if (careType === 'infant') {
        throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['An infant profile cannot be linked to an account'])
    }
}

// Compared after trimming, the same way the schema stores them
function medicationKey(medication) {
    const text = (value) => (value ?? '').trim()
    return JSON.stringify([
        text(medication.name),
        text(medication.dosage),
        text(medication.frequency),
        medication.startDate ? new Date(medication.startDate).getTime() : null,
        text(medication.notes)
    ])
}

// Entries identical to a stored one keep their updatedBy/updatedAt;
// new or edited entries are stamped with the current user and time.
function stampMedications(medications, stored, userId) {
    const storedByKey = new Map(stored.map((m) => [medicationKey(m), m]))
    const now = new Date()

    const stamped = medications.map((medication) => {
        const match = storedByKey.get(medicationKey(medication))
        return match
            ? { ...medication, updatedBy: match.updatedBy, updatedAt: match.updatedAt }
            : { ...medication, updatedBy: userId, updatedAt: now }
    })

    // Same entries in any order counts as unchanged; a removed entry counts as a change
    const keys = (list) => list.map(medicationKey).sort().join('\n')
    return { medications: stamped, changed: keys(medications) !== keys(stored) }
}

// ---------- Handlers ----------

// GET /api/families/:familyId/recipients
// Query (optional): includeArchived=true
export async function listRecipients(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const includeArchived = req.query.includeArchived === 'true'
        const recipients = await CareRecipient.getRecipientsByFamily(req.family._id, { includeArchived })
        return res.json({ recipients })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// GET /api/families/:familyId/recipients/:recipientId
export async function getRecipient(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const recipient = await findRecipientInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.recipientId)
        return res.json({ recipient: await CareRecipient.getPopulatedRecipientById(recipient._id) })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/recipients
// New recipients are always active; family and isActive in the body are ignored.
export async function createRecipient(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const data = parseRecipientInput(req.body, { partial: false })
        assertLinkedUserInFamily(data.linkedUser, req.family)
        assertLinkAllowed({ linkedUser: data.linkedUser, careType: data.careType, userId: req.user.userId })

        if (data.medications) {
            data.medications = stampMedications(data.medications, [], req.user.userId).medications
        }

        const recipient = await CareRecipient.createRecipient({
            ...data,
            family: req.family._id,
            isActive: true
        })

        const populated = await CareRecipient.getPopulatedRecipientById(recipient._id)
        return res.status(201).json({ recipient: populated })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// PATCH /api/families/:familyId/recipients/:recipientId
export async function updateRecipient(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const recipient = await findRecipientInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.recipientId)

        // Only editable fields are picked, so family and isActive are ignored
        const changes = parseRecipientInput(req.body, { partial: true })
        if (!Object.keys(changes).length) {
            throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['Nothing to update'])
        }

        assertLinkedUserInFamily(changes.linkedUser, req.family)
        // Check the result of the update, so changing an already-linked recipient
        // to infant is caught too
        assertLinkAllowed({
            linkedUser: changes.linkedUser !== undefined ? changes.linkedUser : recipient.linkedUser,
            careType: changes.careType ?? recipient.careType,
            storedLinkedUser: recipient.linkedUser,
            userId: req.user.userId
        })

        let medicationsChanged = false
        if (changes.medications) {
            const result = stampMedications(changes.medications, recipient.medications, req.user.userId)
            changes.medications = result.medications
            medicationsChanged = result.changed
        }

        const updated = await CareRecipient.updateRecipient(req.family._id, recipient._id, changes)
        if (!updated) throw httpError(404, 'Care recipient not found')

        const populated = await CareRecipient.getPopulatedRecipientById(updated._id)
        if (medicationsChanged) await announce(EVENTS.MEDICATION_CHANGED, populated)
        return res.json({ recipient: populated })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/recipients/:recipientId/archive   (admin)
// Recipients are archived, never deleted, so their tasks and logs stay readable.
export async function archiveRecipient(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const recipient = await findRecipientInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.recipientId)

        const archived = await CareRecipient.archiveRecipient(req.family._id, recipient._id)
        if (!archived) throw httpError(404, 'Care recipient not found')

        return res.json({ recipient: await CareRecipient.getPopulatedRecipientById(archived._id) })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import CareRecipient from './CareRecipient.model.js'

// Keep the account link when inactive: tasks/logs and later reactivation use
// the original recipient id. The unique family+linkedUser index guards races.
export async function syncAccountRecipientInFamily(user, familyId) {
    const filter = { family: familyId, linkedUser: user._id }
    if (!user.isCaretaker) {
        await CareRecipient.updateMany(filter, { $set: { isActive: false } })
        return
    }
    const update = {
        $set: { isActive: true, name: user.name, profilePicture: user.profilePicture || '' },
        $setOnInsert: { careType: 'other' }
    }
    try {
        await CareRecipient.findOneAndUpdate(filter, update, { upsert: true, new: true, runValidators: true, setDefaultsOnInsert: true })
    } catch (error) {
        if (error.code !== 11000) throw error
        // Another request inserted the same link first; reuse its record.
        await CareRecipient.findOneAndUpdate(filter, update, { new: true, runValidators: true })
    }
}

export async function syncAccountRecipients(user) {
    const families = await Family.find({ 'members.userId': user._id }).select('_id')
    for (const family of families) await syncAccountRecipientInFamily(user, family._id)
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Handler for GET /api/families/:familyId/search.
// Checks the query string, then hands over to service.js.
//
// requireAuth + requireFamilyMember run first, so req.family is always set.
// The family always comes from req.family, never from the query string.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { runSearch, SEARCH_TYPES, SEARCH_WHEN, SEARCH_STATUS, SEARCH_SORT } from './service.js'

const MIN_QUERY = 2
const MAX_QUERY = 80
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 5 // the dropdown under the search bar
const MAX_LIMIT = 50 // the full results page

function pick(value, allowed, fallback, name, errors) {
    if (value === undefined || value === '') return fallback
    if (typeof value === 'string' && allowed.includes(value)) return value
    errors.push(`${name} must be one of: ${allowed.join(', ')}`)
    return fallback
}

// Returns { params } or { errors }
export function parseSearchQuery(query) {
    const errors = []

    const q = typeof query.q === 'string' ? query.q.trim() : ''
    if (q.length < MIN_QUERY || q.length > MAX_QUERY) {
        errors.push(`Search must be ${MIN_QUERY} to ${MAX_QUERY} characters`)
    }

    const type = pick(query.type, SEARCH_TYPES, 'all', 'type', errors)
    const when = pick(query.when, SEARCH_WHEN, 'any', 'when', errors)
    const status = pick(query.status, SEARCH_STATUS, 'any', 'status', errors)
    const sort = pick(query.sort, SEARCH_SORT, 'best', 'sort', errors)

    let recipient = null
    if (query.recipient !== undefined && query.recipient !== '') {
        if (typeof query.recipient === 'string' && mongoose.isValidObjectId(query.recipient)) {
            recipient = query.recipient
        } else {
            errors.push('recipient must be a valid id')
        }
    }

    let limit = DEFAULT_LIMIT
    if (query.limit !== undefined && query.limit !== '') {
        limit = Number(query.limit)
        if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > MAX_LIMIT) {
            errors.push(`limit must be a whole number from 1 to ${MAX_LIMIT}`)
        }
    }

    if (errors.length) return { errors }
    return { params: { q, type, when, status, sort, recipient, limit } }
}

export async function searchFamily(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const { params, errors } = parseSearchQuery(req.query)
        if (errors) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: errors[0], errors })
        }

        const result = await runSearch(req.family, params)
        return res.json(result)
    } catch (error) {
        return next(error)
    }
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Family search: tasks, care log notes, people and places that match a word.
//
// Every query is filtered by the family passed in (req.family from requireFamilyMember),
// never by an id from the query string. The search word is escaped before it becomes a
// case-insensitive RegExp, so "(" or ".*" are matched literally.
// There is no $text index yet: a family has at most a few thousand rows, so a regex scan
// on the family's documents is fast enough and needs no migration.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Task from '../tasks/TaskModel.js'
import LogEntry from '../logs/CareLog.model.js'
import CareRecipient from '../recipients/CareRecipient.model.js'
import User from '../auth/User.model.js'
import { TASK_STATUS } from '../../constants.js'

export const SEARCH_TYPES = ['all', 'tasks', 'logs', 'people', 'places']
export const SEARCH_WHEN = ['any', 'upcoming', 'past30', 'past180']
export const SEARCH_STATUS = ['any', 'open', 'claimed', 'completed']
export const SEARCH_SORT = ['best', 'newest', 'oldest']

// Safety cap on matches read per group; counts above this show as the cap
const MAX_MATCHES = 500
const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
const SNIPPET_LENGTH = 120

// "Claimed" includes tasks already under way
const STATUS_FILTERS = {
    open: [TASK_STATUS.OPEN],
    claimed: [TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS],
    completed: [TASK_STATUS.COMPLETED]
}

const CARE_TYPE_LABELS = {
    elderly: 'Elderly care',
    pregnancy: 'Pregnancy',
    postpartum: 'Postpartum care',
    infant: 'Infant',
    injury: 'Injury recovery',
    other: 'Care recipient'
}

// ---------- Text helpers ----------

export function escapeRegExp(text) {
    return text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
}

// 0 = one of the exact fields equals the word, 1 = some field starts with it, 2 = anywhere
function matchTier(exactFields, allFields, q) {
    const word = q.toLowerCase()
    const clean = (text) => (text || '').trim().toLowerCase()
    if (exactFields.some((text) => clean(text) === word)) return 0
    if (allFields.some((text) => clean(text).startsWith(word))) return 1
    return 2
}

// About 120 characters centred on the first match, with "â€¦" where it was cut
export function makeSnippet(text, q, size = SNIPPET_LENGTH) {
    const clean = (text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
    if (clean.length <= size) return clean

    const at = clean.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase())
    const centre = at < 0 ? 0 : at + q.length / 2
    let end = Math.min(clean.length, Math.max(size, Math.round(centre + size / 2)))
    let start = Math.max(0, end - size)

    // Cut at spaces, never inside the match
    if (start > 0) {
        const space = clean.indexOf(' ', start)
        if (space > -1 && (at < 0 || space < at)) start = space + 1
    }
    if (end < clean.length) {
        const space = clean.lastIndexOf(' ', end)
        if (space > start && (at < 0 || space >= at + q.length)) end = space
    }

    return `${start > 0 ? 'â€¦' : ''}${clean.slice(start, end)}${end < clean.length ? 'â€¦' : ''}`
}

// ---------- Shared shapes ----------

const idOf = (doc) => (doc?._id ?? doc)?.toString()

function recipientRef(recipient) {
    if (!recipient || typeof recipient !== 'object') return null
    return { id: idOf(recipient), name: recipient.nickname || recipient.name }
}

function userRef(user) {
    if (!user || typeof user !== 'object') return null
    return { id: idOf(user), name: user.name }
}

function placeKey(name, address) {
    return `${(name || '').trim().toLowerCase()}|${(address || '').trim().toLowerCase()}`
}

// Date window for a "when" filter, or null for any time
function dateRange(when, now) {
    if (when === 'upcoming') return { $gte: now }
    if (when === 'past30') return { $gte: new Date(now - 30 * DAY), $lte: now }
    if (when === 'past180') return { $gte: new Date(now - 180 * DAY), $lte: now }
    return null
}

const byDate = (field, direction) => (a, b) => direction * (new Date(a[field]) - new Date(b[field]))

// ---------- Tasks ----------

async function searchTasks(familyId, re, { q, recipient, when, status, sort }, now) {
    const filter = {
        family: familyId,
        status: status === 'any' ? { $ne: TASK_STATUS.CANCELLED } : { $in: STATUS_FILTERS[status] },
        $or: [{ title: re }, { description: re }, { 'location.name': re }, { 'location.address': re }]
    }
    if (recipient) filter.recipient = recipient
    const range = dateRange(when, now)
    if (range) filter.startAt = range

    const tasks = await Task.find(filter)
        .populate('recipient', 'name nickname')
        .populate('claimedBy', 'name')
        .limit(MAX_MATCHES)
        .lean()

    const results = tasks.map((task) => ({
        id: idOf(task),
        title: task.title,
        recipient: recipientRef(task.recipient),
        startAt: task.startAt,
        status: task.status,
        needsTransit: Boolean(task.needsTransit),
        place: task.location?.name || task.location?.address || '',
        claimedBy: userRef(task.claimedBy),
        matchTier: matchTier(
            [task.title],
            [task.title, task.description, task.location?.name, task.location?.address],
            q
        )
    }))

    if (sort === 'newest') return results.sort(byDate('startAt', -1))
    if (sort === 'oldest') return results.sort(byDate('startAt', 1))
    // Best: tier, then upcoming (soonest first) before past (latest first)
    return results.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.matchTier !== b.matchTier) return a.matchTier - b.matchTier
        const aUpcoming = new Date(a.startAt) >= now
        const bUpcoming = new Date(b.startAt) >= now
        if (aUpcoming !== bUpcoming) return aUpcoming ? -1 : 1
        return aUpcoming ? byDate('startAt', 1)(a, b) : byDate('startAt', -1)(a, b)
    })
}

// ---------- Care log ----------

async function searchLogs(familyId, re, { q, recipient, when, sort }, now) {
    const filter = {
        family: familyId,
        // Original text only; the translations Map is never searched
        $or: [
            { content: re },
            { 'consultation.doctorName': re },
            { 'consultation.clinic': re },
            { 'medicationChanges.name': re },
            { 'medicationChanges.details': re }
        ]
    }
    if (recipient) filter.recipient = recipient
    const range = dateRange(when, now)
    // An upcoming note is a consultation whose next appointment is still ahead
    if (when === 'upcoming') filter['consultation.nextAppointment'] = range
    else if (range) filter.createdAt = range

    const logs = await LogEntry.find(filter)
        .populate('recipient', 'name nickname')
        .populate('author', 'name')
        .limit(MAX_MATCHES)
        .lean()

    const results = logs.map((log) => {
        const changes = log.medicationChanges || []
        const medication = changes.find((change) => re.test(change.name) || re.test(change.details)) || changes[0]
        const doctorName = log.consultation?.doctorName || ''
        const clinic = log.consultation?.clinic || ''

        // Snippet from the note itself, or from whichever field matched
        const snippetSource = [log.content, medication?.details, medication?.name, doctorName, clinic]
            .find((text) => text && re.test(text)) || log.content

        const result = {
            id: idOf(log),
            type: log.type,
            recipient: recipientRef(log.recipient),
            author: userRef(log.author),
            createdAt: log.createdAt,
            snippet: makeSnippet(snippetSource, q),
            matchTier: matchTier(
                [doctorName, ...changes.map((change) => change.name)],
                [log.content, doctorName, clinic, ...changes.flatMap((change) => [change.name, change.details])],
                q
            )
        }
        if (doctorName) result.doctorName = doctorName
        if (clinic) result.clinic = clinic
        if (medication) {
            result.medication = { name: medication.name, change: medication.change, details: medication.details || '' }
        }
        return result
    })

    if (sort === 'oldest') return results.sort(byDate('createdAt', 1))
    if (sort === 'newest') return results.sort(byDate('createdAt', -1))
    return results.sort((a, b) => a.matchTier - b.matchTier || byDate('createdAt', -1)(a, b))
}

// ---------- People ----------

async function searchPeople(family, re, { q, recipient }) {
    const recipientFilter = { family: family._id, isActive: true, $or: [{ name: re }, { nickname: re }] }
    if (recipient) recipientFilter._id = recipient

    const recipients = await CareRecipient.find(recipientFilter)
        .select('name nickname careType profilePicture')
        .limit(MAX_MATCHES)
        .lean()

    // Members aren't "for" a recipient, so a recipient filter leaves them out
    let members = []
    if (!recipient) {
        const roles = new Map(family.members.map((member) => [idOf(member.userId), member.role]))
        const users = await User.find({ _id: { $in: [...roles.keys()] }, name: re })
            .select('name profilePicture')
            .limit(MAX_MATCHES)
            .lean()
        members = users.map((user) => ({
            id: idOf(user),
            kind: 'member',
            name: user.name,
            subtitle: roles.get(idOf(user)) === 'admin' ? 'Family admin' : 'Family member',
            profilePicture: user.profilePicture || '',
            matchTier: matchTier([user.name], [user.name], q)
        }))
    }

    const people = recipients.map((person) => {
        const careLabel = CARE_TYPE_LABELS[person.careType] || CARE_TYPE_LABELS.other
        return {
            id: idOf(person),
            kind: 'recipient',
            name: person.nickname || person.name,
            subtitle: person.nickname ? `${careLabel} Â· ${person.name}` : careLabel,
            profilePicture: person.profilePicture || '',
            careType: person.careType,
            matchTier: matchTier([person.name, person.nickname], [person.name, person.nickname], q)
        }
    })

    return [...people, ...members].sort((a, b) => a.matchTier - b.matchTier || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
}

// ---------- Places ----------

// Each recipient's most frequent task place, as Map(placeKey -> { id, name }).
// A place needs at least two tasks to count as someone's usual place.
export async function findFrequentPlaces(familyId) {
    const rows = await Task.aggregate([
        { $match: {
            family: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(String(familyId)),
            status: { $ne: TASK_STATUS.CANCELLED },
            recipient: { $ne: null },
            $or: [{ 'location.name': { $nin: ['', null] } }, { 'location.address': { $nin: ['', null] } }]
        } },
        { $group: {
            _id: {
                recipient: '$recipient',
                name: { $toLower: { $trim: { input: { $ifNull: ['$location.name', ''] } } } },
                address: { $toLower: { $trim: { input: { $ifNull: ['$location.address', ''] } } } }
            },
            count: { $sum: 1 }
        } },
        { $sort: { count: -1 } },
        { $group: { _id: '$_id.recipient', name: { $first: '$_id.name' }, address: { $first: '$_id.address' }, count: { $first: '$count' } } },
        { $match: { count: { $gte: 2 } } }
    ])

    const recipients = await CareRecipient.find({ _id: { $in: rows.map((row) => row._id) } })
        .select('name nickname')
        .lean()
    const names = new Map(recipients.map((recipient) => [idOf(recipient), recipientRef(recipient)]))

    const usual = new Map()
    for (const row of rows) {
        const key = placeKey(row.name, row.address)
        const who = names.get(idOf(row._id))
        if (who && !usual.has(key)) usual.set(key, who)
    }
    return usual
}

async function searchPlaces(familyId, re, { q, recipient }) {
    const match = {
        family: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(String(familyId)),
        status: { $ne: TASK_STATUS.CANCELLED },
        $or: [{ 'location.name': re }, { 'location.address': re }]
    }
    if (recipient) match.recipient = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(recipient)

    const [rows, usual] = await Promise.all([
        Task.aggregate([
            { $match: match },
            { $group: {
                _id: {
                    name: { $toLower: { $trim: { input: { $ifNull: ['$location.name', ''] } } } },
                    address: { $toLower: { $trim: { input: { $ifNull: ['$location.address', ''] } } } }
                },
                name: { $first: '$location.name' },
                address: { $first: '$location.address' },
                postal: { $max: '$location.postal' },
                taskCount: { $sum: 1 }
            } },
            { $limit: MAX_MATCHES }
        ]),
        findFrequentPlaces(familyId)
    ])

    return rows
        .map((row) => ({
            name: row.name || row.address,
            address: row.name ? row.address || '' : '',
            postal: row.postal || '',
            taskCount: row.taskCount,
            usualFor: usual.get(placeKey(row._id.name, row._id.address)) || null,
            matchTier: matchTier([row.name], [row.name, row.address], q)
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.matchTier - b.matchTier || b.taskCount - a.taskCount || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
}

// ---------- Entry point ----------

// family: the Family document from requireFamilyMember
// params: checked by controller.js ({ q, type, when, status, sort, recipient, limit })
export async function runSearch(family, params) {
    const { q, type, limit } = params
    const re = new RegExp(escapeRegExp(q), 'i')
    const now = new Date()

    // Counts are always for every type, so the filter pills can show them
    const [tasks, logs, people, places] = await Promise.all([
        searchTasks(family._id, re, params, now),
        searchLogs(family._id, re, params, now),
        searchPeople(family, re, params),
        searchPlaces(family._id, re, params)
    ])

    const groups = { tasks, logs, people, places }
    const counts = { tasks: tasks.length, logs: logs.length, people: people.length, places: places.length }
    counts.all = counts.tasks + counts.logs + counts.people + counts.places

    const results = {}
    for (const [key, list] of Object.entries(groups)) {
        results[key] = type === 'all' || type === key ? list.slice(0, limit) : []
    }

    return { query: q, counts, results }
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
// Handlers for /api/families/:familyId/tasks. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md (section D).
//
// All database access goes through the statics in TaskModel.js.
//
// requireAuth + requireFamilyMember run before every handler, so these are always set:
//   req.user.userId, req.family, req.memberRole

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Task, { LOCKED_STATUSES, UNDELETABLE_STATUSES } from './TaskModel.js'
import { TASK_CATEGORIES, TASK_STATUS, TASK_STATUSES, EVENTS } from '../../constants.js'
import { notify } from '../../utils/notify.js'
import { createRecurringTasks, ensureRecurringTasks, changeRecurringClaim, updateRecurringTasks, deleteRecurringOccurrence, listRecurringSeries, setSeriesPaused } from './recurringService.js'
// ---------- Helpers ----------

function httpError(status, message, errors) {
    return Object.assign(new Error(message), { status, errors })
}

// Send known errors as { error, errors? }; pass anything else to the global handler
function handleError(error, res, next) {
    if (error instanceof mongoose.Error.ValidationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Validation failed',
            errors: Object.values(error.errors).map((e) => e.message)
        })
    }

    if (error.status) {
        const body = { error: error.message }
        if (error.errors) body.errors = error.errors
        return res.status(error.status).json(body)
    }

    return next(error)
}

// Placeholder until F adds utils/notify.js and D adds Socket.IO.
// Every task write already calls this, so wiring them up is a one-line change.
// replaced 
async function announce(eventType, task) {
    const familyId = task?.family?._id ?? task?.family
    await notify(familyId, eventType, task)
}

function isCreatorOrAdmin(task, userId, memberRole) {
    return memberRole === 'admin' || task.createdBy.toString() === userId
}

function isClaimer(task, userId) {
    return task.claimedBy?.toString() === userId
}

async function findTaskInFamily(familyId, taskId) {
    // A malformed id is treated as not found, same as requireFamilyMember
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(taskId)) {
        throw httpError(404, 'Task not found')
    }

    const task = await Task.getTaskInFamily(familyId, taskId)
    if (!task) throw httpError(404, 'Task not found')
    return task
}

function parseDate(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' && typeof value !== 'number') return null
    const date = new Date(value)
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date
}

function parseLocation(value, errors) {
    if (value === null || value === '') return null

    if (typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
        errors.push('Location must be an object')
        return undefined
    }

    const location = {}
    for (const key of ['name', 'address', 'postal']) {
        if (value[key] === undefined || value[key] === null) continue
        if (typeof value[key] !== 'string') {
            errors.push(`Location ${key} must be text`)
        } else {
            location[key] = value[key]
        }
    }
    for (const key of ['lat', 'lng']) {
        if (value[key] === undefined || value[key] === null) continue
        if (typeof value[key] !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value[key])) {
            errors.push(`Location ${key} must be a number`)
        } else {
            location[key] = value[key]
        }
    }
    return location
}

// Pick and type-check the editable fields from a request body.
// partial = true for PATCH (only the fields sent), false for POST.
// Length/range limits are left to the schema validators.
export function parseTaskInput(body, { partial }) {
    const input = body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {}
    const data = {}
    const errors = []
    const has = (key) => input[key] !== undefined

    if (has('title') || !partial) {
        if (typeof input.title !== 'string' || !input.title.trim()) {
            errors.push('Title is required')
        } else {
            data.title = input.title
        }
    }

    if (has('description')) {
        if (input.description === null) data.description = ''
        else if (typeof input.description !== 'string') errors.push('Description must be text')
        else data.description = input.description
    }

    if (has('category')) {
        if (!TASK_CATEGORIES.includes(input.category)) {
            errors.push(`Category must be one of: ${TASK_CATEGORIES.join(', ')}`)
        } else {
            data.category = input.category
        }
    }

    if (has('startAt') || !partial) {
        const startAt = parseDate(input.startAt)
        if (!startAt) errors.push('A valid start time is required')
        else data.startAt = startAt
    }

    if (has('endAt')) {
        if (input.endAt === null || input.endAt === '') {
            data.endAt = null
        } else {
            const endAt = parseDate(input.endAt)
            if (!endAt) errors.push('End time must be a valid date')
            else data.endAt = endAt
        }
    }

    if (has('recipient')) {
        if (input.recipient === null || input.recipient === '') {
            data.recipient = null
        } else if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(input.recipient)) {
            errors.push('Recipient is invalid')
        } else {
            data.recipient = input.recipient
        }
    }

    if (has('location')) {
        const location = parseLocation(input.location, errors)
        if (location !== undefined) data.location = location
    }

    if (has('needsTransit')) {
        if (typeof input.needsTransit !== 'boolean') errors.push('needsTransit must be true or false')
        else data.needsTransit = input.needsTransit
    }

    if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)
    return data
}

async function assertRecipientInFamily(recipientId, familyId) {
    if (recipientId && !(await Task.recipientInFamily(recipientId, familyId))) {
        throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['Recipient not found in this family'])
    }
}

// ---------- Status changes ----------
// Each action lists the statuses it starts from, who may run it, and what it sets.

const ACTIONS = {
    claim: {
        from: [TASK_STATUS.OPEN],
        allowed: () => true,
        conflict: (task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED
            ? 'Task already claimed'
            : new Date(task.startAt).getTime() <= Date.now() ? 'This task is overdue and can no longer be claimed'
            : `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be claimed`,
        set: (_task, userId) => ({
            status: TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED, claimedBy: userId, claimedAt: new Date()
        }),
        event: EVENTS.TASK_CLAIMED
    },
    unclaim: {
        from: [TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED],
        allowed: (task, userId) => isClaimer(task, userId) || task.createdBy.toString() === userId,
        forbidden: 'Only the task creator or the person who claimed it can unclaim it',
        conflict: (task) => `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be unclaimed`,
        set: () => ({ status: TASK_STATUS.OPEN, claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null }),
        event: EVENTS.TASK_UNCLAIMED
    },
    start: {
        from: [TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED],
        allowed: (task, userId) => isClaimer(task, userId),
        forbidden: 'Only the person who claimed this task can start it',
        conflict: (task) => `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be started`,
        set: () => ({ status: TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS }),
        event: EVENTS.TASK_STARTED
    },
    complete: {
        from: [TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS],
        allowed: (task, userId) => isClaimer(task, userId),
        forbidden: 'Only the person who claimed this task can complete it',
        conflict: (task) => `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be completed`,
        set: () => ({ status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETED, completedAt: new Date() }),
        event: EVENTS.TASK_COMPLETED
    },
    cancel: {
        from: [TASK_STATUS.OPEN, TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS],
        allowed: (task, userId, role) => isCreatorOrAdmin(task, userId, role) || isClaimer(task, userId),
        forbidden: 'Only the task creator, assigned person or an admin can cancel this task',
        conflict: (task) => `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be cancelled`,
        set: () => ({ status: TASK_STATUS.CANCELLED, cancelledAt: new Date() }),
        event: EVENTS.TASK_CANCELLED
    }
}

async function changeStatus(actionName, { familyId, taskId, userId, memberRole, expectedUpdatedAt, scope }) {
    const action = ACTIONS[actionName]
    const task = await findTaskInFamily(familyId, taskId)
    if (expectedUpdatedAt && +new Date(task.updatedAt) !== +new Date(expectedUpdatedAt)) {
        throw httpError(409, 'This task changed. Please prepare a new proposal.')
    }

    // Status first: an open task has no claimer, so "not allowed" would be misleading
    if (!action.from.includes(task.status)) {
        throw httpError(409, action.conflict(task))
    }
    if (!action.allowed(task, userId, memberRole)) {
        throw httpError(403, action.forbidden)
    }
    if (actionName === 'claim' && new Date(task.startAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) {
        throw httpError(409, 'This task is overdue and can no longer be claimed')
    }
    if (task.recurringSeries && ['claim', 'unclaim'].includes(actionName)) {
        await changeRecurringClaim(actionName, { familyId, taskId, userId, scope, expectedUpdatedAt })
        return Task.getTaskInFamily(familyId, taskId)
    }

    // Two people claiming at once: only the first update matches, the other gets null
    const updated = await Task.updateTaskStatus(task, action.set(task, userId))

    if (!updated) {
        const latest = await Task.getTaskById(task._id)
        throw httpError(409, latest
            ? action.conflict(latest)
            : 'Task was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.')
    }

    return updated
}

// Shared completion function for E's "home" milestone (see docs/OWNERSHIP.md).
// Same rules as POST /:taskId/complete. Throws errors with .status on failure.
export async function completeTask({ familyId, taskId, userId, memberRole = 'member', expectedUpdatedAt }) {
    const task = await changeStatus('complete', { familyId, taskId, userId, memberRole, expectedUpdatedAt })
    await Task.endTransitSession(task)
    const populated = await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(task._id)
    await announce(EVENTS.TASK_COMPLETED, populated)
    return populated
}

// Used by both HTTP actions and confirmed assistant proposals.
export async function performFamilyTaskAction(actionName, context) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(ACTIONS, actionName)) throw httpError(400, 'Unsupported task action')
    if (actionName === 'complete') return { task: await completeTask(context) }
    const task = await changeStatus(actionName, context)
    if (actionName === 'cancel') await Task.endTransitSession(task)
    let transitSession = null
    if (actionName === 'start') {
        try { transitSession = await Task.startTransitSession(task) }
        catch (error) {
            await Task.updateTaskStatus(task, { status: TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED })
            throw error
        }
    }
    const populated = await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(task._id)
    if (ACTIONS[actionName].event) await announce(ACTIONS[actionName].event, populated)
    return actionName === 'start' ? { task: populated, transitSession } : { task: populated }
}

function statusHandler(actionName) {
    return async (req, res, next) => {
        try {
            const context = {
                familyId: req.family._id,
                taskId: req.params.taskId,
                userId: req.user.userId,
                memberRole: req.memberRole,
                scope: req.body?.scope
            }

            return res.json(await performFamilyTaskAction(actionName, context))
        } catch (error) {
            return handleError(error, res, next)
        }
    }
}

// ---------- Handlers ----------

// GET /api/families/:familyId/tasks
// Query (all optional): status=open,claimed  recipient=<id>|none
//                       claimedBy=me|<userId>  from=<date>  to=<date>
export async function listTasks(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const { status, recipient, claimedBy, from, to } = req.query
        const filter = {}
        const errors = []

        if (status !== undefined) {
            const statuses = String(status).split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
            const invalid = statuses.filter((s) => !TASK_STATUSES.includes(s))
            if (invalid.length || !statuses.length) {
                errors.push(`Status must be one or more of: ${TASK_STATUSES.join(', ')}`)
            } else {
                filter.status = { $in: statuses }
            }
        }

        if (recipient !== undefined) {
            if (recipient === 'none') filter.recipient = null
            else if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(recipient)) filter.recipient = recipient
            else errors.push('Recipient is invalid')
        }

        if (claimedBy !== undefined) {
            if (claimedBy === 'me') filter.claimedBy = req.user.userId
            else if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(claimedBy)) filter.claimedBy = claimedBy
            else errors.push('claimedBy must be "me" or a user id')
        }

        if (from !== undefined || to !== undefined) {
            filter.startAt = {}
            if (from !== undefined) {
                const fromDate = parseDate(from)
                if (!fromDate) errors.push('from must be a valid date')
                else filter.startAt.$gte = fromDate
            }
            if (to !== undefined) {
                const toDate = parseDate(to)
                if (!toDate) errors.push('to must be a valid date')
                else filter.startAt.$lte = toDate
            }
        }

        if (errors.length) throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', errors)

        await ensureRecurringTasks(req.family._id)
        const tasks = await Task.getTasksByFamily(req.family._id, filter)
        return res.json({ tasks })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// GET /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId

    try {
        const task = await findTaskInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.taskId)
        return res.json({ task: await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(task._id) })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

            taskId: req.params.taskId, userId: req.user.userId, memberRole: req.memberRole, expectedUpdatedAt: req.body?.expectedUpdatedAt })
        return res.json({ task: populated })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// Shared by the task form and the assistant's explicit confirmation endpoint.
export async function createFamilyTask({ body, familyId, userId, taskId }) {
    const data = parseTaskInput(body, { partial: false })
    await assertRecipientInFamily(data.recipient, familyId)
    if (data.endAt && data.endAt < data.startAt) {
        throw httpError(400, 'End time must be after the start time')
    }
    if (body.recurrence && body.recurrence.frequency !== 'none') {
        const first = await createRecurringTasks(data, body.recurrence, familyId, userId)
        await announce(EVENTS.TASK_CREATED, first)
        return first
    }
    const task = await Task.createTask({ ...data, ...(taskId ? { _id: taskId } : {}),
        family: familyId, createdBy: userId, status: TASK_STATUS.OPEN })
    const populated = await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(task._id)
    await announce(EVENTS.TASK_CREATED, populated)
    return populated
}

export async function updateFamilyTask({ body, familyId, taskId, userId, memberRole, expectedUpdatedAt }) {
    const task = await findTaskInFamily(familyId, taskId)

    if (task.createdBy.toString() !== userId) {
        throw httpError(403, 'Only the task creator can edit this task')
    }
    if (LOCKED_STATUSES.includes(task.status)) {
        throw httpError(409, `Task is ${task.status} and can no longer be edited`)
    }

    // Only editable fields are picked, so status and claimedBy are ignored
    const changes = parseTaskInput(body, { partial: true })
    if (!Object.keys(changes).length) {
        throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['Nothing to update'])
    }

    await assertRecipientInFamily(changes.recipient, familyId)

    const startAt = changes.startAt ?? task.startAt
    const endAt = changes.endAt !== undefined ? changes.endAt : task.endAt
    if (endAt && endAt < startAt) {
        throw httpError(400, 'Validation failed', ['End time must be after the start time'])
    }

    // Status guard: if it was completed/cancelled meanwhile, don't edit it
    const updated = task.recurringSeries
        ? { _id: await updateRecurringTasks(task, changes, body.scope || 'one', expectedUpdatedAt) }
        : await Task.updateEditableTask(familyId, task._id, changes, expectedUpdatedAt)
    if (!updated) {
        throw httpError(409, 'Task was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.')
    }

    const populated = await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(updated._id)
    await announce(EVENTS.TASK_UPDATED, populated)
    return populated
}

// DELETE /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId   (creator only)
// in_progress and completed tasks can't be deleted; cancel them instead.
export async function deleteTask(req, res, next) {
    try {
        const task = await findTaskInFamily(req.family._id, req.params.taskId)

        if (task.createdBy.toString() !== req.user.userId) {
            throw httpError(403, 'Only the task creator can delete this task')
        }
        if (UNDELETABLE_STATUSES.includes(task.status)) {
            throw httpError(409, `Task is ${task.status} and cannot be deleted. Cancel it instead.`)
        }

        const populated = await Task.getPopulatedTaskById(task._id)
        const result = task.recurringSeries
            ? (await deleteRecurringOccurrence(task), { deletedCount: 1 })
            : await Task.deleteDeletableTask(req.family._id, task._id)
        if (!result.deletedCount) {
            throw httpError(409, 'Task was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.')
        }

        await announce(EVENTS.TASK_DELETED, populated)
        return res.json({ message: 'Task deleted', taskId: task._id.toString() })
    } catch (error) {
        return handleError(error, res, next)
    }
}

// POST /api/families/:familyId/tasks/:taskId/<action>
export const claimTask = statusHandler('claim')
export const unclaimTask = statusHandler('unclaim')
export const startTask = statusHandler('start')
export const completeTaskHandler = statusHandler('complete')
export const cancelTask = statusHandler('cancel')

export async function getRecurringSeries(req, res, next) {
    try { return res.json({ series: await listRecurringSeries(req.family._id) }) }
    catch (error) { return handleError(error, res, next) }
}
export async function pauseRecurringSeries(req, res, next) {
    try {
        if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(req.params.seriesId)) throw httpError(404, 'Repeating task not found')
        await setSeriesPaused(req.params.seriesId, req.family._id, req.user.userId, req.body?.paused)
        return res.json({ ok: true })
    } catch (error) { return handleError(error, res, next) }
}
