FILE: server/src/features/tasks/recurringService.js
================================================
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Task from './TaskModel.js'
import Series from './RecurringSeries.model.js'
import Family from '../families/Family.model.js'
import { parseRecurrence, recurrenceDates, recurrenceLabel, generationHorizon, sgDay } from './recurrenceRule.js'
import { syncInBackground } from '../calendar-sync/sync.js'

const error = (status, message) => Object.assign(new Error(message), { status })
const id = value => String(value?._id || value || '')
const fields = ['title', 'description', 'category', 'recipient', 'location', 'needsTransit']
const mutable = { $in: ['open', 'claimed'] }

// Recurrence changes span many task documents. A transaction and a write to the
// series document serialize generation, claiming, detachment, editing and pause.
async function transaction(work) {
  const session = await mongoose.startSession()
  try { return await session.withTransaction(() => work(session)) }
  catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 20 || /Transaction numbers are only allowed/.test(err.message)) throw error(503, 'Repeating tasks require MongoDB Atlas or a MongoDB replica set. Ordinary tasks are still available.')
    throw err
  } finally { await session.endSession() }
}

async function lockSeries(seriesId, familyId, session) {
  const series = await Series.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: seriesId, family: familyId }, { $inc: { revision: 1 } }, { new: true, session })
  if (!series) throw error(404, 'Repeating task not found in this family')
  return series
}

function occurrenceData(series, occurrence) {
  const template = { ...series.template }
  let shift = 0, duration = series.endAt ? +series.endAt - +series.startAt : null
  for (const revision of series.revisions) {
    if (occurrence.index < revision.fromIndex) continue
    for (const field of fields) if (Object.hasOwn(revision.fields, field)) template[field] = revision.fields[field]
    if (revision.fields.timeShiftMs !== undefined) shift = revision.fields.timeShiftMs
    if (revision.fields.durationMs !== undefined) duration = revision.fields.durationMs
  }
  const startAt = new Date(+occurrence.startAt + shift)
  const claimed = series.usualHelper && +startAt > Date.now()
  return { ...template, family: series.family, createdBy: series.createdBy,
    recurringSeries: series._id, occurrenceIndex: occurrence.index, originalStartAt: occurrence.startAt,
    recurrenceLabel: recurrenceLabel(series.rule), startAt, endAt: duration == null ? null : new Date(+startAt + duration),
    status: claimed ? 'claimed' : 'open', claimedBy: claimed ? series.usualHelper : null,
    claimedAt: claimed ? series.helperClaimedAt : null }
}

async function materialize(series, session) {
  if (series.paused) return []
  if (series.usualHelper && !(await Family.exists({ _id: series.family, 'members.userId': series.usualHelper }).session(session))) {
    const previous = series.usualHelper
    series.usualHelper = null; series.helperClaimedAt = null
    await Task.updateMany({ family: series.family, recurringSeries: series._id, recurrenceDetached: false,
      claimedBy: previous, status: 'claimed', startAt: { $gt: new Date() } }, { $set: { status: 'open', claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null } }, { session })
  }
  const horizon = generationHorizon(series.startAt)
  const dates = recurrenceDates(series.rule, series.startAt, series.endAt, horizon)
  const existing = await Task.find({ family: series.family, recurringSeries: series._id }).select('occurrenceIndex').session(session).lean()
  const seen = new Set([...existing.map(task => task.occurrenceIndex), ...series.deletedOccurrences])
  const documents = dates.filter(date => !seen.has(date.index)).map(date => occurrenceData(series, date))
  if (documents.length) await Task.insertMany(documents, { session })
  series.generatedThrough = horizon
  series.generatedAll = series.rule.end.mode !== 'never'
  await series.save({ session })
  return documents
}

export async function createRecurringTasks(data, input, familyId, userId) {
  const rule = parseRecurrence(input, data.startAt)
  if (!rule) return null
  if (+data.startAt <= Date.now()) throw error(400, 'The first repeating session must be in the future')
  recurrenceDates(rule, data.startAt, data.endAt, generationHorizon(data.startAt))
  const check = new Task({ ...data, family: familyId, createdBy: userId }).validateSync()
  if (check) throw check
  const firstId = await transaction(async session => {
    const [series] = await Series.create([{ family: familyId, createdBy: userId, template: data,
      startAt: data.startAt, endAt: data.endAt, rule }], { session })
    await materialize(series, session)
    const first = await Task.findOne({ family: familyId, recurringSeries: series._id }).sort({ startAt: 1 }).session(session)
    return first._id
  })
  return Task.getPopulatedTaskById(firstId)
}

export async function ensureRecurringTasks(familyId) {
  const series = await Series.find({ family: familyId, paused: false }).lean()
  for (const entry of series) {
    const horizon = generationHorizon(entry.startAt)
    const helperLeft = entry.usualHelper && !(await Family.exists({ _id: familyId, 'members.userId': entry.usualHelper }))
    if (!helperLeft && (entry.generatedAll || (entry.generatedThrough && +new Date(entry.generatedThrough) >= +horizon))) continue
    const generated = await transaction(async session => {
      const locked = await lockSeries(entry._id, familyId, session)
      if (!locked.paused && (helperLeft || !locked.generatedThrough || +locked.generatedThrough < +horizon)) return materialize(locked, session)
    })
    if (generated?.length || helperLeft) syncInBackground(id(entry.createdBy), id(entry.usualHelper))
  }
}

export async function changeRecurringClaim(action, context) {
  const { taskId, familyId, userId, expectedUpdatedAt } = context
  return transaction(async session => {
    const snapshot = await Task.findOne({ _id: taskId, family: familyId }).session(session)
    if (!snapshot) throw error(404, 'Task not found')
    const series = await lockSeries(snapshot.recurringSeries, familyId, session)
    const task = await Task.findOne({ _id: taskId, family: familyId }).session(session)
    if (!task) throw error(404, 'Task not found')
    if (expectedUpdatedAt && +task.updatedAt !== +new Date(expectedUpdatedAt)) throw error(409, 'This task changed. Please prepare a new proposal.')
    const family = await Family.findOne({ _id: familyId, 'members.userId': userId }).session(session)
    if (!family) throw error(403, 'You are no longer a member of this family')
    const now = new Date()
    if (action === 'unclaim') {
      if (task.status !== 'claimed') throw error(409, 'Only a claimed task that has not started can be unclaimed')
      if (![id(task.claimedBy), id(task.createdBy)].includes(userId)) throw error(403, 'Only the creator or assigned person can unclaim this task')
      // A one-date opening is permanently excluded from future series claims.
      await Task.updateOne({ _id: task._id, family: familyId }, { $set: { status: 'open', claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null, recurrenceDetached: true } }, { session })
    } else {
      if (task.status !== 'open') throw error(409, 'Task already claimed or no longer available')
      if (+task.startAt <= +now) throw error(409, 'This task is overdue and can no longer be claimed')
      if (series.paused && !task.recurrenceDetached) throw error(409, 'This repeating task is paused')
      const scope = task.recurrenceDetached ? 'one' : (context.scope || 'series')
      if (!['one', 'next4', 'series'].includes(scope)) throw error(400, 'Choose this date, next four sessions or the whole series')
      if (scope === 'series') {
        if (series.usualHelper && id(series.usualHelper) !== userId) throw error(409, 'Someone already claimed this repeating series')
        series.usualHelper = userId; series.helperClaimedAt = now
        await series.save({ session })
        await materialize(series, session)
        await Task.updateMany({ recurringSeries: series._id, family: familyId, recurrenceDetached: false, status: 'open', startAt: { $gt: now } },
          { $set: { status: 'claimed', claimedBy: userId, claimedAt: now } }, { session })
      } else {
        const selected = scope === 'one' ? [task] : await Task.find({ recurringSeries: series._id, family: familyId,
          recurrenceDetached: false, status: 'open', startAt: { $gte: task.startAt, $gt: now } }).sort({ startAt: 1 }).limit(4).session(session)
        await Task.updateMany({ _id: { $in: selected.map(item => item._id) }, family: familyId, status: 'open', startAt: { $gt: now } },
          { $set: { status: 'claimed', claimedBy: userId, claimedAt: now, recurrenceDetached: true } }, { session })
      }
    }
    const saved = await Task.findById(taskId).session(session)
    if (action === 'claim' && (saved.status !== 'claimed' || id(saved.claimedBy) !== userId)) throw error(409, 'Task was changed by someone else')
    return { taskId: saved._id, usualHelper: series.usualHelper }
  })
}

export async function updateRecurringTasks(task, changes, scope = 'one', expectedUpdatedAt) {
  if (!['one', 'future', 'all'].includes(scope)) throw error(400, 'Choose this date, this and future sessions, or every upcoming session')
  const result = await transaction(async session => {
    const series = await lockSeries(task.recurringSeries, task.family, session)
    const current = await Task.findById(task._id).session(session)
    if (!current || (expectedUpdatedAt && +current.updatedAt !== +new Date(expectedUpdatedAt)) || +current.updatedAt !== +task.updatedAt) throw error(409, 'This task changed. Refresh and try again.')
    if (['completed', 'cancelled', 'in_progress'].includes(current.status)) throw error(409, 'Only upcoming, unstarted recurring sessions can be edited')
    if (current.recurrenceDetached && scope !== 'one') throw error(400, 'This is a one-day exception. Edit only this date.')
    if (scope === 'one') {
      await Task.updateOne({ _id: current._id, family: task.family }, { $set: { ...changes, recurrenceEdited: true } }, { session, runValidators: true })
    } else {
      const now = new Date()
      if (changes.startAt && sgDay(changes.startAt) !== sgDay(current.startAt)) throw error(400, 'To move a session to a different date, choose Only this date. Series-wide edits can change the time on existing dates.')
      if (+current.startAt <= +now) throw error(409, 'Series edits apply only to upcoming sessions')
      const revision = {}
      for (const field of fields) if (Object.hasOwn(changes, field)) revision[field] = changes[field]
      if (changes.startAt) revision.timeShiftMs = +changes.startAt - +current.originalStartAt
      if (Object.hasOwn(changes, 'endAt')) revision.durationMs = changes.endAt == null ? null : +changes.endAt - +(changes.startAt || current.startAt)
      const fromIndex = scope === 'future' ? current.occurrenceIndex : 0
      const candidates = await Task.find({ family: task.family, recurringSeries: series._id, recurrenceDetached: false,
        status: mutable, startAt: { $gt: now }, occurrenceIndex: { $gte: fromIndex } }).session(session)
      for (const entry of candidates) {
        const update = { ...changes }
        if (revision.timeShiftMs !== undefined) update.startAt = new Date(+entry.originalStartAt + revision.timeShiftMs)
        const duration = revision.durationMs !== undefined ? revision.durationMs : entry.endAt ? +entry.endAt - +entry.startAt : null
        if (changes.startAt || Object.hasOwn(changes, 'endAt')) update.endAt = duration == null ? null : new Date(+(update.startAt || entry.startAt) + duration)
        const validation = new Task({ ...entry.toObject(), ...update }).validateSync()
        if (validation) throw validation
        if (+new Date(update.startAt || entry.startAt) <= +now) throw error(400, 'A series edit cannot move an upcoming session into the past')
        await Task.updateOne({ _id: entry._id, family: task.family }, { $set: update }, { session, runValidators: true })
      }
      series.revisions.push({ fromIndex, fields: revision })
      await series.save({ session })
    }
    return { taskId: current._id, helper: id(series.usualHelper), creator: id(series.createdBy) }
  })
  syncInBackground(result.creator, result.helper)
  return result.taskId
}

export async function deleteRecurringOccurrence(task, expectedUpdatedAt) {
  await transaction(async session => {
    const series = await lockSeries(task.recurringSeries, task.family, session)
    const result = await Task.deleteOne({ _id: task._id, family: task.family, status: { $nin: ['in_progress', 'completed'] },
      updatedAt: expectedUpdatedAt ? new Date(expectedUpdatedAt) : task.updatedAt }, { session })
    if (!result.deletedCount) throw error(409, 'Task changed and cannot be deleted')
    if (!series.deletedOccurrences.includes(task.occurrenceIndex)) series.deletedOccurrences.push(task.occurrenceIndex)
    await series.save({ session })
  })
}

export async function listRecurringSeries(familyId) {
  await ensureRecurringTasks(familyId)
  return Series.find({ family: familyId }).select('createdBy template rule startAt endAt usualHelper paused generatedThrough').populate('usualHelper', 'name profilePicture').sort({ createdAt: -1 })
}

export async function setSeriesPaused(seriesId, familyId, userId, paused) {
  if (typeof paused !== 'boolean') throw error(400, 'Paused must be true or false')
  const helper = await transaction(async session => {
    const series = await lockSeries(seriesId, familyId, session)
    if (id(series.createdBy) !== userId) throw error(403, 'Only the creator can pause or resume this repeating task')
    if (series.paused === paused) return id(series.usualHelper)
    series.paused = paused
    await series.save({ session })
    const filter = { family: familyId, recurringSeries: series._id, recurrenceDetached: false, startAt: { $gt: new Date() } }
    if (paused) await Task.updateMany({ ...filter, status: mutable }, { $set: { status: 'cancelled', recurrencePaused: true } }, { session })
    else {
      await Task.updateMany({ ...filter, recurrencePaused: true, status: 'cancelled' }, { $set: {
        status: series.usualHelper ? 'claimed' : 'open', claimedBy: series.usualHelper || null,
        claimedAt: series.usualHelper ? series.helperClaimedAt : null, recurrencePaused: false,
      } }, { session })
      await materialize(series, session)
    }
    return id(series.usualHelper)
  })
  syncInBackground(userId, helper)
}

// Owner: Marcus (D)
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { TASK_CATEGORIES, TASK_STATUS, TASK_STATUSES, TRANSIT_STATUS } from '../../constants.js'

// Where the task happens. lat/lng are optional (filled in by OneMap later).
const locationSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 120, default: '' },
    address: { type: String, trim: true, maxlength: 200, default: '' },
    postal: { type: String, trim: true, match: /^(\d{6})?$/, default: '' },
    lat: { type: Number, min: -90, max: 90 },
    lng: { type: Number, min: -180, max: 180 }
}, { _id: false })

const taskSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    family: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'Family',
        required: true
    },

    // Optional: household tasks have no recipient
    recipient: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'CareRecipient',
        default: null
    },

    title: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Title is required'],
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [120, 'Title must be at most 120 characters']
    },

    description: {
        type: String,
        trim: true,
        maxlength: [2000, 'Description must be at most 2000 characters'],
        default: ''
    },

    category: {
        type: String,
        enum: TASK_CATEGORIES,
        default: 'other'
    },

    startAt: {
        type: Date,
        required: [true, 'Start time is required']
    },

    endAt: {
        type: Date,
        default: null,
        validate: {
            validator(value) {
                // In update queries `this` is the Query, so only check on documents
                if (!value || !(this instanceof mongoose.Document)) return true
                return value >= this.startAt
            },
            message: 'End time must be after the start time'
        }
    },

    location: {
        type: locationSchema,
        default: null
    },

    needsTransit: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    },

    status: {
        type: String,
        enum: TASK_STATUSES,
        default: TASK_STATUS.OPEN
    },

    createdBy: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'User',
        required: true
    },

    claimedBy: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: 'User',
        default: null
    },

    recurringSeries: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'RecurringSeries', default: null },
    occurrenceIndex: { type: Number, default: null },
    originalStartAt: { type: Date, default: null },
    recurrenceDetached: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    recurrenceLabel: { type: String, default: '' },
    recurrencePaused: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    recurrenceEdited: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    claimedAt: { type: Date, default: null },
    completedAt: { type: Date, default: null },
    cancelledAt: { type: Date, default: null }
}, {
    timestamps: true,
    collection: 'tasks'
})

// Family task board, sorted by start time
taskSchema.index({ family: 1, startAt: 1 })
taskSchema.index({ recurringSeries: 1, occurrenceIndex: 1 }, { unique: true, partialFilterExpression: { recurringSeries: { $type: 'objectId' } } })
// Recipient tasks tab
taskSchema.index({ family: 1, recipient: 1, startAt: 1 })
// My Tasks (E): a user's claimed tasks across families
taskSchema.index({ claimedBy: 1, status: 1, startAt: 1 })

// ---------- Database operations ----------
// Every query on tasks lives here; controller.js only calls these statics.

// Tasks in these statuses can't be edited
export const LOCKED_STATUSES = [TASK_STATUS.COMPLETED, TASK_STATUS.CANCELLED]
// Tasks in these statuses can't be deleted (cancel them instead)
export const UNDELETABLE_STATUSES = [TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS, TASK_STATUS.COMPLETED]

const USER_FIELDS = 'name telegramUsername profilePicture'
const RECIPIENT_FIELDS = 'name nickname careType profilePicture linkedUser'

// Models owned by other packages. Looked up by name so this file still works
// before they exist: no recipient populate / transit session until they are registered.
const recipientModel = () => mongoose.models.CareRecipient
const transitModel = () => mongoose.models.TransitSession

function populatePeople(query) {
    query.populate('createdBy', USER_FIELDS).populate('claimedBy', USER_FIELDS)
    if (recipientModel()) query.populate('recipient', RECIPIENT_FIELDS)
    return query
}

taskSchema.statics.getTasksByFamily = function (familyId, filter = {}) {
    return populatePeople(
        this.find({ ...filter, family: familyId }).sort({ startAt: 1, createdAt: 1 })
    )
}

taskSchema.statics.getTaskInFamily = function (familyId, taskId) {
    return this.findOne({ _id: taskId, family: familyId })
}

taskSchema.statics.getTaskById = function (taskId) {
    return this.findById(taskId)
}

taskSchema.statics.getPopulatedTaskById = function (taskId) {
    return populatePeople(this.findById(taskId))
}

taskSchema.statics.createTask = function (taskData) {
    return this.create(taskData)
}

// Returns null if the task was completed or cancelled in the meantime
taskSchema.statics.updateEditableTask = function (familyId, taskId, changes, expectedUpdatedAt) {
    return this.findOneAndUpdate(
        { _id: taskId, family: familyId, status: { $nin: LOCKED_STATUSES },
            ...(expectedUpdatedAt ? { updatedAt: new Date(expectedUpdatedAt) } : {}) },
        { $set: changes },
        { new: true, runValidators: true }
    )
}

// Resolves to { deletedCount: 0 } if the task was started or completed in the meantime
taskSchema.statics.deleteDeletableTask = function (familyId, taskId) {
    return this.deleteOne({
        _id: taskId,
        family: familyId,
        status: { $nin: UNDELETABLE_STATUSES }
    })
}

// Only applies if the status and claimer are still what they were when `task`
// was read, so two people claiming at once can't both succeed. Returns null otherwise.
taskSchema.statics.updateTaskStatus = function (task, changes) {
    return this.findOneAndUpdate(
        { _id: task._id, family: task.family, status: task.status, claimedBy: task.claimedBy,
            ...(task.updatedAt ? { updatedAt: task.updatedAt } : {}),
            ...(changes.status === TASK_STATUS.CLAIMED && task.status === TASK_STATUS.OPEN
                ? { startAt: { $gt: changes.claimedAt } } : {}) },
        { $set: changes },
        { new: true }
    )
}

// True if the recipient belongs to this family (always true until C's model exists)
taskSchema.statics.recipientInFamily = async function (recipientId, familyId) {
    const CareRecipient = recipientModel()
    if (!CareRecipient) return true
    return Boolean(await CareRecipient.exists({ _id: recipientId, family: familyId }))
}

// One session per task: reused if the task is started again after an unclaim.
// Starting again is a new journey, so the old steps and location are cleared.
taskSchema.statics.startTransitSession = async function (task) {
    const TransitSession = transitModel()
    if (!TransitSession || !task.needsTransit) return null

    return TransitSession.findOneAndUpdate(
        { task: task._id },
        {
            $set: {
                companion: task.claimedBy,
                status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE,
                milestones: [],
                path: [],
                startedAt: new Date(),
                endedAt: null
            },
            $unset: { lastLocation: '' },
            $setOnInsert: { family: task.family, task: task._id }
        },
        { upsert: true, new: true }
    )
}

taskSchema.statics.endTransitSession = async function (task) {
    const TransitSession = transitModel()
    if (!TransitSession) return

    await TransitSession.updateOne(
        { task: task._id, status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ACTIVE },
        { $set: { status: TRANSIT_STATUS.ENDED } }
    )
}

export default mongoose.models.Task ||
    mongoose.model('Task', taskSchema, 'tasks')

FILE: server/src/middleware/requireAuth.js
================================================

import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken'
import User from '../features/auth/User.model.js'

export async function requireAuth(req, res, next) {
  const authorization = req.headers.authorization

  const match = typeof authorization === 'string'
    ? /^Bearer\s+(\S+)$/i.exec(authorization)
    : null

  if (!match) {
    return res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Authentication token required'
    })
  }

  try {
    if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET) {
      throw new Error('JWT_SECRET is not configured')
    }

    // Step 1: Verify JWT signature and expiration
    const payload = jwt.verify(
      match[1],
      process.env.JWT_SECRET,
      { algorithms: ['HS256'] }
    )

    if (
      !payload ||
      typeof payload !== 'object' ||
      typeof payload.userId !== 'string'
    ) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid authentication token'
      })
    }

    // Step 2: Retrieve user from MongoDB FIRST
    const user = await User.findById(payload.userId)

    // Step 3: Check user existence and token revocation
    if (
      !user ||
      payload.tokenVersion !== (user.tokenVersion ?? 0)
    ) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Session expired or revoked. Please log in again.'
      })
    }

    // Step 4: Attach authenticated user to request
    req.user = {
      userId: user._id.toString()
    }

    return next()

  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof jwt.JsonWebTokenError) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid or expired authentication token'
      })
    }

    console.error('Authentication error:', error)

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Internal server error'
    })
  }
}

FILE: server/src/middleware/requireFamilyMember.js
================================================
// Owner: Sera (package A)
// Use after requireAuth on every /api/families/:familyId/... route.
//
//   router.use('/families/:familyId', requireAuth, requireFamilyMember)
//
// On success it sets:
//   req.family      the Family document (a full Mongoose doc, so controllers can .save() it)
//   req.memberRole  'admin' or 'member'
//
// Controllers must filter every query by req.family._id,
// never by a familyId taken from the body or query string.

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Family from '../features/families/Family.model.js'

export async function requireFamilyMember(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.userId
    if (!userId) {
      // requireAuth didn't run before this middleware
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication token required' })
    }

    const { familyId } = req.params
    // A malformed id would make Mongoose throw a CastError, so treat it as not found
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(familyId)) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Family not found' })
    }

    const family = await Family.findById(familyId)
    if (!family) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Family not found' })
    }

    const membership = family.members.find((m) => m.userId.toString() === userId)
    if (!membership) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'You are not a member of this family' })
    }

    req.family = family
    req.memberRole = membership.role
    return next()
  } catch (error) {
    return next(error)
  }
}

// Use after requireFamilyMember, on admin-only routes only:
//   router.post('/:familyId/invite-code', requireFamilyAdmin, regenerateInviteCode)
export function requireFamilyAdmin(req, res, next) {
  if (req.memberRole !== 'admin') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only family admins can do this' })
  }
  return next()
}

FILE: server/src/utils/notify.js
================================================
// The only way other packages talk to Telegram (docs/OWNERSHIP.md: "Call notify(familyId, eventType, payload)
// from server/src/utils/notify.js. Never call Telegram directly."):
//
//   await notify(familyId, EVENTS.TASK_CLAIMED, populatedTask)
//
// It saves a row in `notifications` (shown in "Recent updates"), then sends it. The row's status is:
//   sent     delivered to the family's Telegram group
//   skipped  no group linked yet, the family muted this event, or the caller passed { send: false }
//   failed   Telegram refused or timed out (the reason is in `error`)
//
// notify() never throws, so a Telegram outage can't make claiming a task fail.
//
// This file has three parts: 1) which events a family switched on, 2) the message wording, 3) notify() itself.
import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import Family from '../features/families/Family.model.js'
import Notification from '../features/notifications/Notifications.model.js'
import { sendTelegramMessage } from '../features/integrations/telegram.js'
import { EVENTS, EVENT_TYPES, NOTIFICATION_STATUS, NOTIFY_NONE } from '../constants.js'

// ---------- Switches ----------
// family.notifyOn is a list of event names:
//   []         never configured -> everything is on (the design doc: "defaults to all")
//   ['none']   an admin switched everything off (an empty list can't mean "off")
//   [...]      only these events are on
export function isEventEnabled(notifyOn, eventType) {
  if (!Array.isArray(notifyOn) || notifyOn.length === 0) return true
  return notifyOn.includes(eventType)
}

// What the settings screen should show as switched on
export function effectiveEvents(notifyOn) {
  if (!Array.isArray(notifyOn) || notifyOn.length === 0) return [...EVENT_TYPES]
  return EVENT_TYPES.filter((eventType) => notifyOn.includes(eventType))
}

// Validate the body of PATCH /notify-settings. Returns { value } or { error }.
export function parseNotifyOn(input) {
  if (!Array.isArray(input)) return { error: 'notifyOn must be a list of event names' }
  const unknown = input.filter((eventType) => !EVENT_TYPES.includes(eventType))
  if (unknown.length) return { error: `Unknown events: ${unknown.join(', ')}. Use: ${EVENT_TYPES.join(', ')}` }
  const events = EVENT_TYPES.filter((eventType) => input.includes(eventType))
  return { value: events.length ? events : [NOTIFY_NONE] }
}

// ---------- Wordings ----------
// Matches the previews already in the client (NewTaskModal / TransitView) and seed.js.
// Group chats get forwarded, so NEVER put health details here: no drug names, doses,
// conditions, symptoms or free-typed note text. Say "medication was updated".
const SG_TZ = 'Asia/Singapore'

// Hand-typed transit steps arrive as type 'custom' with free text, which could say anything.
// Only these preset chip texts are repeated. Keep in sync with transit/utils/wording.js.
const SAFE_CUSTOM_LABELS = new Set(['seeing the doctor', 'collecting medicine', 'going for lunch'])
const HONORIFICS = /^(aunt|auntie|uncle|grandma|grandpa|mr|mrs|ms|dr)\.?$/i

// "Jasmine Tan" -> "Jasmine", "Aunt May" -> "Aunt May"
export function shortName(name) {
  const parts = String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
  if (!parts.length) return ''
  return HONORIFICS.test(parts[0]) && parts[1] ? `${parts[0]} ${parts[1]}` : parts[0]
}

function idOf(value) {
  if (!value) return ''
  const raw = typeof value === 'object' && value._id ? value._id : value
  return String(raw)
}

const recipientLabel = (recipient) => recipient?.nickname || recipient?.name || ''
const dayKey = (date) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: SG_TZ }).format(date)

// "today 2:00pm", "tomorrow 9:30am", "Tue, 27 Oct 10:00am" (Singapore time)
export function whenLabel(value) {
  const date = new Date(value)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return ''
  const now = new Date()
  let day
  if (dayKey(date) === dayKey(now)) day = 'today'
  else if (dayKey(date) === dayKey(new Date(now.getTime() + 86400000))) day = 'tomorrow'
  else day = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: SG_TZ }).format(date)
  const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-SG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: SG_TZ })
    .format(date).replace(/\s/g, '').toLowerCase()
  return `${day} ${time}`
}

// "Buy formula and diapers for Baby Emma" (same style as seed.js); the plain title for a household task
function taskSubject(task) {
  const title = String(task.title || 'a task').trim()
  const who = recipientLabel(task.recipient)
  return who ? `${title} for ${who}` : title
}

const taskRef = (task) => ({ refType: 'task', refId: idOf(task) })

function transitMilestone(session) {
  const steps = session.milestones || []
  const step = steps[steps.length - 1]
  if (!step) return null
  const task = session.task && typeof session.task === 'object' ? session.task : null
  const companion = shortName(session.companion?.name)
  const who = recipientLabel(task?.recipient)
  const place = task?.location?.name
  const withWho = companion ? `, with ${companion}` : ''
  const subject = who || companion || 'The trip'

  const lines = {
    departed: `${companion || 'Someone'} is on the way${who ? ` to fetch ${who}` : ''}.`,
    arrived: `${subject} has arrived${place ? ` at ${place}` : ''}${withWho}.`,
    consultation_done: `${subject}'s consultation is done${withWho}.`,
    heading_home: `${subject} is heading home${withWho}.`,
    home: `${subject} is safely back home${withWho}.`,
  }
  let text = lines[step.type]
  if (!text) {
    const label = String(step.label || '').trim()
    text = SAFE_CUSTOM_LABELS.has(label.toLowerCase())
      ? `${label}${withWho}.`
      : `${subject} has a new trip update${withWho}.`
  }
  return { text, ...taskRef(session.task) }
}

// A log (has .recipient) or a care recipient (the care profile was edited)
const recipientOf = (payload) => (payload.recipient && typeof payload.recipient === 'object' ? payload.recipient : payload)

// Care log events. Only the kind of note and who it is for: never what is in it.
function logMessage(log, sentence) {
  const recipient = recipientOf(log)
  const kind = log.type === 'consultation' ? 'consultation note' : 'care note'
  return { text: sentence(kind, recipientLabel(recipient) || 'a family member'), refType: 'careRecipient', refId: idOf(recipient) }
}
// Whoever edited or deleted it (set by the logs controller), else the author
const editorName = (log) => shortName(log.changedBy?.name || log.author?.name) || 'Someone'
const LOG_EVENTS = [EVENTS.LOG_CREATED, EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED, EVENTS.LOG_DELETED]

const BUILDERS = {
  [EVENTS.TASK_CREATED]: (task) => {
    const when = whenLabel(task.startAt)
    const transit = task.needsTransit ? ' Needs someone to take them there.' : ''
    return { text: `New task: ${taskSubject(task)}${when ? `, ${when}` : ''}.${transit} Who can take it?`, ...taskRef(task) }
  },
  [EVENTS.TASK_UPDATED]: (task) => {
    const when = whenLabel(task.startAt)
    return { text: `${shortName(task.createdBy?.name) || 'Someone'} updated: ${taskSubject(task)}${when ? `, ${when}` : ''}.`, ...taskRef(task) }
  },
  [EVENTS.TASK_DELETED]: (task) => ({
    text: `${shortName(task.createdBy?.name) || 'Someone'} removed: ${taskSubject(task)}.`, ...taskRef(task),
  }),
  [EVENTS.TASK_STARTED]: (task) => ({
    text: `${shortName(task.claimedBy?.name) || 'Someone'} started: ${taskSubject(task)}.`, ...taskRef(task),
  }),
  [EVENTS.TASK_CLAIMED]: (task) => ({
    text: `${shortName(task.claimedBy?.name) || 'Someone'} claimed: ${taskSubject(task)}.`, ...taskRef(task),
  }),
  [EVENTS.TASK_UNCLAIMED]: (task) => {
    const subject = taskSubject(task)
    return { text: `${subject.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${subject.slice(1)} needs someone again.`, ...taskRef(task) }
  },
  [EVENTS.TASK_COMPLETED]: (task) => ({
    text: `Done: ${taskSubject(task)}, by ${shortName(task.claimedBy?.name) || 'a family member'}.`, ...taskRef(task),
  }),
  [EVENTS.TASK_CANCELLED]: (task) => ({ text: `Cancelled: ${taskSubject(task)}.`, ...taskRef(task) }),
  [EVENTS.TRANSIT_MILESTONE]: transitMilestone,
  [EVENTS.LOG_CREATED]: (log) => logMessage(log, (kind, who) => `New ${kind} for ${who}.`),
  [EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED]: (log) => logMessage(log, (kind, who) => `${editorName(log)} edited a ${kind} for ${who}.`),
  [EVENTS.LOG_DELETED]: (log) => logMessage(log, (kind, who) => `${editorName(log)} deleted a ${kind} for ${who}.`),
  [EVENTS.MEDICATION_CHANGED]: (payload) => {
    const recipient = recipientOf(payload)
    return {
      text: `${recipientLabel(recipient) || 'A family member'}'s medication was updated. Check the app.`,
      refType: 'careRecipient', refId: idOf(recipient),
    }
  },
}

// Returns { text, refType, refId } or null when there is nothing to send
export function buildMessage(eventType, payload) {
  const build = BUILDERS[eventType]
  if (!build || !payload) return null
  const message = build(payload)
  return message?.text ? message : null
}

// Deep link to the page the event is about, using the real client routes.
// Needs APP_URL (the website address); returns '' when it isn't set.
export function deepLink({ eventType, refType, refId, familyId }) {
  const base = (process.env.APP_URL || '').replace(/\/+$/, '')
  if (!base || !refId) return ''
  if (refType === 'task') {
    if (eventType === EVENTS.TASK_DELETED) return '' // the task page no longer exists
    return eventType === EVENTS.TRANSIT_MILESTONE
      ? `${base}/transit/${familyId}/${refId}`
      : `${base}/families/${familyId}/tasks/${refId}`
  }
  if (refType === 'careRecipient') {
    return LOG_EVENTS.includes(eventType) ? `${base}/recipients/${refId}/log` : `${base}/recipients/${refId}`
  }
  return ''
}

// ---------- Notify ----------
// { send: false } records the update for "Recent updates" without a Telegram message
// (e.g. a care note posted with "Notify the family Telegram group" unticked).
export async function notify(familyId, eventType, payload, { send = true } = {}) {
  try {
    if (!EVENT_TYPES.includes(eventType)) return null

    const id = familyId?._id ?? familyId
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(id)) return null

    const message = buildMessage(eventType, payload)
    if (!message) return null

    const family = await Family.findById(id).select('telegram notifyOn').lean()
    if (!family) return null

    const chatId = family.telegram?.chatId
    const skip = !send || !chatId || !isEventEnabled(family.notifyOn, eventType)

    const record = await Notification.create({
      family: id,
      eventType,
      refType: message.refType,
      refId: mongoose.isValidObjectId(message.refId) ? message.refId : undefined,
      text: message.text,
      status: skip ? NOTIFICATION_STATUS.SKIPPED : NOTIFICATION_STATUS.PENDING,
    })
    if (skip) return record

    const link = deepLink({ eventType, refType: message.refType, refId: message.refId, familyId: String(id) })
    try {
      await sendTelegramMessage(chatId, link ? `${message.text}\n${link}` : message.text)
      record.status = NOTIFICATION_STATUS.SENT
      record.sentAt = new Date()
    } catch (error) {
      record.status = NOTIFICATION_STATUS.FAILED
      record.error = String(error.message).slice(0, 300)
    }
    await record.save()
    return record
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('notify() failed:', error.message)
    return null
  }
}

const presets = ['alex', 'aunt-may', 'baby-emma', 'grandma', 'grandpa', 'jasmine', 'mia', 'mochi']
export function validProfilePicture(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && (value === '' ||
    presets.some(name => value === `/avatars/people/${name}.png`) ||
    (value.length <= 50000 && /^data:image\/jpeg;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(value)))
}

FILE: server/test/support/database.js

import mongoose from 'mongoose'
import { MongoMemoryReplSet } from 'mongodb-memory-server-core'

// These helpers never read .env or accept a shared/remote database URI.
// A real mongod runs in a fresh temporary directory and is removed on shutdown.
export async function startTestDatabase(label) {
  // A developer's exported cloud credentials must never enable paid/live calls
  // in an otherwise isolated API/E2E run. Tests can opt into local provider doubles.
  for (const key of ['GEMINI_API_KEY', 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID', 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET', 'GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI',
    'AZURE_TRANSLATOR_KEY', 'AZURE_TRANSLATOR_REGION', 'GROQ_API_KEY']) delete process.env[key]
  const dbName = `carecircle_test_${label}_${process.pid}`
  // One real local replica-set member enables multi-document transactions.
  const mongo = await MongoMemoryReplSet.create({ replSet: { count: 1, ip: '127.0.0.1', storageEngine: 'wiredTiger' } })
  const uri = mongo.getUri(dbName)
  try {
    await connectTestDatabase(uri)
    process.env.MONGODB_URI = uri
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'carecircle-isolated-tests-only-secret'
    return { uri, async stop() { await mongoose.disconnect(); await mongo.stop() } }
  } catch (error) {
    await mongo.stop()
    throw error
  }
}

export async function connectTestDatabase(uri) {
  validateTestDatabaseUri(uri)
  await mongoose.connect(uri)
}

export function validateTestDatabaseUri(uri) {
  const parsed = new URL(uri)
  if (parsed.protocol !== 'mongodb:' || parsed.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' ||
      !/^\/carecircle_test_[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(parsed.pathname)) {
    throw new Error('Tests require a generated local carecircle_test_ database')
  }
}

export function assertTestDatabase() {
  if (mongoose.connection.host !== '127.0.0.1' || !mongoose.connection.name?.startsWith('carecircle_test_'))
    throw new Error('Refusing to reset data outside an isolated test database')
}

export { mongoose }

    { _id: ids.otherRecipient, family: ids.otherFamily, name: 'Lee recipient', careType: 'other', createdBy: ids.outsider },
  ])
  const day = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' }).format(new Date())
  await Task.create({ _id: ids.task, family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa,
    title: 'Collect medicine', startAt: new Date(`${day}T14:00:00+08:00`), createdBy: ids.jasmine })
  await Log.create({ _id: ids.log, family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, author: ids.alex,
    type: 'general', content: 'Sample note in the isolated test database.' })
  await Promise.all([User, Family, Recipient, Task, Log].map(Model => Model.init()))
}

FILE: shared/recurrence.js

// Shared browser/server calendar arithmetic: Singapore UTC+08, no daylight saving.
const DAY = 86400000, OFFSET = 8 * 3600000
export const MAX_SESSIONS = 500
const fail = message => { throw Object.assign(new Error(message), { status: 400 }) }
export const sgDay = value => new Date(+new Date(value) + OFFSET).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
// Pick the next selected weekday using the same Monday-first Singapore calendar
// as generation. A calendar-selected date is a lower bound, not an extra session.
export function nextWeeklyDate(anchor, time, weekdays, now = new Date()) {
  const today = sgDay(now), from = anchor > today ? anchor : today
  if (!weekdays?.length) return from
  for (let offset = 0; offset <= 7; offset++) {
    const day = new Date(Date.parse(from) + offset * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    const weekday = (new Date(`${day}T12:00:00+08:00`).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
    if (!weekdays.includes(weekday)) continue
    if (time && +new Date(`${day}T${time}:00+08:00`) <= +now) continue
    return day
  }
  return from
}
export function parseRecurrence(input, startAt) {
  if (input == null || input.frequency === 'none') return null
  if (typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) fail('Repeat settings must be an object')
  const { frequency, interval = 1, weekdays, end = { mode: 'never' } } = input
  if (!['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'].includes(frequency)) fail('Choose a valid repeat frequency')
  if (!Number.isInteger(interval) || interval < 1 || interval > 365) fail('Repeat interval must be between 1 and 365')
  const weekday = (new Date(+new Date(startAt) + OFFSET).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
  const days = frequency === 'weekly' ? (weekdays ?? [weekday]) : []
  if (!Array.isArray(days) || (frequency === 'weekly' && !days.length) || days.some(day => !Number.isInteger(day) || day < 0 || day > 6)) fail('Choose at least one valid repeat weekday')
  if (!end || !['never', 'on', 'after'].includes(end.mode)) fail('Choose how the repeating task ends')
  const ending = { mode: end.mode }
  if (end.mode === 'after') {
    if (!Number.isInteger(end.count) || end.count < 1 || end.count > MAX_SESSIONS) fail(`Repeat count must be between 1 and ${MAX_SESSIONS}`)
    ending.count = end.count
  }
  if (end.mode === 'on') {
    if (typeof end.until !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(end.until)) fail('Choose a valid repeat end date')
    const until = new Date(`${end.until}T00:00:00Z`)
    if (!Number.isFinite(+until) || until.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== end.until || end.until < sgDay(startAt)) fail('Repeat end date must be on or after the first session')
    if (+until - Date.parse(sgDay(startAt)) > 366 * 5 * DAY) fail('Repeat end date must be within five years')
    ending.until = end.until
  }
  return { frequency, interval, weekdays: [...new Set(days)].sort((a, b) => a - b), end: ending }
}

export function recurrenceDates(rule, startAt, endAt, through) {
  const first = new Date(startAt), local = new Date(+first + OFFSET)
  const firstDay = Date.parse(sgDay(first)), time = (+local % DAY + DAY) % DAY
  const firstWeekday = (local.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
  const duration = endAt ? +new Date(endAt) - +first : null
  const result = [], count = rule.end.mode === 'after' ? rule.end.count : Infinity
  const last = rule.end.mode === 'on' ? Date.parse(rule.end.until) + DAY - 1 - OFFSET : +new Date(through)
  if (!Number.isFinite(last) && rule.end.mode !== 'after') fail('A generation horizon is required')
  // Bounded even for sparse monthly/custom schedules; no unbounded request loops.
  for (let day = 0; day <= 366 * 500 && result.length < count; day++) {
    const candidateDay = firstDay + day * DAY
    const at = candidateDay + time - OFFSET
    if (at > last && rule.end.mode !== 'after') break
    let matches = false
    if (rule.frequency === 'daily') matches = day % rule.interval === 0
    if (rule.frequency === 'weekly') matches = Math.floor((day + firstWeekday) / 7) % rule.interval === 0 && rule.weekdays.includes((firstWeekday + day) % 7)
    if (rule.frequency === 'monthly') {
      const date = new Date(candidateDay)
      const months = (date.getUTCFullYear() - local.getUTCFullYear()) * 12 + date.getUTCMonth() - local.getUTCMonth()
      matches = months % rule.interval === 0 && date.getUTCDate() === local.getUTCDate()
    }
    if (!matches) continue
    if (result.length >= MAX_SESSIONS && rule.end.mode !== 'never') fail(`A recurring task can contain at most ${MAX_SESSIONS} sessions`)
    // Long-running "Never" series are paged by time, rather than total history.
    result.push({ index: result.length, startAt: new Date(at), endAt: duration == null ? null : new Date(at + duration) })
  }
  if (!result.length) fail('The repeat settings do not include any sessions')
  if (rule.end.mode === 'after' && result.length < count) fail('This repeat interval and count extend too far into the future')
  return result
}

export function recurrenceLabel(rule) {
  const names = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']
  const unit = { daily: 'day', weekly: 'week', monthly: 'month' }[rule.frequency]
  return `Every ${rule.interval === 1 ? '' : `${rule.interval} `}${unit}${rule.interval > 1 ? 's' : ''}${rule.frequency === 'weekly' ? ` on ${rule.weekdays.map(day => names[day]).join(', ')}` : ''}`
}

export function generationHorizon(startAt, now = new Date()) {
  return new Date(Math.max(Date.parse(sgDay(now)), Date.parse(sgDay(startAt))) + 29 * DAY - 1 - OFFSET)
}

FILE: tests/e2e/README.md

# End-to-end tests

Recurring workflows are in `recurring-workflows.spec.mjs`: form creation,
whole-series claim, one-day handover, cancellation and next-four claims. They run
on both desktop/mobile projects using the local replica-set test database.
See [current setup and verification](../../docs/TESTING-RECURRING.md).

Run `npm run test:e2e` from the repository root. Playwright starts the real Vue
app and Express API, with a fresh local MongoDB process and test-only accounts.
It never runs `server/seed.js`, loads the server's `.env`, or uses a shared DB.

The same workflows run in desktop Chromium and a 390px mobile Chromium context:
login/logout, language saving, global dark mode, recipient create/edit/archive,
task creation/claim and family isolation, member roles, invite regeneration,
care-log translation/cache, care-log posting/filtering/editing/deleting, member
permissions and voice input, consultation notes added from a task, task editing,
the family Calendar (tasks and follow-up appointments, filters, months), and
expansion of multiple live trips.
Application API responses are real. Azure alone uses a controlled provider double
in the test server; no live translation credential or paid request is needed.
The voice-input success case replaces only the `/integrations/transcribe` reply in
the browser, because Groq is paid; the no-key case uses the real 503 reply.
The language case gates a request to observe its pending
state before allowing the real request through. Decorative Google fonts are blocked.

Use `npm run test:e2e:headed` to watch. Use `pnpm exec playwright show-report` to
open the HTML report. Failure screenshots and traces are saved in `test-results/`.

See [the testing guide](../../docs/TESTING.md) for installation, test layers,
database isolation and which features remain outside the tested scope.

// Owner: SeungHak (F). Family Calendar: tasks and follow-up appointments on one month grid.
import { test, expect, ids, login, authenticatedApi } from './fixtures.mjs'

// Tomorrow in Singapore, so the test doesn't depend on the time of day it runs
function tomorrow() {
  const day = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600e3).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' })
  return { day, at: hour => `${day}T${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:00:00+08:00` }
}

async function openDay(page, day) {
  await page.goto('/calendar')
  const thisMonth = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' }).slice(0, 7)
  if (day.slice(0, 7) > thisMonth) await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
  if (day.slice(0, 7) < thisMonth) await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous month' }).click()
  await page.getByTestId(`calendar-day-${day}`).click()
  return page.getByTestId('calendar-agenda')
}

test('shows the family\'s tasks and follow-up appointments, and filters by person', async ({ page, isolatedData }) => {
  await login(page)
  const api = await authenticatedApi(page, isolatedData.apiURL)
  const root = `/families/${ids.family}`
  const { day, at } = tomorrow()

  const grandpaTask = await api(`${root}/tasks`, { method: 'POST', data: { title: 'Physio session', recipient: ids.grandpa, category: 'therapy', startAt: at(10) } })
  expect(grandpaTask.status()).toBe(201)
  const taskId = (await grandpaTask.json()).task._id
  expect((await api(`${root}/tasks/${taskId}/claim`, { method: 'POST' })).status()).toBe(200)
  expect((await api(`${root}/tasks`, { method: 'POST', data: { title: 'Buy groceries', category: 'groceries', startAt: at(9) } })).status()).toBe(201)
  expect((await api(`${root}/logs`, { method: 'POST', data: {
    recipient: ids.grandpa, type: 'consultation', content: 'Check-up went well.', notify: false,
    consultation: { doctorName: 'Dr Lim', clinic: 'AMK Polyclinic', nextAppointment: at(15) },
  } })).status()).toBe(201)

  const agenda = await openDay(page, day)
  const items = agenda.locator('.agenda-item')
  await expect(items).toHaveCount(3)
  // Sorted by time, each with who it's for and its state
  await expect(items.nth(0)).toContainText('Buy groceries')
  await expect(items.nth(0)).toContainText('Household')
  await expect(items.nth(0)).toContainText('Needs someone')
  await expect(items.nth(1)).toContainText('Physio session')
  await expect(items.nth(1)).toContainText('Claimed by Alex')
  await expect(items.nth(2)).toContainText('Follow-up with Dr Lim, AMK Polyclinic')
  await expect(items.nth(2)).toContainText('Next appointment')

  // Only Grandpa's
  await page.getByTestId('calendar-filter').selectOption(ids.grandpa)
  await expect(items).toHaveCount(2)
  await expect(agenda).not.toContainText('Buy groceries')

  // A task opens its detail page
  await items.filter({ hasText: 'Physio session' }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/families/${ids.family}/tasks/${taskId}$`))
})

test('the Calendar opens from Home, and the month can be changed', async ({ page, isMobile }) => {
  await login(page)
  // Desktop: the sidebar. Phones: the calendar button beside the profile picture on Home.
  if (isMobile) await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open the family calendar' }).click()
  else await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Calendar', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/calendar$/)
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Calendar', level: 1 })).toBeVisible()

  const month = page.getByTestId('calendar-month')
  const current = await month.textContent()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
  await expect(month).not.toHaveText(current)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Today' }).click()
  await expect(month).toHaveText(current)

  const widths = await page.evaluate(() => ({ document: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, viewport: innerWidth }))
  expect(widths.document).toBeLessThanOrEqual(widths.viewport)
})

test('adds a task straight onto a day, like Apple Calendar', async ({ page, isMobile }) => {
  await login(page)
  // Five days ahead: not one of the form's quick chips, so the picked date must carry over
  const day = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 24 * 3600e3).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' })
  await openDay(page, day)

  // Desktop: double-click the day. Phones: "+ Add task" in the day's list.
  if (isMobile) await page.getByTestId('calendar-add-task').click()
  else await page.getByTestId(`calendar-day-${day}`).dblclick()

  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'New task' })
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByLabel('Date')).toHaveValue(day)
  await dialog.getByLabel('What needs doing?').fill('Bring Grandpa to the dentist')
  await dialog.getByLabel('Starts').fill('09:30')
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post task' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)

  const agenda = page.getByTestId('calendar-agenda')
  await expect(agenda.locator('.agenda-item').filter({ hasText: 'Bring Grandpa to the dentist' })).toContainText('9:30am')

  // Yesterday can't take new tasks
  const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3600e3).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Singapore' })
  await openDay(page, yesterday)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('calendar-add-task')).toHaveCount(0)
})

// Owner: SeungHak (F)
import { test, expect, ids, login, authenticatedApi } from './fixtures.mjs'
import { accounts, password } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'

const logPage = `/recipients/${ids.grandpa}/log`

function cards(page) {
  return page.locator('[data-testid^="log-card-"]')
}

async function postNote(page) {
  const created = page.waitForResponse(response =>
    response.url().endsWith(`/families/${ids.family}/logs`) && response.request().method() === 'POST')
  await page.getByTestId('log-submit').click()
  const response = await created
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201)
  return { request: response.request().postDataJSON(), log: (await response.json()).log }
}

// fixtures.mjs login() looks for "May" in the Home greeting, which reads "Good morning, Aunt"
async function loginAsMember(page) {
  await page.goto('/login')
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(accounts.may)
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Log in/ }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/home$/)
}

// A silent tone stands in for the microphone, so MediaRecorder produces a real recording.
async function useFakeMicrophone(page) {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const fakeGetUserMedia = async () => {
      const context = new AudioContext()
      const tone = context.createOscillator()
      const output = context.createMediaStreamDestination()
      tone.connect(output)
      tone.start()
      return output.stream
    }
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'mediaDevices', { value: {} })
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia = fakeGetUserMedia
  })
}

  await page.getByLabel('Doctor optional', { exact: true }).fill('Dr Lim')
  await page.getByLabel('Clinic optional', { exact: true }).fill('Ang Mo Kio Polyclinic')
  await page.getByTestId('log-notify').uncheck()
  const { request, log } = await postNote(page)

  expect(request).toMatchObject({ type: 'consultation', notify: false, inputMethod: 'text' })
  const card = page.getByTestId(`log-card-${log._id}`)

  await page.reload()

  await page.getByTestId('log-filter-consultation').click()
  await expect(cards(page)).toHaveCount(1)

  page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
  await card.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete note', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(card).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('saved-toast')).toHaveText("Note deleted from Grandpa's log")
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`log-card-${ids.log}`)).toBeVisible()
  await expect(card).toHaveCount(0)

  const widths = await page.evaluate(() => ({ document: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, viewport: innerWidth }))
  expect(widths.document).toBeLessThanOrEqual(widths.viewport)
})

test('a transcribed voice note is added to the text and saved as voice input', async ({ page, isolatedData }) => {
  await useFakeMicrophone(page)
  // Groq is a paid external service, so only the transcription reply is replaced.
  // The recording is still made in the browser and the note is saved by the real API.
  let uploadedType = ''
  await page.route('**/integrations/transcribe', route => {
    uploadedType = route.request().headers()['content-type']
    return route.fulfill({ json: { text: 'Grandpa walked to the park today.' } })
  })
  await login(page)
  await page.goto(logPage)

  await page.getByTestId('log-content').fill('Morning update:')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Speak your note', exact: true }).click()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Stop and use what I said', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('log-content')).toHaveValue('Morning update: Grandpa walked to the park today.')
  await expect(page.getByText('Added from voice. Check the text before posting.', { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  expect(uploadedType).toMatch(/^audio\//)

  const { request, log } = await postNote(page)

import { test as base, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { connectTestDatabase, mongoose } from '../../server/test/support/database.js'
import { resetFixtures, ids, accounts, password } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'

export const test = base.extend({
  isolatedData: [async ({ context }, use) => {
    const runtime = JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../../.test-runtime/e2e.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'))
    await connectTestDatabase(runtime.uri)
    await resetFixtures()
    // Decorative Google fonts aren't a dependency of a user workflow.
    await context.route('https://fonts.googleapis.com/**', route => route.abort())
    await context.route('https://fonts.gstatic.com/**', route => route.abort())
    await use({ ids, apiURL: runtime.apiURL })
  }, { auto: true }],
})
test.afterAll(async () => { await mongoose.disconnect() })
export { expect, ids }

// API-assisted setup for trips that another family member may already have
// started. Browser assertions still use the real Home page and API responses.
export async function authenticatedApi(page, apiURL, account = 'alex') {
  const response = await page.request.post(`${apiURL}/auth/login`, { data: { email: accounts[account], password } })
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  const { token } = await response.json()
  return (path, options = {}) => page.request.fetch(`${apiURL}${path}`, {
    ...options, headers: { ...options.headers, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  })
}

export async function login(page, account = 'alex') {
  await page.goto('/login')
  await page.getByLabel('Email address', { exact: true }).fill(accounts[account])
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Log in/ }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/home$/)
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText(account === 'alex' ? 'Alex' : 'May')
}

import { test, expect, ids, login, authenticatedApi } from './fixtures.mjs'
import { recurringTaskPayload } from '../support/recurring-fixtures.mjs'

const path = `/families/${ids.family}/tasks`
async function seed(page, apiURL) {
  const api = await authenticatedApi(page, apiURL)
  const response = await api(path, { method: 'POST', data: recurringTaskPayload({ count: 6 }) })
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201)
  const { task } = await response.json()
  return { api, task }
}
async function sessions(api, seriesId) {
  const response = await api(path); expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  return (await response.json()).tasks.filter(t => t.recurringSeries === seriesId)
}
const take = page => page.getByRole('button', { name: /I.ll take it/i }).filter({ visible: true })

test('creates a daily series from the form and persists every session', async ({ page, isolatedData }) => {
  await login(page)
  await page.goto('/tasks/new')
  await page.getByLabel('What needs doing?', { exact: true }).fill('E2E repeating therapy')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Tomorrow', exact: true }).click()

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'After a number of times', exact: true }).click()
  await page.getByLabel('Sessions', { exact: true }).fill('6')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Post 6 tasks', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/home$/)

test('default series claim and a one-day handover preserve other assignments', async ({ page, isolatedData }) => {
  const { api, task } = await seed(page, isolatedData.apiURL)
  await login(page, 'may')
  await page.goto(`${path}/${task._id}`)
  await take(page).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: `Take ${task.title}?` })
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: /Every upcoming session/ })).toBeChecked()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: "I'll take it", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible()
  await expect.poll(async () => (await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).filter(t => t.claimedBy?._id === ids.may).length).toBe(6)
  page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Give back/i }).filter({ visible: true }).click()
  await expect.poll(async () => (await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).find(t => t._id === task._id)?.recurrenceDetached).toBe(true)
  await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.clear())
  await login(page)
  await page.goto(`${path}/${task._id}`)
  await take(page).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: `Take ${task.title}?` })).not.toBeVisible()
  await expect.poll(async () => (await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).find(t => t._id === task._id)?.claimedBy?._id).toBe(ids.alex)
  const saved = await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)
  expect(saved.filter(t => t._id !== task._id).every(t => t.claimedBy?._id === ids.may)).toBe(true)
})

test('claim cancellation writes nothing; next-four limits the assignment', async ({ page, isolatedData }) => {

  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Not now', exact: true }).click()
  expect((await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).every(t => t.status === 'open')).toBe(true)
  await take(page).click()
  dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: `Take ${task.title}?` })
  await dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: /The next 4 sessions/ }).check()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: "I'll take it", exact: true }).click()
  await expect.poll(async () => (await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).filter(t => t.claimedBy?._id === ids.may).length).toBe(4)
  expect((await sessions(api, task.recurringSeries)).filter(t => t.status === 'open')).toHaveLength(2)
})

import { before, beforeEach, after, test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { startApiHarness } from '../support/api-harness.mjs'
import { recurringTaskPayload } from '../support/recurring-fixtures.mjs'
import { ids } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import Series from '../../server/src/features/tasks/RecurringSeries.model.js'

let api
const path = `/families/${ids.family}/tasks`
before(async () => { api = await startApiHarness('recurring') }, { timeout: 180000 })
beforeEach(async () => { await api.reset() })
after(async () => { await api?.stop() })
const request = (...args) => api.request(...args)
async function create(options) {
  const result = await request(path, { method: 'POST', body: { ...recurringTaskPayload(options), recipient: ids.grandpa } })
  assert.equal(result.status, 201, JSON.stringify(result.data))
  return result.data.task
}
const occurrences = series => Task.find({ recurringSeries: series }).sort({ occurrenceIndex: 1 }).lean()
const action = (task, name, user = 'may', body) => request(`${path}/${task._id}/${name}`, { method: 'POST', user, body })

test('creation persists separate sessions and validates family, rule and permissions', async () => {
  const first = await create()
  assert.equal((await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)).length, 8)
  assert.equal((await Series.findById(first.recurringSeries)).rule.end.count, 8)
  assert.equal((await request(path, { method: 'POST', user: 'outsider', body: recurringTaskPayload() })).status, 403)
  assert.equal((await request(path, { method: 'POST', body: recurringTaskPayload({ count: 501 }) })).status, 400)
  assert.equal(await Series.countDocuments({ family: ids.family }), 1)
})
test('real concurrent transactions have exactly one series claimant', async () => {
  const first = await create()
  const results = await Promise.all([action(first, 'claim', 'may'), action(first, 'claim', 'jasmine')])
  assert.deepEqual(results.map(r => r.status).sort(), [200, 409])
  const winner = results.find(r => r.status === 200).data.task.claimedBy._id
  assert.ok((await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)).every(t => String(t.claimedBy) === winner && t.status === 'claimed'))
})
test('giving back a date and reclaiming it never steals the other sessions', async () => {
  const first = await create(); assert.equal((await action(first, 'claim')).status, 200)
  const day = (await occurrences(first.recurringSeries))[2]
  assert.equal((await action(day, 'unclaim', 'jasmine')).status, 403)
  assert.equal((await action(day, 'unclaim')).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await action(day, 'claim', 'jasmine', { scope: 'series' })).status, 200)
  const saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  assert.equal(String(saved[2].claimedBy), ids.jasmine); assert.equal(saved[2].recurrenceDetached, true)
  assert.ok(saved.filter(t => t.occurrenceIndex !== 2).every(t => String(t.claimedBy) === ids.may))
})
test('next-four claims leave the rest open and protect against cross-family claims', async () => {
  const first = await create()
  assert.equal((await action(first, 'claim', 'may', { scope: 'next4' })).status, 200)
  const saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  assert.equal(saved.filter(t => t.status === 'claimed' && t.recurrenceDetached).length, 4)
  assert.equal(saved.filter(t => t.status === 'open').length, 4)
  assert.equal((await request(`/families/${ids.otherFamily}/tasks/${first._id}/claim`, { method: 'POST' })).status, 404)
})
test('scoped editing preserves completed/independent dates and rejects stale versions', async () => {
  const first = await create()
  const saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  await action(saved[1], 'claim', 'may', { scope: 'one' })
  await action(first, 'claim', 'alex', { scope: 'one' }); await action(first, 'complete', 'alex')
  const edit = { method: 'PATCH', body: { title: 'Updated recurring therapy', scope: 'all', expectedUpdatedAt: saved[2].updatedAt } }
  assert.equal((await request(`${path}/${saved[2]._id}`, { ...edit, user: 'may' })).status, 403)
  assert.equal((await request(`${path}/${saved[2]._id}`, edit)).status, 200)
  const result = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  assert.equal(result[0].title, first.title); assert.equal(result[1].title, first.title)
  assert.ok(result.slice(2).every(t => t.title === edit.body.title))
  assert.equal((await request(`${path}/${saved[2]._id}`, edit)).status, 409)
})
test('pause/resume preserves one-date openings and deleted dates do not regenerate', async () => {
  const first = await create({ never: true }); await action(first, 'claim')
  let saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  await action(saved[1], 'unclaim')
  const seriesPath = `${path}/recurring/${first.recurringSeries}`
  assert.equal((await request(seriesPath, { method: 'PATCH', user: 'may', body: { paused: true } })).status, 403)
  assert.equal((await request(seriesPath, { method: 'PATCH', body: { paused: true } })).status, 200)
  saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  assert.equal(saved[1].status, 'open'); assert.equal(saved[2].recurrencePaused, true)
  await request(seriesPath, { method: 'PATCH', body: { paused: false } })
  assert.equal((await Task.findById(saved[2]._id)).status, 'claimed')
  assert.equal((await request(`${path}/${saved[2]._id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })).status, 200)
  await Series.updateOne({ _id: first.recurringSeries }, { $set: { generatedThrough: null } })
  assert.equal((await request(path)).status, 200)
  assert.equal(await Task.findById(saved[2]._id), null)
  assert.equal(await Task.countDocuments({ recurringSeries: first.recurringSeries, occurrenceIndex: 2 }), 0)
})
test('rolling generation retains ownership without duplicate occurrence indexes', async () => {
  const first = await create({ never: true }); await action(first, 'claim')
  // Simulate a gap at the edge of the materialized window, then exercise real read generation.
  const last = (await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)).at(-1)
  await Task.deleteOne({ _id: last._id })
  await Series.updateOne({ _id: first.recurringSeries }, { $set: { generatedThrough: null } })
  await request(path); await request(path)
  const saved = await occurrences(first.recurringSeries)
  assert.equal(saved.filter(t => t.occurrenceIndex === last.occurrenceIndex).length, 1)
  assert.ok(saved.every(t => String(t.claimedBy) === ids.may))
})

import { before, beforeEach, after, describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { app } from '../../server/src/app.js'
import { startTestDatabase } from '../../server/test/support/database.js'
import { resetFixtures, ids, accounts, password } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'
import Recipient from '../../server/src/features/recipients/CareRecipient.model.js'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import Log from '../../server/src/features/logs/CareLog.model.js'
import { makeSnippet } from '../../server/src/features/search/service.js'

let database, server, base, tokens
before(async () => {
  database = await startTestDatabase('search')
  server = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1')
  await new Promise(resolve => server.once('listening', resolve))
  base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api`
}, { timeout: 180000 })
after(async () => {
  if (server) {
    server.closeAllConnections()
    await new Promise(resolve => server.close(resolve))
  }
  await database?.stop()
})
async function request(path, { user = 'alex', method = 'GET', body } = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, {
    method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(tokens?.[user] ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokens[user]}` } : {}) },
    ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
  })
  return { status: response.status, data: await response.json() }
}
const search = (params, options) => request(`/families/${ids.family}/search?${new URLSearchParams(params)}`, options)
const inDays = days => new Date(Date.now() + days * 86400000)

// Eye-related rows in the Tan family, plus look-alikes in the Lee family that must never show
async function seedEyeData() {
  const clinic = { name: 'TTSH Eye Centre', address: '11 Jalan Tan Tock Seng', postal: '308433' }
  await Task.create([
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, title: 'Eye check-up', startAt: inDays(1), location: clinic, createdBy: ids.jasmine },
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, title: 'Eye check-up', startAt: inDays(-20), location: clinic, status: 'completed', claimedBy: ids.jasmine, createdBy: ids.jasmine },
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, title: 'Collect eye drops', startAt: inDays(3), createdBy: ids.alex },
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, title: 'Old eye appointment', startAt: inDays(2), status: 'cancelled', createdBy: ids.alex },
    { family: ids.otherFamily, recipient: ids.otherRecipient, title: 'Eye exam (Lee)', startAt: inDays(1), location: { name: 'Lee Eye Clinic' }, createdBy: ids.outsider },
  ])
  await Log.create([
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, author: ids.jasmine, type: 'consultation', content: 'Continue the eye drops twice a day and review in 3 months.', consultation: { doctorName: 'Dr Lim', clinic: 'TTSH Eye Centre' } },
    { family: ids.family, recipient: ids.grandpa, author: ids.may, type: 'medication_change', content: 'Started new drops.', medicationChanges: [{ name: 'Eye drops', change: 'added', details: '2 drops, morning and night' }] },
    { family: ids.otherFamily, recipient: ids.otherRecipient, author: ids.outsider, type: 'general', content: 'Lee eye note' },
  ])
  await Recipient.create({ family: ids.otherFamily, name: 'Eyeleen Lee', careType: 'other' })
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetFixtures()
  tokens = {}
  for (const [name, email] of Object.entries(accounts)) {
    const login = await request('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', body: { email, password } })
    assert.equal(login.status, 200)
    tokens[name] = login.data.token
  }
})

describe('Family search API', () => {
  it('only returns the selected family, even for a member of both families', async () => {
    await seedEyeData()
    // alex belongs to both families; the family id in the query string is ignored
    const result = await search({ q: 'eye', limit: 50, family: ids.otherFamily })
    assert.equal(result.status, 200)
    const text = JSON.stringify(result.data)
    for (const leak of ['Lee', 'Eyeleen', ids.otherRecipient, ids.otherFamily]) assert.ok(!text.includes(leak), `found ${leak}`)
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.counts, { all: 6, tasks: 3, logs: 2, people: 0, places: 1 })
    // Cancelled tasks are left out
    assert.ok(!result.data.results.tasks.some(task => task.title === 'Old eye appointment'))

    const other = await request(`/families/${ids.otherFamily}/search?q=eye&limit=50`)
    assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(other.data).includes('Collect eye drops'))
    assert.equal(other.data.counts.tasks, 1)
    assert.equal((await search({ q: 'eye' }, { user: 'outsider' })).status, 403)
  })

  it('treats regex characters in the search literally', async () => {
    await Task.create({ family: ids.family, title: 'Eye (left) check?', startAt: inDays(1), createdBy: ids.alex })
    const literal = await search({ q: '(left) check?' })
    assert.equal(literal.status, 200)
    assert.equal(literal.data.counts.tasks, 1)
    for (const q of ['.*', '.+', '[a-z]+', '^C', 'a|b']) {
      const result = await search({ q })
      assert.equal(result.status, 200, q)
      assert.equal(result.data.counts.all, 0, q)
    }
  })

  it('returns only the requested type, while counts cover every type', async () => {
    await seedEyeData()
    const counts = { all: 6, tasks: 3, logs: 2, people: 0, places: 1 }
    for (const type of ['tasks', 'logs', 'people', 'places']) {
      const result = await search({ q: 'eye', type, limit: 50 })
      assert.equal(result.status, 200)
      assert.deepEqual(result.data.counts, counts)
      for (const [group, list] of Object.entries(result.data.results)) {
        assert.equal(list.length, group === type ? counts[group] : 0, `${type}: ${group}`)
      }
    }
    const people = await search({ q: 'jasm', type: 'people' })
    assert.deepEqual(people.data.results.people.map(person => [person.kind, person.name]), [['member', 'Jasmine']])
    const recipients = await search({ q: 'grandpa', type: 'people' })
    assert.equal(recipients.data.results.people[0].kind, 'recipient')
  })

  it('shapes results for the dropdown: best match first, snippets, places and filters', async () => {
    await seedEyeData()
    const { data } = await search({ q: 'eye check-up', limit: 50 })
    // Exact title first, the upcoming one before the past one
    assert.equal(data.results.tasks[0].title, 'Eye check-up')
    assert.ok(new Date(data.results.tasks[0].startAt) > new Date())
    assert.equal(data.results.tasks[1].claimedBy.name, 'Jasmine')
    assert.equal(data.results.tasks[0].recipient.name, 'Grandpa')

    const eye = (await search({ q: 'eye', limit: 50 })).data
    const consultation = eye.results.logs.find(log => log.type === 'consultation')
    assert.equal(consultation.doctorName, 'Dr Lim')
    assert.equal(consultation.author.name, 'Jasmine')
    const place = eye.results.places[0]
    assert.deepEqual([place.name, place.postal, place.taskCount, place.usualFor?.name], ['TTSH Eye Centre', '308433', 2, 'Grandpa'])

    assert.equal((await search({ q: 'eye', status: 'completed', limit: 50 })).data.counts.tasks, 1)
    assert.equal((await search({ q: 'eye', when: 'upcoming', limit: 50 })).data.counts.tasks, 2)
    assert.equal((await search({ q: 'eye', when: 'past30', limit: 50 })).data.counts.tasks, 1)
    assert.equal((await search({ q: 'eye', limit: 1 })).data.results.tasks.length, 1)
  })

  it('rejects a search shorter than 2 characters and invalid filters', async () => {
    for (const params of [{}, { q: 'e' }, { q: '   e  ' }, { q: 'x'.repeat(81) }, { q: 'eye', type: 'secrets' },
      { q: 'eye', recipient: 'not-an-id' }, { q: 'eye', limit: 500 }, { q: 'eye', sort: 'random' }]) {
      const result = await search(params)
      assert.equal(result.status, 400, JSON.stringify(params))
      assert.ok(result.data.error)
    }
  })

  it('cuts long notes into a snippet around the first match', () => {
    const text = `${'Before the visit we talked about many things. '.repeat(4)}Remember the eye drops tonight. ${'After that we went home and had dinner together. '.repeat(4)}`
    const snippet = makeSnippet(text, 'eye drops')
    assert.ok(snippet.length <= 122)
    assert.ok(snippet.startsWith('â€¦') && snippet.endsWith('â€¦'))
    assert.ok(snippet.includes('eye drops'))
    assert.equal(makeSnippet('Short note about eyes', 'eye'), 'Short note about eyes')
  })
})

// Owner: Chaithra (E) Â· API/DB integration tests for My Tasks & Transit
// Real Express routes + JWT login + Mongoose + an isolated MongoDB (never the shared Atlas DB).
// Uses SangYoon's test database helpers; extra trip data comes from transit-fixtures.js.
import { before, beforeEach, after, describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { app } from '../../server/src/app.js'
import { startTestDatabase } from '../../server/test/support/database.js'
import { accounts, password } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'
import { resetTransitFixtures, transitIds as ids, TTSH, NEAR_TTSH } from '../../server/test/support/transit-fixtures.js'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import TransitSession from '../../server/src/features/journeys/Journey.model.js'

let database, server, base, tokens
before(async () => {
  database = await startTestDatabase('transit')
  server = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1')
  await new Promise(resolve => server.once('listening', resolve))
  base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api`

after(async () => {
  if (server) {
    server.closeAllConnections()
    await new Promise(resolve => server.close(resolve))
  }
  await database?.stop()
