async function request(path, { method = 'GET', user = 'alex', body, authenticated = true } = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, {
    method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...(authenticated && tokens?.[user] ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokens[user]}` } : {}),
    }, ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
  })
  return { status: response.status, data: response.status === 204 ? null : await response.json() }
}
beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetTransitFixtures()
  tokens = {}
  for (const [name, email] of Object.entries(accounts)) {
    const login = await request('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', authenticated: false, body: { email, password } })
    assert.equal(login.status, 200)
    tokens[name] = login.data.token
  }
})

const task = `/families/${ids.family}/tasks/${ids.tripTask}`
const transit = `${task}/transit`
const startTrip = () => request(`${task}/start`, { method: 'POST' })
const post = (body, user = 'alex') => request(`${transit}/milestones`, { method: 'POST', user, body })

describe('Transit APIs with Express, authentication and a real isolated MongoDB', () => {
  it('starting a claimed trip task creates a live trip for the claimer', async () => {
    assert.equal((await request(transit)).status, 404) // no trip before starting
    const started = await startTrip()
    assert.equal(started.status, 200)
    assert.equal(started.data.task.status, 'in_progress')
    assert.equal(started.data.transitSession.status, 'active')
    assert.equal(String(started.data.transitSession.companion), ids.alex)

    const fetched = await request(transit, { user: 'jasmine' }) // any family member can follow
    assert.equal(fetched.status, 200)
    assert.equal(fetched.data.transitSession.companion.name, 'Alex Tan')
    assert.equal(fetched.data.transitSession.task.title, 'Physio at TTSH')
  })

  it('saves updates in order with the server\'s time, and fills in preset labels', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    const before = Date.now()
    assert.equal((await post({ type: 'departed' })).status, 201)
    const second = await post({ type: 'custom', label: '  Stuck in traffic  ', at: '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z' })
    assert.equal(second.status, 201)

    const steps = second.data.transitSession.milestones
    assert.deepEqual(steps.map(s => s.label), ['Departed home', 'Stuck in traffic'])
    // The time a person sends is ignored: the server sets it
    assert.ok(new Date(steps[1].at).getTime() >= before)
  })

  it('rejects an unknown step type and an empty custom update', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    const wrongType = await post({ type: 'teleported' })
    assert.equal(wrongType.status, 400)
    assert.match(wrongType.data.errors[0], /Type must be one of/)
    const empty = await post({ type: 'custom', label: '   ' })
    assert.equal(empty.status, 400)
    assert.deepEqual(empty.data.errors, ['Please type what is happening'])
    const tooLong = await post({ type: 'custom', label: 'x'.repeat(81) })
    assert.equal(tooLong.status, 400)
    assert.equal((await TransitSession.findOne({ task: ids.tripTask })).milestones.length, 0)
  })

  it('only the person on the trip can post, end, remove or share location', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'departed' })
    assert.equal((await post({ type: 'arrived' }, 'jasmine')).status, 403)
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/end`, { method: 'POST', user: 'jasmine' })).status, 403)
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', user: 'may', body: TTSH })).status, 403)
    const at = (await TransitSession.findOne({ task: ids.tripTask })).milestones[0].at.toISOString()
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/milestones?at=${encodeURIComponent(at)}`, { method: 'DELETE', user: 'jasmine' })).status, 403)
    assert.equal((await TransitSession.findOne({ task: ids.tripTask })).milestones.length, 1)
  })

  it('people outside the family cannot see or change the trip', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    assert.equal((await request(transit, { user: 'outsider' })).status, 403)
    assert.equal((await post({ type: 'arrived' }, 'outsider')).status, 403)
    assert.equal((await request(transit, { authenticated: false })).status, 401)
  })

  it('removes a wrong update, but never "Safely back home"', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'departed' })
    const wrong = await post({ type: 'custom', label: 'asdfgh' })
    const at = wrong.data.transitSession.milestones[1].at

    const removed = await request(`${transit}/milestones?at=${encodeURIComponent(at)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
    assert.equal(removed.status, 200)
    assert.deepEqual(removed.data.transitSession.milestones.map(s => s.label), ['Departed home'])
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/milestones?at=${encodeURIComponent(at)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })).status, 404)
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/milestones?at=not-a-date`, { method: 'DELETE' })).status, 400)

    const home = await post({ type: 'home' })
    const homeAt = home.data.transitSession.milestones.at(-1).at
    const blocked = await request(`${transit}/milestones?at=${encodeURIComponent(homeAt)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
    assert.equal(blocked.status, 409)
    assert.equal((await TransitSession.findOne({ task: ids.tripTask })).milestones.at(-1).type, 'home')
  })

  it('"Safely back home" completes the task and ends the trip; later updates are refused', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'departed' })
    const home = await post({ type: 'home' })
    assert.equal(home.status, 201)
    assert.equal(home.data.transitSession.status, 'ended')
    assert.equal(home.data.transitSession.milestones.at(-1).label, 'Safely back home')

    const saved = await Task.findById(ids.tripTask)
    assert.equal(saved.status, 'completed')
    assert.ok(saved.completedAt)
    assert.equal((await post({ type: 'arrived' })).status, 409)
  })

  it('"End the trip" keeps the task in progress, and the trip can be resumed', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'departed' })
    const ended = await request(`${transit}/end`, { method: 'POST' })
    assert.equal(ended.status, 200)
    assert.equal(ended.data.transitSession.status, 'ended')
    assert.equal((await Task.findById(ids.tripTask)).status, 'in_progress')
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/end`, { method: 'POST' })).status, 409)

    const resumed = await request(`${transit}/resume`, { method: 'POST' })
    assert.equal(resumed.status, 200)
    assert.equal(resumed.data.transitSession.status, 'active')
    assert.deepEqual(resumed.data.transitSession.milestones.map(s => s.type), ['departed']) // steps kept
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/resume`, { method: 'POST' })).status, 409)
  })

  it('a finished task\'s trip cannot be resumed', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'home' })
    const resumed = await request(`${transit}/resume`, { method: 'POST' })
    assert.equal(resumed.status, 409)
    assert.equal((await TransitSession.findOne({ task: ids.tripTask })).status, 'ended')
  })

  it('live location is saved as the latest spot and added to the trail', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', body: TTSH })).status, 200)
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', body: NEAR_TTSH })).status, 200)

    const followed = await request(transit, { user: 'jasmine' })
    const trip = followed.data.transitSession
    assert.equal(trip.lastLocation.lat, NEAR_TTSH.lat)
    assert.deepEqual(trip.path.map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]), [[TTSH.lat, TTSH.lng], [NEAR_TTSH.lat, NEAR_TTSH.lng]])
  })

  it('rejects impossible coordinates and stops sharing once the trip ends', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    const bad = await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { lat: 200, lng: 'east' } })
    assert.equal(bad.status, 400)
    assert.equal(bad.data.errors.length, 2)
    await request(`${transit}/end`, { method: 'POST' })
    assert.equal((await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', body: TTSH })).status, 409)
  })

  it('starting again clears the old trip\'s steps and trail', async () => {
    await startTrip()
    await post({ type: 'departed' })
    await request(`${transit}/location`, { method: 'PATCH', body: TTSH })
    await Task.updateOne({ _id: ids.tripTask }, { $set: { status: 'claimed' } }) // back to claimed
    const again = await startTrip()
    assert.equal(again.data.transitSession.milestones.length, 0)
    assert.equal(again.data.transitSession.path.length, 0)
    assert.equal(again.data.transitSession.lastLocation, undefined)
  })

  it('lists the family\'s live trips for the Family Home banner', async () => {
    assert.deepEqual((await request(`/families/${ids.family}/transit?status=active`, { user: 'may' })).data.transitSessions, [])
    await startTrip()
    const live = await request(`/families/${ids.family}/transit?status=active`, { user: 'may' })
    assert.equal(live.status, 200)
    assert.equal(live.data.transitSessions.length, 1)
    assert.equal(live.data.transitSessions[0].task.title, 'Physio at TTSH')
    assert.equal(live.data.transitSessions[0].task.recipient.name, 'Grandpa')
    assert.equal((await request(`/families/${ids.family}/transit?status=paused`)).status, 400)
    // Another family's banner never shows this trip
    const other = await request(`/families/${ids.otherFamily}/transit?status=active`)
    assert.deepEqual(other.data.transitSessions, [])
  })

  it('My Tasks: only the claimer\'s tasks come back for claimedBy=me', async () => {
    const mine = await request(`/families/${ids.family}/tasks?claimedBy=${ids.alex}`)
    assert.equal(mine.status, 200)
    const titles = mine.data.tasks.map(t => t.title)
    assert.ok(titles.includes('Physio at TTSH'))
    assert.ok(!titles.includes('Eye check')) // not claimed by anyone
  })

FILE: tests/support/api-harness.mjs

import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { app } from '../../server/src/app.js'
import { startTestDatabase } from '../../server/test/support/database.js'
import { resetFixtures, accounts, password } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'

export async function startApiHarness(label) {
  const database = await startTestDatabase(label)
  let server, tokens = {}
  try {
    server = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1')
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { server.once('listening', resolve); server.once('error', reject) })
    const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api`
    async function request(path, { method = 'GET', user = 'alex', body, authenticated = true } = {}) {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, { method, headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(authenticated && tokens[user] ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokens[user]}` } : {}),
      }, ...(body !== undefined ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}) })
      return { status: response.status, data: response.status === 204 ? null : await response.json() }
    }
    return { request, async reset() {
      await resetFixtures(); tokens = {}
      for (const [user, email] of Object.entries(accounts)) {
        const result = await request('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', authenticated: false, body: { email, password } })
        assert.equal(result.status, 200); tokens[user] = result.data.token
      }
    }, async stop() {
      try { server.closeAllConnections(); await new Promise(resolve => server.close(resolve)) }
      finally { await database.stop() }
    } }
  } catch (error) {
    server?.closeAllConnections(); server?.close()
    await database.stop(); throw error
  }
}

test('recurring fixtures remain in the future at Singapore day/year boundaries', () => {

    const now = new Date(instant), payload = recurringTaskPayload({ now })
    assert.ok(new Date(payload.startAt) > now)

import { mkdir, writeFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { createServer } from '../../client/node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js'
import { app } from '../../server/src/app.js'
import { startTestDatabase } from '../../server/test/support/database.js'
import { resetFixtures } from '../../server/test/support/fixtures.js'
import { installTranslationProvider } from '../../server/test/support/translation-provider.js'

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url))
const runtime = new URL('../../.test-runtime/', import.meta.url)
let database, api, vite, translationProvider
let stopping
async function stop() {
  if (stopping) return stopping
  stopping = (async () => {
    await vite?.close()
    if (api) {
      api.closeAllConnections()
      await new Promise(resolve => api.close(resolve))
    }
    await database?.stop()
    translationProvider?.restore()
    await rm(new URL('e2e.json', runtime), { force: true })
  })()
  return stopping
}
for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) process.on(signal, () => stop().then(() => process.exit(0)))
try {
  database = await startTestDatabase('e2e')
  translationProvider = installTranslationProvider()
  await resetFixtures()
  api = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1')
  await new Promise(resolve => api.once('listening', resolve))
  const apiURL = `http://127.0.0.1:${api.address().port}/api`
  process.env.VITE_API_URL = apiURL
  await mkdir(runtime, { recursive: true })
  await writeFile(new URL('e2e.json', runtime), JSON.stringify({ uri: database.uri, apiURL }))
  vite = await createServer({ root: `${root}client`, configFile: `${root}client/vite.config.js`,
    server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 5180, strictPort: true } })
  await vite.listen()
  console.log('Isolated CareCircle E2E app ready at http://127.0.0.1:5180')
} catch (error) {
  console.error(error)
  await stop()
  process.exit(1)
}

// Stable future dates, independent of the host timezone or time of day.
export function recurringTaskPayload({ count = 8, never = false, now = new Date() } = {}) {
  const day = new Date(+now + 8 * 3600000 + 2 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  return { title: 'Test recurring therapy', category: 'therapy',
    startAt: `${day}T06:30:00.000Z`, endAt: `${day}T07:30:00.000Z`,
    recurrence: { frequency: 'daily', interval: 1, end: never ? { mode: 'never' } : { mode: 'after', count } } }
}

FILE: tests/unit/account-recipient.test.mjs

import test, { after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import User from '../../server/src/features/auth/User.model.js'
import Family from '../../server/src/features/families/Family.model.js'
import CareRecipient from '../../server/src/features/recipients/CareRecipient.model.js'
import { updateProfile } from '../../server/src/features/auth/controller.js'
import { syncAccountRecipientInFamily } from '../../server/src/features/recipients/syncAccountRecipient.js'

const originals = { user: User.findByIdAndUpdate, families: Family.find, upsert: CareRecipient.findOneAndUpdate, update: CareRecipient.updateMany }
after(() => { User.findByIdAndUpdate = originals.user; Family.find = originals.families; CareRecipient.findOneAndUpdate = originals.upsert; CareRecipient.updateMany = originals.update })
let recipients = [], account, nextId, collision
function setup() {
  recipients = []; nextId = 1; collision = false
  account = { _id: 'account-a', name: 'Alex', isCaretaker: false }
  User.findByIdAndUpdate = async (id, update) => { assert.equal(id, account._id); Object.assign(account, update.$set); return account }
  Family.find = filter => { assert.equal(filter['members.userId'], account._id); return { select: async () => [{ _id: 'family-a' }, { _id: 'family-b' }] } }
  CareRecipient.findOneAndUpdate = async (filter, update, options) => {
    let row = recipients.find(r => r.family === filter.family && r.linkedUser === filter.linkedUser)
    if (!row && options.upsert) {
      row = { _id: `recipient-${nextId++}`, ...filter, ...update.$setOnInsert, careNotes: 'Keep my notes' }; recipients.push(row)
      if (collision) { collision = false; throw Object.assign(new Error('duplicate'), { code: 11000 }) }
    }
    if (row) Object.assign(row, update.$set)
    return row
  }
  CareRecipient.updateMany = async (filter, update) => {
    recipients.filter(r => r.family === filter.family && r.linkedUser === filter.linkedUser).forEach(r => Object.assign(r, update.$set))
  }
}
async function save(enabled) {
  let status, body
  const res = { status(value) { status = value; return this }, json(value) { body = value; return this } }
  await updateProfile({ user: { userId: account._id }, body: { name: 'Alex Tan', phone: '', preferredLang: 'en', telegramUsername: '', isCaretaker: enabled } }, res)
  assert.equal(status, 200)
  assert.equal(body.user.isCaretaker, enabled)
}

test('profile checkbox persists and reuses one recipient per family through repeated toggles', async () => {
  setup()
  await save(true)
  const ids = recipients.map(r => r._id)
  const existingTask = { recipient: ids[0], title: 'Please collect my medicine', status: 'open' }
  recipients[0].careType = 'injury'
  recipients.push({ _id: 'unrelated', family: 'family-a', linkedUser: 'someone-else', isActive: true })
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    await save(false)
    assert.ok(recipients.slice(0, 2).every(r => !r.isActive && r.linkedUser === account._id))
    assert.equal(existingTask.recipient, ids[0])
    assert.equal(existingTask.status, 'open')
    await save(true)
    assert.deepEqual(recipients.slice(0, 2).map(r => r._id), ids)
    assert.ok(recipients.slice(0, 2).every(r => r.isActive))
  }
  assert.equal(recipients.length, 3)
  assert.equal(recipients[0].careType, 'injury')
  assert.equal(recipients[0].careNotes, 'Keep my notes')
  assert.equal(recipients[2].isActive, true)
})

test('simultaneous insert collision reuses the winning recipient', async () => {
  setup(); account.isCaretaker = true; collision = true
  await syncAccountRecipientInFamily(account, 'family-a')
  await syncAccountRecipientInFamily(account, 'family-a')
  assert.equal(recipients.length, 1)
  assert.equal(recipients[0].isActive, true)

const clone = value => value == null ? value : structuredClone(value)
const eq = (left, right) => String(left) === String(right)
function matches(record, filter) {
  return Object.entries(filter).every(([key, value]) => {
    const actual = record[key]
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !(value instanceof Date)) {
      if ('$ne' in value) return actual !== value.$ne
      if ('$gt' in value) return new Date(actual) > value.$gt
      if ('$gte' in value || '$lte' in value) return (!value.$gte || new Date(actual) >= value.$gte) && (!value.$lte || new Date(actual) <= value.$lte)
      if ('$regex' in value) return new RegExp(value.$regex, value.$options).test(actual)
    }
    return value === null ? actual == null : eq(actual, value)
  })
}
function query(data) {
  let limit = Infinity
  return {
    select() { return this }, sort() { return this }, limit(value) { limit = value; return this },
    lean() { return Promise.resolve(clone(data.slice(0, limit))) },
    then(resolve, reject) { return Promise.resolve(clone(data.slice(0, limit))).then(resolve, reject) }
  }
}
function draft(overrides = {}) {
  return { intent: 'create', message: 'Ready to review.', suggestions: [], task: {
    title: 'Eye check', recipient: recipientId, startAt: '2026-10-23T10:30:00+08:00', location: { name: 'Eye Centre' }, ...overrides
  } }
}
async function request(path, { user = admin, body = {}, authenticated = true, family = familyId } = {}) {
  const token = jwt.sign({ userId: user, tokenVersion: 0 }, 'assistant-test-secret', { algorithm: 'HS256' })
  const response = await nativeFetch(`${base}/families/${family}/assistant/${path}`, { method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(authenticated ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
  return { status: response.status, data: await response.json() }
}

test('unclaim blocks unrelated admins and rechecks the claimer at confirmation', async t => {
  Object.assign(tasks.get(taskId), { status: 'claimed', claimedBy: member, createdBy: outsider })
  reply = { intent: 'unclaim', taskId, message: 'Review unclaim', suggestions: [] }
  assert.equal((await chat()).status, 403)
  const proposed = await chat({ user: member })
  assert.equal(proposed.status, 200)
  t.mock.method(Task, 'findOneAndUpdate', async (filter, update) => {
    const task = tasks.get(taskId)
    assert.equal(filter.claimedBy, member)
    assert.equal(filter.status, 'claimed')
    assert.equal(+filter.updatedAt, +new Date(task.updatedAt))
    Object.assign(task, update.$set); writes++; return clone(task)
  })
  const saved = await request(`proposals/${proposed.data.proposal.id}/confirm`, { user: member })
  assert.equal(saved.status, 200)
  assert.equal(saved.data.task.status, 'open')
  assert.equal(saved.data.task.claimedBy, null)
  assert.equal(writes, 1)
  Object.assign(tasks.get(taskId), { status: 'claimed', claimedBy: member })
  const next = await chat({ user: member })
  tasks.get(taskId).claimedBy = admin
  assert.equal((await request(`proposals/${next.data.proposal.id}/confirm`, { user: member })).status, 403)
  assert.equal(writes, 1)
})

test('deletion needs two confirmations, enforces manual permissions and supports retry', async t => {

  assert.equal((await chat({ user: member })).status, 403)
  const proposed = await chat()
  const path = `proposals/${proposed.data.proposal.id}/confirm`
  t.mock.method(Task, 'deleteOne', async filter => {
    assert.equal(String(filter.family), familyId)
    assert.equal(+filter.updatedAt, +new Date(tasks.get(taskId).updatedAt))
    tasks.delete(taskId); writes++; return { deletedCount: 1 }
  })
  const first = await request(path)
  assert.equal(first.data.requiresSecondConfirmation, true)
  assert.equal(writes, 0)
  const second = await request(path)
  assert.equal(second.status, 200)
  assert.equal(second.data.deleted, true)
  assert.equal(writes, 1)
  assert.equal((await request(path)).data.deleted, true)
  assert.equal(writes, 1)
})

test('edit questions explain non-ownership and locked status before asking for changes', async () => {

  for (const body of [
    { selectedTaskId: taskId, selectTask: true, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Select task' }] },
    { selectedTaskId: taskId, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Change title' }] },
    { selectedTaskId: taskId, editField: 'title', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Visit Friend' }] },
  ]) {

    assert.match(response.data.message, /cannot edit.*not its creator/)
    assert.equal(response.data.editField, undefined)
    assert.equal(response.data.proposal, undefined)
  }
  await assert.rejects(validateDraft({ intent: 'update', taskId }, { familyId, userId: admin }), error => error.status === 403 && /not its creator/.test(error.message))
  tasks.get(taskId).createdBy = admin
  for (const status of ['completed', 'cancelled']) {
    tasks.get(taskId).status = status
    const response = await request('chat', { body: { selectedTaskId: taskId, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Change title' }] } })
    assert.match(response.data.message, new RegExp(`cannot edit.*${status}`))
    assert.equal(response.data.proposal, undefined)
  }
  assert.equal(providerCalls.length, 0)
  assert.equal(writes, 0)
})

import test, { beforeEach, afterEach } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import jwt from '../../server/node_modules/jsonwebtoken/index.js'
import { getConnectUrl, getStatus, oauthCallback } from '../../server/src/features/calendar-sync/controller.js'

const keys = ['GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID', 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET', 'GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI', 'JWT_SECRET']
let saved
beforeEach(t => {
  saved = Object.fromEntries(keys.map(key => [key, process.env[key]]))
  Object.assign(process.env, { GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: 'test-client', GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: 'test-only-secret',
    GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI: 'http://app.example.test/api/google/callback', JWT_SECRET: 'calendar-test-secret' })
  t.mock.method(console, 'error', () => {})
})
afterEach(() => {
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key]
    else process.env[key] = saved[key]
  }
})
function response() {
  const result = { statusCode: 200 }
  return Object.assign(result, { status(code) { result.statusCode = code; return this },
    json(body) { result.body = body; return this }, redirect(url) { result.location = url; return this } })
}

test('calendar connection URL contains expiring user-bound state and no client secret', () => {
  const res = response()
  getConnectUrl({ user: { userId: 'alex' } }, res)
  const url = new URL(res.body.url)
  assert.equal(url.origin, 'https://accounts.google.com')
  const state = jwt.verify(url.searchParams.get('state'), process.env.JWT_SECRET)
  assert.equal(state.userId, 'alex')
  assert.equal(state.purpose, 'google-calendar')
  assert.equal(state.exp - state.iat, 600)
  assert.ok(!res.body.url.includes(process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET))
})

test('unconfigured calendar status and connect fail safely without a database or provider', async t => {
  delete process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
  const fetch = t.mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { throw new Error('No provider call expected') })
  const status = response(), connect = response()
  await getStatus({ user: { userId: 'alex' } }, status)
  getConnectUrl({ user: { userId: 'alex' } }, connect)
  assert.deepEqual(status.body, { available: false, connected: false })
  assert.equal(connect.statusCode, 503)
  assert.equal(fetch.mock.callCount(), 0)
})

test('unconfigured public callback returns 503 even when the redirect URL is absent', async t => {
  delete process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
  delete process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
  const fetch = t.mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { throw new Error('No provider call expected') })
  const res = response()
  await oauthCallback({ query: {} }, res)
  assert.equal(res.statusCode, 503)
  assert.equal(fetch.mock.callCount(), 0)
})

for (const kind of ['tampered', 'expired', 'wrong-purpose']) {
  test(`calendar callback rejects ${kind} state before exchanging a code`, async t => {
    const fetch = t.mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { throw new Error('No provider call expected') })
    const state = kind === 'tampered' ? 'forged-token' : jwt.sign({ userId: 'alex',
      purpose: kind === 'wrong-purpose' ? 'login' : 'google-calendar' }, process.env.JWT_SECRET,
    { expiresIn: kind === 'expired' ? -1 : 600 })
    const res = response()
    await oauthCallback({ query: { state, code: 'unused-test-code' } }, res)
    assert.equal(new URL(res.location).searchParams.get('calendar'), 'error')
    assert.equal(fetch.mock.callCount(), 0)
  })
}

test('cancelled calendar consent does not exchange codes or write a link', async t => {
  const fetch = t.mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { throw new Error('No provider call expected') })

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { analyzeContributions, contributionPoints } from '../../client/src/features/contributions/analytics.js'

const members = ['a', 'b', 'c'].map(id => ({ user: { _id: id, name: id } }))
const task = (changes = {}) => ({ family: 'family-a', status: 'completed', claimedBy: { _id: 'a', name: 'a' }, completedAt: '2026-10-27T01:00:00Z', ...changes })
const now = new Date('2026-10-27T08:00:00Z')

test('isolates families and counts only recorded completions; includes zero contributors', () => {
  const stats = analyzeContributions([task(), task({ family: 'family-b' }), task({ status: 'claimed' }), task({ completedAt: null }), task({ completedAt: '2026-10-28T01:00:00Z' })], members, 'family-a', 'month', now)
  assert.equal(stats.total, 1)
  assert.deepEqual(stats.rows.map(r => r.count), [1, 0, 0])
  assert.equal(stats.rows[0].share, 100)
})
test('awards bonuses only for valid claim times and appointments with transit', () => {
  const fields = { category: 'appointment', needsTransit: true, createdAt: '2026-10-26T00:00:00Z', claimedAt: '2026-10-26T01:00:00Z' }
  assert.equal(contributionPoints(fields), 3)
  assert.equal(contributionPoints({ ...fields, claimedAt: '2026-10-25T23:00:00Z' }), 2)
  assert.equal(contributionPoints({}), 1)
})
test('uses Singapore month and Monday week boundaries', () => {
  const tasks = [task({ completedAt: '2026-09-30T16:00:00Z' }), task({ completedAt: '2026-10-25T16:00:00Z' }), task({ completedAt: '2026-10-25T15:59:59Z' })]
  assert.equal(analyzeContributions(tasks, members, 'family-a', 'month', now).total, 3)
  assert.equal(analyzeContributions(tasks, members, 'family-a', 'week', now).total, 1)
})
test('streaks count distinct days through yesterday and ties receive consecutive ranks', () => {
  const tasks = [task({ completedAt: '2026-10-26T01:00:00Z' }), task({ completedAt: '2026-10-26T02:00:00Z' }), task({ completedAt: '2026-10-25T01:00:00Z' }), ...Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => task({ claimedBy: { _id: 'b', name: 'b' } }))]
  const stats = analyzeContributions(tasks, members, 'family-a', 'all', now)
  assert.equal(stats.rows[0].streak, 2)
  assert.equal(stats.rows[0].rank, 1)
  assert.equal(stats.rows[1].rank, 2)
  assert.equal(stats.rows[2].rank, null)
  assert.equal(analyzeContributions(tasks, members, 'family-a', 'all', new Date('2026-10-29T08:00:00Z')).rows[0].streak, 0)
})

// HTTP tests use an in-memory model double; no shared MongoDB data is touched.
import test, { beforeEach, afterEach } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import express from '../../server/node_modules/express/index.js'
import jwt from '../../server/node_modules/jsonwebtoken/index.js'
import Family from '../../server/src/features/families/Family.model.js'
import User from '../../server/src/features/auth/User.model.js'
import familyRoutes from '../../server/src/features/families/routes.js'

const familyId = '000000000000000000000001'
const alex = '000000000000000000000101',
  jasmine = '000000000000000000000102',
  may = '000000000000000000000103',
  outsider = '000000000000000000000104'
const users = Object.fromEntries(
  [
    [alex, 'Alex'],
    [jasmine, 'Jasmine'],
    [may, 'May'],
    [outsider, 'Outsider'],
  ].map(([id, name]) => [
    id,
    {
      _id: id,
      name,
      email: `${name.toLowerCase()}@carecircle.test`,
      preferredLang: 'en',
      tokenVersion: 0,
      passwordHash: 'never-return-this',
    },
  ]),
)
let state, server, base, secretBefore, writeCount
const token = (id) =>
  jwt.sign({ userId: id, tokenVersion: 0 }, 'carecircle-test-only-secret', {
    algorithm: 'HS256',
  })
function memberMatches(member, criteria) {
  return Object.entries(criteria).every(([key, value]) =>
    key === 'userId'
      ? member.userId === String(value)
      : typeof value === 'object'
        ? member[key] !== value.$ne
        : member[key] === value,
  )
}
function matches(filter) {
  if (filter._id && String(filter._id) !== state._id) return false
  if (filter.$and) return filter.$and.every(matches)
  if (filter.$or) return filter.$or.some(matches)
  if (filter.$expr)
    return (
      state.members.filter((member) => member.role === 'admin').length >
      filter.$expr.$gt[1]
    )
  if (filter.members?.$elemMatch)
    return state.members.some((member) =>
      memberMatches(member, filter.members.$elemMatch),
    )
  return true
}
function document(value) {
  if (!value) return null
  const copy = structuredClone(value)
  copy.populate = async function () {
    this.members = this.members.map((member) => ({
      ...member,
      userId: users[member.userId] || null,
    }))
    return this
  }
  return copy
}
function query(execute) {
  let pending
  const once = () => (pending ||= Promise.resolve().then(execute))
  return {
    then: (resolve, reject) => once().then(resolve, reject),
    populate: async () => {
      const doc = await once()
      return doc ? doc.populate() : null
    },
  }
}
async function request(
  path,
  { method = 'GET', userId = alex, body, authenticated = true } = {},
) {
  const response = await fetch(`${base}/families/${familyId}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      ...(authenticated ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token(userId)}` } : {}),
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
  })
  return {
    status: response.status,
    data: response.status === 204 ? null : await response.json(),
  }
}

beforeEach(async (t) => {
  secretBefore = process.env.JWT_SECRET
  process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'carecircle-test-only-secret'
  state = {
    _id: familyId,
    inviteCode: 'AABBCCDDEE',
    members: [
      { userId: alex, role: 'admin' },
      { userId: jasmine, role: 'admin' },
      { userId: may, role: 'member' },
    ],
  }
  writeCount = 0
  t.mock.method(User, 'findById', async (id) => users[id] || null)
  t.mock.method(Family, 'findById', async (id) =>
    String(id) === familyId ? document(state) : null,
  )
  t.mock.method(Family, 'findOneAndUpdate', (filter, update, options) =>
    query(() => {
      writeCount++
      if (!matches(filter)) return null
      if (update.$set?.['members.$[target].role']) {
        const id = String(options.arrayFilters[0]['target.userId'])
        state.members.find((member) => member.userId === id).role =
          update.$set['members.$[target].role']
      }
      if (update.$pull)
        state.members = state.members.filter(
          (member) => member.userId !== update.$pull.members.userId,
        )
      if (update.$set?.inviteCode) state.inviteCode = update.$set.inviteCode
      return document(state)
    }),
  )
  const app = express()
  app.use(express.json())
  app.use('/families', familyRoutes)
  app.use((err, req, res, next) => res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }))
  server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const running = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve(running))
  })
  base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`
})
afterEach(async () => {
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve))
  if (secretBefore === undefined) delete process.env.JWT_SECRET
  else process.env.JWT_SECRET = secretBefore
})

test('member listing requires authentication and family membership', async () => {
  assert.equal(
    (await request('/members', { authenticated: false })).status,
    401,
  )
  assert.equal((await request('/members', { userId: outsider })).status, 403)
  const result = await request('/members', { userId: may })
  assert.equal(result.status, 200)
  assert.equal(result.data.members.length, 3)
  assert.equal(result.data.members[0].user.name, 'Alex')
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(result.data).includes('passwordHash'))
})

        method: 'PATCH',
        userId: may,

    403,
  )
  assert.equal(

  )

  assert.equal(

    404,

  assert.equal(writeCount, 0)
})
test('admins can change roles; the last admin cannot be demoted or removed', async () => {
  const demotion = await request(`/members/${jasmine}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: { role: 'member' },
  })
  assert.equal(demotion.status, 200)
  assert.equal(demotion.data.member.role, 'member')
  assert.equal(
    (
      await request(`/members/${alex}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: { role: 'member' },
      })
    ).status,
    409,
  )
  assert.equal(
    (await request(`/members/${alex}`, { method: 'DELETE' })).status,
    409,
  )

    'admin',
  )
})
test('concurrent self-demotions preserve at least one admin', async () => {
  const results = await Promise.all([
    request(`/members/${alex}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      userId: alex,
      body: { role: 'member' },
    }),
    request(`/members/${jasmine}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      userId: jasmine,
      body: { role: 'member' },
    }),
  ])
  assert.deepEqual(results.map((result) => result.status).sort(), [200, 409])
  assert.equal(
    state.members.filter((member) => member.role === 'admin').length,
    1,
  )
})
test('members can leave themselves but cannot remove someone else', async () => {
  assert.equal(
    (await request(`/members/${jasmine}`, { method: 'DELETE', userId: may }))
      .status,
    403,
  )

    204,

})
test('invite regeneration uses the 10-character format supported by Join Family', async () => {
  const oldCode = state.inviteCode
  const result = await request('/invite-code', { method: 'POST' })
  assert.equal(result.status, 200)
  assert.match(result.data.inviteCode, /^[A-F0-9]{10}$/)
  assert.notEqual(result.data.inviteCode, oldCode)
  assert.equal(result.data.inviteCode, state.inviteCode)
})

test('invite regeneration retries unique-code collisions', async (t) => {
  let attempts = 0
  t.mock.method(Family, 'findOneAndUpdate', (_filter, update) =>
    query(() => {
      attempts++
      if (attempts === 1)
        throw Object.assign(new Error('Duplicate invitation'), {
          code: 11000,
          keyPattern: { inviteCode: 1 },
        })
      state.inviteCode = update.$set.inviteCode
      return document(state)
    }),
  )
  const result = await request('/invite-code', { method: 'POST' })
  assert.equal(result.status, 200)
  assert.equal(attempts, 2)
  assert.match(result.data.inviteCode, /^[A-F0-9]{10}$/)
})

test('language changes keep the existing roster visible and patch only the saved user', async t => {
  seed()
  const current = { id: 'alex', name: 'Alex', preferredLang: 'en' }
  let memberReads = 0
  t.mock.method(http, 'get', async path => {
    if (path === '/auth/me') return { data: { user: current } }
    assert.equal(path, '/families/one/members')
    memberReads++
    return { data: { members: [
      { user: { _id: 'alex', name: 'Alex', preferredLang: 'en' }, role: 'admin' },
      { user: { _id: 'jasmine', name: 'Jasmine', preferredLang: 'en' }, role: 'member' },
    ] } }
  })
  const waiting = deferred()
  t.mock.method(http, 'patch', () => waiting.promise)
  mounted = harness.mountWorkspace(false, true)
  await settled()
  const roster = mounted.settings.members.value
  const save = mounted.settings.run(() => mounted.settings.changeLanguage('zh'))
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.language.value, 'zh')
  await settled()
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.language.value, 'zh')
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.loading.value, false)
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.members.value, roster)
  assert.equal(roster.length, 2)
  waiting.resolve({ data: { user: { ...current, preferredLang: 'zh' } } })
  assert.equal(await save, true)
  assert.equal(memberReads, 1)
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.members.value, roster)
  assert.equal(roster[0].user.preferredLang, 'zh')
  assert.equal(roster[1].user.preferredLang, 'en')
  assert.equal(mounted.settings.language.value, 'zh')
})

  seed()
  t.mock.method(http, 'get', async path => ({ data: path === '/auth/me'
    ? { user: { id: 'alex', name: 'Alex', preferredLang: 'en' } }
    : { members: [{ user: { _id: 'alex', name: 'Alex' }, role: 'admin' }] } }))

test('one appearance choice reaches the document, other consumers and system mode', () => {
  mounted = harness.mountAppearance()
  const other = harness.mountAppearance(false)
  try {
    other.state.setAppearance('dark')
    assert.equal(document.documentElement.dataset.theme, 'dark')
    assert.equal(document.documentElement.dataset.bsTheme, 'dark')
    assert.equal(storage.get('carecircle:appearance'), 'dark')

    assert.equal(document.documentElement.dataset.theme, 'light')
    for (const listener of mediaListeners) listener({ matches: true })
    assert.equal(document.documentElement.dataset.theme, 'dark')
    mounted.state.setAppearance('light')
    assert.equal(document.documentElement.dataset.theme, 'light')
  } finally { other.unmount() }
})

// Owner: SeungHak (F). Telegram wording and links for care log events; no database needed.
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { buildMessage, deepLink, effectiveEvents, parseNotifyOn } from '../../server/src/utils/notify.js'
import { EVENTS } from '../../server/src/constants.js'

const grandpa = { _id: '000000000000000000000201', name: 'Tan Ah Kow', nickname: 'Grandpa' }
const note = {
  type: 'consultation',
  content: 'Doctor raised the blood pressure dose.',
  recipient: grandpa,
  author: { name: 'Alex Tan' },
}

test('care log messages say who and which kind of note, never the note itself', () => {
  assert.equal(buildMessage(EVENTS.LOG_CREATED, note).text, 'New consultation note for Grandpa.')
  assert.equal(buildMessage(EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED, note).text, 'Alex edited a consultation note for Grandpa.')
  assert.equal(
    buildMessage(EVENTS.LOG_DELETED, { ...note, type: 'symptom', changedBy: { name: 'Aunt May Lim' } }).text,
    'Aunt May deleted a care note for Grandpa.',
  )
  for (const event of [EVENTS.LOG_CREATED, EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED, EVENTS.LOG_DELETED]) {
    const message = buildMessage(event, note)
    assert.ok(!message.text.includes('blood pressure'))
    assert.deepEqual([message.refType, message.refId], ['careRecipient', grandpa._id])
  }
})

test('care log events link to the recipient\'s Log page', (t) => {
  process.env.APP_URL = 'https://app.example.test/'
  t.after(() => delete process.env.APP_URL)
  for (const eventType of [EVENTS.LOG_CREATED, EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED, EVENTS.LOG_DELETED]) {
    assert.equal(
      deepLink({ eventType, refType: 'careRecipient', refId: grandpa._id, familyId: 'f1' }),
      `https://app.example.test/recipients/${grandpa._id}/log`,
    )
  }
})

test('the new events are on by default and can be switched off', () => {
  assert.ok(effectiveEvents([]).includes(EVENTS.LOG_UPDATED))
  assert.ok(effectiveEvents([]).includes(EVENTS.LOG_DELETED))
  assert.deepEqual(parseNotifyOn(['log.updated']).value, ['log.updated'])
})

FILE: tests/unit/public-profile.test.mjs

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import User from '../../server/src/features/auth/User.model.js'
import Family from '../../server/src/features/families/Family.model.js'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import { getPublicProfile } from '../../server/src/features/auth/public-profile.controller.js'

test('public profiles require a shared family and omit private account fields', async (t) => {
  const viewer = '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011'
  const target = '507f1f77bcf86cd799439012'
  let shared = true, queried = false
  t.mock.method(Family, 'find', (query) => {
    assert.equal(query['members.userId'].$all[0], viewer)
    return { select: () => ({ lean: async () => shared ? [{ _id: 'shared-family' }] : [] }) }
  })
  t.mock.method(Task, 'find', (query) => {
    assert.deepEqual(query.family.$in, shared ? ['shared-family'] : [])
    assert.ok([target, viewer].includes(query.claimedBy))
    assert.deepEqual(query.status.$in, ['claimed', 'in_progress', 'completed'])
    return { select: (fields) => {
      assert.equal(fields, 'title status startAt completedAt')
      return { sort: () => ({ limit: (limit) => {
        assert.equal(limit, 3)
        return { lean: async () => [{ title: 'Help with lunch', status: 'completed' }] }
      } }) }
    } }
  })
  t.mock.method(User, 'findById', () => {
    queried = true
    return { select: () => ({ lean: async () => ({
      _id: target, name: 'Grandma', email: 'private@example.com', phone: '123',
      passwordHash: 'secret', tokenVersion: 5, telegramUsername: 'private',
    }) }) }
  })
  const invoke = async (userId) => {
    const res = { statusCode: 200, status(code) { this.statusCode = code; return this }, json(body) { this.body = body; return this } }
    await getPublicProfile({ params: { userId }, user: { userId: viewer } }, res, (error) => { throw error })
    return res
  }
  const allowed = await invoke(target)
  assert.equal(allowed.statusCode, 200)
  assert.equal(allowed.body.user.name, 'Grandma')
  assert.equal(allowed.body.user.tasks[0].title, 'Help with lunch')
  for (const key of ['email', 'phone', 'passwordHash', 'tokenVersion', 'telegramUsername']) assert.equal(key in allowed.body.user, false)
  shared = false; queried = false
  assert.equal((await invoke(target)).statusCode, 404)
  assert.equal(queried, false)
  assert.equal((await invoke('invalid')).statusCode, 404)
  assert.equal(queried, false)
  assert.equal((await invoke(viewer)).statusCode, 200)
})

FILE: tests/unit/recurrence.test.mjs
================================================
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { parseRecurrence, recurrenceDates, generationHorizon, sgDay, nextWeeklyDate } from '../../shared/recurrence.js'

function dates(start, input, end = null, horizon = generationHorizon(start)) {
  return recurrenceDates(parseRecurrence(input, start), start, end, horizon)
}
test('weekly selection chooses the next actual weekday without choosing Today/Tomorrow', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-10-28T02:00:00Z') // Wednesday 10am Singapore
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-10-28', '14:30', [0], now), '2026-11-02')
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-10-28', '14:30', [2], now), '2026-10-28')
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-10-28', '09:00', [2], now), '2026-11-04')
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-10-28', '09:00', [2, 4], now), '2026-10-30')
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-11-10', '14:30', [0], now), '2026-11-16')
})
test('weekly selection respects Singapore midnight and year boundaries', () => {
  assert.equal(nextWeeklyDate('2026-12-31', '09:00', [4], new Date('2026-12-31T16:00:00Z')), '2027-01-01')
})
test('Tuesday/Friday recurrence includes the last date and preserves Singapore time/duration', () => {
  const result = dates('2026-11-03T06:30:00Z', { frequency: 'weekly', weekdays: [1, 4], end: { mode: 'on', until: '2026-12-18' } }, '2026-11-03T07:30:00Z')
  assert.equal(result.length, 14)
  assert.equal(sgDay(result.at(-1).startAt), '2026-12-18')
  assert.ok(result.every((d, i) => d.index === i && d.startAt.getUTCHours() === 6 && d.endAt - d.startAt === 3600000))
})
test('biweekly schedules use Monday-based weeks across year boundaries', () => {
  const result = dates('2026-12-29T06:00:00Z', { frequency: 'weekly', interval: 2, weekdays: [1, 4], end: { mode: 'after', count: 4 } })
  assert.deepEqual(result.map(d => sgDay(d.startAt)), ['2026-12-29', '2027-01-01', '2027-01-12', '2027-01-15'])
})
test('monthly schedules skip nonexistent dates and handle leap years', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(dates('2027-01-31T06:00:00Z', { frequency: 'monthly', end: { mode: 'after', count: 3 } }).map(d => sgDay(d.startAt)), ['2027-01-31', '2027-03-31', '2027-05-31'])
  assert.equal(sgDay(dates('2028-01-29T06:00:00Z', { frequency: 'monthly', end: { mode: 'after', count: 2 } })[1].startAt), '2028-02-29')
})
test('rolling windows extend with stable occurrence indexes at Singapore midnight', () => {
  const start = '2026-11-01T16:15:00Z', rule = { frequency: 'daily' }
  const first = dates(start, rule, null, generationHorizon(start, new Date(start)))
  const next = dates(start, rule, null, generationHorizon(start, new Date('2026-11-08T16:15:00Z')))
  assert.equal(first.length, 29)
  assert.equal(next.length, 36)
  assert.deepEqual(next.slice(0, first.length), first)
  assert.equal(sgDay(first[0].startAt), '2026-11-02')
})
test('invalid input and oversized finite series are rejected', () => {
  const start = '2026-11-03T06:00:00Z'
  for (const input of [{ frequency: 'weekly', weekdays: [] }, { frequency: 'daily', interval: 0 }, { frequency: 'daily', end: { mode: 'after', count: 501 } }, { frequency: 'daily', end: { mode: 'on', until: '2026-02-30' } }]) assert.throws(() => dates(start, input), { status: 400 })
  assert.throws(() => dates(start, { frequency: 'daily', end: { mode: 'on', until: '2028-11-03' } }), /at most 500/)
  assert.equal(dates(start, { frequency: 'daily', end: { mode: 'after', count: 500 } }).length, 500)
  assert.equal(parseRecurrence({ frequency: 'none' }, start), null)
})

// Service tests use a serializable in-memory transaction double; actual MongoDB
// write-conflict/retry behavior still requires a replica-set integration run.
import test, { beforeEach } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import mongoose from '../../server/node_modules/mongoose/index.js'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import Series from '../../server/src/features/tasks/RecurringSeries.model.js'
import Family from '../../server/src/features/families/Family.model.js'
import { createRecurringTasks, changeRecurringClaim, ensureRecurringTasks, updateRecurringTasks, deleteRecurringOccurrence, setSeriesPaused } from '../../server/src/features/tasks/recurringService.js'

const family = '000000000000000000000001', creator = '000000000000000000000002', helper = '000000000000000000000003', backup = '000000000000000000000004'
let tasks, series, counter, members
const copy = value => value == null ? value : value instanceof Date ? new Date(value) : Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(copy) : value?._bsontype === 'ObjectId' ? String(value) : typeof value === 'object' ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).filter(([, v]) => typeof v !== 'function').map(([k, v]) => [k, copy(v)])) : value
function matches(doc, filter) {
  return Object.entries(filter).every(([key, expected]) => {
    const actual = doc[key]
    if (expected && typeof expected === 'object' && !(expected instanceof Date)) return Object.entries(expected).every(([op, val]) => op === '$in' ? val.map(String).includes(String(actual)) : op === '$nin' ? !val.map(String).includes(String(actual)) : op === '$gt' ? actual > val : op === '$gte' ? actual >= val : false)
    return actual instanceof Date || expected instanceof Date ? +new Date(actual) === +new Date(expected) : String(actual) === String(expected)
  })
}
function query(read) {
  let sorting, max = Infinity
  const q = { session() { return q }, select() { return q }, populate() { return q }, lean() { return q }, sort(value) { sorting = value; return q }, limit(value) { max = value; return q }, then(resolve, reject) {
    return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      let result = read()
      if (Array.isArray(result)) {
        if (sorting) { const [key, order] = Object.entries(sorting)[0]; result.sort((a, b) => (a[key] > b[key] ? 1 : -1) * order) }
        result = result.slice(0, max)
      }
      return result
    }).then(resolve, reject)
  } }
  return q
}
function taskDoc(raw) { return raw ? Object.assign(copy(raw), { toObject() { return copy(this) } }) : null }
function seriesDoc(raw) { return raw ? Object.assign(copy(raw), { async save() { series.set(String(this._id), copy(this)); return this } }) : null }
function update(doc, change) { Object.assign(doc, copy(change.$set || {})); for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(change.$inc || {})) doc[k] += v; doc.updatedAt = new Date(+doc.updatedAt + 1) }
beforeEach(t => {
  t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: new Date('2026-11-01T00:00:00Z') })
  tasks = new Map(); series = new Map(); counter = 100; members = new Set([creator, helper, backup])
  let queue = Promise.resolve()
  t.mock.method(mongoose, 'startSession', async () => ({ endSession: async () => {}, withTransaction(work) {
    const run = queue.then(async () => { const beforeTasks = copy([...tasks]), beforeSeries = copy([...series]); try { return await work() } catch (err) { tasks = new Map(beforeTasks); series = new Map(beforeSeries); throw err } })
    queue = run.catch(() => {}); return run
  } }))
  t.mock.method(Family, 'exists', filter => query(() => members.has(String(filter['members.userId'])) ? { _id: family } : null))
  t.mock.method(Family, 'findOne', filter => query(() => members.has(String(filter['members.userId'])) ? { _id: family } : null))
  t.mock.method(Series, 'create', async ([data]) => {
    const doc = copy(new Series(data).toObject()); series.set(doc._id, doc); return [seriesDoc(doc)]
  })
  t.mock.method(Series, 'find', filter => query(() => [...series.values()].filter(d => matches(d, filter)).map(seriesDoc)))
  t.mock.method(Series, 'findOneAndUpdate', (filter, changes) => query(() => { const found = [...series.values()].find(d => matches(d, filter)); if (!found) return null; update(found, changes); return seriesDoc(found) }))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'find', filter => query(() => [...tasks.values()].filter(d => matches(d, filter)).map(taskDoc)))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'findOne', filter => query(() => taskDoc([...tasks.values()].find(d => matches(d, filter)))))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'findById', id => query(() => taskDoc(tasks.get(String(id)))))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'getPopulatedTaskById', async id => taskDoc(tasks.get(String(id))))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'insertMany', async documents => {
    for (const data of documents) {
      const model = new Task({ ...data, _id: (++counter).toString(16).padStart(24, '0') }); await model.validate()
      const doc = copy(model.toObject()); doc.updatedAt = new Date(); tasks.set(doc._id, doc)
    }
  })
  for (const method of ['updateOne', 'updateMany']) t.mock.method(Task, method, async (filter, changes) => {
    let count = 0
    for (const doc of tasks.values()) if (matches(doc, filter)) { update(doc, changes); count++; if (method === 'updateOne') break }
    return { modifiedCount: count }
  })
  t.mock.method(Task, 'deleteOne', async filter => { const doc = [...tasks.values()].find(d => matches(d, filter)); if (doc) tasks.delete(doc._id); return { deletedCount: doc ? 1 : 0 } })
})
const all = () => [...tasks.values()].sort((a, b) => a.occurrenceIndex - b.occurrenceIndex)
const claim = (task, userId = helper, scope = 'series') => changeRecurringClaim('claim', { taskId: task._id, familyId: family, userId, scope })
async function create(never = false) { return createRecurringTasks({ title: 'Physiotherapy', category: 'therapy', startAt: new Date('2026-11-03T06:30:00Z'), endAt: new Date('2026-11-03T07:30:00Z') }, { frequency: 'daily', end: never ? { mode: 'never' } : { mode: 'after', count: 8 } }, family, creator) }

test('series claim, one-date release, and replacement never transfer the rest of the series', async () => {
  const first = await create(); await claim(first)
  assert.ok(all().every(t => t.status === 'claimed' && t.claimedBy === helper))
  const released = all()[2]
  await changeRecurringClaim('unclaim', { taskId: released._id, familyId: family, userId: helper })
  assert.equal(tasks.get(released._id).recurrenceDetached, true)
  await claim(released, backup, 'series')
  assert.equal(tasks.get(released._id).claimedBy, backup)
  assert.ok(all().filter(t => t._id !== released._id).every(t => t.claimedBy === helper))
})
test('simultaneous whole-series claims have one winner and no split assignment', async () => {
  const first = await create()
  const results = await Promise.allSettled([claim(first), claim(first, backup)])
  assert.equal(results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length, 1)
  assert.equal(results.find(r => r.status === 'rejected').reason.status, 409)
  assert.equal(new Set(all().map(t => t.claimedBy)).size, 1)
})
test('next four and just this date remain independent of the usual helper', async () => {
  const first = await create(); await claim(first, helper, 'next4')
  assert.equal(all().filter(t => t.claimedBy === helper && t.recurrenceDetached).length, 4)
  await claim(all()[4], backup)
  assert.equal(all().filter(t => t.claimedBy === backup).length, 4)
})
test('Never extends the rolling window without duplicates, retaining the usual helper', async t => {
  const first = await create(true); await claim(first)
  const original = all().length
  t.mock.timers.tick(14 * 86400000)
  await ensureRecurringTasks(family)
  assert.ok(all().length > original)

function memoryStorage() {
  const values = new Map()
  return {
    getItem: (key) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key, value) => values.set(key, String(value)),
    removeItem: (key) => values.delete(key),
    clear: () => values.clear(),
  }
}

import test, { beforeEach } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import Task from '../../server/src/features/tasks/TaskModel.js'
import Family from '../../server/src/features/families/Family.model.js'
import { claimTask, unclaimTask, startTask } from '../../server/src/features/tasks/controller.js'

const familyId = '000000000000000000000001', taskId = '000000000000000000000002'
const creator = '000000000000000000000003', member = '000000000000000000000004'
let stored, transit
beforeEach(t => {
  t.mock.method(Family, 'findById', () => ({ select: () => ({ lean: async () => null }) }))
  stored = { _id: taskId, family: familyId, createdBy: creator, claimedBy: null, status: 'open', needsTransit: true, startAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000) }
  transit = []
  t.mock.method(Task, 'getTaskInFamily', async (family, id) => family === stored.family && id === stored._id ? { ...stored } : null)
  t.mock.method(Task, 'getTaskById', async () => ({ ...stored }))
  t.mock.method(Task, 'getPopulatedTaskById', async () => ({ ...stored, claimedBy: stored.claimedBy ? { _id: stored.claimedBy, name: 'Helper' } : null }))
  // Exercise the actual updateTaskStatus static, including its compare-and-set filter.
  t.mock.method(Task, 'findOneAndUpdate', async (filter, update) => {
    if (!Object.entries(filter).every(([key, value]) => value?.$gt ? new Date(stored[key]) > value.$gt : stored[key] === value)) return null
    Object.assign(stored, update.$set)
    return { ...stored }
  })
  t.mock.method(Task, 'startTransitSession', async task => {
    const session = { _id: 'trip', task: task._id, family: task.family, companion: task.claimedBy, status: 'active' }
    transit.push(session)
    return session
  })
})
async function invoke(handler, userId = member, family = familyId) {
  let status = 200, data
  const res = { status(value) { status = value; return this }, json(value) { data = value; return this } }
  await handler({ family: { _id: family }, params: { taskId }, user: { userId }, memberRole: 'member' }, res, error => { throw error })
  return { status, data }
}
test('member claims a real task then starts transit as its companion', async () => {
  const claimed = await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal(claimed.status, 200)
  assert.equal(claimed.data.task.claimedBy._id, member)
  assert.ok(stored.claimedAt instanceof Date)
  const started = await invoke(startTask)
  assert.equal(started.status, 200)
  assert.equal(stored.status, 'in_progress')
  assert.equal(started.data.transitSession.companion, member)
  assert.equal(transit.length, 1)
})
test('simultaneous claims have exactly one winner', async () => {
  const results = await Promise.all([invoke(claimTask, member), invoke(claimTask, creator)])
  assert.deepEqual(results.map(r => r.status).sort(), [200, 409])
  const winner = results.find(r => r.status === 200).data.task.claimedBy._id
  assert.equal(stored.claimedBy, winner)
})
test('another family cannot claim a task and only the claimer can start its trip', async () => {
  assert.equal((await invoke(claimTask, member, '000000000000000000000099')).status, 404)
  await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal((await invoke(startTask, creator)).status, 403)
  assert.equal(transit.length, 0)
})

test('overdue tasks reject claims without changing the assignment', async () => {
  stored.startAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1)
  const result = await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal(result.status, 409)
  assert.match(result.data.error, /overdue/)
  assert.equal(stored.status, 'open')
  assert.equal(stored.claimedBy, null)
})

test('claim checks the deadline atomically if it expires after the initial read', async t => {
  const originalRead = Task.getTaskInFamily
  t.mock.method(Task, 'getTaskInFamily', async (...args) => {
    const snapshot = await originalRead(...args)
    stored.startAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1000)
    return snapshot
  })
  const result = await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal(result.status, 409)
  assert.match(result.data.error, /overdue/)
  assert.equal(stored.claimedBy, null)
})

test('claimer can unclaim and another member can then claim, but strangers cannot unclaim', async () => {
  await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal((await invoke(unclaimTask, '000000000000000000000099')).status, 403)
  assert.equal((await invoke(unclaimTask)).status, 200)
  assert.equal(stored.claimedBy, null)
  assert.equal(stored.claimedAt, null)
  assert.equal((await invoke(claimTask, creator)).status, 200)
  assert.equal(stored.claimedBy, creator)
  assert.equal((await invoke(claimTask, member)).status, 409)
})

test('unclaim remains available after the deadline, but nobody can reclaim the expired task', async () => {
  await invoke(claimTask)
  stored.startAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1000)
  assert.equal((await invoke(unclaimTask)).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await invoke(claimTask, creator)).status, 409)
})

test('task creator can release a claim, and in-progress tasks cannot be unclaimed', async () => {
  await invoke(claimTask)
  assert.equal((await invoke(unclaimTask, creator)).status, 200)
  await invoke(claimTask)
  await invoke(startTask)
  assert.equal((await invoke(unclaimTask)).status, 409)
})
